item.title: ReFi Retrospective: The CCA Unconference
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Agnew
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="whats-a-refi-unconference">What's a ReFi Unconference?</h3><p><a href="https://www.crypto-commons.org/">Crypto Commons Association</a> (CCA) is a non-profit organisation founded in 2021 to connect and foster projects at the intersection of blockchain and the commons. Their goal has been to bring the power of distributed ledger technologies (DLTs) to public goods and local sustainable economies, as well as to climate action and social justice struggles. Digital commons goods are public goods in the form of software, data sets, AI models, standards or content that are generally free cultural works and contribute to sustainable national and international digital development. The CCA are focused on ‘crypto commons’ - specifically ​​freely accessible web3 protocols that are beneficial to the common good by making planetary resource limits visible. These act as coordination mechanisms for decision-making in horizontally organised groups; as well as market mechanisms which, in addition to internalising external costs, generate funds for the regeneration of natural commons. <br></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/Au0Ibpm_vHgUC-acLEX1s0RZ6SZapCXAtpvyjKoBWWQwX-snFt54rZuJgA-7uKMaQyW_cQzTx07Kr4DaS6DNzyhQ_GCmzNgr2jt2dfpYR35agONAdNWWRtthDDfYy1TVn3xeYfN-Cen8EM1Slw" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure><p><em>[<a href="https://twitter.com/CCommonsHub/status/1521878706783928321">CCA co-founders happier together</a>. From left: <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna">Anna</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/HumbertoBesso">Humberto</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/felixfritsch2">Felix Fritsch</a>, <a href="http://@leobasso9">Leo Basso</a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_">Giulio Quarta</a>]</em></p><p>CCA have a physical space in the Austrian Alps, called the ‘<a href="https://www.crypto-commons.org/crypto-commons-hub">Crypto Commons Hub</a>’, where they host thematic events, team retreats, artistic initiatives, and parties. It is a placemaking experiment to explore what a Regen life could be in a practical sense; living with communal spirit and deploying low tech infrastructures for the self sustainability of the Hub. </p><p>The most recent event was the ReFi Unconference, from the 30th of April to the 6th of May, where <strong>60 Regens</strong> - representing <strong>25 projects</strong> and all kinds of disciplines from computer science to arts - shared experiences, tools, strategies, feelings and warm vibes throughout the Hub, and some of the best convos happened in the hot tub! The conference was made possible due to the generosity of their principal sponsor, <a href="https://www.regen.network/">Regen Network</a> and to the other event sponsors: <a href="https://refidao.com/">ReFi DAO</a>, <a href="https://www.noe.gv.at/noe/Topics-in-English/Provincial_Government_of_Lower_Austria.html">Lower Austria Government</a> and <a href="https://www.telos.net/">Telos Network</a>.</p><h3 id="why">Why?</h3><blockquote>Giulio explained: “We organised this Unconference and also contributed to the broader <a href="https://refispring.com/">ReFi Spring initiative</a> because we are fascinated by this young emerging field of blockchain for climate innovators and wanted to support its development. There are many aspects we are not enthusiastic about in the DeFi space, which of course also influence the ReFi movement. Our aim with this event was to address these problems by discussing them constructively and collectively.”</blockquote><h3 id="what-did-you-learn">What did you learn? </h3><p>They found less broad consensus on wild speculation for crazy abstract tokenomics and more focus on real world communities; less financialisation of everything by default and more cautious comprehension of where it makes sense and where it doesn’t.</p><blockquote>“We covered a lot of topics and projects during a week of event! Zooming in on participants' efforts, ReFi projects, networks, tools, approaches, and zooming out on the broader geopolitical and ecological global context, policies, historical trends. We think these events are fundamental to put all the pieces together, to avoid over focusing on our own disciplinary perspective/practice (being too detached from the real world, or too immersed into practice), and to reconsider what we are doing at a fundamental level, to do it better!”</blockquote><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/XvTuOnoNEocR6pBkW01x1CMDENHNoojF4fGdsiAT6pV-atf1hXIW05zTYpHJZ5KSdkyBtnm_lwKjEF2qYS0v6p7lTzLMfiAy8yRMDn2OEvCY3nTYfbtTRosazpTCZ7tWC6PXfaCd0oD_3ffERw" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure><p><br>Among all the excellent contributions to the discussion, of highlight were <a href="https://ca.linkedin.com/in/jeff-emmett-05268139">Jeff Emmett</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/JessicaZartler">Jessica Zartler</a>'s take on the design and governance of the Commons. Their incredible experience crossing all the major crypto commons projects (<a href="https://twitter.com/commonsstack">Commons Stack</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/tokengineering">Token Engineering</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/block_science">BlockScience</a>) is so valuable to our ecosystem and embody the ReFi movement greatly. The <a href="https://twitter.com/H_O_L_O_">Holochain</a> co-founders, <a href="https://twitter.com/artbrock">Art Brock</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/zippy314">Eric Harris-Braun</a>, brought al the participants into a deep dive on “flows logic”; the art of designing and building systems suitable to the new societal and economic paradigm made of networks and complex flows. </p><blockquote>“I’m especially excited about the upcoming launch of Holo apps as they sound amazing!” Giulio exclaimed! </blockquote><p><a href="https://in.linkedin.com/in/nena-jain-44b4667b">Nena Jain</a> from Regen Foundation - as well as many other participants - were very vocal about the importance of including local communities in the governance and design of ReFi protocols, and <a href="https://twitter.com/felixfritsch2">Felix Fritsch</a>, co-founder at CCA thinks this is the crucial takeaway:</p><blockquote>“We are hopeful that the ReFi movement can have a huge positive impact on stabilising the climate, as long as communities on the ground are given an adequate voice. The risk of ReFi being co-opted by Venture Capitalists and greedy green washy TradFi is very real, as are the continuation of exploitation under Green Capitalism and Green Colonialism at large. In reaction, we propose a vigilant and uneasy truce with big capital mainly in order to retain access to funding that accelerates the transition, without forgetting who should be in charge - sovereign local communities and their Commons.” </blockquote><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/WSHcqCpc88flZzMCc8oRzxM2XoV7yl0XEpfdRNOFjfbdtr9btkTe49dI5sFwlQkx9bYV2aC_alxbo1NK8b9JojThN65VlhEWkhajiTONEeLD-MlFDhdbrnn0d2ogENuH1g2OmX2-FoEw-nfLOg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure><p>If you are excited by:</p><ul><li>The possibilities of ReFi,</li><li>Sharing the CCA’s sentiments for the commons and their wariness of the intentions of big capital,</li><li>As well as the intention to explore liberating applications of DLTs and related technologies rather than simply protesting their extractive application,</li></ul><p>Then they are delighted to welcome you into their community! Feel free to follow CCA <a href="https://twitter.com/CCommonsHub">on twitter</a>, join their <a href="https://t.me/+Vcg9sHyhEh0Fv9Qt">telegram channel</a>, attend <a href="https://www.crypto-commons.org/events">upcoming events</a> or drop Giulio or Felix an email at <a href="mailto:cryptocommonshub@protonmail.com">cryptocommonshub@protonmail.com</a>.<br></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/RwwkzTtGx-Djr3y9ZnaWJlxOE4nqs4n8h9uel1FCvJC1C3VNzYj7yFco5SxItOUN8x6BoqKCTCmbHyXU7UnnUohNTaaY8nNQIaedFk8Y9wgbeB3eIdzqN3FWoYcvRbvjdZ2BGtrvklxXNcNNyQ" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure>
item.excerpt:encoded: Transitioning to a crypto commons requires the integration of local communities in protocol design.

item.title: ReFi Rate-athon is Underway!
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Agnew
John Dass
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="refi-dao-is-halfway-through-the-refi-rate-athon-a-partnership-with-prime-dao-and-impacta-finance-to-help-build-trust-in-the-refi-space-and-encourage-capital-to-flow-to-high-integrity-projects"><a href="https://refidao.com/">ReFi DAO</a> is halfway through the ReFi Rate-athon, a partnership with <a href="https://www.prime.xyz/">Prime DAO</a> and <a href="https://www.impacta.finance/">Impacta Finance</a> to help build trust in the ReFi space and encourage capital to flow to high-integrity projects.</h3><p>By creating an open framework for evaluation and rewarding researchers for their analysis—we hope to help curate a list of verified ReFi projects so that founders, talent and investors can make sense of where to invest their time, energy and capital.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/w_ndxZklWxbF5pYV-U3YIKGG832V2dP1m8eybP_fNBHAk3-3ucVHuGxC_jZ5d4kCgdZrmqOSCPT3cwXgRSTr71ozv_bakqgXX4Vm--kOLrTFIWDjN_d5ffqkyNk4qXs0aA_RxD2DydUSor0L8g" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"><figcaption><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MmrTgKLTwrk&amp;t=24s">An overview</a> of the Rate-athon with <a href="https://twitter.com/LuukDAO">Luuk Weber</a> (PrimeDAO), <a href="https://twitter.com/_paulapalermo">Paula Palermo</a> (Impacta Finance) and <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a> (ReFi DAO). You can <a href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1vVqF-NKMDWcYT15Ff-FliB9meid8UiTk0GZc6sf44uk/edit#slide=id.g128c1d9be86_0_48">view the deck here</a>.</figcaption></figure><h2 id="how-do-we-grow-a-movement-with-integrity-and-impact">How do we grow a movement with integrity and impact?</h2><p>Despite the massive potential for leveraging web3 tools to coordinate meaningful climate impact at scale, there are a number of high level challenges we face in the ReFi space:</p><ul><li> Most people mistakenly believe crypto is bad for the planet and therefore don’t engage</li><li>Bad actors have degraded trust; the recent collapse of Terra is one of several costly failed experiments that impacts the perception of the space</li><li>We don’t have enough data on meaningful and impactful use cases for web3 despite the amount of capital flowing into the system</li><li>Regulators don’t understand the power of Web3 to address the most pressing challenges of our time</li><li>Due to regulatory uncertainty, many actors adopt a pseudo anonymous identity which exacerbates the issue of distrust </li></ul><h3 id="who-watches-the-watchers">Who watches the watchers?</h3><p>With the latest crash seeing crypto plunge over 50% from $3.1 trillion to less than $1.3 trillion (as of writing on the 16th June 2022) we’ve seen life savings decimated and many projects die. On the one hand this is a part of a rapidly emerging space beginning to mature as we go through market cycles, but on the other it fuels the call for tougher regulation from traditional finance and governments who would rather see punitive policies that inhibit innovation. </p><p>Web3 actors have been asking for regulatory clarity and much is needed, but how far will governments go to restrict the sandbox of experimentation in the space? How can we ensure there are fewer Terra's and Klima's and more high-impact applications of blockchain solving real-world problems?</p><p>Given the severity and urgency of the climate crisis and ecosystem collapse, we need to be laser-focused on using this powerful technology to solve <em>real</em> problems. We need to courageously call out bad actors and encourage everyone to build ventures with impact, integrity and inclusion at its core.</p><blockquote>“We’re seeing a very nice parity with a lot of protocols emerging, so we feel it is important to see the protocols from within and evaluate them in a transparent and distributed way.” — Paula Palermo from <a href="https://www.impacta.finance/">Impacta Finance</a> </blockquote><p>This speaks to web3’s characteristics of decentralisation, openness, 'trustlessness',that would allow the ReFi movement to self-regulate.</p><h3 id="the-big-picture">The big picture</h3><p>The first ReFi rating event of Prime Rating went live on June 13th and will finish on June 27th. During this period, ReFi Researchers will create reports on the leading and upcoming ReFi projects. It's working towards a crowdsourced evaluation framework and open database to incentivize actors to use the power of web3 for planet positive impact. </p><p>This is a part of Prime DAO’s collaboration with Celo called the "ReFi Launch Program" that provides up-and-coming ReFi protocols with pre-purchasing and liquidity. Being able to identify the most promising up and coming actors seems to be a great move by Prime DAO to protect the deployment of capital via the ReFi Launch program.<br></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/8GzrpbYKPJM-n0DqZOG8DOxBOY5l2cM3_gXRJoprLljLWfyrpdTIascZse1mu-6THsqLuZVjqsLrcTDLDjIZwcWQc4OQpZmnu6KlpdZZ1LVZvjKWBXXOjlornnjQ9aC5d1VwgHGylvvOTSbJbA" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure><p>During the ReFi Rate-athon, a handful of analysts will evaluate the integrity of a number of ReFi projects with the aim to create a baseline understanding and comparison. From this baseline, raters will be able to share their learnings and help ReFi protocols improve. </p><p>As anyone in the impact space knows, it's really hard to objectively define and measure impact. Given the subjective nature, it's important that we get started while recognising the need for intellectual humility and transparency. The evaluation framework created by Prime DAO and Impacta leverages their joint experience across the DeFi, Metaverse and impact investing space and acts as a launch pad for improvement based on feedback from experts, evaluators and the projects themselves. </p><h3 id="becoming-jedi">Becoming JEDI!</h3><p>We hope to also build on the existing frameworks that have been developed over many years, such as the <a href="https://jediinvesting.com/about-this-toolkit">J.E.D.I. Toolkit</a>. JEDI stands for Justice, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. This toolkit has been designed to encourage allocators, investment influencers and intermediaries across the spectrum to understand the dimensions of JEDI investing, and start applying gender and JEDI lenses throughout their investment processes and strategies.</p><p>Or the well established <a href="https://impactmanagementproject.com/">IMP</a> - The "Impact Management Project" which began in 2016 as a time-bound forum for building global consensus on how to measure, assess and report impacts on people and the natural environment.</p><h3 id="learning-from-elsewhere">Learning from elsewhere</h3><p>We’ve also seen the <a href="https://www.bcorporation.net/">B Corp</a> successfully implement a global accreditation program for Benefit Corps that increasingly pushes them to be more impactful and makes it easier for consumers to identify impactful businesses. In ReFi, we see various projects looking to use technology to measure, report and verify carbon projects. </p><p><a href="https://www.regen.network/">Regen Network </a>and <a href="https://twitter.com/OpenForest_/status/1531384707086266371?s=20&amp;t=nqtP-Qr3c1LYsC992JzUTw">Open Forest Protocol’s</a> validators have a specific role to carry out due diligence on carbon projects; looking at information provided by a project, the validators have to stake their tokens on how accurate they believe the information to be without seeing what other validators are staking too. In this manner "truth can be coordinated more easily than falsehood" as the fiscal responsibility of the stakers to carry out due diligence is motivated by the financial incentives designed by the system. </p><p>You can read more in our <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-deep-dive-open-forest-protocol/">Deep Dive on Open Forest Protocol here</a>.</p><hr><h2 id="has-this-been-done-before">Has this been done before?</h2><p>Yes, but specifically more around financial and blockchain due diligence rather than impact. Prime DAO have been creating open models and rating events to evaluate <a href="https://www.prime.xyz/rating-about#:~:text=Prime%20Rating%20offers%20a%20neutral,based%20on%20publicly%20available%20data.">DeFi and Metaverse projects</a>. They created a framework for quantifying the quality and risk of open finance protocols as a public good for DeFi market. A similar approach is now being adapted for the impact aspirations of ReFi protocols.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/yorQJxfiy_bqQtVLHuBeEZ6tTcZBRIVjFBQVMszL8sjpZ3BE_uaJrZMZ1JJO8Kn259CaYjPsIVmM6LfEKJCUGG5yH-ympJQbuFfuM-QKmLbzPIzU1F_fyitTudzsCTtb_Yo4-saIn89Ybwopng" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure><hr><h2 id="why-does-it-matter">Why does it matter?</h2><h3 id="increasing-trust">Increasing trust</h3><p>One of the most important factors that investors look at is the level of associated risk in any investment. Due diligence goes as deep as it can to find information on what is actually happening within an organisation. When information isn’t available or the data shows red flags, then the associated risk is too high and the investor will likely not invest. Conversely, if there is transparency and the operations can be analysed, then risk goes down, trust in that organisation is increased, and investors are more likely to invest as long as there are no red flags.</p><h3 id="resiliency">Resiliency</h3><p>Having our own protocols subject to different levels of scrutiny also helps founders see blind spots. This is vital at early stages when we could find ourselves in an echo chamber or otherwise blinkered by our own biases. With a different lens on the challenges we are trying to solve, we can adapt, remove red flags, and build more resilient organisations.</p><h3 id="increasing-collaboration-opportunities">Increasing collaboration opportunities</h3><p>With an open database that goes into depth on the activities of a protocol, we increase the chances that another partner can find the missing elements they need to get their own project off the ground - or to increase their impact through for example a greater outreach.</p><h3 id="efficiencies">Efficiencies</h3><p>As Luuk Weber from PrimeDAO commented “For me, that’s the really most exciting part, opening up the collaboration space”. By having an open collaboration space gives us economies of scale; it speeds up the time it would take for any collaborator to do the due diligence on a potential partner. Imagine you have two protocols debating whether they should or shouldn’t collaborate. If a third party has done the due diligence on both, and it’s been corroborated by multiple peers then the time it takes for these two protocols to make a decision is dramatically shortened. For every hour the raters put in means the next partner has less work to do as they access that data. </p><h3 id="save-money">Save money</h3><p>Security audits are expensive! And many protocols have failed as a result of shoddy tokenomics and not paying for a good auditor to run a solid testing process. By crowdsourcing accreditation we can perhaps lower the costs of regulation so more protocols can access the service. This avoids traditional bottlenecks that we see in centralised traditional financial markets when only a small group of auditors are available to carry out due-diligence.</p><h3 id="win-win">Win-win</h3><p>It also reduces the chances of redundancy. One thing that Daryl Edwards has learnt through the ReFi DAO founders circles has been “seeing how founders find the tech they need that other founders have already made. When we build on each other’s work, we see the whole sector level up consistently in win-win scenarios rather than trying to compete against each other.”</p><h3 id="incentivising-impact">Incentivising Impact</h3><p>Rather than punishing companies for the things they do or don’t do, ReFi Ratings hope to reward and incentivise better behaviour. It’s hard to implement justice, equity, diversity and inclusion (JEDI) in our orgs, but with the right incentives to encourage founders to do this perhaps we can really be a driving force for fighting social injustice around the globe.</p><hr><h2 id="gefnsett">'GEFNSETT'</h2><p>There is a good sense-check concept in <a href="https://www.sociocracyforall.org/the-liberating-effect-of-good-enough-for-now/">Sociocracy</a>; do you all feel this is “Good Enough for Now and Safe Enough to Try?" We realize that our first version won't be perfect, but it will be a starting point for feedback and improvement. The first Rate-athon is about getting on the right trajectory - it’s not about determining whose standards for measuring carbon are better than others, but to cover just the basics for each organization. The methodologies will be designed over two-week sprints. Some methodologies will be measurable from the outset. But Luuk’s main hope is to see who is navigating in the right direction for a ReFi vision, and over time, we’ll see some evolutions to build granularity in our methodologies.</p><p>Currently the Prime Rating methodology carries out a <em>two part process</em>:</p><ol><li><strong>Fundamental Review</strong>: The Fundamental Analysis evaluates the overall quality of a project based on its Value Proposition, Tokenomics, Team, Governance, and Regulatory qualities.</li><li><strong>Technical Review</strong>: Essentially a security audit, created in collaboration with DeFi Safety, the Technical quality Review evaluates the technical quality of a project based on its Code, Documentation, Testing, Security and Access Controls.</li></ol><h3 id="open-questions">Open Questions:</h3><p>The methodology opens up many interesting questions for founders, investors and for raters. For example would you feel comfortable revealing data on your ReFi protocol if you were asked to share: </p><ul><li><em>Founder profiles and names for public accountability</em></li><li><em>Upload collateral (white paper etc, for review)</em></li><li><em>Open books (access to finances for review, </em></li><li><em>Cap Table (Founder token holdings)</em></li><li><em>Open source code for security auditing</em></li><li><em>Increasing breadth and depth of regenerative practises</em></li></ul><p>From an investor’s perspective, if you knew that a protocol had openly shared and been rated on all of the above and more, would you be more likely to invest in it? We’re delighted to have that conversation in the <a href="https://t.me/+ojytIaTBslwxMjA0">ReFi DAO telegram channel</a> and we are already finding that founders of ReFi projects are electing to make publicly available their data for evaluation.</p><h2 id="get-involved">Get involved</h2><p>The benefits of joining as a Rater are you earn cUSD for each Report accepted. You gain experience and get a chance network in the ReFi space. You also get the chance to become part of one of the friendliest and most engaging research DAOs in web3!</p><p>As ReFI DAO, we've been very grateful to meet the incredible team at Prime DAO and have the chance to support them in this amazing opportunity.</p><h2 id="become-a-rater-and-earn">Become a rater and earn!</h2><p>If you're an expert in either Web3 or Impact / Regeneration evaluation, then we need you for the final week! If you have some experience researching Web 3.0 projects and some affinity with Impact / Regeneration, you’re still in good shape. If you’re not as experienced in one of the two fields, you can still participate, however, we would suggest you try to team up with someone else who is more experienced in the part that’s new to you! You can use the <a href="https://discord.gg/VDBtuCxKYy">#ReFi-Rating discord</a> channel in <a href="https://discord.com/invite/primedao">PrimeDAO’s discord</a> to find partners and invite people you know to the space.</p><p>And to become a <strong>ReFi Rater</strong>, you can <a href="https://primerefi.xyz/refi-rate-athon">📝 Apply here!</a> We can't wait to get the ball rolling and we thank you for your enthusiasm and participation. Finally, Luuk from Prime DAO has written up a fact sheet on Kickstarting the ReFi Rate-athon which has many more details for you to get involved.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/h7z7-5nkMLP1apSRknIgxJEFLHiiLp0g6M6syvM4J7st6MVEi15LMyUCMVycpxCdu-OVIl-cGo9qYtntxIWxx6GPE1Frz8EghpxrRQjW-xBhoxSEWhPdSxN_kxFO6HzD0an1a0ndE7FsdMBX0g" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy"></figure>

By creating an open framework for evaluation and rewarding researchers for their analysis—we hope to help

item.title: ReFi DAO GR13 Grant Update
item.dc:creator: John Dass
item.content:encoded: <p>Happy GR14 frens! 🎉</p><p>We are super grateful to provide an update on everything in ReFi DAO. So much has happened since GR13. None of this could have happened without you!</p><p>Despite not reaching our full-target, we are super excited to share the progress we’ve made with the $22,636 we received in GR13. We still have a balance of $9,863 remaining to allocate.</p><p>jE has left his role leading growth at Toucan to focus on ReFi DAO and ReFi Podcast full-time. Daryl Edwards continues to provide immense support to the founder community every week. Jeremy Agnew has kept ReFi Roundup rolling. Slaptain has come in from Klima DAO to help us get ReFi Jobs off the ground.</p><p>We were also <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XwBexHiS9K8">finalists in the Commons Stack prize</a> which was awarded to Grassroots Economics!</p><h2 id="project-updates"><strong>Project Updates</strong></h2><p>Below are updates from the initiatives and objectives listed in the GR13 application.</p><h3 id="refi-podcast">ReFi Podcast</h3><ul><li>As a result of a loss in johnx’s family and jE’s move, we’ve taken a short pause to reflect and connect with our community. We’ve got an exciting line-up of guests and some exciting partnerships.</li><li>We’re hiring a <a href="https://refi.pallet.com/list/refi/jobs/e10eb000-9810-49d3-a45a-762b2762ef78">Community &amp; Social Manager</a> to help grow the movement around the podcast</li><li>We’ve got a partnership with Bankless DAO + Bankless Consulting to launch season two</li><li>We’ve engaged an experienced producer to improve production quality</li></ul><h3 id="refi-founder%E2%80%99s-circles">ReFi Founder’s Circles</h3><ul><li>We’ve welcomed over 200 up-and-coming ReFi Founders into our Discord</li><li>Thanks to the dedication of Daryl and brilliant founders we’ve guided four circles of founders through 8-week journeys</li><li>We’re in the process of forming new founder’s circles with the help of a network scientists:</li><li>Timezone specific (Americas, EMEA, APAC)</li><li>Water, Fundraising, Biodiversity, and MRV circles</li></ul><h3 id="refidaocom-refi-jobs-refi-talent"><a href="http://ReFiDAO.com">ReFiDAO.com</a>, ReFi Jobs &amp; ReFi Talent</h3><ul><li>Grown the directory to 227—the largest public web3 impact list</li><li>Launched ReFi Jobs with 79 active opportunities and 23 leading companies</li><li>Launched ReFi Talent Collective with 14 hand-picked members from orgs like UNICEF, Citrix, UN, and more…</li><li>Working on a partnership with Climatebase to onboard the next generation of talent into the space</li></ul><h3 id="refi-spring">ReFi Spring</h3><ul><li>Has grown and decided to spin out into it’s own working group</li><li>Created a collective within <a href="https://opencollective.com/all4climate">All4Climate</a> DAO to receive grant funding</li><li>Provided funding and support to <a href="https://spring.refidao.com/events/refi-unconference">ReFi Unconference</a> in Austria and <a href="https://spring.refidao.com/events/refi-spring-portugal-1">ReFi Portugal at TDF</a></li><li>Received a grant from <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective</a> to reach 5,000 people over 50 events</li><li>Created a core team that ReFi DAO members actively support in a weekly committee meeting</li></ul><h3 id="refi-wide-contributor-program">ReFi-wide Contributor Program</h3><ul><li>Have opened up a board on <a href="https://www.wonderverse.xyz/">Wonderverse</a> where we are building a ReFi-wide contributor program for all of our members</li><li>Created a Sobol instance to map ReFi DAO and support self-organization</li><li>Creating a series of working agreements to accelerate the contributor program for members</li><li>This needs further funding to build out, and we are hoping GR14 can provide us this opportunity</li></ul><hr><h1 id="thank-you-stay-tuned">Thank you &amp; stay tuned!</h1><p>We so appreciate all of your support. Gitcoin grant funding has been <em>the</em> energy by which we have brought this movement in ReFi to life.</p><p>We’re excited to provide an update on the community build and protocol for <a href="https://gitcoin.co/grants/4024/refi-dao-season-one">GR14</a>!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-11-at-09.45.19.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1060" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-11-at-09.45.19.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-11-at-09.45.19.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-11-at-09.45.19.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-11-at-09.45.19.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="gr14-is-live-%F0%9F%8E%89">GR14 is Live! 🎉</h2>

item.title: ReFi Roundup #21 - Moss Brazil, Guardians of The Rainforest, Prime Rate-athon, and how to Adapt & Endure...
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Agnew
item.content:encoded: <p>We're super excited to announce a collaboration with <a href="https://web3climate.substack.com/">Web3 for Climate</a>—written by Alex Filotimo and other investors at Aera Force DAO. Each week, we'll be working together to cover the full ReFi ecosystem from different angles. Our newsletter will increasingly focus on materials for ReFi founders, while Web3 for Climate is about to undergo a rebrand and cater for ReFi investors.</p><p>There's much more to come in the ReFi DAO x Aera Force DAO dynamic—stay tuned!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://web3climate.substack.com/?utm_source&#x3D;%2Fprofile%2F67872405-alex-filotimo&amp;utm_medium&#x3D;reader2-nav" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Check out Web3 for Cliamte</a></div><h2 id="moss-catching-multiple-headlines-this-week">Moss catching multiple headlines this week</h2><p>Two major Brazilian airlines <a href="https://www.voegol.com.br/">GOL Linhas Aéreas </a>and aCVC announced carbon neutral corporate flights made possible by the <a href="https://cointelegraph.com.br/explained/erc-20-tokens-explained/amp">tokenization </a>of carbon credits made by <a href="https://moss.earth/pt-br/">Moss</a>, on the Ethereum <a href="https://cointelegraph.com.br/explained/what-is-blockchain-how-it-works/amp">blockchain </a>(<a href="https://cointelegraph.com.br/ethereum-price-index">ETH</a>).<strong> </strong>While this is a great milestone for Moss and corporate adoption of on-chain carbon, it does raise questions as to why these GOL and aCVC decided to use Ethereum rather than Polygon given it's carbon intensity and availability of MCO2 on both chains.</p><p>Regardless, Moss raised eyebrows here and in their Community Voices feature with our friends <a href="https://myclimatejourney.substack.com/">My Climate Journey</a>, as shown below.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://myclimatejourney.substack.com/p/the-brazilian-carbon-compliance-market"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/luis-adame.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1294" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/luis-adame.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/luis-adame.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/06/luis-adame.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/luis-adame.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p>Here in MCJ's Substack, <a href="https://twitter.com/luis_adaime">Luis</a> <a href="https://myclimatejourney.substack.com/p/the-brazilian-carbon-compliance-market"> published an article</a> discussing the latest policy changes in Brazil where we find 40% of the world’s tropical forests and 50% of the world’s capacity for carbon credit generation. The Brazilian federal government have launched a compliance market framework which is a momentous step as they've previously been dismissive.</p><blockquote>Eliminating a large source of uncertainty for Brazilian project REDD+ credits is key for international investors to put money to work in the country for the expansion of supply and for us to create economic incentives for the conservation of Brazilian forests.</blockquote><p>Though our good friend Marcelo Silva, Community Manager at ReFi Spring commented:</p><blockquote>It’s very serious for people fighting for climate justice. We've just seen the death of the two regens here in Brazil.</blockquote><p>Dom Philips a British journalist was <a href="https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/amp/internacional/en/brazil/2022/06/journalist-dom-phillips-murdered-at-age-57-loved-brazil-and-the-amazon.shtml">murdered</a> along with an indigenous activist Bruno Pereira while trying to protect native folks and the forest from illegal miners. Bruno was a Brazilian civil employee who was fired by the government after applying penalties for criminals linked to Bolsonaro. Sadly we hear of corruption on all levels when conservation is at play - something that those looking to have an impact have to contend with regularly.</p><hr><h2 id="state-of-dmrv-roundtable-tickets-go-live">State of dMRV Roundtable tickets go live!</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/dmrv-roundtable-event.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="969" height="500" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/dmrv-roundtable-event.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/dmrv-roundtable-event.jpg 969w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>The kick-off event for the inaugural MRV Day has free and paid tickets available on ReFi Spring. Check them out and grab yours before they're gone!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spring.refidao.com/events/state-of-dmrv-roundtable" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get tickets</a></div><h2 id="guardians-of-the-rainforest">Guardians of the Rainforest</h2><p>I recently had a fantastic conversation with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/creatorcharlie">Charlie Graham</a> from <a href="https://volum8.com/">Volum8</a>. He and his team have been building the <a href="https://nemus.earth/">Nemus project</a> which just launched their first NFT drop which covers 8,300ha of a 41k hectare private property in the Brazilian Rainforest. Each plot is either small, medium, large or extra large and has a beautifully designed NFT attached to it and a corresponding price. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://www.instagram.com/nemus.earth/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.04.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1216" height="1208" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.04.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.04.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.04.png 1216w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p>By purchasing NFTs, Guardians make it possible to secure land and foster sustainable economic activities that ensure protection and productivity within the rainforest for generations to come. Part of the sale of the NFT goes to supporting on the ground conservation efforts that reduce clear cutting and create alternative income streams for indigenous communities, for example. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://app.nemus.earth/map"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.38.37.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="950" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.38.37.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.38.37.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.38.37.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.38.37.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption>Their super cool <a href="https://app.nemus.earth/map">interactive map</a> embedded in the app</figcaption></figure><p>They launched in March and they've already sold 20% of the drop to 4,000 buyers and raised $1m which is very impressive. Here's hoping we see more ReFi projects that support the preservation of the lungs of our planet. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.instagram.com/nemus.earth/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.29.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1224" height="1228" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.29.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.29.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-14.32.29.png 1224w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption>92 pieces of original artwork have been minted in their genesis drop</figcaption></figure><hr><h2 id="refi-rate-athon-with-prime-dao-impacta-finance">ReFi Rate-athon with Prime DAO &amp; Impacta Finance</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-13-at-15.11.03.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1149" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-13-at-15.11.03.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-13-at-15.11.03.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-13-at-15.11.03.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-13-at-15.11.03.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>We're halfway through the Prime DAO and Impacta Finance. The kick-off featured close to 30 participants and we're looking to cover the top 50-70 ReFi projects in this first two week sprint.</p><p>Check out the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-deep-dive-refi-rate-athon/">Deep Dive: ReFi Rate-athon</a> where we go into full details about the event!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-deep-dive-refi-rate-athon/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read more</a></div><hr><h2 id="funding-the-commons-in-vivo-june-24-25">Funding the Commons in vivo June 24-25</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.32.38.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.32.38.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.32.38.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.32.38.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.32.38.png 2288w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><a href="https://protocol.ai/">Protocol Labs</a>, <a href="https://gitcoin.co/">Gitcoin</a> and Fifty Years are co-organizing '<a href="https://fundingthecommons.io/">Funding the Commons</a>' to explore new ways to fund, and create value for public goods. '<a href="https://fundingthecommons.io/">Funding the Commons</a>' is moving in-person to the <a href="https://www.nyhistory.org/">New York Historical Society</a>, NY's oldest museum! They are hosting a 2-day in-person summit (June 24-25) for individuals and organizations building new models of sustainable public goods funding and value alignment in open source networks. </p><blockquote>"Our goal is to bridge the public goods community across Web2 / Web3, research, philanthropy and industry."</blockquote><hr><h2 id="adapting-to-endure">Adapting to Endure</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-13.07.09.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1260" height="702" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-13.07.09.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-13.07.09.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-13.07.09.png 1260w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Sequoia Capital warned their portfolio founders to batten down the hatches in May. In case you missed it, <a href="https://www.sequoiacap.com/article/adapting-to-endure/">here's their presentation</a> which has some useful advice for those looking to raise funds and weather the storm. The R word (the bad kind - recession, not the good kind - ReFi) has been banded about so we could be in for a rougher global ride than we've experienced so far.</p><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-dark" style="" data-kg-background-image=""><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="refi-bites">ReFi Bites</h2><h3 class="kg-header-card-subheader" id="a-smattering-of-tweets-and-news-from-the-last-week">A smattering of tweets and news from the last week...</h3></div><p></p><h3 id="gr14-is-in-its-final-week-%F0%9F%8E%81">GR14 is in it's final week! 🎁</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/unf_cktheplanet/status/1506672815818293264"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.12.37.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1180" height="688" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.12.37.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.12.37.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.12.37.png 1180w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p>GR14 has finished it's first week and people's generosity abounds! The epic aspect of the Gitcoin grants lies in how every donation is amplified through match funding using a quadratic formula.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.14.09.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1178" height="1110" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.14.09.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.14.09.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.14.09.png 1178w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>For example, <a href="https://gitcoin.co/grants/4024/refi-dao-season-one">our ReFi DAO grant application</a> has raised only $3,435 but from a whopping 1489 contributors (thank you to everyone who has donated!). With quadratic voting this gets amplified and adds an estimated $88k more! So even the smallest donations have a huge impact. I made a <a href="https://twitter.com/jeremyanew/status/1536729161875656705?s=20&amp;t=_IsFjQR8e9xkhFeNPLacCQ">thread to outline our proposal</a> in how ReFi DAO will support the ReFi movement! </p><p>If you can please help contribute to as many ReFi projects as possible. 🙏</p><hr><h3 id="earthbanc-announces-deal-that-could-remove-29-billion-tonnes-annually-%F0%9F%98%B1">Earthbanc announces deal that could remove 2.9 billion tonnes annually 😱</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/earthbanc/status/1537477790408253441"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.07.13.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1178" height="1052" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.07.13.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.07.13.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-12.07.13.png 1178w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p><a href="https://earthbanc.io/earthbanc-announces-partnership-with-the-unccd-to-finance-land-restoration-and-carbon-removal/">Earthbanc has signed a partnership</a> with the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) to explore options that finances land restoration and carbon removal. It would enable investors to support projects that directly advance the goals of the UNCCD Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) targets.</p><p>This means up to 2.9 billion tonnes annually according to the IPCC, can be sequestered into soils, trees and ecosystems. The ecological state data and issuance of credits will occur on <a href="https://registry.regen.network/">Regen Registry</a> – the web3 registry for high quality nature based solutions carbon credits. </p><p>Another huge win for planet earth and the team at Regen Network who have been working hard to pioneer on-chain carbon before ReFi was even a thing...</p><hr><h2 id="not-all-nfts-are-equal">Not all NFTs are equal! </h2><p>Klima calculates the CO2 needed to mint an NFT on Polygon versus Ethereum and the results are astoundingly different. It's shocking to see the impact of Proof of Work versus Proof of Stake consensus mechanisms. We're so excited to see The Merge come to fruition in the next few months!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.28.56.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1174" height="1026" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.28.56.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.28.56.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.28.56.png 1174w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><hr><h2 id="thought-of-the-day">Thought of the day</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/johnx25bd/status/1537711737553797120?s=20&amp;t=_IsFjQR8e9xkhFeNPLacCQ"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.21.58.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1178" height="728" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.21.58.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.21.58.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/06/Screenshot-2022-06-17-at-11.21.58.png 1178w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-dark" style="" data-kg-background-image=""><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="refi-jobs">ReFi Jobs!</h2><h3 class="kg-header-card-subheader" id="the-best-jobs-in-the-world-quit-that-office-job-and-do-this-instead">The best jobs in the world. Quit that office job and do this instead!</h3></div><p>We've heard that if you do a ReFi job in this lifetime, you come back as a frikkin' golden eagle or probably a dolphin in the next life... true story. 🤪</p><p>We've got positions in Software Engineering, Marketing &amp; Growth, People &amp; HR, Product, Sales &amp; Partnerships, Creative &amp; Design, Legal, Finance, and Data &amp; Analytics! <br><br>Here are the latest most exciting jobs that hit <a href="https://refi.pallet.com/jobs">the ReFi job board</a> in the last week, many of which were expertly collated by the lowly (but awesome) <a href="https://twitter.com/SlaptainShwirv">Slaptain Shwirv</a> himself. 👏</p><ul><li>Story DAO - Head of Community Story DAO - Team Coordinator</li><li>Story DAO - Web3 NFT Analyst</li><li>Story DAO - Director of Engineering</li><li>Story DAO - Full Stack Developer</li><li>HBAR Foundation - Director, Sustainable Impact - EU &amp; Africa</li><li>HBAR Foundation - Director, Sustainable Impact - APAC</li><li>MRV Collective - MRV Studio Community/DAO Manager</li><li>Thallo - Community Engagement Manager</li></ul><p>As well as over 70+ other positions!</p><hr><h2 id="other-refi-newsletters-to-enjoy">Other ReFi newsletters to enjoy</h2><ul><li><a href="https://web3climate.substack.com/">web3climate.substack.com</a> by Alex Filotimo and investors at Aera Force VC</li><li><a href="https://cryptogood.substack.com/">cryptogood.substack.com</a> by Deepa and <a href="https://cryptogood.substack.com/p/-call-for-contributors-a-study-of">researchers exploring Impact DAOs</a></li><li><a href="https://blog.toucan.earth/tag/decarbonized/">deCarbonized</a> by Dr. Anna Holwat at Toucan</li></ul><p>Any other favorites we should follow? Let us know!</p><h2 id="thats-a-wrap"><strong>That's a wrap!</strong></h2><p>Thanks so much for your time and attention as always. If you have a story, please do submit and we'll look to include in our next edition of ReFi Roundup.</p><p>We're also growing our contributor program so feel free to drop us a note if you're interested.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://tally.so/embed/3jOz1w?hideTitle=1&alignLeft=1" width="800" height="600" frameborder="0" marginheight="0" marginwidth="0" title="Tally Forms"></iframe></figure><p></p>

Here's a quick run through of everything happening so you can figure out how to get involved.</p><p>We're running a 'formation week' for the ReFi Summer cohort of Founder's Circles, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist/status/1548956026086608900?s=20&amp;t=Be9YP5m_LrRwf-GzAQXxww">speaking to Luis from Moss on ReFi Podcast</a> and co-hosting an event with Flowcarbon in Paris around ETH CC!</p><p>Also, we've got the chance to do a LIVE podcast with Kevin Owocki from Gitcoin and Green Pill on Saturday at <a href="https://sbs.tech/">SBS</a>! Grab your tickets. I'm also doing a talk on MRV there...</p><h2 id="formation-week-refi-summer-founders-circles">Formation Week: ReFi Summer Founder's Circles</h2><p>Today mark's the 'formation week' of Founder's Circles for ReFi Summer. item.title: ReFi Roundup #27: The Story of Redemption DAO
item.dc:creator: John Dass
item.content:encoded: <figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/086eKHtvI5k?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen title="Redemption DAO: The Bigger Picture"></iframe></figure><p>On Wednesday morning the ReFi community discovered that the Democratic Republic of Congo was going to auction 27m hectares of land—30 blocks across 5 distinct basins —to oil companies for oil exploration. <a href="https://twitter.com/anranga95">Nirvaan</a> from <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective</a> posted this New York Time's story to the ReFi DAOist community which provided the spark for RedemptionDAO to emerge. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://www.nytimes.com/svc/oembed/html/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nytimes.com%2F2022%2F07%2F24%2Fworld%2Fafrica%2Fcongo-oil-gas-auction.html" scrolling="no" frameborder="0" allowtransparency="true" title="Congo to Auction Land to Oil Companies: ‘Our Priority Is Not to Save the Planet’" style="border:none;max-width:500px;min-width:300px;min-height:550px;display:block;width:100%;"></iframe></figure><p>The Congo Basin holds roughly 8% of the world's forest-based carbon. It is home to over 80 million people. More than 10,000 species of plants depend upon the forest for their survival. It is home to some of the most beautiful and rare animal species on the planet—many of whom are on the risk of extinction.</p><h2 id="a-new-dao-is-born">A new DAO is born...</h2><p>Within a few hours Redemption DAO was born to win the auction – but use the land for Nature-Based Services (not oil) and preserve them for the local community. Redemption DAO surfaced as a rapid collaboration between many of the top organizations in ReFi alongside a group of organizers and activists on-the-ground in the DRC. It's comprised of some of the top leaders in the regenerative finance space, most of whom are in ReFi DAO Founder's Circles—showing the deep commitment to collaboration that defines the regenerative finance space.</p><ul><li>Jae-Hee Bae from Civics Unplugged</li><li>Carl Cervone, Dream DAO champion</li><li>Helena &amp; Doug from Spirals Protocol</li><li>Phil from Flowcarbon</li><li>Gregory from Regen Network</li><li>Wes from HBAR Foundation</li><li>Mallika from Questa Games</li><li>Holly from Astral Protocol</li><li>James from Helios</li><li>Gloria and Ben from Gitcoin</li><li>Cyrus from Eden Dao</li><li>Ale from Impact DAO and FiftyYears</li><li>Max from Carbonbase</li><li>Hayley from Thallo</li></ul><p>With a full list of organizations and contributors involved here: <a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wO1WkenLQuKuPGNkwcaJGCM2O8y9FC00UquY2nI5KXQ/edit#gid=0">RedemptionDAO Orgs</a></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://discord.gg/ZrmkcBk6gB" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Redemption DAO</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/image-17.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1055" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/07/image-17.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/07/image-17.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/07/image-17.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/07/image-17.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="redemption-daos-theory-of-change">Redemption DAO's theory of change</h2><p>In a similar way to the Constitution DAO's $50M bid for the US Constitution, Redemption DAO believes it can rally a community of support around the #SaveCongoBasin story to raise enough funds to win one or more blocks -- and develop an innovative model of co-stewardship of natural assets with local communities.</p><p>Several of the Redemption DAO organizers are in touch with top CEO's around the world, including some of the most wealthy people on the planet. The business case is clear:</p><ol><li>Purchase the rights to use the land</li><li>Preserve land and generate yield through avoided deforestation credits</li><li>Use credits to fulfill net zero commitments, and sell any excess to reinvest in the local community</li></ol><p>If the right events fall into place and humanity gets behind the Redemption DAO movement we may well see a major win for the local communities who have been working on the ground tirelessly year after year to protect the Congo Basin. They've been doing their best to get their voices heard but it took a crisis to bring this to mainstream media.</p><p>This won't just be a win for the DRC, or for Africa. It will be a win for all of humanity as we finally discover how to truly value what matters most. </p><p>If Redemption DAO fails to acquire and preserve any of the parcels of land there's also an opportunity to apply social and legal pressure to the oil companies to preserve the integrity of the forests as much as possible. With the increasing demand for carbon credits, we will undoubtedly see a major shift in geopolitics away from fossil fuels and towards natural resources and renewable energy.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/image-18.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1118" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/07/image-18.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/07/image-18.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/07/image-18.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/07/image-18.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>A slide from dClimate co-founder Osho Jha's presentation at MRV Day June 2022</figcaption></figure><p>Let's front-run the opportunity and show people how it's done!</p><h2 id="unpacking-the-auction-process">Unpacking the auction process</h2><p>At first, it appeared as though the auction was going to be complete by the end of day today—July 29th, but thanks to some digging from French-speaking friends in Redemption DAO (<a href="https://twitter.com/cyrusofeden">Cyrus</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/ncostrowski">Nathan</a>), we know have until Q1 2023 to create a bidding entity and submit a bid. </p><p>That should give Redemption DAO enough time to build a coalition, raise several billion dollars and secure as many of the 30 plots as possible. </p><blockquote>“the counting of the offers will take place in public session and in the presence of the candidates or their representatives on the date and at the address below: February 03, 2023 Commune de la Gombe à Kinshasa ”</blockquote><p>Below are several key resources for unpacking the process:</p><ul><li><a href="https://www.drcbidround2022.com/2022-bid-round">https://www.drcbidround2022.com/2022-bid-round</a></li><li><a href="http://www.hydrocarbures.gouv.cd/">http://www.hydrocarbures.gouv.cd/</a></li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/1.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/2.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/3.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div></div><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/4.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/5.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/6.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div></div><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/7.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/8.jpg" width="596" height="842" loading="lazy" alt></div></div></div></figure><h2 id="a-moonshot-with-huge-potential">A moonshot with huge potential</h2><p>The current criteria is heavily focused on experienced oil project developers. It would take significant social and political pressure to get a seat at the table—but this is exactly the kind of feat that would grab global headlines and create a massive shift on the world stage.</p><p>If Redemption DAO is able to bring big capital to the table to preserve the natural world instead of exploiting it for oil—Redemption DAO will have achieved one of the most significant milestones in climate mitigation. It's a long shot but it's worth it. Our climate and our future is at stake.</p><h2 id="social-impact">Social impact</h2><p>Over <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congo_Basin#cite_note-:0-8">80 million of the 92 million people</a> that live in the DRC live within the Congo Basin and depend on its resources for their survival. Selling these 30 plots to oil companies would be catastrophic for indigenous people—a vital group in humanity's survival who preserve over 80% of the world's remaining biodiversity and maintain a cultural identity that is deeply connected to nature and one another.</p><h2 id="cultural-impact">Cultural impact</h2><p>Eight sites in the Congo Basin are inscribed in the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Heritage_Site">World Heritage List</a> with five being marked as 'In Danger'—a number surely to increase if these parcels are auctioned off for extraction.</p><p>It's home to seven national parks and has provided home for indigenous people for thousands of years.</p><ul><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lob%C3%A9k%C3%A9_National_Park">Lobéké National Park</a></li><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lomami_National_Park">Lomami National Park</a></li><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nouabal%C3%A9-Ndoki_National_Park">Nouabalé-Ndoki National Park</a></li><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ntokou-Pikounda_National_Park">Ntokou-Pikounda National Park</a></li><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odzala-Kokoua_National_Park">Odzala-Kokoua National Park</a></li><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salonga_National_Park">Salonga National Park</a></li><li><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virunga_National_Park">Virunga National Park</a></li></ul><h2 id="carbon-impact">Carbon impact</h2><p>It's been estimated that there are three years of global annual emissions worth of carbon stored across the 30 parcels for sale. If these were to be sold to extractive oil companies willing to destroy the natural habitat to extract and burn fossil fuels—this single sale could be devastating in the climate story.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/image-15.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1578" height="1378" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/07/image-15.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/07/image-15.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/image-15.png 1578w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="biodiversity-impact">Biodiversity impact</h2><p>More than <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congo_Basin#cite_note-:0-8">10,000 plant species</a> can be found in and around the forest.</p><p>Thanks to Mallika, CEO of <a href="https://twitter.com/QuestaGame">Questa Game</a> and the lead of the ReFi Gaming <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/73f67c354a0a4f24a9c9ff5466eba7a2?v=0cb0605903d548a9bd71829db95dccee">Founder's Circle</a>, we have a sizable sample of all the beautiful life forms that call Virunga—a national park in the eastern part of the Democratic Republic of Congo. The habitats of these beautiful creatures are at risk as a result of this auction.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/3.jpeg" width="546" height="412" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/lizard.jpeg" width="703" height="1024" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/07/lizard.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/lizard.jpeg 703w"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/07/papilio-phorcas.jpeg" width="768" height="1024" 720px"></div></div></div></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://portal.biosmart.life/virunga-national-park" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">View more</a></div><h2 id="the-big-picture">The big picture</h2><p>The Democratic Republic of Congo has one of the richest natural resource bases—and one of the poorest populations in the world with a <a href="https://www.statista.com/statistics/1041557/gross-domestic-product-gdp-per-capita-in-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo/">per capita GDP of 536.45 in 2020</a>.</p><p>To raise revenues, the Congolese government is auctioning 30 tracts of pristine rainforest to oil companies at the end of this month. </p><p>In reading DRC president <a href="https://www.ft.com/stream/97388999-71bf-4209-b781-d54bcb5fa2bb">Félix Tshisekedi</a>'s article in FT last year<a href="https://www.ft.com/content/3da44d66-a1d3-4e12-8a29-b9bf6f399324"> leading up to COP 26</a>, he understands the gravity of the climate crisis.</p><blockquote>Climate change could wipe out 15 per cent of Africa’s gross domestic product by 2030. This means an additional 100m people in extreme poverty by the end of the decade. This is a cruel fate for a continent that contributes so little to global warming.</blockquote><p>He formed a coalition with other African leaders in the African Union to form an "Africa Adaptation Acceleration Program" requesting $25B over 5 years from developed nations to "make good their 2009 pledge to spend $100bn a year mitigating climate change in the developing world."</p><blockquote>Five billion dollars a year is a small change — the world spent $20tn to fight Covid-19 — but the key is that this initial capital will help Africa to create much more, through new financial instruments and by de-risking resilience projects to attract private investors.</blockquote><p>Tshisekedi didn't get what he asked for, and it's obvious why he would be outraged at the hypocrisy of developed nations who have produced a vast majority of the global emissions to date, have failed to uphold their climate goals year after year, and continue to open new coal power plants and oil rigs in the face of record temperatures, famines, forest fires and biodiversity collapse.</p><h2 id="pragmatic-climate-finance">Pragmatic climate finance</h2><p>With many countries investing billions of dollars in emergent carbon removal technologies with cost curves that decline over several decades—it's clear we need to reassess our priorities with such significant sums of carbon stored in rainforests and natural habitats around the world.</p><p>The cost of preserving what we have is significantly less than restoring what is lost. We need to pressure our elected officials to finance climate mitigation and adaptation in the developing world—as these regions are the home of most of the carbon sinks we have left.</p><p>Mihir Sharma's piece in Bloomberg titled "<a href="https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2022-07-27/congo-should-get-paid-to-save-forests-as-carbon-sinks">To Save the Planet, Poor Nations Need to Get Paid</a>", is well worth a read to unpack this argument in further detail.</p><p>The Amazon is in rapid decline due to the demand for beef and leather from the developed world with over <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2021/oct/07/the-amazon-rain-forest-is-losing-200000-acres-a-day-soon-it-will-be-too-late">10,000 acres of rainforest being destroyed <em>every single day</em></a>—equating to the size of California since 1988.</p><h2 id="understanding-our-role-as-consumers-and-citizens">Understanding our role as consumers and citizens</h2><p>We vote both with our dollars and with our pens.</p><p>It's great to see the ReFi movement rallying around protecting both nature and the communities that depend on it. It'd be wonderful to see this consciousness playing out in our everyday purchasing decisions as well.</p><p>Every time we fly or eat meat it has a cost. Offsetting carbon doesn't cover the true cost of those emissions—the only way we're going to get out of this mess is by dramatically reducing emissions and migrating away from fossil fuels.</p><h2 id="learning-from-gabon">Learning from Gabon</h2><p>As we can see from <a href="https://www-forbes-com.cdn.ampproject.org/c/s/www.forbes.com/sites/kensilverstein/2022/07/24/if-gabons-largest-ever-carbon-credit-sale-works-it-will-be-world-changing/amp/">Gabon's largest-ever carbon credit sale</a> the story of preserving land for conservation and carbon credits has huge potential. Jeff Bezos visited both Gabon and Congo Basin back in June and has pledged "$10 billion between 2020 and 2030 to battle climate change and preserve nature."</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www-forbes-com.cdn.ampproject.org/c/s/www.forbes.com/sites/kensilverstein/2022/07/24/if-gabons-largest-ever-carbon-credit-sale-works-it-will-be-world-changing/amp/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">If Gabon’s Largest-Ever Carbon Credit Sale Works, It Will Be World-Changing</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Africa’s Gabon will hold the largest ever sale of carbon credits, raising potentially more than $2 billion. It is giving rainforest nations hope, and could be a blueprint for other tropical countries.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://i-forbesimg-com.cdn.ampproject.org/i/s/i.forbesimg.com/48X48-F.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Forbes</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Ken Silverstein</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://imageio.forbes.com/specials-images/imageserve/62d8505ca91733b644c1ec8d/0x0.jpg?format&#x3D;jpg&amp;width&#x3D;1200" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>“Jeff (Bezos) is very keen on Gabon,” says Gabon’s Minister of Water, Forests, Sea, and Environment Lee White, in an interview with this writer. “He was extremely engaged. We have an ally for Gabon and for the rainforests and biodiversity. The experience moved him.</p><p>Gabon’s forests are part of the Congo Basin. Specifically, Gabon absorbed 1 billion tons of CO2 between 2010 and 2018. Under REDD+ — a financial mechanism to reward countries for saving their trees — Gabon is allowed to sell credits worth 90 million tons."</p><p>"The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change evaluates that progress before approving their performance and emissions reductions. If Gabon sold its credits for $25 a ton, it would net $2.25 billion."</p><p>There is a massive opportunity to present the 30 Congo Basin plots to major corporations as the best way to execute their climate goals, uphold their corporate social responsibility and invest according to the environmental, social and governance concerns of it's shareholders.</p><p>If you'd like to help #SaveCongoBasin, it'd be great to connect you with the Redemption DAO team so you can get involved.</p><h2 id="get-involved">Get involved</h2><ol><li><a href="https://www.rainforest-rescue.org/petitions/1261/drc-do-not-sacrifice-congos-rainforests-to-the-oil-industry#letter">Sign the petition</a></li><li><a href="https://discord.gg/ZrmkcBk6gB">Join the Discord</a></li><li><a href="https://t.me/redemptiondao">Join the Telegram</a></li><li><a href="https://tinyurl.com/redemptiondao-snapshot">Pledge USDC on Snapshot</a></li></ol><p></p>
