item.title: Top 10 ReFi Grant Programs in Q4 2022! 💸 📡
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
Akshay Aditya
item.content:encoded: <div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-image" style="background-image: url(https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2022/11/Asset-1@4x-1.png)" data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2022/11/Asset-1@4x-1.png"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="welcome-to-refi-radar">Welcome to ReFi Radar!</h2><h3 class="kg-header-card-subheader" id="emintroducing-refi-radar-%E2%80%94nbspidentifying-clusters-of-important-topics-themes-projects-and-opportunities-in-the-regenerative-finance-landscape-embrbremwe-would-love-to-hear-what-you-think-tweet-us-a-hrefhttpstwittercomrefidaoistrefidaoista-%F0%9F%91%88em"><em>Introducing ReFi Radar —&nbsp;identifying clusters of important topics, themes, projects and opportunities in the regenerative finance landscape. </em><br><br><em>We would love to hear what you think! Tweet us @<a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist">ReFiDAOist</a> 👈</em></h3></div><p>It's the bear. It's winter. Everybody is feeling it.</p><p>Projects need funding. But where to look?</p><p>Let's get into it!</p><h2 id="tldr">TL;DR</h2><p><em>The infamous Gitcoin GR16 grants round has been postponed this quarter as the hotly awaited <a href="https://go.gitcoin.co/blog/introduction-to-grants-protocol">Grants Protocol upgrade</a> is being implemented. So what better way to start the ReFi Radar than with a scan of some of the other top sources of grant funding available for ReFi projects right now! With the help of <a href="https://twitter.com/thede_plandude">Akshay Aditya'</a>s <a href="https://www.notion.so/ReFi-Grants-Database-f0fbd96788bb437eb61ff02ec4ee7e23">ReFi Grants Notion Database</a>, we uncover the top 10 grant programs and provide some further context. </em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/image-37.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="600" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/image-37.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/image-37.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/image-37.png 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>Gitcoin | <a href="https://go.gitcoin.co/blog/introduction-to-grants-protocol">Introduction to Grants Protocol</a></figcaption></figure><h2 id="the-backdrop-%F0%9F%93%8D">The Backdrop 📍</h2><p>The Web2 world seems to present an almost binary choice: </p><ol><li>Open-source software (no business model, underfunded)</li><li>Proprietary tech (extractive, overfunded).</li></ol><p>Web3 provides a space and tools to experiment with new economic systems to overcome this dichotomy, of which public goods funding is an essential part.</p><p><a href="https://gitcoin.co/grants/">Gitcoin</a> has been leading the way in this domain. Since its launch in November 2017, they have facilitated the raise over $72.4m for over 11 thousand unique public goods projects, leveraging a unique quadratic funding mechanism to create a more democratic and community-powered allocation system. This has helped to fuel an explosion of new projects and initiatives emerging. You can read more about Gitcoin in the ReFi DAO deep dive and podcast here → <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-deep-dive-gitcoin/" rel="noopener noreferrer">https://blog.refidao.com/refi-deep-dive-gitcoin/</a></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://techstory.in/gitcoin-everything-you-need-to-know/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/image-39.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="554" height="273"></a><figcaption><a href="https://techstory.in/gitcoin-everything-you-need-to-know/">Gitcoin: Everything you need to know</a></figcaption></figure><p>The <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective</a> has also been a key player in the web3 climate ecosystem, providing support for many of the exciting ReFi projects building on Celo! Yet the collective is also going through a period of reflection as they prepare for an updated program in 2023. It seems <a href="https://green.filecoin.io/">Filecoin Green's grant program</a> is going through a short pause at this time of year as well...</p><p>So what to do ReFi founder? 🤔</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/image-40.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="679" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/image-40.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/image-40.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/image-40.png 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://medium.com/@ClimateCollective/introducing-the-climate-collectives-new-grants-program-2ec76b97318c">Climate Collective “Wave 0” Grant Recipients</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-white"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💬</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><em>"To date, the Climate Collective has given out 31 grants to a value of $3.7M, both independently and co-funded with Celo Foundation. Grant sizes have varied from $10K to $250K. The Climate Collective has expanded its member base recently and aligned around a new mission and vision. These new priorities will be reflected in the updated grants strategy being launched in Q1 of 2023."</em><br><strong><em>Alison Filler - Community Lead @ClimateCollective</em></strong></div></div><p>With Gitcoin and Climate Collective slowing down in Q4, combined with tough macroeconomic conditions, many projects are wondering how to stay afloat! </p><p>Fear not! Lets get into some of the other sources of funding available... 🤑</p><hr><h1 id="top-10-grant-programs-for-refidec-2022">Top 10 Grant Programs for ReFi - Dec 2022</h1><p><em>Grant programs have been selected from the </em><a href="__GHOST_URL__/f0fbd96788bb437eb61ff02ec4ee7e23" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em>ReFi Grants Notion Database</em></a><em> based on their focus on ReFi and the size of fund. Furthermore, before we dive in, you might want to checkout the <a href="https://alphagrowth.io/grants">AlphaGrowth</a> platform that aggregates over 120 Crypto Grants Programs in one place!</em></p><h3 id="1-future-quest-%E2%80%94-deadline-extended-to-dec-7">1) Future Quest — Deadline Extended to Dec 7!</h3><p>An exciting coalition of organiszations including <a href="https://twitter.com/0xPolygon" rel="noopener noreferrer">@0xPolygon</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/BMWfoundation" rel="noopener noreferrer">@BMWfoundation</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloOrg" rel="noopener noreferrer">@CeloOrg</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noopener noreferrer">@ReFiDAOist</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/Gitcoin" rel="noopener noreferrer">@Gitcoin</a>, and<a href="https://twitter.com/bobanetwork" rel="noopener noreferrer">@bobanetwork</a> have come together with <a href="https://future.quest/">Future Quest</a> to form a $1M Grant Pool for Innovative Climate Projects! It was due to draw to a close yesterday but <strong>the deadline has been extended to Dec 7th</strong>! Click below to apply now! 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://future.quest/submit"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-3.01.18-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1586" height="1046" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-3.01.18-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-3.01.18-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-3.01.18-pm.png 1586w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://future.quest/submit">Applications now open until December 7th!</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://future.quest/submit" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Submit application</a></div><hr><h3 id="2-givethio">2) Giveth.io</h3><p>The always open <a href="https://giveth.io/">giveth.io</a> has being providing support for positive impact projects since 2017. It's worth verifying your project to make the most of the Giveth ecosystem. Submit yours <a href="https://giveth.io/projects">here</a>!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.14.54-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="696" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.14.54-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.14.54-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.14.54-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.14.54-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://giveth.io/">https://giveth.io/</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://giveth.io/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Create a project</a></div><hr><h3 id="3-earthfund-%E2%80%94-dao-focused">3) EarthFund — DAO-focused</h3><p>Under a range of causes, projects can be listed and voted on by the community to receive a grant. Current causes include <a href="https://carboncommons.earthfund.io/">community-led carbon removal</a>! </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://carboncommons.earthfund.io/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.29.23-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1766" height="1120" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.29.23-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.29.23-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.29.23-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.29.23-pm.png 1766w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.earthfund.io/">https://www.earthfund.io/</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.earthfund.io/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Raise funds for a DAO</a></div><hr><h3 id="4-protocol-labs-research-grants">4) Protocol Labs Research Grants</h3><p>With more of a research based focus this looks like one for DeSci or blockchain infrastructure folks! Check it out at <a href="https://grants.protocol.ai/">https://grants.protocol.ai/</a></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.37.58-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1003" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.37.58-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.37.58-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.37.58-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.37.58-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://grants.protocol.ai/prog/rfp-013_cryptonet_network_grants/">https://grants.protocol.ai/prog/rfp-013_cryptonet_network_grants/</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://grants.protocol.ai/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply now</a></div><hr><h2 id="ecosystem-specific-funds-%F0%9F%A6%9A">Ecosystem-specific Funds 🦚</h2><p>Now lets cover some of the sources of funding avilable for projects building or affiliated with specific crypto ecosystems:</p><h3 id="1-prezentis-celo-community-fund">1) Prezenti's Celo Community Fund!</h3><p>Building on Celo? A new grants organization is taking over the helm of stewarding some (800,000 CELO) of the funds from <a href="https://docs.celo.org/protocol/pos/epoch-rewards-community-fund#what-is-the-community-fund" rel="noreferrer">Celo's Community Fund</a>! It is open to all Celo community members across the world for assistance bringing Education, Research and Community Tooling projects to fruition. On-chain governance can be a slow and difficult process, but this pre-approved pool of CELO managed by the Prezenti team provides a quick route to secure much needed funding! More info <a href="https://mirror.xyz/prezenti.eth/YA68v6xcVj36I3gu_j2qdAIuD7PkqMTb0g_0BX37_lg">here</a>!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://prezenti.xyz/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-6.27.41-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="725" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-6.27.41-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-6.27.41-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-6.27.41-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-6.27.41-pm.png 2324w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://prezenti.xyz/">https://prezenti.xyz/</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://prezenti.xyz/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply now</a></div><hr><h3 id="2-the-solana-foundation-grants-program">2) The Solana Foundation Grants Program</h3><p>Despite the impact of the FTX meltdown, Solana Foundation is continuing to run it's grants program—albeit, understandably they might be a bit more restricted in outgoings compared to a few months ago... Still, their milestone-based funding program supports initiatives aimed at decentralizing, growing, and securing the Solana network. For ReFi folks, Financial Inclusion &amp; Climate Change are included as categories they are interested in funding! </p><p>Also given the success of the <a href="https://lu.ma/gw29nfkz">ReFi Lisbon event at Solana Breakpoint in October</a>, we know personally there is a lot of enthusiasm for regeneration internally at the Foundation from key actors.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://solana.org/grants"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Grants | Solana: Build crypto apps that scale</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Grants</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://solana.org/favicon.ico" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">return home</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://solana.org/_next/static/media/solana_foundation_colored_logo_only.124d9acc.svg" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://solanafoundation.notion.site/Solana-Foundation-RFPs-be81db095f054b3f895e1c03de3e65fd"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.01.03-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="161" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.01.03-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.01.03-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.01.03-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/Screenshot-2022-11-30-at-4.01.03-pm.png 2290w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://solanafoundation.notion.site/Solana-Foundation-RFPs-be81db095f054b3f895e1c03de3e65fd">Solana Foundation RFPs</a></figcaption></figure><hr><h3 id="3-polygon-x-questbook">3) Polygon x Questbook </h3><p>A general grant line aimed at onboarding the next 1000 projects to Polygon with cash (upto $15k) and voucher rewards (upto $40k). Applications submission close on the 10th of Decemeber! More detials <a href="https://new.questbook.app/explore_grants/about_grant/?grantId=0xe9df1e5eafd6b1fda30ab6c518c2ce579dfd9622&amp;chainId=137">here</a>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/11/image-43.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="598" height="381"><figcaption><a href="https://lobsters.substack.com/">Lobsters Research</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://new.questbook.app/explore_grants/about_grant/?grantId&#x3D;0xe9df1e5eafd6b1fda30ab6c518c2ce579dfd9622&amp;chainId&#x3D;137" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply now</a></div><hr><h3 id="4-filecoin-grants">4) Filecoin Grants</h3><p>Two opportunities available here:</p><ol><li><strong>Filecoin Ecosystem Grants</strong>: intended to support novel ideas that advance the Filecoin ecosystem, bring significant new usage, or directly advance the Filecoin mission statement. --&gt; <a href="https://grants.filecoin.io/">https://grants.filecoin.io/</a></li><li><strong>Filecoin Foundation Fund</strong> - three themes for open request, but ReFi projects might be particularly interested in the Public education piece! See here --&gt; <a href="https://ffdweb.org/awards/">https://ffdweb.org/awards/</a></li></ol><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="640" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image.png 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://github.com/filecoin-project/devgrants">https://github.com/filecoin-project/devgrants</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://grants.filecoin.io/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply now</a></div><hr><h3 id="5-chainlink-grant-program">5) Chainlink Grant Program</h3><p>Deploying resources toward the creation of critical developer tooling, <u>the addition of high-quality data</u> (ReFi data maybe?), and the launching of key services around the Chainlink Network. Congratulations to <a href="https://shamba.network/">Shamba Network</a> for receiving this grant back in November last year to <a href="https://blog.chain.link/shamba-receives-grant-to-bring-climate-data-on-chain/">Bring Geospatial Climate Data On-Chain</a>! </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-2.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1600" height="800" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/image-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/image-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-2.png 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://blog.chain.link/introducing-the-chainlink-community-grant-program/">Introducing the Chainlink Community Grant Program</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://chain.link/community/grants" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply now</a></div><hr><h3 id="6-regen-ecosystem-fund-ref">6) Regen Ecosystem Fund (REF) </h3><p>An ecosystem venture fund aimed towards the rapid and decentralized global growth of the Regen Network ecosystem. More details here --&gt; </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://medium.com/regen-network/congratulations-to-our-community-funding-program-awardees-50c023a21d8"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-1.png 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><strong><strong><a href="https://medium.com/regen-network/congratulations-to-our-community-funding-program-awardees-50c023a21d8">Congratulations to the Community Funding Program Awardees!</a></strong></strong></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regen.network/fund/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply now</a></div><hr><h2 id="thats-a-wrap">That's a wrap!</h2><p>Hopefully we helped someone get funded this quarter as we come to a close on one roller coaster of a year. To all those builders in ReFi out there—hang tight, focus on the prize of regeneration and no matter what: Don't give up!</p><p>Climate change is the most pressing challenge of our time.</p><p>It is also the biggest opportunity.</p><p>Web3 gives us the power into finance impact with publicly verifiable proof. </p><p>LFG! 🔥</p>

item.title: ReFi on the Ground! - ReFi Spring Events 2022
item.dc:creator: Hereward McGillivray
Marcelo Silva
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Orginally published at <a href="https://www.refispring.com/blog/refi-spring-2022-retrospective">https://www.refispring.com/blog/refi-spring-2022-retrospective</a> - edited by <a href="https://twitter.com/HerewardReFi">Hereward</a> &amp; <a href="https://twitter.com/MarceloReFi">Marcelo</a>.</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/5235974a-e65d-4537-aa3b-8cb361eb9f2e/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141619.259.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"><figcaption>ReFi Barichara!</figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-grey"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❗</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><strong><a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1lPKqBWvQdYGb?s=20">The Growth of a Movement: 2022 ReFi events recap!</a></strong><br><em>Twitter Spaces discussing highlights and learnings for this year of events.</em></div></div><hr><h2 id="refi-springour-journey-%F0%9F%8C%B1"><strong>ReFi Spring - Our Journey 🌱</strong></h2><p>ReFi Spring launched in May 2022 with the mission of supporting 50 in-person events to take place leading up to April 2023 to accelerate the Regenerative Finance (ReFi) movement. Learn more about the movement <a href="https://je.mirror.xyz/S-dpms92hw6aiacUHoL3f_iAnLVDvbEUOXw7wpy7JaU">here</a>.</p><p>Our small but mighty team of four fervently undertook this task and jumped into the unknown. We could not have imagined the rapid development of the movement and the sheer range of communities that have emerged since we embarked. So far, 27 events have been directly supported by ReFi Spring, along with numerous additional ReFi events occurring!</p><p>Over the past six months, ReFi Spring has contacted and supported an international group of inspiring community builders. We wrote this blog to share information about the diverse themes of events and communities that have shaped the founding months of our project.</p><p>We started out developing open-source resources focused on providing event organizers with funding, marketing materials, speaker lists, and event frameworks. All of these resources to date can be found in our <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit?usp=sharing">Event Toolkit</a>.</p><p>Our focus from the beginning has been to target support where the effects of the climate emergency are most intense: the Global South. Given the urgency of the climate crisis and its impact on communities today, we’ve been dedicated to catalyzing new ReFi communities in this region. We will continue to do so in 2023. Let’s jump into the 2022 events by themes!</p><hr><h2 id="theme-1-engaging-new-audiences"><strong><strong>Theme 1: Engaging new audiences</strong></strong></h2><h3 id="refi-kenya"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1579813629633114115?s=20&amp;t=VHq7SY6CrXhnwd7sKxCFpw">ReFi Kenya</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/defe555f-7d26-426d-a865-000efa8b8fd5/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T140031.046.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>Kenya is widely known as a leading country regarding strong web3 ecosystem development across the African continent. However, if we look at the scope of ReFi, a leader figure emerges in the landscape. This pioneer is <a href="https://twitter.com/shambanetwork">Shamba Network</a>, a startup led by <a href="https://twitter.com/KennedyWNganga">Kennedy Ng'ang'a</a>, working to build measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) tools accessible to small farmers. This team organized the first-ever ReFi gathering in Kenya.</p><p>The event introduced local farmers to ReFi principles, developed three ongoing projects on the ground, and included onsite tree planting.</p><h3 id="refi-uganda"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1578064304418471938?s=20&amp;t=VHq7SY6CrXhnwd7sKxCFpw">ReFi Uganda</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/1c5706f5-4a3f-4a41-a714-30ee1332840b/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T140136.034.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>In Uganda’s Tororo region, a regenerative force exists at the core of the efforts of <a href="https://twitter.com/ayowecca_uganda">AYOWECCA Uganda</a>; an NGO led by <a href="https://twitter.com/j_olwenyi">Johnathan Olwenyi</a> focused on raising awareness about the climate emergency among small farmers and young generations.</p><p>More than 300 people attended this gathering, including state authorities. With the help of <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloUganda">Celo Uganda’s</a> <a href="https://twitter.com/umar_sebyala">Umar Sebyala</a> and Shamba Network’s Kennedy Ng'ang'a, this event was considered the first brick in building a bridge between local regenerative activities and the global ReFi movement.</p><h3 id="refi-peru">ReFi Peru</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/d3f224d2-4dcf-4c07-bde5-ede547442e53/perubom.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p><a href="https://twitter.com/celoperu">Celo Peru</a> Ecosystem Leader <a href="https://twitter.com/luisotravez_eth?s=21&amp;t=GpU4as-4tkKjQwnhgNc15A">Luis Carranzas</a> organized a side event during <a href="https://twitter.com/EthereumLima">Ethereum Lima</a> to present the ReFi movement to local entrepreneurs and university students. This event focused on building trust with web3 developers and providing them with networking experiences to kick off planning for another ReFi Spring event in Peru in 2023.</p><h3 id="refi-cameroon"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1577332159559471104?s=20&amp;t=VHq7SY6CrXhnwd7sKxCFpw">ReFi Cameroon</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/07510463-00bf-4f6c-88f2-f2b01e14c74a/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T140217.067.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>The first ReFi event in Cameroon brought together a female-led community to present ReFi as a way to unify social, environmental, and entrepreneurship impacts. This gathering introduced participants to the foundations of regenerative finance and explored inflation’s effects on the local community, the power of social currencies, and the adoption of mutual credit networks.</p><h3 id="refi-silicon-valley"><a href="https://www.instagram.com/p/ChFbwmkLtT_/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link">ReFi Silicon Valley</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/5455b5d8-1983-4ec1-935c-16a8919e8a4c/siliciobom.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This ReFi gathering took place in the heart of Silicon Valley in mid-August and focused on onboarding under-represented minorities into the web3 x climate space. A series of talks, workshops, and games brought together a local network of climate activists and crypto enthusiasts to discover the regenerative finance ecosystem.</p><h3 id="refi-suriname"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1595405668516859906?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">ReFi Suriname</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/fc7368d6-d16c-4e7d-acd3-677cd1fca086/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T140305.727.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>The first-ever ReFi event in Suriname, “Innovators Buzz,” connected innovative minds in the web3 space to imagine a regenerative and resilient future for the country. This event served as a catalyst, sparking a new sustainable and innovative development movement in Suriname and the broader Caribbean region. This event brought together state authorities, local startups, academics, scientists, and university students to learn about regenerative finance and discuss Suriname's strategic position in this global ecosystem.</p><h3 id="rio-crypto-hub"><a href="https://linktr.ee/riocryptohub">Rio Crypto Hub</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/78099bfd-9b96-4b57-a2d8-2d6107e899a5/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T140431.027.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>Rio Crypto Hub served as our leading partner for organizing ReFi events in Brazil. Together, their team organized three events introducing new communities to ReFi and showcasing local projects such as <a href="https://twitter.com/DetrashGlobal">DeTrash</a> and <a href="http://www.muda-oe.com/">Muda</a> to new audiences.</p><p>While ReFi Spring did not financially support the <a href="https://www.blockchainrio.com.br/">Blockchain In Rio</a> event, our team provided content and speakers for six panels on the ReFi Summit stage. Our partnership with <a href="https://twitter.com/agroforestDAO">AgroForestDAO</a> enabled us to cover the travel expenses of Founder Diogo Jorge so he could host a workshop on how to build regenerative communities on the ground and the web.</p><h3 id="regenere-se"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1580939247418122240">Regenere-se</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/c68dbec0-a683-41a7-84bb-dea34daf2fde/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T140751.086.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>With an audience composed of young members of the traditional Afro-Brazilian religion Candomblé, Muda’s event had the merit of being a gathering where people had their first contact with blockchain through the ReFi narrative, exploring Regenerative finance basics whilst learning how organizations like <a href="https://www.cambiatus.com/">Cambiatus</a> are generating new forms of community through social currencies.</p><h3 id="primavera-regenerativa-minas-gerais">Primavera Regenerativa (Minas Gerais)</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/Captura-de-Tela-2022-12-07-a-s-14.30.21.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1662" height="1272" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/Captura-de-Tela-2022-12-07-a-s-14.30.21.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/Captura-de-Tela-2022-12-07-a-s-14.30.21.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/12/Captura-de-Tela-2022-12-07-a-s-14.30.21.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/Captura-de-Tela-2022-12-07-a-s-14.30.21.png 1662w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Moving from Rio de Janeiro to the State of Minas Gerais (the Brazilian state where two <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mariana_dam_disaster">significant environmental</a> <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brumadinho_dam_disaster">crimes occurred</a>), AgroforestDAO’s Diogo organized another event, Primavera Regeneretiva, to introduce local farmers and youth to ReFi and how the movement can support local agroforestry projects.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/vMLPTzzK910bV0Ii2Abh2mYmTgeBXlZrVAW5_SjRGs-iyCr68brcjEJTTUCO-ljwRFIPk9AmzdxJjgUn36zojLRFqZMhrQwZg2-AqOnWTFYYWcSkDRLoS76vgVTjCNCGdthHH5LAwiwLGUrYyk6di2qWftgvgilrE_jXTDwc99DpRx9qMR3WDOCYtXpy" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="226" height="122"></figure><h3 id="descentraliza-bh-minas-gerais"><a href="https://artigos.banklessbr.com/p/por-dentro-do-descentraliza-bh">Descentraliza BH</a> (Minas Gerais)</h3><p>On the same day of the event in Lima Duarte, another ReFi event took place in Minas Gerais, the beautiful city of Belo Horizonte, where <a href="https://twitter.com/BanklessBR">Bankless Brazil</a> organized the event DescentralizaBH with our support.</p><p>Following the lines of the Bankless narrative, the content delivered in this panel addressed the urgency of creating an on-chain market for the de-carbonization of the atmosphere and highlighted the <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective’s</a> role in building this market.</p><h3 id="refi-costa-rica">ReFi Costa Rica</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/fe3930b0-c19e-4b2a-8524-88a672a86316/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141055.142.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This event served as the launch of the <a href="https://medium.com/cambiatus/conociendo-de-modernos-negocios-colaborativos-con-cofiblocks-88ed3ddfa88a">CoFiBlocks Initiative</a>, a new cooperative of small coffee producers using blockchain to ensure the use of regenerative practices in coffee production in Costa Rica’s Monta Verde region. A community of local farmers and web-3 natives came together to share a day of talks and workshops exploring blockchain use cases for their local context.</p><h3 id="refi-madrid"><a href="https://twitter.com/Mad_Regen">ReFi Madrid</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/49ee1e08-646c-46eb-a12a-f37400ceed7d/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141240.019.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>The “Mad Regen Gathering” event organized by <a href="https://ethix.ethichub.com/">Ethic Hub</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/lettyprados">Letty Prados</a> activated Madrid’s Regen community to come together for a weekend of planning and networking to support local regeneration projects and community development.</p><h3 id="refi-fest"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?ab_channel=SEEDS%3ARegenerativeEconomies&amp;v=m66T0Phsxkw">Refi Fest</a></h3><p>This event held in North Carolina, United States, celebrated the third anniversary of <a href="https://joinseeds.earth/">SEEDS</a>, bringing together academics, scientists, regenerators, and indigenous peoples for a full day of talks and community building illuminating the journey that is required towards regenerative cultures and economies.</p><h3 id="carbonfi"><a href="https://dandelion.earth/events/632a6f1a8a10380010acea77?cohost=refi-spring">Carbon.fi</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/510c88e8-b74d-47f2-8819-08622f941f9a/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141337.939.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This event, held during Singapore’s <a href="https://www.mse.gov.sg/climate-action-week/">Climate Action Week</a>, brought actors, organizations, and stakeholders from the sustainability and ReFi spaces together for two days of explorative talks and interactive workshops.</p><h3 id="refi-portugal"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1542795142330847233?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">ReFi Portugal</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/51ef1402-fda3-44e4-9eba-ab671c1153a5/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T085112.530.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This four-day event at the <a href="https://traditionaldreamfactory.com/">Traditional Dream Factory</a> focused on connecting ReFi protocols with land-based ventures and regenerative agriculture and agroforestry experts. Featured talks from <a href="https://celo.org/">Celo</a>, <a href="https://www.gooddollar.org/">Good Dollar</a>, <a href="https://polygon.technology/">Polygon</a>, and several others served as the first experience many local farmers in attendance had with web3 and blockchain.</p><h3 id="refi-portugal-1"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1542795142330847233?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">ReFi Portugal</a></h3><hr><h2 id="theme-2-interdisciplinary-events"><strong><strong>Theme 2: Interdisciplinary Events</strong></strong></h2><h3 id="refi-unconference"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1538810252719702016?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">ReFi Unconference</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/eea2c91f-1adf-483e-9419-727f96305964/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T090027.619.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>The first ReFi Spring-supported event of 2022 was the ReFi Unconference held at the <a href="https://www.crypto-commons.org/">Crypto Commons Hub</a> in Austria. Talks from <a href="https://commonsstack.org/">Commonstack</a>, <a href="https://www.holochain.org/">Holochain</a>, and <a href="https://regen.foundation/">Regen Foundation</a> were featured amongst many others, interspersed with many discussions around defining value and impact.</p><h3 id="regens-unite"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1571781342030864386?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">Regens Unite</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/bfa09f56-6598-4e45-a629-ca2abac09402/Captura+de+Tela+2022-11-30+a%CC%80s+18.30.44.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>The dedicated team behind <a href="https://www.regensunite.earth/">Regens Unite</a> held an event in Berlin focused on building bridges between diverse groups, web3 Regens, web2 climate tech, non-tech, science, and climate activist audiences. This two-day gathering featured an interactive, intimate, high-participation program to facilitate open discussions around building regenerative systems.</p><h3 id="planethealth"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1584916527198965766?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">Planet.Health</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/5bb5ace8-ca5c-4f95-88fd-4045d6e05be2/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T090920.691.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This three-day unconference, held at the Château du Feÿ in France, brought together two seemingly disparate movements. <em>Planetary health</em>, an interdisciplinary medical field recognizing human health as interconnected and interdependent with ecology - and web3 advocates. Experts from global health, climate, governance, technology, philanthropy, law, art, ecology, and academia discussed how blockchain technology could improve planetary health. Follow this team’s ongoing journey on Twitter <a href="https://twitter.com/PlanetHealthX">here</a>.</p><h3 id="solarpunk-wow"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1583500208352030720?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">Solarpunk WOW</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/f6088133-0bcb-4076-8995-a47fc9e9ab68/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141828.604.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This event, held at the <a href="https://www.crypto-commons.org/">Crypto Commons Hub</a> in Austria, brought together permaculture and web3 developers to participate in a hands-on permaculture workshop. Together, attendees explored applying internet of technology (IoT) and AI-backed visualization tools during a facilitated skills exchange session, all embedded in a continuous discussion about the politics and aesthetics of the Solarpunk and broader ReFi movement.</p><h3 id="refi-singapore-x-indigenous"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1577615027993022464?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">ReFi Singapore x Indigenous</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/05952d32-0212-4a8c-a1c9-81a75da078a5/chinezinmanero.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>This event brought together indigenous community representatives to explore creating an inclusive framework for responsible planet stewardship. Discussions featured questions such as how to generate a shared understanding of the measurement of hyper-local ecological and social capital and how to approach the inclusion of second-order spiritual impacts and indigenous commons into calculating carbon credits and other economic measurements.</p><h3 id="the-future-is-now"><a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring/status/1582378546194153472?s=20&amp;t=SUGF0spsAwTrM8Ea5bhbuw">The Future is Now</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/b48e3c79-bfd9-4592-bbd7-abe35affe704/co%CC%81pia+de+1_8inSz0XCO5qWx8xMOiGTuA+%281%29.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>Just north of Berlin, Germany, <a href="https://twitter.com/pstehlik">Philip Stehlik</a> gathered a group of Regens from different parts of the world to build the basis for coordinating their projects. This gathering also served as a moment for group reflection and spiritual healing.</p><hr><h2 id="theme-3-bioregion-focused-events"><strong><strong>Theme 3: Bioregion-Focused Events</strong></strong></h2><h3 id="kolektivo-festival"><a href="https://medium.com/kolektivo-co/regenerative-finance-blooms-in-the-caribbean-b1dfef2dfa25">Kolektivo Festival</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/06d09f57-b01e-4a73-b1c1-863b64a846e5/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141449.099.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>On the island of Curaçao, next to the coast of Venezuela, <a href="https://www.kolektivo.network/">Kolektivo</a> organized a ReFi event to bring together global and local ecosystem representatives. This event served as the largest ReFi-only event of the year, with 700+ attendees. Attendees gathered to participate in different workshops and build bridges between their projects.</p><h3 id="refi-barichara"><a href="https://twitter.com/SevNightingale/status/1579715211824889857">ReFi Barichara</a></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62c1ab2e724bdb47d13cf746/d177d9c8-00ae-4024-a5d9-a3f18a21f247/Untitled+design+-+2022-12-01T141659.044.png?format=2500w" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675"></figure><p>Just before <a href="https://schellingpoint.gitcoin.co/">Schelling Point Bogotá</a> and <a href="https://sbs.tech/">Sustainable Blockchain Summit</a>, several ReFi ecosystem representatives gathered in a small city eight hours from Bogotá to learn from locals about the regeneration of the Barichara bioregion. During the four-day event, attendees visited projects aimed at different fields of regeneration: land, forest, social tissue, and water. Stay updated with this project’s development by following them on Twitter <a href="https://twitter.com/cognitivepolicy">here</a>.</p><hr><h2 id="its-been-a-pleasure-%F0%9F%92%9A">It's been a pleasure 💚</h2><p>The first season of ReFi Spring events has brought together ~2500 attendees across 20+ countries. Our team is thrilled to see a diverse range of communities and projects taking off as we collectively explore and define this growing movement, bursting at the seams with talented humans striving to explore web3 pathways to enable communities to build a regenerative economy. ReFi Spring will return in January 2023 in preparation for the next season of local events! We are very excited about the communities that have been born, the communities to come, and the conversations that will arise. Follow our ongoing developments on <a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring">Twitter</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-spring">LinkedIn</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/refispring/">Instagram</a>.</p>

item.title: Impact DAO book out now!
item.dc:creator: Deepa Chaudharz
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hello ReFi Nation 👋 In this community update we share an exciting new resource for those interested in the world of Impact DAOs + some calls to action to rally behind. Lets dive in.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-grey"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❗</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><strong>Already part of an Impact DAO?</strong><br><em>We need your help! <a href="https://mobile.twitter.com/impactdaos">Impact DAO Media</a> is collecting candidates for an updated map of the <u>real</u> impact DAO landscape - fill out this short form to register an organisation and get featured in media updates + press: <a href="https://t.co/viLJbS3lDu">https://forms.gle/wceWx72n53f6LgW89…</a></em></div></div><h2 id="setting-the-scene-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Setting the Scene 🌱</h2><p>Web3 is more than the mainstream narrative portrays it to be. For many builders, it’s not about building a better portfolio but building a better world. Nonetheless, mainstream perception is shaped by mainstream media. This book is an attempt to share a different side of story that remains largely untold and unheard, but is already beginning to shape the future.</p><p>The origins of this book can be traced to the founding of <a href="https://twitter.com/Ukraine_DAO">Ukraine DAO</a> - an organization that seemingly appeared out of nowhere and raised $7 million from 3000 people on the internet thanks to the power of cryptocurrency. The initiative was entirely volunteer-run and made use of almost every web3 tool available to raise funds for Ukrainians suffering the effects of the Russian invasion. The speed at which the DAO was formed and the effectiveness of its execution demonstrated a new, practical way of achieving ambitious goals for the benefit of a large number of people. Individuals combining in cyberspace and around a shared purpose to solve societal-level problems.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-16.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1200" height="630" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/image-16.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/image-16.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-16.png 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://www.freethink.com/society/dao-ukraine">DAO raises millions of dollars in crypto to support Ukraine</a></figcaption></figure><p>We live in a time when the world is facing unprecedented global challenges that require radical new thinking and fundamental change. Web3-enabled collectives called 'ImpactDAOs' have the potential to become the norm in helping to solve problems in almost every order of magnitude. </p><h2 id="all-about-impact-daosout-now-%F0%9F%8E%89">All About Impact DAOs - Out Now 🎉 </h2><p>Wherever you come from, or whatever causes you care about, there is likely already an ImapctDAO out there for you. If you want to understand more about the space or get more invovled, the definitive guide to Impact DAOs by the amazing <a href="https://twitter.com/deeparocks">Deepa Rocks</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/impactdaos">ImpactDAO Media</a> is out now. If you’re a complete newbie to the space, or a seasoned Web3 builder, this free online book has insights for all:</p><ul><li><strong>Getting started</strong>: <a href="https://impactdaos.xyz/posts/2-what-is-a-dao">What is a DAO?</a>, <a href="https://impactdaos.xyz/posts/3-what-is-impactdao">What is an Impact DAO</a> &amp; <a href="https://cryptogood.substack.com/p/impact-daos-nonprofits">Why Impact DAOs &gt; Nonprofits</a></li><li><strong>Diving in</strong>: <a href="https://impactdaos.xyz/posts/4-12-case-studies">Impact DAO Case Studies</a> + <a href="https://impactdaos.xyz/posts/5-learnings-and-analysis">Learnings &amp; Analysis</a></li><li><strong>Moving Forward</strong>: <a href="https://impactdaos.xyz/posts/6-daos-and-the-future">Impact DAOs and the Future</a></li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/Screenshot-2022-12-08-at-4.59.47-pm.png" width="1222" height="486" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/Screenshot-2022-12-08-at-4.59.47-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/Screenshot-2022-12-08-at-4.59.47-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/Screenshot-2022-12-08-at-4.59.47-pm.png 1222w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/telegram-cloud-photo-size-1-4940983137152904219-y.jpg" width="900" height="1200" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/telegram-cloud-photo-size-1-4940983137152904219-y.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/telegram-cloud-photo-size-1-4940983137152904219-y.jpg 900w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><a href="https://impactdaos.xyz/">https://impactdaos.xyz/</a></figcaption></figure><h2 id="calls-to-action">Calls to Action</h2><ol><li>Register your impact DAO: <a href="https://t.co/viLJbS3lDu">https://forms.gle/wceWx72n53f6LgW89…</a></li><li>Contribute to the development of the book. The book is stored as a <a href=" https://twitter.com/deeparocks/status/1597371855958310913?s=46&amp;t=D5EQJHIyztoEPm3pLq6NNw">repo on Github</a> to allow for easy collaborative auto updates to the rapidly evolving knowledge on Impact DAO.</li><li>Show some love to <a href="https://twitter.com/deeparocks">Deepa Rocks</a> for all this amazing research and go subscribe to her <a href="https://cryptogood.substack.com/">Newsletter</a>, or one better, collect her <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x53C510E1Eb08b8b0b480f1Fe51A4a2bEdbFCBc73/P0mTYzsEW-IKMoWAmJgCa3Et9uhujhgobjoBV6xBtHQ">article on Mirror</a>! 👇</li></ol><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x53C510E1Eb08b8b0b480f1Fe51A4a2bEdbFCBc73/P0mTYzsEW-IKMoWAmJgCa3Et9uhujhgobjoBV6xBtHQ" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support work on Mirror</a></div><h2 id="other-resources">Other Resources...</h2><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/show/3Mpb4Kp19RU14XJVMTumhi?"><strong>All About Impact DAOs Podcast</strong></a>: Listen to authentic conversations on ImpactDAO building from founders and contributors of Proof Of Humanity, Gitcoin, Human DAO, GoodDollar, Endaoment and others</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe style="border-radius: 12px" width="100%" height="152" title="Spotify Embed: All About Impact DAOs" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen allow="autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; fullscreen; picture-in-picture" loading="lazy" src="https://open.spotify.com/embed/show/3Mpb4Kp19RU14XJVMTumhi?si=pWLDzwHWQX-TGYHlmesoCQ&utm_source=oembed"></iframe></figure><ul><li><strong><a href="https://store.gitcoin.co/products/impactdao-book-digital-edition">ImpactDAOs book by Kevin Owocki</a> </strong>(The first book on Impact DAOs)</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://store.gitcoin.co/products/impactdao-book-digital-edition"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/image-12.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1221" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2022/12/image-12.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2022/12/image-12.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2022/12/image-12.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2022/12/image-12.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://store.gitcoin.co/products/impactdao-book-digital-edition">https://store.gitcoin.co/products/impactdao-book-digital-edition</a></figcaption></figure>

item.title: RECs Renaissance with Arkreen, Jasmine Energy & Reneum Institute
item.dc:creator: Phaedrus
item.content:encoded: <p>This week on the <a href="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast">ReFi Podcast</a>, your host John holds first live ReFi Podcast on Twitter Spaces! He is joined by ReFi pioneers Brianna, co-founder and CEO at <a href="https://reneum.com/">Reneum</a>; Dalton, co-founder and CPO at <a href="https://www.jasmine.energy/">Jasmine Energy</a>; and Karl, head of commuity growth at <a href="https://arkreen.com/">Arkreen</a>. </p><p>With a total audience of 244 listeners from across the ReFi Nation, they take a deep dive into the world of Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) - which are certificates issued by a government agency to a power-producing company that utilizes environmentally-friendly methods to generate electricity.</p><p>If you weren't able to tune in live, you can check out the <a href="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/episodes/RECs-Renaissance-with-Arkreen--Jasmine-Energy--Reneum-Institute-e1s65gc">full Season Two, Episode 20 here</a> on Anchor.fm, or find it on your favourite podcast platform. </p><p>You can also play back the entire conversation via YouTube right here:<br></p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/A7MiGu_q3-s?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen title="ReFi S2E20: RECs Renaissance with Arkreen, Jasmine Energy &amp; Reneum Institute"></iframe></figure><h3 id="links"><br>Links:</h3><p>Follow Brianna,Co-Founder, CEO at Renuem:</p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/briannaleewelsh">https://twitter.com/briannaleewelsh</a> | <a href="https://reneum.com/">https://reneum.com/</a></p><p>Follow Dalton, Co-Founder, CPO at Jasmine Energy: <a href="https://twitter.com/TDaltonC">https://twitter.com/TDaltonC</a> | <a href="https://www.jasmine.energy/">https://www.jasmine.energy/</a> </p><p>Follow Karl, Head of Commuity Growth at Arkreen: <a href="https://twitter.com/karljweaver1">https://twitter.com/karljweaver1</a> | <a href="https://arkreen.com/ ">https://arkreen.com/ </a></p>

item.title: Bear means BUIDL w/ Jahed from Cerulean Ventures
item.dc:creator: Phaedrus
item.content:encoded: <p>What better time to 'BUIDL' than in a bear market. In Season 2, Episode 21 of the <a href="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast">ReFi Podcast</a>, your host John sits down with Jahed Momand, co-founder of <a href="https://cerulean.vc/">Cerulean Ventures</a> for a deep-dive into his experience with prior market cycles, and insights funding projects operating at the intersection of Climate &amp; Web3.</p><p>Cerulean Ventures is an investment firm that believes natural assets will unlock the next $50 trillion in growth, while incentivizing the regeneration of Earth through new coordination technologies. They focus on the ecosystems in <a href="https://cosmos.network/">Cosmos Network</a> and <a href="https://www.regen.network/">Regen Network</a>, but invest actively outside it, as we believe the value unlocked by interblockchain communication (IBC) and other infrastructural innovations will rapidly scale climate impact through user-focused web3 tools.</p><p>You can <a href="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/episodes/Bear-means-BUIDL-with-Jahed-from-Cerulean-Ventures-e1sbn9d">check out the full episode here</a>, or on your podcast platform of choice.</p><p>We also have you covered if you'd like to dive into the conversation in video format here too:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card kg-card-hascaption"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/QrwID5EQ60o?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen title="ReFi Podcast S2E21: Bear means BUIDL with Jahed from Cerulean Ventures"></iframe><figcaption>ReFi Podcast Season 2, Episode 21</figcaption></figure><h2 id="resources">Resources</h2><p>Follow Jahed: on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jahedmomand/">Linked In</a>;</p><p>Follow Cerulean Ventures: on <a href="https://mobile.twitter.com/cerulean_xyz">Twitter</a>; <a href="https://cerulean.vc/">Website</a>.</p>

item.title: Meet Sepandar Kamvar from Celo & Mosaic
item.dc:creator: Phaedrus
item.content:encoded: <p>This week on the <a href="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast">ReFi Podcast</a>, your hosts John and Simar are joined by Sepandar Kamvar. Sep is the co-founder of <a href="https://celo.org/">Celo</a>, which positions itself as a decentralized, open source, mobile-first platform helping to build a carbon-negative financial system that creates the conditions of prosperity for all.</p><p>During the episode, Sep shares his own background before guiding us on a fascinating exploration of what fungal mycelium networks have to do with web3, the stories we tell with technologies like blockchain, and the future of money.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-green"><div class="kg-callout-text">"The blockchain reminds us that money is just a technology, but money has always been a technology, which can change..."</div></div><p>If you're at all curious about the possibilities of Regenerative Finance, or on your own journey toward a more sustainable future, you'll no doubt find fresh inspiration from the stories Sep has to share.</p><p><a href="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/episodes/Sep-Kamvar-from-Celo--Mosaic-e1sgi2d">Listen to the entire conversation here</a>, or on your favourite podcasting platform.</p><p>Or you can check out the full episode right here in video format as well:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/8QSa3Si0pCs?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen title="ReFi Podcast S2E22: Sep Kamvar from Celo &amp; Mosaic"></iframe></figure><h2 id="resources">Resources</h2><p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sdk12345/">Sep on LinkedIn</a></p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/CeloOrg">Celo Twitter</a></p><p><a href="https://celo.org/">Celo Website </a></p>

item.title: ReFi Roundup #47: ReFi Spring Season 2 & ReFi Villages 🛖🌿🌐
item.dc:creator: Hereward McGillivray

item.title: ReFi Villages + How to Build One! 🌱🛖 🌐
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hello ReFi Nation, <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty</a> here with a community update 👋 </em></p><p>On Friday we published a new <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0">ReFi DAO Mirror</a> article introducing the concept of a '<a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/ye6fI3GDY2FJA6mNbxru2L_97OjMalhdbVjKOunq2EI">ReFi Village</a>' as the next evolution of eco-community living. Empowered by Web3 technologies, we think they present a scalable on-the-ground solution to the global challenges we face today - 'The Regen Network State'. If you haven't already, check out the full article below, share it far and wide, or even collect the work as an NFT to immortalise the moment!👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/ye6fI3GDY2FJA6mNbxru2L_97OjMalhdbVjKOunq2EI"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Villages: Web3-Enabled Communities for People and Planet</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Hello everyone! Monty here with a cross-section of Web3, ReFi, &amp; Ecovillage experts to bring you the first article to define and explore the emerging phenomenon of a ‘ReFi Village’. We have Sam Delesque from OASA and TDF, Jeremy Agnew from Re:Build and Re:Source, Nico S from Agartha, and Charlotte F…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://mirror.xyz/icon/favicon-32x32.png" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://mirror-media.imgix.net/nft/UMYsan7npw5Xd2d94sSaD.jpeg?h&#x3D;null&amp;w&#x3D;null&amp;auto&#x3D;compress" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/Screenshot-2023-01-13-at-12.39.00-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="622" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/Screenshot-2023-01-13-at-12.39.00-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/01/Screenshot-2023-01-13-at-12.39.00-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/01/Screenshot-2023-01-13-at-12.39.00-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/01/Screenshot-2023-01-13-at-12.39.00-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>Led by pioneers such as the <a href="https://traditionaldreamfactory.com/" rel="noreferrer">Traditional Dream Factory</a> — the first land-based regenerative village DAO in Europe, the ReFi Village movement is only just getting started. In order to achieve its full potential, we need to catalyse environmentalists, techies, and builders from all walks of life to take this regenerative way of living to the masses!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/Group-10.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1400" height="540" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/Group-10.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/01/Group-10.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/Group-10.png 1400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>Want to join the movement? The "<a href="https://www.treehousedao.earth/">How To Build A Regenerative Village</a>" book cowritten by 29 people is live today! Check it our below and take a leap towards a radically better way of living in harmony with the earth and each other. + If you happen to be in Lisbon, there is a book launch event today at <strong><a href="https://goo.gl/maps/wCsKCSQbN79tQRZE7">Crew Hassan, 8a Rua Andrade</a>. </strong>👇 </p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.treehousedao.earth/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Treehouse DAO</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The web3 publishing organisation that focuses on regenerating the planet.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://www.treehousedao.earth/favicon.ico" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Treehousedao</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://www.treehousedao.earth/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Frame-6gitcoinBanner.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://www.treehousedao.earth/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/How-to-Build-a-Regenerative-ReFi-Village-handbook.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1123" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/How-to-Build-a-Regenerative-ReFi-Village-handbook.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/01/How-to-Build-a-Regenerative-ReFi-Village-handbook.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/01/How-to-Build-a-Regenerative-ReFi-Village-handbook.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/01/How-to-Build-a-Regenerative-ReFi-Village-handbook.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p><em>We hope you enjoyed this article and as excited as we are too see how it will evolve. Stay tuned for part 2 where we will dive deeper into the pioneers of this space with a ReFi Radar of top projects... Make sure to subscribe!</em></p>
item.excerpt:encoded: People are increasingly looking for ways to live that are more sustainable, resilient, and regenerative. ‘ReFi Villages’ present a compelling solution to change how we live, work, and relate to one another...

item.title: Introducing The ReFi Commons Prize 🌎🌍🌏
item.dc:creator: John Dass
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>The <a href="https://grant-explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x1b165fe4da6bc58ab8370ddc763d367d29f50ef0">Gitcoin AlphaRound</a> has officially started, and together with <a href="https://twitter.com/commonsstack">Commons Stack</a> we are raising $100k to accelerate the growth of the #ReFi movement.</em> 🚀</p><p><em>We would super appreciate any and all support: <a href="https://bit.ly/ReFiCommons">bit.ly/ReFiCommons</a> </em>💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href=" https://bit.ly/ReFiCommons" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi Commons</a></div><hr><h2 id="background">Background</h2><p>Over the last 12 months, ReFiDAO has laid the foundation for the cultural home of regeneration in web3.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/2022-12-30-5.16.42-pm.jpg" width="520" height="532" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/2022-12-30-5.16.51-pm.jpg" width="520" height="532" loading="lazy" alt></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/2022-12-30-5.16.54-pm.jpg" width="520" height="532" loading="lazy" alt></div></div></div></figure><p>Specifically, in the three months since our last round of funding from Gitcoin's GR15, we have achieved many key milestones:</p><ul><li>Supported 152 founders in Founder's Circle 02</li><li>Onboarded over 70 community managers into <a href="https://twitter.com/TheCMGuild">The CM Guild</a></li><li>Onboarded over 20 regen investors</li><li>Reached 1700 newsletter subscribers with over 15 diverse contributers</li><li>Co-launched the $1M grant pool with Future Quest, Celo, Polygon, and others</li><li>Expanded our directory at <a href="https://www.refidao.com/">refidao.com</a> to start including people, content, deals and events—all of this aimed at helping onboard more talent and capital into the work of regeneration.</li><li>Launched v1 of the <a href="https://www.refidao.com/projects-impact">ReFi Impact Dashboard</a></li></ul><p>+ much much more...</p><p>Now, we are raising money to launch a ReFi Commons Incubator and we are super excited to share it with you!</p><h2 id="theory-of-change-%F0%9F%8C%94">Theory of Change 🌔</h2><p>We believe that in order to realize a global regenerative economy, we need to fulfill three objectives:</p><ol><li>A global startup movement rooted in diverse local communities</li><li>Hundreds of radical startup experiments drive exponential impact</li><li>Global coordination between private, public and civil society organizations</li></ol><p>To test this evolved theory of change, we are partnering with Commons Stack to launch a 6-month ReFi Commons Incubator with three key objectives:</p><ol><li>Onboard new talent and capital into ReFi</li><li>Create radical startup experiments for exponential impact</li><li>Build public, private and civil society partnerships</li></ol><p>The goal is to pilot the incubator with an initial cohort of three communities and to build a regular program that incubates ReFi Commons all over the world.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-9.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1375" height="537" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/image-9.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/01/image-9.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-9.png 1375w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>Startup Incubation</figcaption></figure><h2 id="what-is-a-refi-commons">What is a ReFi Commons?</h2><p>A ReFi Commons is a founder-led impact DAO that exists to regenerate the earth through radical startup experimentation and innovation.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-12.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1000" height="446" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/image-12.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-12.png 1000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>A ReFi Commons could be created as a startup community in a specific city (Lisbon, Bangalore) or a startup ecosystem focused on a shared problem space (such as plastic pollution or biodiversity).</p><p>The models and methods of regeneration are unique to each community, but there are a few key criteria:</p><ol><li>Mission, vision, and values statements establish the commons</li><li>All funds must be held in a public treasury</li><li>Community curates governance parameters and procedures</li><li>Impact activities must be publicly verifiable</li><li>Funded startup ventures must be open source</li><li>Impact and finances are reported quarterly</li><li>Three or more founding members make a 7-year commitment to realize their mission and vision of regeneration while upholding the commons’ values</li></ol><p>The idea for a ReFi Commons takes inspiration from <a href="https://www.onthecommons.org/magazine/elinor-ostroms-8-principles-managing-commmons">Elinor Ostrom’s 8 Principles</a>, <a href="https://sacred-economics.com/">Charles Eisenstein’s Sacred Economics</a> and <a href="https://startupcommunityway.com/">Brad Feld’s Startup Community Way</a>. It is rooted in the belief that <strong>governments and corporations cannot solve climate change alone</strong>. We need a social movement that creates new economic models and provides an alternative to our extractive system.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-11.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1124" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/image-11.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/01/image-11.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/01/image-11.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/01/image-11.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="what-does-a-refi-commons-do">What does a ReFi Commons do?</h2><p>While we recognize that regeneration looks differently according to the context, we believe there are a number of key behaviors that contribute to the three core objectives of a ReFi Commons.</p><p>The key behaviors are:</p><ol><li>Hold regular meetings and events</li><li>Create shared work spaces</li><li>Collaborate with other startup communities</li><li>Build in public</li><li>Support entrepreneurs and innovators</li></ol><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-13.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1124" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/01/image-13.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/01/image-13.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/01/image-13.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-13.png 2292w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="the-refi-commons-prize-%F0%9F%8E%96">The #ReFi Commons Prize 🎖</h2><p>The ReFi Commons Prize will be the genesis cohort of the ReFi Commons Incubator focused entirely on starting ReFi Commons in strategic local communities.</p><p>It’s an opportunity for regens all around the world to submit proposals to become a ReFi Commons with the full support of ReFiDAO and Commons Stack including the strong core contributor team: </p><ul><li>Griff Green <a href="https://twitter.com/thegrifft">@thegrifft</a></li><li>Tamara <a href="https://twitter.com/tamarandom">@tamarandom</a></li><li>Liviade <a href="https://twitter.com/_liviade">@_liviade</a></li><li>Usama <a href="https://twitter.com/usama_LFC">@usama_LFC</a></li><li>Daryl Edwards <a href="https://twitter.com/daryljedwards">@daryljedwards</a></li><li>John Ellison <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">@climateXcrypto</a></li></ul><p>The first three ReFi Commons will be selected by a community-led governance process, implemented over the following six months, and culminate in the launch of new governance tokens. More details to come... 👀</p><p>The expectation is for each ReFi Commons to participate in the global ReFiDAO community and to provide a critical onramp of talent and capital to accelerate impact for people and the planet.</p><h2 id="thank-you">Thank you!</h2><p>We have been so grateful to everyone in this community for their incredible support over the last 12 months 💚💚💚 We will continue to steward the funds received with maximum capital efficiency, respecting the long-term horizon of the challenges at hand.</p><p>We are not building this startup movement for this cycle, or for next, but to see a global regenerative economy—and beyond.</p><p>If you share this vision, we would be super grateful for any and all support: <a href="https://bit.ly/ReFiCommons">bit.ly/ReFiCommons</a> 🙏</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href=" https://bit.ly/ReFiCommons" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi Commons</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/image-14.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="500" height="500"></figure><p>Peace xx ✌️</p><hr>
item.excerpt:encoded: A new joint venture between ReFiDAO and Commons Stack will pilot a new concept across three local startup communities in 2023 - the ReFi Commons.

Did we miss any? Who will be the next generation of pioneers? Let us know <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">@ReFiDAOist</a> 🐦 + if you havn't already, make sure to check out our <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/eQ97c95DZUdLcPKM0tR_vYtQnjNha0bIZN9edOfSe7A">ReFi Roundup 2022</a> for a dive into some of the emerging pioneers of the last year...</p><p>🚨 If you enjoyed this article, we would be super grateful if you could <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/xGYS9g9TBItqW1rvBA3XQ0GxhMSXf0YSWCMuR-d58Wc">collect the post on Mirror</a> as a historic NFT and to support our work in making content like this free and publicly available around the world. We are also working to make translations of key content into every major language - lets get the word of ReFi as far and wide as possible! 🌎🌍🌏 Speaking of... 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/0U2An" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share article</a></div><p></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-grey"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">☀️</div><div class="kg-callout-text">From the <a href="https://twitter.com/0xUrbanika">Urbánika</a> &amp; <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist">ReFi DAO</a> teams, our deepest thanks to you, reader, for dedicating your valuable time into learning, experimenting, building at the forefront of the regenerative frontier. Together WAGMI</div></div><hr>

item.title: ReFi Glossary
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p>Decentralized ledgers, smart contracts, DAO’s, NFT’s, cryptocurrencies, and web3 enabled co-ops could act as potent tools for managing data, strategic coordination, and economies around regenerative projects. </p><p><strong><strong>Decentralized ledgers</strong></strong> facilitate distributed consensus, providing a source of truth and tool for governance that could enable previously excluded stakeholders to co-create and manage projects. These decentralized ledgers, when correctly integrated, could also enable us to visualize and track the nestedness of systems, understanding how local actions can have national or global ripple effects in an environmental and social context. </p><p><strong><strong>NFT’s</strong></strong> could provide a container for the data of a regenerative project, tracking social, environmental, and economic data within a specific bio-region or other area that defines a whole*system. NFT’s could represent the wholeness of places by organizing all data around one token, unifying our analysis of the place and restoring it to it’s true state. Think of an NFT that represents a bio-region, and the different natural, cultural, and economic systems that support the bioregion are represented as data streams within the NFT. Now we have all the relevant information in one place, facilitating the interdisciplinary understanding of a place’s wholeness that’s necessary for regenerative work. NFT’s could be “linked” to the bio-regional NFT to show their nestedness within the whole of the bio-region. [Astral protocol](<a href="https://astral.global/" rel="noreferrer noopener">https://astral.global/</a>) is working on this right now, in partnership with Kolektivo and other Regen web3 orgs. </p><p>Can read full article here: <a href="https://designregenerationagency.notion.site/Regenerative-Web-3-The-Landscape-Opportunities-and-Entry-Points-535eab92a7794543b46f278d66ec1522" rel="noreferrer noopener">https://designregenerationagency.notion.site/Regenerative-Web-3-The-Landscape-Opportunities-and-Entry-Points-535eab92a7794543b46f278d66ec1522</a><br></p>
