item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Nation! <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty</a> here to introduce a key initiative to create a common language and framework for ReFi, Regeneration, Ecological Assets, and more... </em></p><p><em>If the questions raised in this article resonate with you, make sure to <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin/status/1653126267032551429"><strong>join the ReFi Rabbit Hole</strong></a>. Together we will build towards answering the question of <strong>'What is ReFi'? </strong>with weekly working sessions to digest &amp; synthesis top regenerative frameworks! </em></p><p><em>Now, let's dive in </em>👇</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/What-is-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--2.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/What-is-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/What-is-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/What-is-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/What-is-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--2.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="what-actually-is-refi-%F0%9F%A4%B7%E2%80%8D%E2%99%82%EF%B8%8F">What actually is ReFi? 🤷‍♂️</h1><p><strong>What does it mean to you? What about Regeneration? And how should we measure projects in this space? 🍎🍊🧐</strong></p><p>ReFi stands for Regenerative Finance, and it broadly relates to a movement aiming to use finance as a way to support regenerative and restorative outcomes in social, environmental, and economic systems. Yet it is likely that everyone reading this will have a unique perspective as to what this actually means, and what this actually looks like in practice. This diversity is important, but at the same time, a lack of top-level alignment and shared understanding can create fragmentation and be a bottleneck for progress. </p><p>There are several key questions that continue to surface as we explore the opportunity of regeneration, namely:</p><ol><li>How can we compare carbon and other ecological projects that measure impact differently?</li><li>How can we decide what projects are classified as ‘ReFi’ as opposed to those that are greenwashing?</li><li>Is ReFi purely in the domain of environment? How should we include principles for regenerative social, cultural and economic development as well?</li></ol><p>As we see an ever increasing wave of capital, talent and attention flowing towards this space, it is increasingly important that we gain some shared consensus around these questions</p><p>Let's dive in 🕳️🐇</p><h2 id="breaking-carbon-tunnel-vision-%F0%9F%94%AD">Breaking carbon tunnel vision 🔭</h2><p>In the face of a complex web of existential crises, carbon and other impact markets have the potential to be a key part of the solution. Yet carbon markets themselves face a number of fundamental challenges currently hindering their impact and growth - opacity, misinformation, extraction, fragmentation and the resulting lack of trust - to name a few... Furthermore, it is abundantly clear that carbon remains <em>only one</em> part of the challenge. Holistic approaches are desperately needed to tackle biodiversity loss, growing inequality, and a range of other social, environmental and economic challenges.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/ReFi--Regeneration---Carbon-Tunnel-vision---Jan-Konietzko-graphic-adapted-2.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/ReFi--Regeneration---Carbon-Tunnel-vision---Jan-Konietzko-graphic-adapted-2.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/ReFi--Regeneration---Carbon-Tunnel-vision---Jan-Konietzko-graphic-adapted-2.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/ReFi--Regeneration---Carbon-Tunnel-vision---Jan-Konietzko-graphic-adapted-2.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/ReFi--Regeneration---Carbon-Tunnel-vision---Jan-Konietzko-graphic-adapted-2.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Adaption from Dr. Jan Konietzko's <a href="https://geoffebbs.com/carbon-tunnel-vision-and-degrowth-58061f63e9fc?ref=blog.refidao.com">Carbon Tunnel Vision</a> (2021)</figcaption></figure><p>This beckons the question: How should we as a species value carbon alongside other social and ecological benefits?</p><h2 id="the-ecological-benefits-framework-ebf-%F0%9F%92%A0">The Ecological Benefits Framework (EBF) 💠</h2><p><a href="https://www.thelexicon.org/">The Lexicon</a> is a US-based NGO that uses evidence-based storytelling and strategic mobilization to build impact movements tackling our greatest collective challenges. Co-creating with a large array of academics, practitioners, and other stakeholders, they have begun the development of a framework intended to broaden definitions of carbon markets to encompass the full suite of ecological benefits - air, water, soil, biodiversity, equity, and carbon, as well as create the appropriate methodologies to measure these outcomes.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Adaption from <a href="https://www.thelexicon.org/">The Lexicon</a> (2023)</figcaption></figure><p>This holistic framework is based on the on the insight that humans are a part of — not separate from — nature. The health of our societies, economies, and all life on earth, depend on the health of our air, water, soil, biodiversity, equity, and atmospheric carbon. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Ecological-Economics-2-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Ecological-Economics-2-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Ecological-Economics-2-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Ecological-Economics-2-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Ecological-Economics-2-1.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Adaption from <a href="https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-45843-0_5">The Promise and Pitfalls of Ecosystem Services Classification and Valuation</a> (Flood et al., 2020)</figcaption></figure><p>Building a framework is one thing, but how do we gain collective institutional and community adoption behind it? What if the framework breaks in certain use cases or is not fulfilling the needs of all its stakeholders? How might we further extend or develop the framework and combine it with other concepts of regeneration?</p><h2 id="the-activation-process-%E2%9C%85">The Activation Process ✅</h2><p>Over the past four years, supported in part by Google, the Lexicon has been developing an award winning activation process. Activators are highly-structured outcome-focused initiatives that are conducted with a diverse set of stakeholders, value chains, and domain experts. The aim is to accelerate the transformation of good ideas into industry-aligned tools and intelligence.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/image-41.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1928" height="1926" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/image-41.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/image-41.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/image-41.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/image-41.png 1928w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Now, The Ecological Benefits Framework Acitvator is in progress. Experts across intersecting value chains are being mobilized across 5 workstreams.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Ecological-Benefits-Activator-Workstreams-2-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" expand on this work, identify the principles and practices that directly enable outcomes, and apply it in up to 25 case studies to show how it can be applied in the real world. __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Expanding-The-Framework-for-Ecological-Benefits-2.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>In order to create maximum impact, we must individually and collectively work to align diverse sectors and stakeholders in support of building and adopting these common language &amp; frameworks.. The more thought-leading people and organizations that join this process the better!</p><p><em>If you want to support this work, consider donating to the EBF Gitcoin Grant 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x421510312c40486965767be5ea603aa8a5707983/0x421510312c40486965767be5ea603aa8a5707983-81"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-11.01.15-am.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1986" height="1106" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-11.01.15-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-11.01.15-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-11.01.15-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-11.01.15-am.png 1986w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x421510312c40486965767be5ea603aa8a5707983/0x421510312c40486965767be5ea603aa8a5707983-81">Support the EBF in the Gitcoin Climate Solutions Round</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x421510312c40486965767be5ea603aa8a5707983/0x421510312c40486965767be5ea603aa8a5707983-81" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support the EBF</a></div><p>Continuing this work, what might a shared language and framework look like for ReFi?</p><h2 id="the-refi-dao-view-%F0%9F%94%B5">The ReFi DAO View 🔵</h2><p>ReFi DAO's mission is to realize a global regenerative economy. In order to get there, we aim to support the emergence of a flourishing Regenerative Finance ecosystem with an ever growing network of talent, capital and innovation. As such, we have been maintaining a growing knowledge graph of the ReFi Ecosystem, including people, content, events, and over 600+ ReFi organizations. You can read more about this in the thread below 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">Today, I would like to introduce a key tool for helping to coordinate a symphony of regeneration:<br><br>The ReFi Knowledge Graph &amp; ReFi DAO Web-App.<br><br>❗️ We are currently in Alpha mode but let&#39;s dive into some key features and ideas 👇<br><br>/5 <a href="https://t.co/h0yLW5A41x">pic.twitter.com/h0yLW5A41x</a></p>&mdash; Monty Merlin Bryant 🧙✨ (@MontyMerlin) <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin/status/1642563630041563136?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">April 2, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script> </figure><p>Yet as our database has continued to grow, we have been asking ourselves: </p><ul><li>What actually is ReFi?</li><li>How should we determine which projects are actually classified as ReFi? </li><li>How might we distinguish and evaluate organizations according to their regenerative credentials and impact?</li></ul><p>We are only at the beginning of exploring these questions - in-depth exploration and analysis with a wide array of stakeholders is needed... But thanks to some brilliant thought-leaders, here is a work-in-progress model so far:</p><h3 id="1-regeneration-grows-resource-capacity-over-the-long-term">1) Regeneration <u>grows resource capacity</u> over the long term</h3><p>Regenerative systems have the capacity to continuously renew themselves, they are able to sustainably build resource capacity and adapt to changing conditions.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi---From-sustainable-to-regenerative.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi---From-sustainable-to-regenerative.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi---From-sustainable-to-regenerative.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi---From-sustainable-to-regenerative.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi---From-sustainable-to-regenerative.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Adapted from Bill Reed (2007) - <a href="https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/09613210701475753">Shifting from ‘sustainability’ to regeneration</a></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi-3.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1123" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi-3.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi-3.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi-3.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Growing-Resource-Capacity-with-Regenerative-Systems---ReFi-3.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Shout out to <a href="https://twitter.com/owocki">Kevin Owocki</a> and the <a href="https://greenpill.party/#book">Green Pill Book</a>!</figcaption></figure><blockquote class="kg-blockquote-alt">What does this look like when applied to social, environmental, and economic systems?</blockquote><h3 id="2-regeneration-is-holistic">2) Regeneration is Holistic</h3><p>Concepts surrounding regeneration have existed and evolved over many decades. Amazing work such as John Fullerton's <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLnRRKS74ro">Eight Principles of Regenerative Economics</a>, Dr. Leah Gibbon's <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/publication/340304867_Moving_Beyond_Sustainability_A_Regenerative_Community_Development_Framework_for_Co-creating_Thriving_Living_Systems_and_Its_Application">Regenerative Community Development Framework</a>, and much more, has shown how principles of regeneration can be applied across social, environmental, and economic systems. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1124" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Shout out to <a href="https://www.catalist.network/framework/regenerative-whole-systems-design-1647141730174x538252437817307460">Regenerative Whole Systems Design</a> By <a href="https://www.villagelab.net/">VillageLab</a>, Ecological Benefits Framework from <a href="https://www.thelexicon.org/">The Lexicon</a>, and the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLnRRKS74ro">Eight principles of Regenerative Economics</a> by <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLnRRKS74ro">John Fullerton</a></figcaption></figure><blockquote class="kg-blockquote-alt">How can we further unpack and distill these frameworks? What additional frameworks should we be looking at?</blockquote><h3 id="3-regeneration-builds-wealth-across-diverse-forms-of-capital">3) Regeneration builds wealth across diverse forms of capital.</h3><p>Our modern capitalist economy has become incredibly proficient at maximising for a a single variable - growth in GDP. This relentless drive is increasingly coming at the expense of our individual and collective wellbeing, as well as that of the entire biosphere. Frameworks such <a href="http://www.appleseedpermaculture.com/8-forms-of-capital/">AppleSeed Permaculture's 8 Forms of Capital</a> or the <a href="https://www.metaintegral.com/">MetaImpact Framework's 10 Types of Capital</a> build a model for understanding a more holistic view of the meaning of wealth and capital.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi-1.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1126" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi-1.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Shoutout to <a href="https://twitter.com/gregory_landua">Gregory Landua</a> &amp; <a href="http://www.appleseedpermaculture.com/8-forms-of-capital/">AppleSeed Permaculture</a></figcaption></figure><blockquote class="kg-blockquote-alt">How might we regenerate the capacity of many types of capital simultaneously? </blockquote><h3 id="4-web3-is-powerful-technology-to-enable-regenerative-finance-refi">4) Web3 is powerful technology to enable Regenerative Finance (ReFi)</h3><p>Regenerative Finance is focused on aligning social, environmental, and economic activities with the principles of regeneration. It is not inherently tied to using Web3 &amp; Decentralized Ledger Technologies, yet these tools have incredible power to support the creation of systems that can be more transparent, decentralized, and regenerative, <u>if</u> they are consciously designed with this aim.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><blockquote class="kg-blockquote-alt">What are the best use-cases for Web3 in Regeneration?</blockquote><h2 id="making-regeneration-happen-%F0%9F%91%B7-%F0%9F%8F%97%EF%B8%8F-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Making Regeneration Happen 👷 🏗️ 🌱</h2><p>Going from theory to practice, how will we actually make regeneration happen? </p><p><strong><em>--&gt; We need to build these new systems. We need to mobilize billions of people. We need to invest trillions of dollars. </em></strong></p><p>And thus we arrive as to what I believe is the core of the purpose of ReFi:</p><p><em><strong>--&gt; </strong></em><strong><em>To design &amp; build regenerative social, economic, and environmental systems, <u>channel people &amp; resources into them,</u> and create wealth across the diverse forms of capital.</em></strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/The-Role-Of-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--1.gif" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/The-Role-Of-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--1.gif 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/The-Role-Of-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--1.gif 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/The-Role-Of-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--1.gif 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/The-Role-Of-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--1.gif 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>But how can we actually evaluate whether the systems being built are indeed regenerative? How can we measure and compare projects?</p><h3 id="refi-ratings">ReFi Ratings</h3><p>Last year, together with <a href="https://www.prime.xyz/">Prime DAO</a> and <a href="https://simbiotica.finance/">Simbiotica Finance</a>, ReFi DAO helped to launch the '<a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-deep-dive-refi-rate-athon/">ReFi Rate-athon</a>'. The aim was to start evaluating the wealth of projects coming into the ecosystem while also rewarding researchers for their analysis.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-27-at-1.54.42-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1994" height="1118" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-27-at-1.54.42-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-27-at-1.54.42-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-27-at-1.54.42-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-27-at-1.54.42-pm.png 1994w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>ReFi Ratings Dashboard <a href="https://www.prime.xyz/prime-rating-app-refi">https://www.prime.xyz/prime-rating-app-refi</a></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-deep-dive-refi-rate-athon/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Rate-athon is Underway!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">ReFi DAO is halfway through the ReFi Rate-athon, a partnership with Prime DAO and Impacta Finance to help build trust in the ReFi space and encourage capital to flow to high-integrity projects. By creating an open framework for evaluation and rewarding researchers for their analysis—we hope to help…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Jeremy Agnew</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2022/12/Screenshot-2022-06-03-at-09.49.21.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.prime.xyz/prime-rating-app-refi" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">View ReFi Ratings Dashboard</a></div><p>The analysis was conducted using a <a href="https://primerating.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/QmZMxcG6P7eiCFBhs2dg67xMLNfBaq5Aa4SYUBzaNcnxUm">score-card to evaluate key metrics</a> such as Team, Traction, Tokenomics &amp; Governance, as well as the Impact Proposition and Real-World Impact on the ground.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.13-am.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1380" height="358" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.13-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.13-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.13-am.png 1380w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.26-am.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1422" height="770" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.26-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.26-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-28-at-11.52.26-am.png 1422w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://primerating.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/QmZMxcG6P7eiCFBhs2dg67xMLNfBaq5Aa4SYUBzaNcnxUm " class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">View Full ReFi Ratings Methodology </a></div><p>This methodology is a great version 1, but is it missing a more holistic and detailed view of regeneration? How could we start to evaluate projects, systems, &amp; organizations according to their alignment with the principles of regeneration and the creation of diverse forms of capital? </p><p>Impact Advisor &amp; PhD researcher <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ktlbennett/">Kate Bennett</a> is doing some awesome work exploring these questions. She is developing a 'ReFi Score' that aims to distinguish 'High-Impact ReFi' from 'Low-Impact DeFi' from straight up greenwashing. More on this coming soon! 👀</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--social--economic--and-environmental-systems.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--social--economic--and-environmental-systems.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--social--economic--and-environmental-systems.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--social--economic--and-environmental-systems.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/04/Regenerative-Finance--ReFi--social--economic--and-environmental-systems.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption>Shout out to <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ktlbennett/">Kate Bennett</a> for her awesome work!</figcaption></figure><h2 id="join-us-down-the-refi-rabbit-hole-%F0%9F%95%B3%EF%B8%8F-%F0%9F%90%87">Join us Down the ReFi Rabbit Hole 🕳️ 🐇</h2><p>To make all of this work most effective we need bring people together. We need to form a network of thought-leaders and practitioners that can help to align &amp; refine these methodologies. Together, we can create shared models of understanding and from an answer to the question <em>'What is ReFi'? </em>with wide community consensus.</p><p>Led by <a href="https://twitter.com/SevNightingale">Sev</a> of EcoLabs, <a href="https://eco-labs.notion.site/ReFi-Rabbit-Hole-a5b6546986324354bb46f90c950048cf">The ReFi Rabbit Hole</a> was an initiative set up with this purpose. Now, in partnership with the EBF activator &amp; <a href="https://bxc.network/">BxC</a>, this work is continuing with weekly working sessions to synthesize and digest leading research &amp; ideas in this domain. Come get involved! 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-groups/refi-rabbit-hole#form2" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join the ReFi Rabbit Hole WG</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="150" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GDBopifeafg?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Roadmap Overview - ReFi Ecosystem Materials Work Stream, aka &quot;ReFi Rabbit Hole&quot;"></iframe></figure><p>Furthermore, we would be super grateful if you might consider supporting <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18-243">ReFi DAO in the Web3 Community and Education Round</a> on Gitcoin so we can continue our work supporting these initiatives &amp; more 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18-243"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-12.03.49-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1980" height="1228" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-12.03.49-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-12.03.49-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-12.03.49-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-04-at-12.03.49-pm.png 1980w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18-243">Support ReFi DAO in the Gitcoin Web3 Community and Education Round</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18/0xaa40e2e5c8df03d792a52b5458959c320f86ca18-243" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi DAO</a></div><hr><p><strong><em>Please do share this article with anyone you think would find it useful, let's work together and build ReFi for generations to come! </em>💚</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/6cC4I" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share Article</a></div><p><em>Peace ✌️</em></p>

item.title: Regeneration: A strategic view 🌍 📃
item.dc:creator: Rafael Kaufmann
Nura Linggih
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hi Regens, <a href="https://linkedin.com/in/rkauf">Rafael</a> here 👋. I'm the CTO of <a href="http://digitalgaia.earth">Digital Gaia</a>, on a mission to ignite a regenerative agricultural revolution from the bottom-up, using open science and AI to empower the world’s 1 billion farmers and land stewards with decentralized tools to measure and monetize their regenerative performance.</em></p><p><em>I recently published an article on <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0">ReFi DAO Mirror</a>, diving into a strategic view of regeneration. I look into the current challenges of regeneration, introduce a toolkit for strategic regenerative investment, and provide 7 steps to implement a regeneration strategy.</em></p><p><em> Check out the full article 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/-ijUF0RfXqL1WesyFvgU8zsepyP0QeXCaJjKnwYsYzA"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Regeneration: a strategic view 🌍 📃</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">A strategic view of regeneration:current challenges, toolkit for strategic regenerative investment, and 7 steps to implement a regeneration strategy</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://mirror.xyz/icon/favicon-32x32.png" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://mirror-media.imgix.net/nft/OFfVUuv0FxdF4QYjfwtNM.png?h&#x3D;null&amp;w&#x3D;null&amp;auto&#x3D;compress" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>💡 This is a call to action for all co-designers of the future of the regeneration movement, to intentionally align our actions with the big picture. </p><p>Did you agree with the ideas discussed in the article? Is there anything else you'd like to add that we haven't covered? Let us know <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">@ReFiDAOist</a>. </p><p>🚨 If you enjoyed this article, we would be super grateful if you could <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/-ijUF0RfXqL1WesyFvgU8zsepyP0QeXCaJjKnwYsYzA">collect the post on Mirror</a> as a historic NFT and to support our work in making content like this free and publicly available around the world. We are also working to make translations of key content into every major language - lets get the word of ReFi as far and wide as possible! 🌎🌍🌏 Speaking of... 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/-ijUF0RfXqL1WesyFvgU8zsepyP0QeXCaJjKnwYsYzA" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share article</a></div><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-grey"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">☀️</div><div class="kg-callout-text">Thanks for reading! If you’re interested in evidence-based collective sensemaking, with a particular focus on global challenges – Digital Gaia is <a href="http://bit.ly/dtwins-wp">building</a> open infrastructure for it! <br><br>We’re launching a consortium to support that work, and we’d love your participation – <a href="mailto:rafael.k@digitalgaia.earth">send me a note</a>!</div></div>

item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hello ReFi family, <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty</a> here </em>👋</p><p><em>You may have heard the news already, ReFi DAO is building a network state to regenerate the earth—rooted in local startup communities all over the world. Today I want to give an introduction to a key building block of this vision: the network's digital brain... </em></p><p><em>First some background 👇</em></p><hr><h1 id="refi-dao-network-state">ReFi DAO Network State </h1><p>Over the last year, we’ve built the key ecosystem that has attracted the best founders, hosted dozens of events while also gathering dozens of value-aligned investors. In the process, we’ve reached a key insight on the model that will unlock this vision for regeneration at scale:</p><blockquote><em>We need to bring all of these pieces together to create a global network rooted in <strong>local startup communities</strong> taking <strong>collective action</strong>.</em></blockquote><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/d4b76810-8858-4014-8077-1eb39b444f4f.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1476" height="1570" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/d4b76810-8858-4014-8077-1eb39b444f4f.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/d4b76810-8858-4014-8077-1eb39b444f4f.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/d4b76810-8858-4014-8077-1eb39b444f4f.jpg 1476w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/vrYtvutT7Q4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Regenerate Earth: A Global Startup Movement | #ReFi Commons Prize"></iframe></figure><p>These local startup communities will have a mandate to acquire land and other real-world assets as a sandbox for a regenerative economy. These will be independent organizations connected to a global online community via the reserve asset of $REFI and the shared vision and values of regeneration.</p><p>In other words: ReFi DAO is building a new nation to realize a regenerative economy. Unlike nation states, this network state has no capital building, no headquarters—but rather exists in a decentralized network of embassies in the key startup ecosystems around the world.</p><h2 id="an-accelerant-for-regeneration">An accelerant for regeneration</h2><p>We do not exist in <em>opposition</em> to other nations, rather as an <em>accelerant</em> to realize a <em>just transition</em> to a net zero economy by 2050. We will be an ally to local governments who are actively trying to navigate how to mitigate and adapt to climate change and other systemic challenges.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/network-state-architecture.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="1280" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/network-state-architecture.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/network-state-architecture.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/network-state-architecture.jpg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="this-is-not-about-creating-new-boundaries">This is not about creating new boundaries</h2><p>Our ambition to acquire land is not to create new borders but to demonstrate the power of mission-driven communities, cutting-edge technology and regenerative economics to solve the most pressing challenges of our time. </p><p>In order to successfully launch a nation in the cloud, one that is geographically dispersed and yet highly connected, key questions remain: how will we build and maintain shared collective intelligence? How do we propagate regenerative culture, ideas, and insights? How do we coordinate value to those activities that have the greatest impact on the ground? Today, I would like to introduce a key tool for coordinating this symphony of regeneration: The ReFi DAO Knowledge Graph.</p><hr><h1 id="refidaocomalpha">ReFiDAO.com - Alpha </h1><p>With the new alpha version of <a href="ReFiDAO.com">ReFiDAO.com</a> live in production, let's dive into some of it's key features and plans for the future...</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-12.38.11-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1038" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-12.38.11-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-12.38.11-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-12.38.11-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-12.38.11-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/">https://www.refidao.com</a></figcaption></figure><h2 id="refi-dao-media-%F0%9F%8E%99%EF%B8%8F-%F0%9F%8E%A7-%F0%9F%8E%A5">ReFi DAO Media 🎙️ 🎧 🎥</h2><p>We are super grateful to our ever-growing community of contributors helping to share the story of Web3 &amp; Regeneration - the people, technology and ideas propelling us forward... Explore content through the <a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast">ReFi Podcast</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@refidao">Youtube Channel</a>, <a href="__GHOST_URL__/">Blog</a> and <a href="https://linktr.ee/refidao">Social Platforms</a>.</p><p>We look forward to expanding our diverse range of storytellers, and, in the process, build a family of regenerative culture brands.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/media"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.08.54-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="996" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.08.54-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.08.54-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.08.54-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.08.54-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/media">https://www.refidao.com/media</a></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.14.33-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1373" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.14.33-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.14.33-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.14.33-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.14.33-pm.png 2328w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><hr><h2 id="refi-dao-community-%F0%9F%8C%90">ReFi DAO Community 🌐</h2><p>In addition to media, local communities, events, online guilds, and working groups are forming the core pillars of the ReFi DAO community. Let's explore 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.35.43-pm-1.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="936" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.35.43-pm-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.35.43-pm-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.35.43-pm-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.35.43-pm-1.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community">https://www.refidao.com/community</a></figcaption></figure><h3 id="local-communities-%F0%9F%93%8D">Local Communities 📍</h3><p>ReFi is a global movement, yet it is crucial that local context and connection is not lost. As such, ReFi DAO is helping to facilitate the development of local communities in every region around the world. This will also form the base for new ReFi DAO local nodes to emerge, more on this coming soon.. 👀</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.22.52-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1299" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.22.52-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.22.52-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.22.52-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.22.52-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local">https://www.refidao.com/community/local</a></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/f3b595fd-b2ef-424c-9939-cd0f2801baa9.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1128" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/f3b595fd-b2ef-424c-9939-cd0f2801baa9.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/f3b595fd-b2ef-424c-9939-cd0f2801baa9.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/f3b595fd-b2ef-424c-9939-cd0f2801baa9.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/f3b595fd-b2ef-424c-9939-cd0f2801baa9.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>Note: This graphic is incomplete - new communities are forming in many other regions across the globe!</figcaption></figure><h3 id="refi-dao-events-%F0%9F%8E%AA">ReFi DAO Events 🎪</h3><p>Bringing the online into real world, ReFi DAO - in <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-spring-has-merged-with-refi-dao/">partnership with ReFi Spring</a>, is helping to host and support a growing number of events across the globe in all shapes and sizes..</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/events"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.42.13-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1922" height="1626" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.42.13-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.42.13-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.42.13-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-1.42.13-pm.png 1922w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/events">https://www.refidao.com/community/events</a></figcaption></figure><h3 id="online-guilds-%F0%9F%9B%A0%EF%B8%8F">Online Guilds 🛠️</h3><p>Connecting people and organizations around a shared discipline, a growing number of ReFi DAO online guilds are starting to take shape. Members share knowledge, support each other, and coordinate across the globe. Shout out to <a href="https://twitter.com/MilkMoney64209">Ben Birkholm</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/DanielKnez">Daniel Knez</a> here for their pioneering work setting up <a href="https://twitter.com/TheCMGuild">The Community Managers Guild</a>, watch out for more coming soon!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/guilds"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.54.01-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1107" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.54.01-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.54.01-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.54.01-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.54.01-pm.png 2364w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/guilds">https://www.refidao.com/community/guilds</a></figcaption></figure><h3 id="working-groups-%F0%9F%91%B7">Working Groups 👷</h3><p>Connecting people across disciplines and organizations, working groups emerge to coordinate around a shared mission. ReFi DAO is participating in a growing number of working groups and helping to connect people and organizations together.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-groups"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.21.20-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="982" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.21.20-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.21.20-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.21.20-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.21.20-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-groups">https://www.refidao.com/community/working-groups</a></figcaption></figure><hr><h2 id="refi-ecosystem-%F0%9F%8C%90">ReFi Ecosystem 🌐</h2><p>ReFi is an ever growing and expanding movement spanning a huge variety of sectors and disciplines. How could any individual possibly keep track of all the people, projects, events, content and more? The ReFi Ecosystem explorer aims to provide an interface for anyone to gain unique contextual insights and find their place in ReFi..</p><h3 id="databaseoranizations-people-events-content"><strong>Database</strong> - Oranizations, People, Events &amp; Content...</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/dashboard"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.49.42-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="765" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.49.42-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.49.42-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.49.42-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.49.42-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/dashboard">https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/database</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/add-data" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Add data</a></div><h3 id="dashboarddeals-jobs-map-impact"><strong>Dashboard</strong> - Deals, Jobs, Map, &amp; Impact...</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/dashboard"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.01-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="778" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.01-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.01-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.01-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.01-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/dashboard">https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/dashboard</a></figcaption></figure><h3 id="collectionsimpact-areas-ecosystems-topics-geography"><strong>Collections</strong> - Impact Areas, Ecosystems, Topics &amp; Geography</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/collections"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.17-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="855" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.17-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.17-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.17-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-2.50.17-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/collections">https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem/collections</a></figcaption></figure><hr><h2 id="knowledge-graph-through-data-weavers-%F0%9F%92%BD-%F0%9F%8C%90">Knowledge Graph through Data Weavers 💽 🌐</h2><p>All of the above is being powered by a prototype of a Knowledge Graph—a highly interconnected database that is starting to weave the digital brains of the ReFi ecosystem with key partners across impact areas, local communities, and regenerative blockchain ecosystems.</p><p>But to make this most effective, we need your help! Once you have set-up an account, you can start submitting data that is currently missing and help to steward parts of the database. We see this as a public good for the network state of ReFi DAO and the wider ReFi ecosystem. </p><p>Let's work together to build the key resource that onboards the next generation of talent and capital into the story of regeneration 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/account/sign-up" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Sign-up</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/add-data"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-3.39.17-pm-1.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1176" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-3.39.17-pm-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-3.39.17-pm-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-3.39.17-pm-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-10-at-3.39.17-pm-1.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><strong>Add Data --&gt; <a href="https://www.refidao.com/add-data">https://www.refidao.com/add-data</a></strong></figcaption></figure><p>Furthermore, we are starting to form a data weavers guild with a mission to create collaboration and interoperability with a network of other data partners. If you are a committed partner working in a specific impact area, geographic region, or blockchain ecosystem please reach out to <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin"><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">m</a>e</a> for more details! 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Become a data weaver</a></div><hr><h1 id="thank-you">Thank you!</h1><p>We hope you enjoyed this whistle-stop scrolling tour of the new ReFi DAO web application. We look forward to sharing further updates with you soon! In the meantime, we would hugely appreciate any feedback or bug hunters 🐞 🪳 🪲</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/submit-feedback" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Submit Feedback</a></div><p>Thank you SO much to all the 4k+ donors who have supported us on Gitcoin. We are putting your funds to good use and doing everything we can to solve the most pressing challenges of our time!</p><h2 id="participate-in-user-research-%F0%9F%A7%91%E2%80%8D%F0%9F%94%AC">Participate in user research 🧑‍🔬</h2><p>Lastly, we are actively looking for people to conduct some user research and usability testing, please reach out to <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant">me</a> if you would like to participate—we would be <em>hugely</em> grateful... <em>and</em> you may get a sneak peak of some more upcoming ReFi DAO alpha... 👀</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/image-13.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1202" height="1618" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/image-13.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/image-13.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/image-13.png 1202w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>Gotta love some Balaji RT</figcaption></figure>

item.title: Discover ReFi Spring’s Public Goods
item.dc:creator: Marcelo Silva
item.content:encoded: <p><strong><em>At the edges of our imagination lies a regenerative economy, a financial system that serves humanity and our collective home. Within web3, the Regenerative Finance (ReFi) movement aims to embody this vision within a new economic system. ReFi Spring exists to support its emergence.</em></strong></p><p>Note: ReFi Spring is now LIVE on Gitcoin Grant Round 15! Please consider supporting our project and donate <a href="https://gitcoin.co/grants/6243/refi-spring-2022">here</a>.</p><p>ReFi Spring emerged in what feels like the early moments of ReFi, back in October 2021, when somehow, through the magic of the Internet and the Twitterverse, a collection of Regens (some of us didn’t even know it yet) came together to hold in-person events exploring this emerging scene of projects and ideas simmering at the intersection of web3, regeneration economics, and climate action.</p><p>We quickly learned that there was a lack of resources, finance, and network for burgeoning communities to activate and explore this space. ReFi Spring has emerged to fill this gap and provide the ReFi community with community-focused public goods to enable the growth of this diverse and complexifying movement in a plural and global manner, suited to the scale of problems that we face.</p><p>As part of the still nascent ReFi movement, our work encourages an ethos of interaction, playfulness, and collective sense-making at events. We have the opportunity to generate a new form of regenerative culture, a culture rooted in collaboration and reciprocity within this emerging space. ReFi Spring’s support is not designed to enable standard web3 conference-like events. <strong>Our support enables organizers to create participatory events that generate useful outcomes for their local communities</strong>.</p><p>ReFi Spring’s support is offered through a range of “public goods” freely available to the ReFi community, including:</p><h3 id="grant-funding">Grant Funding</h3><p>Thanks to the generous sponsorship of the <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective</a>, ReFi Spring can offer funding to 50 global events leading up to April 2023 via issuing grants. Two waves of events are taking place in the Global South and Global North’s spring seasons, fitting the seasonal theme of beginnings, renewal, and growth.</p><h3 id="event-toolkit">Event Toolkit</h3><p>A majority of our public goods exist within ReFi Spring’s <a href="https://www.refispring.com/refi-spring-event-support-toolkit">Event Support Toolkit</a>. This toolkit covers topics including how to run a ReFi event, introductions to reciprocal event design, and so much more. In full detail, it contains:</p><ul><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.t3ozspll2e9f"><em>Event Frameworks:</em></a> a comprehensive set of event elements and advice that organizers can utilize to ensure that the event maximizes interaction and supports regenerative relationships and outcomes for your community. There are three frameworks currently offered focused on <a href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1sBFX71Uv3Cq52AfN45NtTgOv6K_HHcB-/edit#slide=id.p1">educational outcomes</a>, <a href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1OgSTnyQT8PR5h_iHn3Lj7eTMS6loT3t3/edit?usp=sharing&amp;ouid=104001181332227788819&amp;rtpof=true&amp;sd=true">collaborative network outcomes</a>, and <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tpuPD0tbag1Hrf7mfkoA6UwRVo7NW-5H/view?usp=sharing">hackathon project outcomes.</a></li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.riyy9xo3mecd"><em>Event Organization for Beginners:</em></a> we’ve created a simple, step-by-step process to guide event organizers in hosting a successful first event.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.w0rnysx7clc3"><em>Guide to Regenerative Culture:</em></a> we have created an introduction and guide to establishing and bringing regenerative culture to ReFi Spring-supported events.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.f2l5lddlo2uv"><em>Marketing Support:</em></a> we provide detailed, step-by-step instructions for achieving successful event marketing and ticket sales growth to help build audiences for various events.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.lj81tqvtrvri"><em>Promotional Materials:</em></a> thanks to a wonderful designer in our network, Andrei Lasc, we provide a bonanza of templates to support event organizers with social media promotion and in-person materials. All event organizers have to do is fill in their event-specific information, download the graphics, and post to online platforms.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.59xotpzhjaes"><em>Engagement Templates:</em></a> we provide tips and starting points for engaging with sponsors, event partners, and local press outlets.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.by3km99j853f"><em>Workshops</em></a><em>:</em> together with our network, ReFi Spring has developed a growing list of event content that can be utilized and delivered by Event organizers to educate attendees on ReFi and associated topics and projects.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.j9vjhthjeuku"><em>Speakers List:</em></a> our team has carefully curated a list of speakers for organizers can contact to speak at events.</li><li><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c1UYt6Kj20tNDOmYAiOTjSCFPqJymqthDFHsPJoNSS8/edit#heading=h.5r94kfvwxu7b"><em>Community Building Guide:</em></a> a collection of useful community-building tips to activate a locally engaged network of Regens.</li></ul><h3 id="event-design-support-sessions">Event Design Support Sessions</h3><p>These sessions, led by skilled event organizers and facilitators, are on ReFi Spring’s provided event frameworks. The coaching sessions will focus on generating an interactive, enjoyable and educational flow for the event. Both prospective and seasonal event organizers can attend, ask questions, and benefit from personal coaching support in planning an event suited to the organizers’ mission and community needs.</p><h3 id="marketing-coaching">Marketing Coaching</h3><p>Every event that applies for ReFi Spring support receives free marketing coaching for their event. Our team has found that effective promotion and social media tactics make a big difference in terms of successful event outcomes. This coaching will support event organizers in planning a coherent social media strategy, outlining attendee journeys, coordinating a successful sales strategy, and building coherent communication strategies and communication plans.</p><h3 id="intro-to-refi-course">Intro to ReFi Course</h3><p>This online learning course (launching later this month!) will onboard both newbies and natives into the ReFi movement. 15 units will provide a narrated journey into the ins and outs of the ReFi space. Through curating and launching this course, ReFi Spring’s aim is to make the space as accessible as possible and support prospective event attendees to have a baseline level of understanding before attending ReFi events.</p><h3 id="local-refi-%E2%80%98mappathons%E2%80%99">Local ReFi ‘Mappathons’</h3><p>In 3 bioregions this year, ReFi Spring will conduct an experimental online series of events mapping the local regulatory space. These events will conclude with creating a visual representation of interest groups and organizations with access, control, or influence over natural resources, land use, water rights, and agriculture within each bioregion. Such initiatives will help participants understand the leverage points, provide signposts for the regenerative finance projects in those areas, and generate momentum for local Refi Spring events.</p><h3 id="permissionless-ticketing-platform">Permissionless Ticketing Platform</h3><p>In partnership with <a href="https://dandelion.earth/">Dandelion,</a> ReFi Spring provides a free-to-use, permissionless platform for event organizers to sell tickets with zero fees. This platform also offers users interactive event design capacity for those that want to co-create their events with attendees.</p><p><strong>—</strong></p><p>All of these public goods are just the start of what we hope to achieve over the next several months at ReFi Spring! We’re currently raising funding through Gitcoin’s Grant Rounds 15 to support additional ReFi events and the creation of more… wait for it, public goods! Our team would like to ask for your consideration to support our grant to make ReFi accessible for all.</p><p>Donate here: <a href="https://gitcoin.co/grants/6243/refi-spring-2022">https://gitcoin.co/grants/6243/refi-spring-2022</a></p><p>Interested in organizing an event after reading this? Apply <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScDi8xCbHvVCdUbc0O6j779zE-vV07HgfX7HtZpdnqdYE97Lw/viewform">here</a>, get in touch with us on <a href="https://t.me/+x44Nc2wd4EVhNjFi">Telegram</a>, and follow us on <a href="https://twitter.com/RefiSpring">Twitter</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-spring">LinkedIn</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/refispring/">Instagram</a>. We’d be happy to welcome you to our global network of changemakers at the intersection of web3, regenerative finance, and climate action.</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Learn more about the seven Public Goods that ReFi Spring is developing, the value that these goods offer to the ReFi community, and how you can support the creation of more ReFi Public Goods through funding this project on Gitcoin Grants Round 15.

item.title: Humans of ReFi: Meet Grace Rachmany of Priceless DAO
item.dc:creator: Marcelo Silva
item.content:encoded: <p>The new Humans of ReFi blog series, part of the <a href="https://www.refispring.com/blog/announcing-the-refi-spring-well">ReFi Spring Well</a>, exists to share beautiful stories, thoughts, and advice from pioneers in the web3 x climate space to encourage more people to begin their journey into ReFi. The first feature is <a href="https://twitter.com/RebeccaRachmany">Grace Rachmany</a>, Co-Founder of <a href="https://pricelessdao.io">Priceless DAO</a>.</p><h4 id="how-we-see-the-world-makes-the-world-what%E2%80%99s-your-perspective-that-brings-more-joy-and-regeneration-into-the-world"><strong>How we see the world makes the world. What’s your perspective that brings more joy and regeneration into the world?</strong></h4><p>Lately, the perspective I’ve been taking is a Cosmos-type perspective. As Carl Sagan said: “The Earth is a very small stage in a vast cosmic arena.” From a human standpoint, what is happening now is highly significant. The current situation is catastrophic for each of us individually and as a community. But from the perspective of the sea or the planet, not to mention the solar system, it’s just another event. From the earth’s perspective, it is inconsequential whether the living creatures are dying out because of a meteor strike, an ice age, or the activities of one of the creatures on the earth. The ebb and flow of such things are inevitable. People aren’t wrong or bad for bringing the earth to this point. At this moment in time, it seems that reconnecting to the planet and other people is the only joyful option. Regenerating the earth is the most satisfying work I can do now.</p><h4 id="where-did-your-journey-in-the-refi-space-begin"><strong>Where did your journey in the ReFi space begin?</strong></h4><p>I do not consider myself someone who is or has ever been in the ReFi space. It is misguided to believe that there is a financial model that is regenerative. Finance, by definition, is the management of money. Money itself is an outdated technology that implies that there is such a thing as an equal value exchange. This is absurd. A giraffe trampling on the plains and leaving behind its waste is not exchanging value with the earth because it is also eating leaves. A mammalian mother feeding her baby milk is not exchanging value with the baby because the baby is smiling back. Regeneration is, by definition, the restoration of complex and multi-faceted systems that are priceless in essence.</p><p>ReFi has the potential to offer some value in the short term in terms of salvaging some of our environmental resources while we make the transition to a more appropriate system. I sense this is a very masculine approach, and I am not oriented that way. The systems I am working on are much-more long-term in their trajectory, looking at post-financial economies.</p><h4 id="what-was-your-aha-refi-moment"><strong>What was your AHA! ReFi moment?</strong></h4><p>For me, it was probably watching <a href="https://finnern.com/2014/07/06/wealth-a-living-systems-model/">Arthur Brock’s Wealth as a Living System</a> video. It took a while to sink in fully, but it was the start of my understanding that money is not a store of value. Another significant influence is <a href="https://www.vox.com/2018/5/8/17308744/bullshit-jobs-book-david-graeber-occupy-wall-street-karl-marx">Bullshit Jobs by David Graeber</a>. These are fundamentals that I think everyone in the industry needs to read. Most of ReFi consists of some form of bullshit job, at least because you are sitting at a desk, not really planting a tree or a garden. I would encourage everyone in the movement to take any step they can towards living a lower-impact life and planting something. If you volunteer on an ecological farm for just one week, it will change your perspective. The other fundamental podcast that I recommend is Nate Hagens’ Great Simplification. Just about every episode provides an AHA moment.</p><h4 id="what-are-the-key-challenges-the-refi-space-is-facing-how-does-that-affect-your-journey"><strong>What are the key challenges the ReFi space is facing? How does that affect your journey?</strong></h4><p>The top two challenges in ReFi are capture and ineffectiveness.</p><p>By capture, I mean, that the more money and work invested in this industry, the higher the risk of blindness. Take a look at this <a href="https://twitter.com/buchmanster/status/1582393763510378500">tweet from Ethan Buchman</a>, the founder of Cosmos, and the response thread, particularly that of the Regen Network Founder Gregory Landua, which starts with Ethan wondering whether they might not all be better off dropping the development of a blockchain and instead going out and doing work in nature. Now, don’t get me wrong. I know, respect, and love these two men. They have probably done more for the ReFi movement than anyone else in terms of the time and thought invested and the excellence of the technologies they’ve created. Ethan and Gregory are truly pioneers and heroes of the movement.</p><p>I’m pointing out here that neither of them could have an intellectually honest conversation about whether they should be out there on the land because there is too much money, time, and tech at stake. Well, at least not in public. They couldn’t have that conversation. I know them both to be thoughtful people who could have that conversation in private. But you get the picture. Anyone working in this space is making a salary they don’t want to sacrifice. They’ve raised money from people who expect them to carry on. And they live in a world that doesn’t want to hear bad news. No crypto podcast wants to interview someone who says this is all bullshit. (Believe me, I’ve tried. LOL.)</p><p>In terms of ineffectiveness, I think the biggest problem is how things are measured. Most ReFi projects are currently looking at carbon sequestering and, more specifically, planting trees. (Regen Network, which I cited above, is the exception to the tree-planting). It turns out that we don’t have enough land on earth to plant enough trees to counter the carbon emissions, so a lot of other work has to be done. It also turns out that these things are gameable. How can we be sure that the same tree isn’t counted by two different projects, for example? How can we be sure that people aren’t just cutting down trees as fast as we are planting them? The problem with carbon credits, in general, has always been the gameability of the credits. Carbon credits are a kind of symbol that represents something in the real world. In other words, a carbon credit isn’t a direct measure of the real world but a proxy for something.</p><p>The final problem with the ReFi movement is that carbon offsets allow polluters to pollute. If there were no such thing as a carbon credit, and companies were required to be carbon neutral, they would have to be carbon neutral. With the advent of carbon offsets, companies can pollute and still call themselves carbon-neutral. Said plainly, a carbon offset is a permission to pollute. All of those problems add up to ineffectiveness, which is the biggest threat, not necessarily to the industry, but to the planet. It's possible for the industry to grow and the environment to worsen. That's what's been happening since the advent of carbon offsets, so we need to be careful that we aren't just doing lip service to environmentalism.</p><p>One tiny pet peeve I have is how much travel is involved in this movement. We can’t keep flying all over the world to conferences and pretending we really care about the environment. Of all the industries, this is where we should be able to get creative about meeting in the metaverse and taking the train. You can work online from anywhere, so what’s the rush? Take the train. They’ve got WiFi and you can afford it. Do combined online/offline events. It’s a bit of a pet peeve, but I think it’s incongruous to spend your career working in this industry but not consider your own ecological footprint.</p><h4 id="what-does-your-work-focus-on-at-the-moment"><strong>What does your work focus on at the moment?</strong></h4><p>My work focuses on connectivity among communities. Right now, the connectivity is informal, either through personal connections or meetings at conferences. There is no “membership card.” There is no map of projects. There is no shared values system. It’s all very informal, and there’s a tremendous amount of duplicated efforts. Even worse, there’s a kind of competition between us. We are all supposedly on the same mission—regenerating the planet—and yet we seem to be competing with one another for members and funding. One paradigm I use is the idea that we have created all of these flotillas: how can we become an armada? ReFi is generally moving in a particular direction but not in a coordinated way, and there are rogues and Greenwashers. The connectivity tissue would allow us to share resources, coordinate, and find one another.</p><p>The most salient thing I’ve been focusing on is PricelessDAO, where we want to explore alternatives to the monetary system. This project is at the research stage, and we’re looking for funding, which is quite a challenge because the systems we want to prototype will probably only be functional two generations from now. That seems the right approach, as far as I’m concerned. Whenever I hear someone talk about “world governance" it chills me. Let’s prototype some things on a regional level, see how they work, and then expand it slowly. So many of these concepts for a new system seem to start with “if only everyone would …”. You don’t know what the right system is for everyone, and neither do I. We’ve done a great job of little experiments and now need to scale to a regional or multi-community level. That’s where my focus has been.</p><p>On our website, <a href="http://PricelessDAO.io">PricelessDAO.io</a>, we have put together a full whitepaper that describes the fundamentals of how we are thinking. For this interview, I want to outline two basics of how regenerators should consider the economies they are creating.</p><p>First of all, the DeFi and ReFi industries suffer from not having any real resources. We don’t own a chip fabrication plant, cloud servers, electricity generation capacity, food, land, or water. The banning of Tornado Cash and the subsequent transition of Ethereum to a censored network is just one example of what happens when we don’t have the ability to host our own systems. So that’s a starter. As you are creating your ReFi ecosystems, to what degree are they real ecosystems versus dependent on other systems for inputs? The more you require inputs from outside, the more you rely on the system you are trying to replace. One measure of success might be that we no longer need fiat currency, so you might ask yourself how we are moving toward that model.</p><p>Secondly, there needs to be some form of identity that allows you to know you are in the network and carry your identity and reputation. Gitcoin’s Passport has done incredible work in this direction, at least in creating a basic identity, and there are physical passports with built-in microchips from the Kong.Land folks.</p><p>Thirdly, there’s an underlying connectivity tissue missing. AI is almost completely lacking. Everyone has 8 chat apps, 6 social networks, 5 email addresses, 4 wallets, 2 search engines, and is still using Google Docs. I’ve been talking to many people about what this “network” might look like, and I’m not sure, but maybe it’s some dashboard with AI behind it, so you aren’t lost every day. The newsfeed is the closest thing I’ve seen to this connectivity network, and it’s not what we need in Web3, but I’m inquiring about what that might be.</p><p>Finally, rethinking community is essential. Hard forks and rage quits are not the way to build the regenerative society of the future. The economies I’m working on are always based on physical communities, so we can start to develop some best practices around that.</p><p>I’ll run my “<a href="https://www.daoleadership.com/future-course/">Future Ain’t What It Used to Be</a>” workshop again in December. It’s a six-week reverse-classroom discussion on currency, governance, and community design.</p><h4 id="which-other-refi-projects-give-you-hope"><strong>Which other ReFi projects give you hope?</strong></h4><p>I mentioned Regen Network and Regen Foundation above, and they are doing good work.</p><p>I have faith in projects like KinDAO, AcreDO, and PortalDAO that are looking at regenerating physical spaces. KinDAO and PortalDAO in particular have been focused on the human work of learning to know themselves and develop the skills needed to live in a community. Our individualistic paradigm needs to transform to really regenerate the earth. I also am a fan of Kong.land because they understand the importance of having control of the devices we use, down to the chipset.</p><h4 id="how-do-you-see-the-future-of-the-refi-movement-developing"><strong>How do you see the future of the ReFi movement developing?</strong></h4><p>Hopefully, ReFi will be able to evolve beyond accounting methods to measure the real impact on the earth. It would be great to see dashboards of the measures of regeneration and coordination on the ground to improve planetary health.</p><h4 id="if-you-have-advice-for-someone-who-wants-to-get-into-the-refi-space-what-would-it-be"><strong>If you have advice for someone who wants to get into the ReFi space, what would it be?</strong></h4><p>Get your hands in the dirt — volunteer in regenerative agriculture or forestry for at least a few weeks. Figure out what is really needed on the ground before you start building. Finance is highly abstract, but regeneration is on the ground. It’s profound to get a natural feeling for how much physical work goes into producing the food, electricity, and other goods you use every day. After all, the connection to the earth is why you are entering the field, so make sure to nurture that connection.</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: ReFi Spring’s Human of ReFi series shares stories from pioneers in the space to encourage more to begin their journey into ReFi. The first feature is Grace Rachmany of Priceless DAO.

item.title: ReFi Spring 2022 Retrospective
item.dc:creator: Marcelo Silva
