item.title: Top 11 ReFi Projects on Solana 🌱
item.dc:creator: Adolfo Casabal
Anna Kaic
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Top of the morning folks!</em></p><p><em><a href="https://twitter.com/Numalunah">Numa</a> here, ReFi eco-system builder and founder at </em><a href="https://twitter.com/CoralTribeNFT"><em>Coral Tribe</em></a><em>. Every day I feel inspired by purpose-driven founders paving the way in solving our world’s biggest problems. The shared goal is to design systems which regenerate our planet &amp; bring prosperity to people. Given our uncertain future, ReFi seems more important than ever.</em></p><p><em>I am also excited to announce the new <a href="https://www.refidao.com/blockchain-ecosystem/solana/r/recr490MgWnxPbYs5">ReFi Solana Dashboard</a> - built in collaboration with <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist">ReFi DAO</a> to map top people, projects, events, content &amp; more. Go check it out and submit your votes! </em>👇‌</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/blockchain-ecosystem/solana/r/recr490MgWnxPbYs5"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-31-at-11.59.38-am.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1387" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-31-at-11.59.38-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-31-at-11.59.38-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-31-at-11.59.38-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/03/Screenshot-2023-03-31-at-11.59.38-am.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><strong><a href="https://www.refidao.com/blockchain-ecosystem/solana/r/recr490MgWnxPbYs5">ReFi Solana Dashboard</a></strong></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/blockchain-ecosystem/solana/r/recr490MgWnxPbYs5" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Visit Dashboard</a></div><p><em>But first, let's explore ReFi on Solana and our selection of top 11 projects </em></p><h1 id="refi-on-solana">ReFi on Solana</h1><p><a href="https://je.mirror.xyz/S-dpms92hw6aiacUHoL3f_iAnLVDvbEUOXw7wpy7JaU">Regenerative finance (ReFi)</a> is an energetic and rapidly growing movement to create organizations in alignment with People &amp; Planet. The <a href="https://solana.com/">Solana ecosystem</a> is committed to this new wave of finance and is a growing hub for new projects.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="336"></figure><p><a href="https://solana.com/environment"><strong>Solana</strong></a> is a web-scale blockchain that is fast, secure and energy efficient. The system currently supports 4000 transactions per second and fees remain less than $0.01. With zero net carbon impact, Solana is the perfect candidate to build regenerative systems. From reforestation initiatives to blue economy investing, the <strong>top 11 Solana ReFi projects</strong> covered in this article are not just pipe dreams but have already achieved fantastic accomplishments:</p><ul><li><a href="https://www.gainforest.earth/">GainForest</a></li><li><a href="https://www.eco-token.io/">EcoToken</a></li><li><a href="https://www.rh2o.app/">Water DAO</a></li><li><a href="https://www.sunrisestake.com/">Sunrise Stake</a> </li><li><a href="https://stepn.com/">STEPN</a></li><li><a href="https://www.deentra.io/">Deentra</a></li><li><a href="https://www.enrex.io/">Enrex</a></li><li><a href="https://www.atlantians.world/">Atlantis</a></li><li><a href="https://www.de-plan.xyz/">De_Plan</a></li><li><a href="https://www.single.earth/">Single.Earth</a></li><li><a href="https://www.coraltribe.io/">Coral Tribe</a></li></ul><p>Whether you're an investor looking for ethical investment opportunities or simply interested in learning more about sustainable solutions, these projects are sure to inspire you. Let's dive in 👇</p><h2 id="1-gainforest-%F0%9F%8D%83">1) GainForest 🍃</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/GainForestNow"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="316"></a></figure><p>Imagine a world where stewardship of nature can be verified with radical transparency, and stewards are fairly rewarded for their work. That is the future <a href="https://twitter.com/GainForestNow">GainForest</a> is helping to unlock. Founded by <a href="https://twitter.com/dwddao">David Dao</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/simgesteen"><a href="https://twitter.com/simgesteen">Simge Steen</a></a>, <strong>Gainforest creates trust in nature-based donations and investment </strong>with a platform that combines the latest technology of our time - satellite imagery, drones, machine learning and more, to measure, report and verify conservation efforts. Conservation projects around the world are funded through their platform - and funds are disbursed only when conservation milestones are reached.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/RcdFn83OmUU?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="GainForest: How does it work?"></iframe></figure><p>Gain Forest has various pilot projects around 3 continents and recently completed a mangrove conservation pilot in the Philippines. Make sure to visit their website and discover all the incredible nature-based projects. 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://gainforest.app/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore website</a></div><h2 id="2-eco-token-%F0%9F%8C%BF">2) Eco-token 🌿</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://www.eco-token.io/"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="339"></a></figure><p><a href="https://www.eco-token.io/"><strong>EcoToken</strong></a> <strong>is a launch pad for sustainable projects and an environmental credit producer and seller</strong>. Founded by <a href="https://twitter.com/jamesbettauer"><a href="https://twitter.com/jamesbettauer">James Bettauer</a></a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/ranchris11">Randy Christie</a>, the project addresses the funding gap for localised impact-driven projects by rewarding those who fund them. Grassroots communities working for the planet's betterment lack a business case and funding, ecoToken solves this problem by allowing users to pre-fund upcoming projects.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/en7wLvslaJA?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Blockchain Carbon Credits and the Environment with EcoToken Co-Founder James Bettauer"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/THEecoToken" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow the journey</a></div><h2 id="3-water-dao-%F0%9F%92%A7">3) Water DAO 💧</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/_WaterDAO"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/image-11.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1207" height="661" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/image-11.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/image-11.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/image-11.png 1207w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p>An off-shoot of the <a href="https://www.eco-token.io/">ecoToken</a> ecosystem, <a href="https://twitter.com/_WaterDAO">Water DAO</a> is<strong> </strong>a decentralized platform that leverages the Solana and <a href="https://www.regen.network/">Regen Ledger</a> blockchains to address the growing challenges of water scarcity and resource management. Their <strong>verifiable water credit methodology</strong> can be issued to qualified projects and reward clean water producers. This encourages responsible consumption and investments in water infrastructure by incentivizing responsible consumption. The platform uses a token-based system to facilitate the creation of credits, which represent a specific volume of water or water-related services.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.rh2o.app/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Deep dive</a></div><h2 id="4-sunrise-stake-%E2%98%80%EF%B8%8F">4) Sunrise Stake ☀️</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://www.sunrisestake.com/"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="332"></a></figure><p>Founded by <a href="https://twitter.com/danbkelleher"><a href="https://twitter.com/danbkelleher">Daniel Kelleher</a></a>, <a href="https://www.sunrisestake.com/">Sunrise Stake</a> empowers users to direct <a href="https://www.coinbase.com/learn/crypto-basics/what-is-staking">blockchain staking rewards</a> to offsetting greenhouse gas emissions or send donations directly to impact projects taking regenerative action on the ground. Simply by just staking Solana, <strong>token holders fund carbon mitigation projects worldwide</strong> - it has never been easier to make a positive impact!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/TXr5anweDgI?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Intro to Sunrise Stake"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/sunrisestake" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Discover Sunrise Stake</a></div><h2 id="5-stepn-%F0%9F%91%9F">5) STEPN 👟</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="360"></figure><p>Founded by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jerry2046/?originalSubdomain=au">Jerry H</a>, <a href="https://stepn.com/">STEPN</a> is an awe-inspiring game that encourages a healthy lifestyle, combats climate change, and fosters community. Equipped with NFTs in the form of sneakers, users can earn game currency by walking, jogging, or running outdoors. This currency can be used in-game or cashed out for profit. In addition, they’ve partnered with <a href="https://nori.com/">Nori</a>, where <strong>a portion of STEPN's profit is used to buy blockchain-based carbon removals</strong>.</p><p>Having reached over 250K community members, STEPN is an excellent example of how technology can be used to incentivize positive behaviour and make a real impact on our environment.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://discord.com/invite/stepn" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join the community</a></div><h2 id="6-deentra-%E2%9A%A1">6) Deentra ⚡ </h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="381"></figure><p><a href="https://www.deentra.io/">Deentra</a> makes <strong>investing in sustainable energy</strong> accessible and profitable. Founded by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/mauro-bonomi/?locale=de_DE">Mauro</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/davide-bonomi-bb7b93200/?originalSubdomain=it">Davide</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/federico-bonomi-44a2a0130/?originalSubdomain=it">Federico Bonomi</a>, the platform brings together people and companies interested in building new photovoltaic plants, connecting investors looking to directly finance the construction of these. By purchasing NFTs on Deentra, investors can contribute to the creation of these plants and share the earnings generated from the energy they produce. So far they've released a story-driven NFT collection and built a vibrant community around their upcoming product launch coming soon 👀</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ngidz1frimo.typeform.com/to/QsUSxUix" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Sign up for early access</a></div><h2 id="7-enrex-%F0%9F%8C%B3">7) Enrex 🌳</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="316"></figure><p><a href="https://www.enrex.io/">Enrex</a> is a protocol that connects <a href="https://ethereum.org/en/defi/">decentralized finance</a> (DeFi) to regulated environmental markets, allowing businesses to <strong>offset carbon emissions</strong> and achieve carbon neutrality. Founded by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/vytautassab/">Vytautas Sabaliauskas</a>, the project has built solutions to assist Web2 and Web3 companies become greener in their business, from offsetting website hosting impacts, to NFT collections and much more. They also have a free tool that enables businesses to generate sustainability goals.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://t.me/enrex_community" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join community</a></div><h2 id="8-atlantis-%F0%9F%94%B1">8) Atlantis 🔱</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="401"></figure><p>Founded by<a href="https://twitter.com/IrthuSuresh"> Irthu Suresh</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/NakulVReddy">Nakul Reddy</a>, <a href="https://www.atlantians.world/">Atlantis</a> is a <strong>peer-to-peer impact network</strong> that helps builders, entrepreneurs, and creators in the climate and social impact sectors set up, measure, and verify the impact of their projects. So far they've worked with incredible projects like <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/hydrop-india/?originalSubdomain=in">Hydrop</a>, which decentralises water access and security in Bangalore. In addition, they supported the organization of the <a href="https://www.refiindia.com/green-pill-festival">Green Pill Festival</a> fostering the connections of like-minded builders in the ecosystem.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.atlantians.world/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Discover Atlantis</a></div><h2 id="9-deplan-%F0%9F%97%BA%EF%B8%8F">9) De_Plan 🗺️</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="200"></figure><p>Founded by <strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/akshay-aditya-75957388/"><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/akshay-aditya-75957388/">Akshay Aditya</a></a></strong>, the high-tech team at <a href="https://www.de-plan.xyz/#">De_Plan</a> builds products that bridge the Web3 and IRL gap while providing solutions for ReFi builders - allowing apps to be built on top of their infrastructure. Their <strong>collective of planners, environmentalists, and urbanists</strong> have built <a href="https://www.proto-geo.xyz/">Proto</a> - a spatial data registry and location protocol, and <a href="https://www.ostrom.world/">Ostrom</a> - a community-based development solution for land regeneration.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://airtable.com/shrcRaQxpWF0RofzC" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join their collective</a></div><h2 id="10-single-earth-%F0%9F%8C%B2">10) Single Earth 🌲</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="287"></figure><p><a href="https://www.single.earth/">Single.Earth</a> is an awe-inspiring Estonian company developing scalable business models to support nature preservation. Founded by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/merit-valdsalu/">Merit Valdsalu</a>,<strong> </strong>and<strong> </strong>led by a high-performing team that <a href="https://www.single.earth/blog/joining-eqt-ventures">raised $7.9M in Venture Capital</a> in 2021 to deliver their vision, they've developed an approach to <strong>incentivize natural resource preservation and reward stakeholders</strong> that actively participate in sustainable land management. With their toolkit, business owners can positively impact the environment, while landowners earn income for preserving biodiversity in their forests. They use in-house tools like satellite data and machine learning models to assess the land's ecological characteristics.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ZRuhheJKdgU?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="How making money will save the planet | Merit Valdsalu | TEDxTallinn"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://discord.com/invite/J4HEVgt6pq" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join the mission</a></div><h2 id="11-coral-tribe-%F0%9F%8C%8A">11) Coral Tribe 🌊</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="602" height="301"></figure><p>Founded by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/christianchegne/">Christian Chegne</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jimmy-lane-053a59172/">Jimmy Lane</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/Numalunah">Adolfo Casabal</a> &amp; <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/averyschwarz/">Avery Schwarz</a>, <a href="https://coraltribe.io/">Coral Tribe</a> aims to expand access to capital for impact-driven businesses globally. Through NFTs and DeFi, they are making impact investing fun, accessible and engaging. Their <a href="https://magiceden.io/marketplace/crypto_coral_tribe">vibrant NFT community</a> is passionate about art, technology, and environmental action. Together they've helped plant 2000 corals across several continents and aided the development of one of the world's largest Web3 environmentally-focused brands. Now, with their upcoming <a href="https://www.coraltribe.io/reefi-hub">ReeFi Hub platform</a>, retail investors will be able to invest in expertly curated impact-focused oppertuntites. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/zn7mQXIoGSc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Crypto Coral Tribe Cinematic"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://discord.com/invite/B7f8Vx2ZFK" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Start contributing</a></div><h1 id="an-exciting-future-for-refi-%E2%9C%A8">An Exciting Future for ReFi ✨</h1><p>The sustainable technology space is full of innovation and creativity. Each one of these exciting projects is solving important problems and contributing to a more sustainable, just, and prosperous world. We are proud to highlight their work and excited to see what they will achieve in the future.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-grey"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❗</div><div class="kg-callout-text">Want to see a project featured in the next ReFi Radar? <a href="https://www.refidao.com/add-data">Add new projects</a> and submit your votes at <a href="https://www.refidao.com/blockchain-ecosystem/solana/r/recr490MgWnxPbYs5">ReFiDAO.com</a>!<br><br>Stay tuned for part 2... 👀</div></div><h2 id="getting-involved-with-solana-refi">Getting Involved with Solana ReFi</h2><p>It is fantastic to see such a strong foundation for the diverse Solana ReFi ecosystem we have today.‌‌‌‌ Thank you to all the pioneering projects here and the amazing teams behind them, and big thanks to the <a href="https://solana.org/">Solana Foundation</a> for all the work and resources aimed at growing this beautiful ReFi eco-system. We’re excited to welcome upcoming projects and support them entering the scene in this ever-evolving world of ReFi.</p><p>Follow<a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist"> ReFi DAO</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/Numalunah">Numa</a> for more ecosystem updates and get more involved by joining the<a href="https://t.me/+OTh5auG7jAQ3MWE0"> Solana ReFi telegram</a> group and network with other founders and contributors. We host bi-weekly community calls and events.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://t.me/+OTh5auG7jAQ3MWE0"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-06-at-12.12.10-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="958" height="976" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-06-at-12.12.10-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Screenshot-2023-04-06-at-12.12.10-pm.png 958w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p>Peace ✌️</p>

item.title: Top 10 ReFi Projects on Celo 🙌
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p></p><h1 id="refi-on-celo"><strong>ReFi on Celo</strong></h1><p>ReFi, or Regenerative Finance, is a new paradigm of finance that aims to create positive social and environmental impact through decentralized platforms. Unlike traditional finance, which often prioritizes profit over people and planet, ReFi aligns incentives with the common good and rewards actions that contribute to solving systemic challenges like climate change, poverty, and inequality.</p><p>ReFi is not just a theoretical concept, but a practical reality that is being implemented by various projects on the Celo blockchain. Celo is a carbon-negative, mobile-first, EVM-compatible blockchain ecosystem that enables anyone with a smartphone to access the benefits of crypto and DeFi. Celo’s vision is to create prosperity for all by fostering a thriving digital economy that is inclusive, sustainable, and resilient.</p><p>In this blog post, we will introduce you to the top 10 ReFi projects on the Celo blockchain that are making a difference in the world. These projects range from payments to lending to governance, and showcase the diversity and innovation of the Celo community.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.regenerative.fi/insights/14-og-refi-pioneers"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">14 OG ReFi Pioneers | Blog</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Meet the trailblazers of Regenerative Finance: 14 pioneering projects shaping a sustainable financial future. Dive into their transformative journeys and innovations in the ReFi landscape.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://assets-global.website-files.com/652d421c1214a2eebd967f1d/652d421c1214a2eebd967f2f_Favicon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Regenerative blue colored logo</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">ReFi DAO</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://assets-global.website-files.com/652d421c1214a2eebd967f36/65bbd3297d006b8d4cf0f74e_14%20OG%20ReFi%20Pioneers.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><h2 id="1-moola-market">1. Moola Market</h2><p>Moola Market is a decentralized money market protocol that allows users to lend and borrow crypto assets on Celo. Moola Market leverages Celo’s stablecoins (cUSD and cEUR) and native token (CELO) to provide low-cost and accessible liquidity to users around the world. Moola Market also supports social impact initiatives by donating a portion of its protocol fees to carbon offset projects and community grants.</p><p>Moola Market was founded by <strong>Patrick Baron</strong>, <strong>Zviad Metreveli</strong>, <strong>Asa Oines</strong>, and <strong>James Prestwich</strong> in 2020. It has raised $3 million in seed funding from investors like Polychain Capital, Andreesen Horowitz, Electric Capital, and Dragonfly Capital.</p><h2 id="2-ubeswap">2. Ubeswap</h2><p>Ubeswap is a decentralized exchange (DEX) that allows users to swap tokens, provide liquidity, and earn fees on Celo. Ubeswap leverages Celo’s fast and cheap transactions to offer a seamless and user-friendly trading experience. Ubeswap also supports social impact initiatives by integrating carbon offsetting into its platform and donating a portion of its protocol fees to community causes.</p><p>Ubeswap was founded by <strong>Evan Kuo</strong> and <strong>Samyak Jain</strong> in 2020. It has raised $1 million in seed funding from investors like Electric Capital, Dragonfly Capital, Nascent Ventures, and The LAO.</p><h2 id="3-impact-market">3. Impact Market</h2><p>Impact Market is a decentralized basic income platform that empowers communities to create and manage their own unconditional cash transfer programs on Celo. Impact Market leverages Celo’s mobile-first design and stablecoins to deliver direct and transparent aid to people in need around the world. Impact Market also supports social impact initiatives by measuring and reporting the outcomes of its programs and incentivizing donors with tax benefits.</p><p>Impact Market was founded by <strong>Diogo Silva</strong>, <strong>João Varela</strong>, <strong>Miguel Almeida</strong>, <strong>Pedro Almeida</strong>, <strong>Rui Rodrigues</strong>, and <strong>Tiago Alves</strong> in 2020. It has raised $2 million in seed funding from investors like cLabs, Electric Capital, Nascent Ventures, Lemniscap, and The Giving Block.</p><h2 id="4-valora">4. Valora</h2><p>Valora is a mobile wallet app that allows users to send and receive money globally on Celo. Valora leverages Celo’s stablecoins (cUSD and cEUR) and phone number verification system to offer a simple and secure way to transact with anyone in the world. Valora also supports social impact initiatives by enabling users to donate to causes they care about and rewarding them with cashback rewards.</p><p>Valora was founded by <strong>Jackie Bona</strong> in 2020 as an independent spin-off from cLabs, the company behind Celo’s core protocol development. It has raised $20 million in Series A funding from investors like Andreesen Horowitz, Polychain Capital, SV Angel, Nima Capital, NFX, Valor Capital Group, Verison Ventures, Slow Ventures, and others.</p><h2 id="5-mento">5. Mento</h2><p>Mento is a decentralized algorithmic reserve-backed stablecoin exchange protocol that maintains the peg of Celo’s stablecoins (cUSD and cEUR) to their respective fiat currencies. Mento leverages Celo’s native token (CELO)</p><h2 id="6-loam">6. Loam</h2><p>Loam is a decentralized marketplace for farming data that incentivizes farmers to engage in regenerative practices. Loam leverages Celo’s stablecoins and native token to reward farmers for sharing their data on soil health, crop yield, carbon sequestration, and other metrics. Loam also supports social impact initiatives by enabling data buyers to fund projects that improve the livelihoods of farmers and the environment.</p><p>Loam was founded by <strong>Alexandra Griffen</strong> and <strong>Evan Kuo</strong> in 2020. It has raised $4 million in seed funding from investors like Electric Capital, Dragonfly Capital, Nascent Ventures, and The LAO.</p><h2 id="7-circular-impact">7. Circular Impact</h2><p>Circular Impact is a platform that enables circular economy companies to quantify and monetize their positive impact using Web3 infrastructure. Circular Impact leverages Celo’s stablecoins and native token to reward companies for reducing waste, emissions, and resource consumption. Circular Impact also supports social impact initiatives by creating a transparent and verifiable marketplace for impact tokens that can be traded or donated.</p><p>Circular Impact was founded by <strong>Sanergy</strong>, a social enterprise that provides safe sanitation solutions in Kenya, and <strong>Celo</strong>, a blockchain ecosystem that enables financial inclusion and sustainability. It has raised $1 million in seed funding from investors like cLabs, Electric Capital, Nascent Ventures, Lemniscap, and The Giving Block.</p><h2 id="8-wren">8. Wren</h2><p>Wren is a platform that allows users to offset their carbon footprint by funding projects that protect and restore nature. Wren leverages Celo’s stablecoins and native token to enable users to pay for their offsets in crypto and track their impact on the blockchain. Wren also supports social impact initiatives by partnering with vetted projects that create co-benefits for communities and biodiversity.</p><p>Wren was founded by <strong>Landon Brand</strong>, <strong>Ben Stanfield</strong>, and <strong>Mimi Tran Zambetti</strong> in 2020. It has raised $3 million in seed funding from investors like Union Square Ventures, Version One Ventures, Homebrew, Collaborative Fund, and others.</p><h2 id="9-moss">9. Moss</h2><p>Moss is a platform that allows users to buy and sell carbon credits on the blockchain. Moss leverages Celo’s stablecoins and native token to enable users to access the global carbon market and support projects that reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Moss also supports social impact initiatives by creating a transparent and efficient marketplace for carbon credits that can be used for compliance or voluntary purposes.</p><p>Moss was founded by <strong>Luis Felipe Adaime</strong> in 2020. It has raised $10 million in Series A funding from investors like Valor Capital Group, Monashees, Foundation Capital, Coinbase Ventures, IDEO CoLab Ventures, and others.</p><h2 id="10-umoja">10. Umoja</h2><p>Umoja is a platform that allows users to access financial services on Celo without a bank account or credit history. Umoja leverages Celo’s stablecoins and native token to enable users to save, borrow, invest, and send money across borders. Umoja also supports social impact initiatives by empowering unbanked and underbanked populations with financial inclusion and literacy.</p><p>Umoja was founded by <strong>Abdulaziz Mohamed</strong> and <strong>Abdikadir Aden</strong> in 2020. It has raised $500k in seed funding from investors like cLabs, Electric Capital, Nascent Ventures, Lemniscap, and The Giving Block.</p><h2 id="conclusion">Conclusion</h2><p>These are just some of the ReFi projects on Celo that are making a difference in the world. There are many more projects that are not listed here but are equally inspiring and impactful. If you want to learn more about ReFi on Celo or join the movement, you can visit https://celo.org/refi or follow @CeloOrg on Twitter.</p><h1 id="an-exciting-future-for-refi-%E2%9C%A8"><strong>An Exciting Future for ReFi ✨</strong></h1><p>The sustainable technology space is full of innovation and creativity. Each one of these exciting projects is solving important problems and contributing to a more sustainable, just, and prosperous world. We are proud to highlight their work and excited to see what they will achieve in the future.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-white"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❗</div><div class="kg-callout-text">Want to see a project featured in the next ReFi Radar?&nbsp;<a href="https://www.refidao.com/add-data?ref=blog.refidao.com">Add new projects</a>&nbsp;and submit your votes at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.refidao.com/blockchain-ecosystem/solana/r/recr490MgWnxPbYs5?ref=blog.refidao.com">ReFiDAO.com</a>!<br><br>Stay tuned for part 2... 👀</div></div>

item.title: Markets in Cryptoassets (MiCA)
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p></p><p>The Markets in Cryptoassets (MiCA) Regulation is a regulatory framework for cryptoassets in the European Union (EU) that will enter into force at some point between mid-2024 and early 20251. The MiCA regulations introduce clear guidelines for handling cryptocurrencies and consumer protection, and divide crypto assets into different sectors, each subject to specific rules2. The final vote on the new regulation is scheduled for April 19, 20232, meaning the days of an unregulated crypto market in the EU may soon be over2.</p><p>According to an economist interviewed by Cointelegraph, MiCA will have a positive impact on stablecoins as it will provide a clear regulatory framework for them2. However, it is still unclear how MiCA will affect other areas of crypto such as DeFi1.</p>

item.title: The Gitcoin coordiNATION game is ON 🕹️🗺️
item.dc:creator: John Dass
Anna Kaic
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><br>Hey ReFi friends! 👋 </p><p>We are incredibly excited to announce that the first-ever Gitcoin coordiNATION game has officially started! From May 2 to 6, ReFi DAO, <a href="https://twitter.com/greenpillglobal">Green Pill</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/regensunite">Regens Unite</a>, and <a href="https://metacrisis.xyz/">metacrisis.xyz</a> are hosting a four-day event across 15 cities to onboard new donors, match funders, and projects into the Gitcoin ecosystem during the Gitcoin Beta Round. It's going to be a blast!</p><h3 id="but-wait-what-is-gitcoin-%F0%9F%A4%94">But wait, what is Gitcoin? 🤔</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1200" height="600" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-1.png 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><a href="https://twitter.com/gitcoin">Gitcoin</a> is a powerful online platform and a vibrant community that has funded over $50M worth of open-source software, climate solutions, decentralized science, and other impact initiatives. The only challenge is that most people and organizations don't know how to get onto Gitcoin and access the funding. That's where the activation stations come in!</p><h3 id="activation-stations-%F0%9F%97%B3%EF%B8%8F">Activation stations 🗳️</h3><p>Imagine the activation stations like polling stations, but instead of casting a vote, you show up to a co-working space or another community venue in your city and get support from experts who can help you get set up in Gitcoin in less than 30 minutes.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Local-Node-Map-5-.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Local-Node-Map-5-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Local-Node-Map-5-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Local-Node-Map-5-.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Local-Node-Map-5-.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Find an activation station near you!</em></i></figcaption></figure><p>The Gitcoin CoordiNATION game is being hosted both in-person and online, with events taking place across 15 cities. Each event is organized by a number of different communities that have begun gathering in specific cities to meet regularly and work towards a shared mission of regeneration.</p><p>If you're a local web3 community inspired by the power of Gitcoin's open-source funding legos, you should host an event! All you need to do is find a venue, create an event on <a href="http://lu.ma/">lu.ma</a> or Eventbrite and submit it by clicking on "add your local event" (see picture below).</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-6.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="1185" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-6.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-6.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-6.png 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/Gitcoin-CoordiNATION" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Add your local event</a></div><h2 id="online-pledge-sessions-%F0%9F%92%BB">Online pledge sessions 💻</h2><p>For those who can't join one of the IRL events, there will be online pledge sessions at specific times. It's easy to participate since anyone can pledge an amount that they will later donate to projects of their choice.</p><p>After you pledge to donate an amount of your choice to <a href="https://grants.gitcoin.co/">one of the Gitcoin rounds</a>, we will celebrate your pledge on Twitter and you'll be invited on stage to speak!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">Gitcoin coordiNATION game is Live ! <a href="https://twitter.com/Aida_Regen?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@Aida_Regen</a> <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@refidaoist</a> <a href="https://twitter.com/gitcoin?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@gitcoin</a> <a href="https://t.co/UCa7F9yl6B">pic.twitter.com/UCa7F9yl6B</a></p>— ReFi Lagos 🌴 #GitcoinBeta (@ReFiLagos01) <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiLagos01/status/1653403015175348226?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">May 2, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/3xrO79" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Pledge now</a></div><p><strong>Join one of the online events happening on Twitter and LinkedIn:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Thursday, May 4</strong> 09.00–10.00 EST / 15.00-16.00 CET | <strong>Twitter</strong> - <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1dRKZMObABMxB">Join here</a></li><li><strong>Thursday, May 4</strong> 10.00–11.00 EST / 16.00-17.00 CET | <strong>LinkedIn</strong> - <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/events/gitcoincoordinationgamewithgree7059224501061898240/">Join here</a></li><li><strong>Saturday, May 6 </strong>TBD — LinkedIn, hosted by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/greenpill-global/">Green Pill Global</a></li></ul><p><strong>Don't miss any official event by adding ReFi DAO's public calendar to your calendar!</strong> 📅</p><ul><li>gCal: <a href="https://bit.ly/3JmCCIr" rel="noreferrer noopener">https://bit.ly/3JmCCIr</a></li><li>Web: <a href="https://bit.ly/3Qc3eOj" rel="noreferrer noopener">https://bit.ly/3Qc3eOj</a></li><li>iCal: <a href="https://bit.ly/3PYMw5p" rel="noreferrer noopener">https://bit.ly/3PYMw5p</a></li></ul><h2 id="the-magic-of-gitcoin-%F0%9F%AA%84">The magic of Gitcoin! 🪄</h2><p>Here's the magic of Gitcoin: each donation can be matched by funding pools worth up to $500k! That means a donation of only $1 to a local impact project or open-source software initiative can produce hundreds of dollars in match funding.</p><hr><p>Thanks to the power of math, public ledgers, and smart contracts, we can make a difference! So what are you waiting for? Join us and be a part of the first-ever Gitcoin coordiNATION game!</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: The first ever Gitcoin coordiNATION game is officially ON. Let's see what is it all about!

item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant

item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hello there, Regens! </em>🌴‌‌ <em><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty</a> &amp; <a href="https://twitter.com/Linggih_ngurah">Nura</a> here to bring you a special ReFi Roundup... Let's dive straight in </em>👇 </p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Nuraling_a_reinassance_style_painting_of_many_people_man_female_a39d5fc5-a98d-4eca-ac3d-fab8967f22e2-copy-1.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="2000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Nuraling_a_reinassance_style_painting_of_many_people_man_female_a39d5fc5-a98d-4eca-ac3d-fab8967f22e2-copy-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Nuraling_a_reinassance_style_painting_of_many_people_man_female_a39d5fc5-a98d-4eca-ac3d-fab8967f22e2-copy-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Nuraling_a_reinassance_style_painting_of_many_people_man_female_a39d5fc5-a98d-4eca-ac3d-fab8967f22e2-copy-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Nuraling_a_reinassance_style_painting_of_many_people_man_female_a39d5fc5-a98d-4eca-ac3d-fab8967f22e2-copy-1.png 2048w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="fuelling-the-regen-assance-%F0%9F%8C%B1-%F0%9F%9A%80">Fuelling the Regen-assance 🌱 🚀</h1><p>A decade ago, it would have been unthinkable that Web3 and the concepts of digital ownership and decentralisation through the internet, could become a vital tool in the fight against climate change and other existential risks. While DeFi (Decentralized Finance) was born on the premise of challenging the entrenched power of centralized financial systems, ReFi (Regenerative Finance) is built on the premise of redesigning money to be in harmony with the earth. </p><p>ReFi holds the potential for being the driving force of a new regenerative paradigm, one that creates holistic wealth for the many over extraction for the few. A Regen-assance is in view... 👀</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1126" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/05/Eight-Forms-of-Capital---ReFi.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption><a href="https://twitter.com/gregory_landua?ref=blog.refidao.com">Gregory Landua</a> &amp; <a href="http://www.appleseedpermaculture.com/8-forms-of-capital/?ref=blog.refidao.com">AppleSeed Permaculture</a>'s Eight Forms of Capital</figcaption></figure><p>But how can we make sure that ReFi actually holds up to this promise? How can we make sure we are not just redesigning the same extractive systems but on Web3 rails? How can we build strength, resiliency, and lasting positive impact for generations to come?</p><h2 id="the-medici-effect-%F0%9F%8F%B0">The Medici Effect 🏰</h2><p>The <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Medici_Effect">Medici effect</a>, named after the influential Medici family of Renaissance Florence, demonstrates that the most revolutionary ideas arise when different fields intersect. The term was popularized by Frans Johannson in his book "<a href="https://www.amazon.de/Medici-Effect-Breakthrough-Insights-Intersection/dp/1591391865">The Medici Effect: Breakthrough Insights at the Intersection of Ideas, Concepts, and Cultures</a>" </p><p>The main concept of the idea is that <strong>embracing diverse perspectives and cross-discipline collaboration</strong> is key to creative problem-solving and tackling complex challenges such as climate change. Without diversity, innovation often stagnates and develops incrementally rather than revolutionarily. Entrenched in their specialist fields of study, individual experts and academics may focus on small, linear changes while overlooking the potential for groundbreaking ideas that could arise from converging disciplines. They may have a deep understanding of individual trees but not see the forest. 🌳🌳</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card kg-card-hascaption"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/72YXnQdGzuk?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="What is the Medici Effect and what does it have to do with Innovation? Dr Rajiv Vaid Basaiawmoit"></iframe><figcaption>A short lecture to dive on the idea</figcaption></figure><h2 id="the-promise-of-digital-%F0%9F%A7%91%F0%9F%8F%BC%E2%80%8D%F0%9F%92%BB">The Promise of Digital 🧑🏼‍💻</h2><p>With the introduction of digital technologies and the internet, we now have incredible and unprecedented ability to bring diverse people and ideas together from across all different fields and backgrounds in a way that was previously impossible. However, the ability to do so does not mean this is what will actually happen..</p><p>In the pursuit of psychological safety, comfort and social connection, humans have a natural tendency to form groups of like-minded individuals. To date, the algorithms that drive main-stream social media sites and search engines seem largely to be fuelling these dynamics with their tendency towards creating echo-chambers over diverse spaces for constructive debate and dialogue. We must therefore be mindful of these limitations, and actively seek out diverse opinions and viewpoints as we tackle complex challenges and build new systems.</p><h2 id="the-role-of-web3-%F0%9F%8C%90">The Role of Web3 🌐</h2><p>Web3 has the potential to help facilitate the Medici effect by empowering the seamless exchange of ideas, data, and resources across borders, as well as bringing people together across diverse backgrounds, skills, and experiences. Furthermore, blockchain &amp; other decentralized ledger technologies have applications across multiple industries and disciplines, from finance to healthcare, art to agriculture. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1105" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/05/The-Role-of-Web3---Blockchain-in-Regenerative-Finance--ReFi-.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>By leveraging the unique strengths of each discipline and working together, individuals and organizations can collaborate to solve some of the world's most pressing challenges. By embracing diversity and fostering cross-disciplinary collaboration, Web3 technology can unleash the full potential of the Medici effect and enable a new era of innovation and problem-solving. But this requires active effort and a willingness to do so - including breaking out of the Web3 twitter echo chamber itself!</p><h2 id="medici-in-refi-web3-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Medici in ReFi &amp; Web3 🌱</h2><p>Just as the <a href="https://www.history.com/topics/renaissance/italian-renaissance">Italian Renaissance</a> was driven by a synergy of intellectual, cultural, economic, and technological forces that led to a remarkable period of cultural and scientific developments, the Web3 era is fuelling a new renaissance powered by it's new global coordination technology.</p><p>The Gitcoin funding rounds are a brilliant example of this. Through the power of <a href="https://wtfisqf.com/?grant=&amp;grant=&amp;grant=&amp;grant=&amp;match=1000">quadratic funding</a>, a diverse and decentralised community of donors helps to efficiently coordinate capital to a brilliant array of diverse projects. Check some of them out below! 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption><a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/eQ97c95DZUdLcPKM0tR_vYtQnjNha0bIZN9edOfSe7A">ReFi Roundup 2022 - The Year of Regenerative Finance!</a></figcaption></figure><p>Furthermore, ReFi's core concept and values have the potential to attract and unite different groups of people with diverse expertise and backgrounds. From crypto techies to regen hippies, traditional finance professionals to climate and impact experts, each group has something to bring. By fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment, ReFi can serve as a platform for these groups to come together and share knowledge, resources, and ideas. Through this collaboration, ReFi can unlock innovative solutions and drive positive impact on a global scale.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.50.57-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1124" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.50.57-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.50.57-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.50.57-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.50.57-pm.png 2338w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="medici-in-refi-dao-%F0%9F%94%B5">Medici in ReFi DAO 🔵</h2><p>ReFi DAO is just at the beginning of conducting a new radical experiment for diverse collaboration at scale. The forming of a new nation - a new economy, culture, &amp; society, that is grounded in the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/">principles of Regeneration</a>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.19.47-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1120" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.19.47-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.19.47-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.19.47-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.19.47-pm.png 2228w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.08.45-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1121" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.08.45-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.08.45-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.08.45-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.08.45-pm.png 2230w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>As part of this we aim to support a diverse and decentralized network of local ReFi &amp; Regen communities. Each local community is an autonomous and independent entity, but all are connected by a mission to regenerate earth using the most powerful tools of our time.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-27.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="846" height="1112" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-27.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-27.png 846w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption>Explore &amp; join local communities at <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local">refidao.com/community/local</a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore Local Communities</a></div><p>Going one step further, a local community may wish to apply to become a ‘ReFi DAO Local Node’—a regionally-based local impact DAO that is fully autonomous yet connected to the network as a whole. Starting with simple meet-ups and events, successful local nodes may go on to acquire land and other real-world assets with the aim of growing a locally-based regenerative economy and community.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.21.29-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1912" height="1068" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.21.29-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.21.29-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.21.29-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-6.21.29-pm.png 1912w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>To support this work, we were excited to announce the launch of the '<a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/FABiu5AhpAR6LBLZxlGSfjOrHsHYj2J8VT4QJWPxbpk">Local Node Prize</a>' earlier this month. This included the formation of a <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x64aa545c9c63944f8e765d9a65eda3cbbdc6e620">Gitcoin featured round for Local Nodes</a> with $25k of match funding from the ReFi DAO treasury primarily aimed at supporting communities in the global south. If you haven't already, go explore the many exciting communities that are emerging and consider supporting them through a donation! By supporting your favorite communities with the best applications, you are helping fuel the magic of Gitcoin in stewarding the match funding. Any and all support would be hugely appreciated 💚 </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x64aa545c9c63944f8e765d9a65eda3cbbdc6e620" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi DAO Local Nodes</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x64aa545c9c63944f8e765d9a65eda3cbbdc6e620"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.02.48-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1019" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.02.48-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.02.48-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.02.48-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/05/Screenshot-2023-05-08-at-7.02.48-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/1/0x64aa545c9c63944f8e765d9a65eda3cbbdc6e620">Explore and support ReFi Local Nodes</a></figcaption></figure><p>Beyond the Gitcoin rounds, ReFi DAO aims to support these nodes through our emerging 'Local Node Incubator' with tools, research, workshops, resources and our emerging AI powered ReFi knowledge graph. More on this coming soon! 👀</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">Where ever you come from, whatever your background, there is a place for you in this story.<a href="https://twitter.com/hashtag/Regeneration?src=hash&amp;ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">#Regeneration</a> is a symphony. Find your instrument and come join one of the 33 current <a href="https://twitter.com/hashtag/ReFi?src=hash&amp;ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">#ReFi</a> communities across the globe<br>--&gt; <a href="https://t.co/baLEY0Lnrw">https://t.co/baLEY0Lnrw</a> 💚<br><br>/17 <a href="https://t.co/i3gPBnFCzH">pic.twitter.com/i3gPBnFCzH</a></p>&mdash; Monty Merlin Bryant 🧙✨ (@MontyMerlin) <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin/status/1648337480570249216?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">April 18, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script> </figure><h3 id="%F0%9F%9A%A8%F0%9F%9A%A8%F0%9F%9A%A8hold-up">🚨🚨🚨Hold up...</h3><p>At this point you might have some questions:</p><ul><li>How will governance work across ReFi DAO and the network?</li><li>Will there be a token? How will this work?</li><li>A ReFi passport?!</li></ul><p>Or maybe even some concerns:</p><ul><li>Is ReFi DAO currently a DAO?</li><li>To network state or not to network state?</li><li>Acquiring land?! How is this going to support models of stewardship &amp; regeneration over extractivism?</li></ul><p>ReFi DAO is currently made up of a small and passionate core team, but to help answer and explore these questions, as well as co-create the answers, I am excited to announce the ReFi DAO Forum. The forum will serve as key part of our mission to become a community-led organization as we embark on a journey of progressive network decentralization. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/telegram-cloud-photo-size-4-5965162086529088708-y.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="720" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/telegram-cloud-photo-size-4-5965162086529088708-y.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/telegram-cloud-photo-size-4-5965162086529088708-y.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/telegram-cloud-photo-size-4-5965162086529088708-y.jpg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://twitter.com/daryljedwards">Daryl Edwards</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty Merlin Bryant</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna">Anna Kaic</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/MarceloReFi">Marcelo Silva</a></figcaption></figure><h3 id="come-join">Come join!</h3><p>Join us on Wednesday the 17th at 16.00 WET for a live forum discussion about ReFi DAO’s governance roadmap and wider vision. We’re inviting leaders from across the regenerative, distributed governance, and monetary policy space to help shape the trajectory of ReFi DAO as we work towards fulfilling our vision of a global regenerative economy rooted in startup cities.</p><p>This event will be the first of it’s kind, with a regular bi-weekly slot to follow that will foster dialogue across the community about how we best steward our shared resources, time and attention in this exciting regenerative finance movement. Register below! 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/refi-dao-forum"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi DAO Forum · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Join us on Wednesday at 16.00 WET for a live forum discussion about ReFi DAO’s governance roadmap now that we have supported the early formation of 19 local nodes in startup cities all around…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://images.lumacdn.com/cdn-cgi/image/format&#x3D;auto,fit&#x3D;cover,dpr&#x3D;2,quality&#x3D;85,width&#x3D;1000,height&#x3D;500/event-covers/bk/06ecf120-0cc2-4ecb-bd59-06b6bbec7a57" alt=""></div></a></figure><h2 id="breaking-the-web3-bubble%E2%80%94diverse-collaboration-for-change">Breaking the Web3 Bubble—Diverse Collaboration for Change</h2><p>Web3 and ReFi have immense potential to drive innovation and collaboration among diverse groups of people to tackle some of the world's most pressing challenges. However, this potential can only be fully realized if we break out of the Web3 bubble and engage with a more diverse range of perspectives and experiences. The Web3 community is known for its technical expertise, but to truly address complex issues like climate change, we need input from people with different backgrounds and areas of expertise. By reaching out to a broader audience and fostering cross-disciplinary collaboration, we can unlock new solutions and opportunities that wouldn't be possible within a single community. Ultimately, the true power of Web3 lies in its ability to bring people together from all walks of life to create a more equitable and sustainable future for everyone. Make sure to grab some tickets and support the ReFi regenerative renaissance wherever you are from! 👇</em></p><h3 id="refi-prague-at-pragueblockchainweek2023">ReFi Prague at #Pragueblockchainweek2023</h3><p><strong>(9 June in Prague, Czech Republic): </strong>If you will be in Prague for the Blockchain Week, don't forget to say hi to fellow regens in the area 👋</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://explore.prgblockweek.com/23/event/refi-prague"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-9.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1410" height="433" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-9.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-9.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-9.png 1410w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explore.prgblockweek.com/23/event/refi-prague" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Register</a></div><h3 id="carbon-fast-forward-mediterannean">Carbon Fast Forward: Mediterannean</h3><p><strong>(22 June in Athen, Greece): </strong>The Carbon Fast Forward event discusses EU environmental markets, emissions goals, and the impact on the Mediterranean region.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://carbon-forward.com/carbon-forward-mediterranean-2023/"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-10.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="786" height="464" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-10.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-10.png 786w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://carbon-forward.com/carbon-forward-mediterranean-2023/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Register here</a></div><h3 id="world-biodiversity-forum-2024">World Biodiversity Forum 2024</h3><p><strong>(16 - 21 June in Davos, Switzerland)</strong>: Looking ahead 1 year from now, one of the most exciting events around Biodiversity will takes place for the 3rd in Davos. Save the date!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">Getting ready for the third edition of World Biodiversity Forum - Davos Congress, 16 - 21 June 2024. <br>Submit your proposal for sessions, workshops, training sessions or panel discussions here: <a href="https://t.co/ocagAtMryJ">https://t.co/ocagAtMryJ</a><br>more info: <a href="https://t.co/W7dOj9Uwkn">https://t.co/W7dOj9Uwkn</a> <a href="https://twitter.com/hashtag/wbf2024?src=hash&amp;ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">#wbf2024</a> <a href="https://t.co/fZR3o5LsFi">pic.twitter.com/fZR3o5LsFi</a></p>&mdash; World Biodiversity Forum (@WorldBioForum) <a href="https://twitter.com/WorldBioForum/status/1654072431819075584?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">May 4, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script> </figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.worldbiodiversityforum.org/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Save the date</a></div><hr><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-image" style="background-image: url(https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/01/ReFi-Cover-5.png)" data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/01/ReFi-Cover-5.png"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="thank-you-%F0%9F%A4%A9">Thank you! 🤩</h2><h3 class="kg-header-card-subheader" id="emfor-being-a-part-of-the-ever-evolving-movement-to-create-a-radically-better-futureem"><em>For being a part of the ever evolving movement to create a radically better future...</em></h3></div><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-grey"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">⚫</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><em>"In a world that is constantly changing, the most important skill to acquire is learning how to learn." - <strong>John Naisbitt</strong></em></div></div><p>Have a fantastic weekend friends &amp; we'll see you again next week 🫡</p><h2 id="enjoyed-this-newsletter">Enjoyed this newsletter?</h2><p>We would be super grateful if you could help spread the word of ReFi by clicking the button below:</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/irWQc" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share Roundup!</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-23.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1024" height="1024" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-23.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-23.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-23.png 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure>

item.dc:creator: Susana Vanessa Gonzalez Nexans

item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey Regens, <a href="https://twitter.com/SuaNex"><em>Susana</em></a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin"><em>Monty</em></a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna"><em>Anna</em></a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/Linggih_ngurah"><em>Nura</em></a> here! 👋</em></p><p><em>With the regular weekly <a href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-on-pause/"><em>ReFi Roundup on pause</em></a>, let's take a moment to look back at some of the top ReFi news and content covered so far this year... </em></p><p><em>But first, if you've ever enjoyed the roundup posts or have some constructive feedback to share, we would be extremely grateful if you took a moment to fill out this feedback form and help shape its future! </em>🙏</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/n07o4Q?ref=blog.refidao.com" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Submit feedback 💚</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-30.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1152" height="768" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-30.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-30.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-30.png 1152w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="standing-strong-in-the-valley-of-despair-%F0%9F%A6%BE">Standing Strong in the Valley of Despair 🦾</h1><p>As we catapult through 2023, we have already seen some amazing developments and ideas shared in the ever-inspiring Regenerative Finance (ReFi) ecosystem. And yet, as the chill of the bear market sets in, and project runways wear thin, do we find ourselves peering into the depths of the 'Valley of Despair'?</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><div><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">Seems we are comfortably situated in the valley of despair. <a href="https://t.co/19JtmqLOTJ">pic.twitter.com/19JtmqLOTJ</a></p>— Ben Birkholm (@MilkMoney64209) <a href="https://twitter.com/MilkMoney64209/status/1671111247209680896?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">June 20, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></div></figure><p>But, in the darkness of this valley, an opportunity glimmers, beckoning resilient regens to rally, build, and transform into a dynamic stage of rebirth and regeneration. As we look towards the future of ReFi, let's take a moment to look back at some of the key moments and content of the year so far...</p><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-image" data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/06/ReFiDAO-Background.jpeg" style="background-image: url(https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/06/ReFiDAO-Background.jpeg)"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="refi-dao-blog-top-posts-"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">ReFi DAO Blog - Top Posts 🎖️</span></h2></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-28.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1121" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-28.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-28.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/image-28.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-28.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="refi-roundup-2022the-year-of-regenerative-finance">ReFi Roundup 2022 - The Year of Regenerative Finance!</h2><p><a href="__GHOST_URL__/author/humberto/"><em>Humberto Besso Oberto Huerta</em></a><em>, <a href="__GHOST_URL__/author/anna-kaic/"><em>Anna Kaic</em></a>, <a href="__GHOST_URL__/author/monty/"><em>Monty Merlin Bryant</em></a>, <a href="__GHOST_URL__/author/thoughtfloats/"><em>Thought Floats</em></a>, <a href="__GHOST_URL__/author/nura/"><em>Nura Linggih</em></a> | Jan 6, 2023</em></p><p>In 2022 <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-roundup-2022/">the ReFi movement</a> underwent a remarkable transformation. It went from a small niche in Web3 that brought carbon credits on-chain, to becoming a widespread and holistic movement seeking to integrate regenerative values across a whole variety of sectors. From <a href="https://twitter.com/regen_network?ref=blog.refidao.com">Regen Network</a>'s foundations to <a href="https://www.klimadao.finance/?ref=blog.refidao.com">KlimaDAO</a> and <a href="https://toucan.earth/?ref=blog.refidao.com">Toucan Protocol</a> bringing over 20 million carbon credits on-chain, to Ethereum's infamous 'Merge'. A lot happened! </p><p><em>Check out the full article for a detailed recap on the origins and timeline of Web3 x Regeneration! Read more and collect on Mirror 👇 </em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/eQ97c95DZUdLcPKM0tR_vYtQnjNha0bIZN9edOfSe7A"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Roundup 2022 - The Year of Regenerative Finance!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What a year 2022 has been for the Regenerative Finance movement. There is so much to be proud of, let’s take a moment to recap some of the key moments! 👉</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://mirror.xyz/icon/favicon-32x32.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">The Year of Regenerative Finance! — ReFi DAO</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://mirror-media.imgix.net/publication-images/E8kIXV2qLV-oDx4hhbF8j.png?height=1401&amp;width=2802&amp;h=1401&amp;w=2802&amp;auto=compress" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/eQ97c95DZUdLcPKM0tR_vYtQnjNha0bIZN9edOfSe7A" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read article</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-29.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-29.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-29.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/image-29.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/05/image-29.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="refi-villages-web3-enabled-communities-for-people-and-planet-%F0%9F%8C%B1-%F0%9F%9B%96">ReFi Villages: Web3-Enabled Communities for People and Planet 🌱 🛖</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin"><em>Monty Merlin Bryant</em></a><em>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/samueldelesque/"><em>Sam Delesque</em></a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeremy-agnew/"><em>Jeremy Agnew</em></a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/syntonikka"><em>Nico S</em></a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/cha_fradet"><em>Charlotte Fradet</em></a> | Jan 13, 2023</em></p><p>Eco-villages have been around since the 1960s, providing a model for how communities can live in harmony with the earth. Yet they often face huge difficulties in management, governance, and coordination. Regenerative villages take a more integrated approach with sustainable modern technologies and economic systems to create resiliency and better standards of living. Taking this a step further, this article coined the idea of ReFi Villages - the next evolution of eco-community living. It highlights the potential of Web3 and digital technology to solve some of the issues faced by eco-villages of the past and provide the infrastructure to scale and grow regenerative communities all over the world...</p><p><em>Explore their potential and join the movement to create a sustainable and regenerative future! Read more and collect on Mirror 👇 </em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/ye6fI3GDY2FJA6mNbxru2L_97OjMalhdbVjKOunq2EI?ref=blog.refidao.com"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Villages: Web3-Enabled Communities for People and Planet</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">People are increasingly looking to live in ways that are more sustainable, resilient, and regenerative. ReFi Villages present a compelling solution to change how we live, work, and relate to one another.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://mirror.xyz/icon/favicon-32x32.png" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://mirror-media.imgix.net/nft/UMYsan7npw5Xd2d94sSaD.jpeg?h=null&amp;w=null&amp;auto=compress" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/ye6fI3GDY2FJA6mNbxru2L_97OjMalhdbVjKOunq2EI" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read article</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-29.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1104" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-29.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-29.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/image-29.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-29.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="a-common-framework-for-refi-ebf-activator-x-refi-dao-%F0%9F%8C%B1">A Common Framework for ReFi | EBF Activator x ReFi DAO 🌱</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin"><em>Monty Merlin Bryant</em></a><em> | May 13, 2023</em><br><br>How do we truly define ReFi or Regeneration? And how can we assess and compare various projects in this space? This article delves into these critical questions and more, exploring how a shared understanding of ReFi can foster global progress. It takes a closer look at innovative concepts like the Ecological Benefits Framework (EBF), an initiative that goes beyond carbon-centric models to encompass a holistic understanding of ecological benefits including air, water, soil, justice, and biodiversity.</p><p><em>Read more below &amp; <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-groups/refi-rabbit-hole?ref=blog.refidao.com#form2"><em>join the ReFi Rabbit Hole</em></a> working group to help collaboratively answer the question of 'What is ReFi'? 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">A Common Framework for ReFi | EBF Activator x ReFi DAO 🌱</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What actually is ReFi? What is Regeneration? How should we measure &amp; compare projects?</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Monty Merlin Bryant</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/ReFi-DAO-x-The-Lexicon---Ecological-Benefits-Framework-Activator--EBF-.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read article</a></div><hr><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-image" data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/06/ReFiDAO-Background.jpeg" style="background-image: url(https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/06/ReFiDAO-Background.jpeg)"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="rounding-up-the-roundups-"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Rounding up the Roundups! 🔃</span></h2></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-36.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1439" height="750" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/image-36.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/image-36.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/image-36.png 1439w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="a-new-framework-for-integrating-justice-into-the-global-commons-%F0%9F%99%8C">A new framework for Integrating Justice into the Global Commons 🙌</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/Shaub_96?ref=blog.refidao.com"><em>Shauna Butterly</em></a><em> | Jan 28, 2023</em></p><p><a href="https://globalcommonsalliance.org/global-commons/?ref=blog.refidao.com">The Global Commons Alliance</a>'s <a href="https://globalcommonsalliance.org/alliance-projects/earth-commission/?ref=blog.refidao.com">Earth Commission</a> developed a new framework to integrate justice into the management of global commons, combining social and ecological thinking. This "Safe and Just Earth System Boundaries" framework aims to create a more sustainable <u>and</u> equitable world. </p><p><em>Read more about this revolutionary scientific breakthrough in the world of environmental stewardship👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-roundup-49/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Roundup #49: Justice &amp; the Global Commons 🌏 💚</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Justice for Global Commons, Regenerative Frameworks, ReFi Commons, the Energy Transition + the latest news, events and updates from across the ReFi ecosystem…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Shauna Butterly</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/01/Roundup-49.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-roundup-49/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read the Roundup</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Roundup-50-2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1429" height="750" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Roundup-50-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Roundup-50-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Roundup-50-2.png 1429w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="unlocking-natural-capital">Unlocking Natural Capital</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/ezeugosimon?ref=blog.refidao.com"><em>Simon Eze</em></a><em>, <a href="https://twitter.com/aida_eze?ref=blog.refidao.com"><em>Adaeze Okafor</em></a> | Feb 6, 2023</em></p><p>Designing systems and technologies that connect effectively with people and nature is no easy task.
