How can we build strength, resiliency, and lasting positive impact for generations to come? —&gt; <strong>The Medici Effect 🏰</strong><br><br>By breaking free from entrenched specialist fields and converging disciplines, groundbreaking ideas can emerge, enabling us to see the forest beyond individual trees and drive revolutionary change.</p><p><em>Learn more about the Medici Effect 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-63/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">The Web3 Medici Effect - Fuelling a Regen Renaissance💡🌱| Roundup #63</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Can ReFi x Web3 drive a new era of innovation and problem-solving in harmony with the earth? + the latest news, updates, jobs and events in ReFi and beyond!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Monty Merlin Bryant</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Roundup-63.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-63/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read the Roundup</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Group-482295.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1050" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Group-482295.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Group-482295.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/Group-482295.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/Group-482295.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="time-for-the-re-generation-%F0%9F%8C%B1-%E2%9C%8A">Time for the Re-Generation 🌱 ✊</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/Foliage201?ref=blog.refidao.com"><em>Cate</em></a><em> | May 23, 2023</em></p><p>We face the challenge of averting environmental and societal collapse but also have a unique opportunity to design new structures. <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generation_Z">Generation Z </a>holds the key to this transition, but creating inclusive pathways into ReFi is crucial. Testimonies from <a href="Maya">Maya</a>,<a href="Niko,"> Niko</a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin?ref=blog.refidao.com">Monty</a> highlight the importance of education, clear communication, and personal discussions. 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-roundup-65/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Next-Gen ReFi: Gen Z’s Power for Change ✨ 🌎 | Roundup #65</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Gen Z’s leaders in ReFi + the latest news, updates, jobs and events in ReFi and beyond!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">cate kelly</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Group-482295.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Group-482307.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1429" height="752" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Group-482307.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Group-482307.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Group-482307.png 1429w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="how-can-biodiversity-credits-drive-value-to-protect-our-planet">How can biodiversity credits drive value to protect our planet?</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/omniharmonic?ref=blog.refidao.com"><em>Benjamin Life</em></a><strong><em> </em><em>| May 30, 2023</em></strong></p><p>Nature is in crisis, but we can make a difference. Introducing biodiversity credits, a novel funding solution to support ecological stewardship, compensate indigenous communities, and restore habitats.</p><p><em>Learn more and start making a difference in your local area! 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-66/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Biodiversity Credits: A Nature-Positive Market 🦆 🐞 🕸️ | Roundup #66</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Biodiversity credits: A Nature-Positive Market + the latest news, updates, jobs and events in ReFi and beyond!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Benjamin Life</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Group-482307.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Roundup-67-1.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1039" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Roundup-67-1.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Roundup-67-1.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/Roundup-67-1.jpeg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Roundup-67-1.jpeg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="unleashing-blockchain-transforming-climate-solutions">Unleashing Blockchain: Transforming Climate Solutions</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/BenWest?ref=blog.refidao.com"><em>Ben West</em></a><em>, Tarah Stafford<strong> </strong>| Jun 7, 2023</em></p><p>Much of the discussion around blockchain technology is often focused on cryptocurrencies or the plethora of meme coins and scams that are often built on top. Yet as the world struggles to address the urgency of the climate crisis, the underlying technology of blockchain has the potential to be a game-changer in the murky waters of international coordination, resource allocation, and international accountability. But to unlock its full potential, collaborative efforts are essential and we need to shift from speculation to action!</p><p><em>Read more and join the movement towards a more sustainable future 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-67/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Non-Financial Blockchain Tech for Climate 🌏 🙏 | Roundup #67</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Hi Regens. It’s Ben West and Tarah Stafford here with the latest ReFi Roundup! 👋 For decades now we have been co-conspirators dedicated to finding climate solutions and helping them thrive. Tarah is a screenwriter, strategist, and certified secret weapon. Ben is the Grants Program Lead at Gitcoin a…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Ben West</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Roundup-67.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-67/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read the Roundup</a></div><hr><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-image" data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/06/ReFiDAO-Background-2.jpeg" style="background-image: url(https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/06/ReFiDAO-Background-2.jpeg)"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="looking-forward-"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Looking Forward ⛅️</span></h2></div><h1 id="from-reflection-to-action-shaping-the-future-of-refi-%E2%9C%A8">From Reflection to Action: Shaping the Future of ReFi ✨</h1><p>As we take a moment to reflect on the sheer breadth of insight, innovative thinking, and collaboration presented in these diverse pieces, our gratitude extends to each and every contributor for their invaluable additions to the vibrant tapestry of Regenerative Finance. The wisdom, passion, and perseverance illuminated in their work serve not only as a beacon of hope but also as a testament to the extraordinary potential that thrives within the ReFi ecosystem.</p><p>Navigating through the 'Valley of Despair,' we are reminded that the road to progress is seldom linear or without obstacles. However, as echoed throughout these articles, it's precisely in these times of uncertainty and challenges that our resilience is fortified, our bonds are strengthened, and our potential is amplified. The first half of 2023 has undeniably had its ups and downs, but it's also been a testament to the power of collective action, innovative thinking, and a shared commitment to a regenerative future - and we're only just getting started...</p><p>So, as we look ahead, let's not forget the lessons and breakthroughs of these past months. Let's continue to build, innovate, and foster a spirit of unity within our community. Let's move forward together, with renewed resolve and unwavering optimism into the next chapter of our regenerative journey 🌱</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><div><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">I love Sev<br><br>but ReFi isn't dead<br><br>it's finding it's niche in the red<br><br>where all teams dread<br><br>but some build cred<br><br>and through the enduring dredge<br><br>we'll find the thread<br><br>that weaves the regenerative bed<br><br>where we all find ourselves resting our head<br><br>GN <a href="https://t.co/5zyDSFZkEx">https://t.co/5zyDSFZkEx</a></p>— Justin Lewis (@jmapping) <a href="https://twitter.com/jmapping/status/1671374884264620038?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">June 21, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></div></figure><h2 id="thank-you">Thank you!</h2><p>Once again huge thank you to all the awesome contributors, and thanks to you, reader, for joining us on this journey through the transformative world of Regenerative Finance, your readership and support are deeply appreciated! If you would like to help shape the future of this blog, we would also be extremely grateful if you took a moment to provide some feedback 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/n07o4Q?ref=blog.refidao.com" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Submit feedback 💚</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/WWWWmonty2ReFi-3.png" width="924" height="917" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/WWWWmonty2ReFi-3.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/WWWWmonty2ReFi-3.png 924w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Untitled-design-181-.png" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Untitled-design-181-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Untitled-design-181-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Untitled-design-181-.png 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/ftBqCEmA_400x400.png" width="386" height="380" loading="lazy" alt=""></div></div></div><figcaption><p><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Roundup coordination and editing team - </em></i><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Monty</em></i></a><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">, </em></i><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Anna</em></i></a><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">, &amp; </em></i><a href="https://twitter.com/Linggih_ngurah"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Nura</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure>

item.title: Biodiversity Credits: A Nature-Positive Market 🦆 🐞 🕸️ | Roundup #66
item.dc:creator: Benjamin Life
Nura Linggih
Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em><strong>Hi! I'm <a href="https://twitter.com/omniharmonic">Benjamin Life</a>. </strong>My career began with virtual reality documentaries about <a href="https://www.earthguardians.org/">Earth Guardians,</a> but a transformative COP23 documentary screening on Amazonian forest protectors changed my perspective. This journey led me into web3, ReFi, civic innovation, embodied in my regenerative systemic work at <a href="Https://www.twitter.com/opencivics">OpenCivics</a>.</em></p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/83981E15-2B82-4879-9EA3-F87C6E6032FD.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1024" height="1024" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/83981E15-2B82-4879-9EA3-F87C6E6032FD.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/83981E15-2B82-4879-9EA3-F87C6E6032FD.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/83981E15-2B82-4879-9EA3-F87C6E6032FD.jpeg 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="exploring-biodiversity-credits-as-a-path-to-environmental-restoration-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Exploring Biodiversity Credits as a Path to Environmental Restoration 🌱</h1><p>A rich and interdependent diversity of plants, animals, and fungi is essential to our survival as a species and the planet as a whole. Yet <a href="https://www.ipbes.net/news/Media-Release-Global-Assessment">biodiversity is declining</a> at an <a href="https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/one-planet-two-crises-tackling-climate-change-and-biodiversity-in-the-fight-for-our-future/">alarming rate</a>. Human activities such as deforestation, overexploitation, pollution, invasive species, and climate change are driving us deeper into what scientists are calling the <a href="sixth mass extinction">sixth great mass extinction event</a> on Earth. How can we divert course? How might we drive value to that which is protecting us all? Could biodiversity credits be a part of the solution? 🦋</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/080F313C-30AC-44A2-A83F-B992597BA8C5.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1600" height="1200" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/080F313C-30AC-44A2-A83F-B992597BA8C5.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/080F313C-30AC-44A2-A83F-B992597BA8C5.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/080F313C-30AC-44A2-A83F-B992597BA8C5.jpeg 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source:</em> <em><a href="https://www.britannica.com/science/biodiversity-loss">Encyclopedia Britannica</a></em></figcaption></figure><h3 id="what-are-biodiversity-credits-%F0%9F%A6%8E">What are Biodiversity Credits? 🦎</h3><p>While they are yet to become widely adopted and there are significant challenges to overcome, <a href="https://www.biodiversitycreditalliance.org/">biodiversity credits</a> are a funding methodology for honouring and protecting nature that directs funds to holistic ecological stewardship. </p><p>In contrast to traditional finance that focuses on single-species landscapes, biodiversity credits encourage a positive impact on a variety of living creatures and habitats. Additionally, they serve as a tool for compensating Indigenous communities and ecological stewards for their holistic protection and care for the ecosystems we all depend on.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/F56996D5-B39E-40B7-919D-B555B2F0E7BC.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1080" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/F56996D5-B39E-40B7-919D-B555B2F0E7BC.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/F56996D5-B39E-40B7-919D-B555B2F0E7BC.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/F56996D5-B39E-40B7-919D-B555B2F0E7BC.jpeg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source: <a href="https://twitter.com/UN/status/1660662802619699200">United Nations</a></em></figcaption></figure><h3 id="biodiversity-credits-carbon-credits-%F0%9F%90%A0">Biodiversity credits &gt; Carbon credits 🐠</h3><p>Unlike carbon offsets, which are payments made by a business to compensate for damaging impacts on ecosystems, biodiversity credits allow companies to support nature-positive action, funding long-term conservation and restoration of ecosystem services. Yet to achieve their potential, biodiversity credits must avoid the <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2023/may/24/chevron-carbon-offset-climate-crisis">pitfalls that have plagued carbon credits</a> in the past like false reporting, overestimating emission reductions, displacing emissions rather than reducing them, harming local communities and ecosystems, or creating perverse incentives for polluters.</p><h3 id="opportunities-and-challenges-of-biodiversity-credits-%F0%9F%94%96">Opportunities and challenges of biodiversity credits 🔖</h3><p>Despite the promise they hold for environmental conservation, biodiversity credits face several challenges that limit their potential to scale:</p><p><strong>🪧</strong> Lack of clear definitions and standards<br>🧐 Lack of transparency and accountability in the market<br>💰 Lack of demand from buyers and supply from sellers<br>🛖 Lack of recognition and inclusion of ecological stewards like indigenous communities</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/A65C7514-F909-4DBC-B48A-C6620C8FF66C.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1080" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/A65C7514-F909-4DBC-B48A-C6620C8FF66C.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/A65C7514-F909-4DBC-B48A-C6620C8FF66C.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/A65C7514-F909-4DBC-B48A-C6620C8FF66C.jpeg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Check out <a href="https://www.forestpeoples.org/en">Forest Peoples Program</a> to learn more about the integral role of Indigenous Land Stewardship</em></figcaption></figure><p>To overcome these challenges, a coalition of experienced field-based conservation practitioners and academics have formed the <a href="https://www.biodiversitycreditalliance.org/">Biodiversity Credit Alliance (BCA)</a> with the mission of bringing clarity and guidance for the formulation of credible and scalable biodiversity credit markets. This includes a set of global biodiversity credit principles seeking to mobilize financial flows towards biodiversity custodians while recognizing local knowledge and contexts. </p><p>The BCA aims to learn from the mistakes made in the development of the carbon credit market by establishing a framework that utilizes <a href="https://www.investopedia.com/terms/d/distributed-ledger-technology-dlt.asp">Distributed Ledger Technology</a> in its architecture from the beginning. </p><h3 id="biodiversity-in-refi-%F0%9F%A6%84">Biodiversity in ReFi 🦄</h3><p>Several projects in the ReFi space are already contributing to the adoption of the biodiversity credit process by offering tokenized marketplaces for biodiversity credits. Here are some of the leading ones:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Most-updated-graph-without-links-1-.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/Most-updated-graph-without-links-1-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/Most-updated-graph-without-links-1-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/05/Most-updated-graph-without-links-1-.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/Most-updated-graph-without-links-1-.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em><a href="https://twitter.com/basindao">Basin Global</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ClimateTrade">Climate Trade</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/regen_network">Regen Network</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/TerrasosCo">Terrasos</a></em></figcaption></figure><h3 id="what-does-the-future-hold-%F0%9F%94%AE">What does the future hold? 🔮</h3><p>Biodiversity credits have the potential to unlock billions of dollars for nature-positive action. A unified framework for evaluating and compensating the preservation of biodiversity would not only help achieve the global biodiversity <a href="https://www.cbd.int/article/cop15-cbd-press-release-final-19dec2022">targets set by the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)</a> but would also create millions of jobs, improve livelihoods, enhance local resilience, and mitigate climate change. </p><p>To ensure credibility, transparency, accountability, and scalability in the market, biodiversity credits must adhere to the global principles and standards set by the BCA and the UN Biodiversity <a href="https://www.unep.org/un-biodiversity-conference-cop-15">COP15 in Montreal</a>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/1DA6F4CA-77C1-447A-8D83-B537B7DE0AF2.webp" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1434" height="642" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/05/1DA6F4CA-77C1-447A-8D83-B537B7DE0AF2.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/05/1DA6F4CA-77C1-447A-8D83-B537B7DE0AF2.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/05/1DA6F4CA-77C1-447A-8D83-B537B7DE0AF2.webp 1434w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em><a href="https://www.nature.com/articles/s41559-021-01619-5">Read this report from Nature</a> on the tax justice and debt implications of biodiversity targets.</em></figcaption></figure><p>In the vibrant tapestry of our planet, each thread of biodiversity credits weaves us closer to a future where economic growth and nature dance in harmonious balance. item.title: Non-Financial Blockchain Tech for Climate 🌏 🙏 | Roundup #67
item.dc:creator: Nura Linggih
Ben West
Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em><strong>Hi Regens. It's </strong><a href="https://twitter.com/BenWest"><strong>Ben West</strong></a><strong> and Tarah Stafford here with the latest ReFi Roundup! 👋 </strong>For decades now we have been co-conspirators dedicated to finding climate solutions and helping them thrive. Tarah is a screenwriter, strategist, and certified secret weapon. Ben is the Grants Program Lead at <a href="https://www.gitcoin.co/">Gitcoin</a> and a seasoned climate campaigner/troublemaker. Together we are a force of nature working with Gitcoin and the support of the <a href="https://ethereum.org/en/">Ethereum Foundation</a> as well as a network of regens inside and outside of web3 to spread awareness and expand capacity for blockchain-enabled climate solutions.</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1024" height="1024" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image.png 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>AI-generated image of a sustainable city using decentralized network technology</em></figcaption></figure><h1 id="unlocking-the-power-of-non-financial-blockchain-tech-as-climate-solutions-%F0%9F%8C%8F">Unlocking the Power of Non-Financial Blockchain Tech as Climate Solutions 🌏</h1><p>Much of the discussion around blockchain technology is often focused on cryptocurrencies or the plethora of meme coins and scams that are often built on top. Yet as the world struggles to address the urgency of the climate crisis, blockchain has the potential to be a game-changer in the murky waters of international coordination, resource allocation, and international accountability. Innovative crypto financial instruments and '<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokenomics#:~:text=Tokenomics%2C%20also%20known%20as%20token,on%20blockchain%2Dbased%20distributed%20ledgers.">tokenomics</a>' may play an important role as climate solutions, but let's a step back to examine some of the core applications of the evolving foundational technology itself...</p><h2 id="carbon-accounting-%F0%9F%A7%AE">Carbon Accounting 🧮</h2><p>It's been said that what gets measured gets done. Accurate carbon accounting is critical if we are going to get serious about climate action. Yet currently, carbon accounting is done using a hodgepodge of non-standardized, jurisdictional, and proprietary carbon accounting tools and methodologies. These systems lack interoperability, are not easily monitored or verified, and are prone to centralized server operational security (opSec) vulnerabilities.</p><p>Using standardized, decentralized, free open source protocols could create a foundation for widely used and more useful carbon accounting at all levels of government. Organizations such as <a href="https://www.blockchainforclimate.org/">Blockchain for Climate</a> and the <a href="https://www.openearth.org/">Open Earth Foundation</a> are leading this charge with government pilot projects around the world to implement robust and verifiable systems for monitoring and managing greenhouse gas emissions (GHGs). 🙌</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.19.45-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1421" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.19.45-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.19.45-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.19.45-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.19.45-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/intellecteu_why-use-blockchain-for-carbon-accounting-activity-7021877574062518272-0EbA">Why use blockchain for carbon accounting?</a> | <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/intellecteu/">IntellectEU</a></em></figcaption></figure><h2 id="supply-chain-management-%F0%9F%8F%AD">Supply Chain Management 🏭</h2><p>Global supply chains suffer from many of the same challenges as carbon accounting: expensive vendor lock-in, data fragmentation and inaccessibility. This makes it challenging to create critical efficiencies or to have international accountability.<br><br>Blockchain can be a neutral, transparent and universal foundation for applications that ensure traceability, allowing every transaction and movement of goods to be recorded on an immutable ledger and verified in real-time. <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zero-knowledge_proof">Zero-knowledge proofs </a>also provide new opportunities to protect trade secrets while retaining reliable verification of data.<br><br>Organizations like <a href="https://twitter.com/permetsystems">Permet Systems</a> and The New Fork (<a href="https://openfoodchain.com/">Open Food Chain</a>)<strong> </strong>are two leading examples building real-world templates for scaling this kind of infrastructure in their industries (fashion and food). 🙌</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-2.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1236" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/image-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/image-2.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source: <a href="https://twitter.com/permetsystems/status/1620219031180689408/photo/1">@permetsystems</a></em></figcaption></figure><h2 id="impact-certificates-decentralized-identity-and-oracles-%F0%9F%AA%A9">Impact Certificates, Decentralized Identity, and Oracles 🪩</h2><p>Individual actions play an important role in creating positive impact from the bottom up. By bringing this valuable data on-chain, we may be able to unleash scalable databases of <a href="https://gov.gitcoin.co/t/impact-certificates-proposals-wanted/10499">impact certificates</a> with trust and accountability. This approach would create a true "resume of good work" for participants. Consider the <a href="https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/4CBoRsCxi5zMWdaDJ/hypercerts-a-new-primitive-for-public-goods-funding">Hypercerts primitive</a>, which can be built to acknowledge and reward individuals who support renewable energy projects, reduce carbon emissions, adopt regenerative agriculture methods, or create any other form of positive impact. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Hypercerts.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1600" height="580" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Hypercerts.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Hypercerts.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Hypercerts.png 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source: <a href="https://twitter.com/hypercerts">@hypercerts</a></em></figcaption></figure><p>A key building block for this kind of infrastructure is <a href="https://ethereum.org/en/decentralized-identity/">decentralized identity</a> - the idea that individuals should be able to have control over their digital identities without relying on centralized authorities or intermediaries. For example, protocols like <a href="https://www.gitcoin.co/passport">Gitcoin Passport</a> enable individuals to verify their personhood and then connect this to the impact work attributable to them. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-9.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1089" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-9.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-9.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/image-9.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-9.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source: <a href="https://blog.ceramic.network/tag/news/">ceramic.network</a></em></figcaption></figure><p>On the other side, once a person (or their handle) is identified, how is the impact they create verified? In the case of carbon mitigation projects, MRV (monitoring, reporting and verification) depends on data collected from sources such as satellites, drones and on-the-ground sensors. <a href="https://chain.link/education/blockchain-oracles">Oracles</a> are the software that brings this valuable data on-chain and they play a key role in carbon accounting and crediting, as well as in creative strategies around crop insurance and the incentivization of GHG reduction strategies in agriculture, oceans, and forestry. <a href="https://shamba.network/">Shamba Network</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/AstralProtocol">Astral Protocol</a> have both been pioneers in this work. 🙌</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-10.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1201" height="551" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-10.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-10.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-10.png 1201w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Astral Protocol Tech Stack (Source: <a href="https://docs.astral.global/archive/astral-protocol/the-overall-capability">Astral</a>)</em></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.50.55-pm.png" width="2000" height="1115" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.50.55-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.50.55-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.50.55-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.50.55-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.16-pm.png" width="2000" height="1122" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.16-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.16-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.16-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.16-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.28-pm.png" width="2000" height="1122" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.28-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.28-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.28-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/Screenshot-2023-06-06-at-6.51.28-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h2 id="lets-build-together-%F0%9F%AB%A1">Let's build together 🫡</h2><p>In conclusion, while international coordination remains a significant obstacle to climate action, non-financial blockchain technology offers promising solutions. Yet it is important to note that while this technology holds great potential, it is not a panacea to fix all of humanity's woes. Furthermore, to truly harness its potential, we must shift gears from talking and speculating to building, doing, and demonstrating. We must embrace a collaborative mindset, recognizing that blockchain technology is a catalyst that requires collective efforts to unleash its full potential. By combining our expertise, resources, and ambitions, we can harness the power of blockchain to drive meaningful change and accelerate progress towards a more sustainable, resilient, and regenerative future. Let's grow 🌱 </p><p><em>If you want to dive deeper into these ideas keep an eye out for interesting events and activities on <a href="https://gitcoin.notion.site/Gitcoin-Grantee-Portal-6adfc92627474bd48a5dfcd1e8438d20?pvs=4">Gitcoin’s community hub</a> pages. We will be sharing talks and hackathons as well as opportunities to get involved in exciting projects and even earn impact certificates. </em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://gitcoin.notion.site/Gitcoin-Grantee-Portal-6adfc92627474bd48a5dfcd1e8438d20?pvs&#x3D;4" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Visit Gitcoin Community Hub! 👀</a></div><hr><p></p><div class="kg-card kg-header-card kg-width-full kg-size-small kg-style-image" style="background-image: url(https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/02/ReFi-Cover-1.png)" data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/02/ReFi-Cover-1.png"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="refi-newsbites-%F0%9F%97%9E%EF%B8%8F">ReFi NewsBites 🗞️</h2><h3 class="kg-header-card-subheader" id="em-stylebox-sizing-border-boxthe-latest-updates-across-refi-twitter-and-beyondem"><em style="box-sizing: border-box;">The latest updates across ReFi Twitter and beyond...</em></h3></div><h3 id="the-most-exciting-refi-projects-in-africa-%F0%9F%8C%8D">The most exciting ReFi projects in Africa 🌍</h3><p><a href="https://twitter.com/shambanetwork">Shamba</a> shared a list of ReFi projects from Africa that are shaping the world. Including <a href="https://twitter.com/ChamaDAO_">Chama DAO</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/TheSafariDAO">Safari DAO</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/Chatafisha">CHATHAFISHA</a>, and many more.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/shambanetwork/status/1663579229433499652?s=20"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-13.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-13.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-13.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/image-13.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/06/image-13.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><h3 id="refi-is-the-future-%F0%9F%94%AE">ReFi is the future 🔮</h3><p><a href="https://cointelegraph.com/">Cointelegraph</a> admits that traditional finance attitudes are limiting crypto's potential. The future lies in regenerative finance, which focuses on renewing resources and making finance fair for everyone.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/Cointelegraph/status/1663533486991622144?s=20"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-14.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="662" height="632" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-14.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-14.png 662w"></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/Cointelegraph/status/1663533486991622144?s&#x3D;20" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read the article</a></div><h3 id="is-refi-changing-the-world-yet-%F0%9F%93%89">Is ReFi changing the world yet? 📉</h3><p><a href="https://twitter.com/MilkMoney64209/status/1663988914388975616">Ben Birkholm</a> aka MilkMoney shared an important question with the ReFi community. Are we still in the building and hustling phase or are we entering the winning phase and changing the world? </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://twitter.com/MilkMoney64209/status/1663988914388975616?s=20"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-15.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="960" height="720" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-15.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-15.png 960w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/MilkMoney64209/status/1663988914388975616" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join the discussion</a></div><h3 id="fc-barcelona-launched-its-first-nft-with-plastiks-%E2%9A%BD%EF%B8%8F">FC Barcelona launched it's first NFT with Plastiks ⚽️</h3><p><a href="https://twitter.com/FCBarcelona">FC Barcelona</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/Plastiks_io">Plastiks</a> are releasing an NFT collection that helps cut plastic waste, equivalent to four football matches, through the exclusive NFT collection, supporting the recovery of over a million kilograms of plastic!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/3505122/fc-barcelona-launches-its-first-nft-collection-in-association-with-plastiks"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-19.png" 624w"></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a id="liberating-structures-learning-journey-begins-%F0%9F%8E%89">Liberating Structures Learning Journey Begins 🎉</h3><p>With the guidance of <a href="https://twitter.com/gospelofchange">Jeremy Aakers</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/BrunoRoemers">Bruno Roemers</a>, the second season of Liberating Structures kicked off last week with 20 participants. Congratulations friends! 👏</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-21.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1779" height="821" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/06/image-21.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/06/image-21.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/06/image-21.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-21.png 1779w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source: <a href="https://twitter.com/gospelofchange/status/1664192762801975296">Twitter</a></em></figcaption></figure><h3 id="the-commonsverse-as-a-parallel-polis-%F0%9F%8C%86">The Commonsverse as a Parallel Polis 🌆</h3><p>One of the top authors of the commons, David Bollier, depicts the social practices as layers on top of a city to achieve a commons-based socio-politic and cultural system.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ckseZNahi84?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="The Commonsverse as a Parallel Polis: Opportunities and Challenges"></iframe></figure><hr><h3 id="submit-content-ideas-or-feedback-%F0%9F%91%87%F0%9F%8F%BD">Submit content ideas or feedback 👇🏽</h3><p><em>Want to see a story featured in next week's Roundup? data-kg-background-image="https://blog.refidao.com/content/images/2023/02/ReFi-Cover.png"><h2 class="kg-header-card-header" id="%F0%9F%94%A5-projects-of-the-week">🔥 Projects of the Week</h2><h3 item.title: Roundup on Pause 🚨
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p>Hello regens! 👋 <br><br><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna">Anna</a> here, with a little update on the ReFi Roundup! You might have noticed that there was no Roundup published last week. Don't worry, it hasn't vanished into thin air! We're simply hitting the pause button to reflect and ensure that we bring you the absolute best content possible.</p><p>We would like to hear from our readers! Whether you've enjoyed the roundup posts in the past or have some constructive feedback to share, please take a moment to fill out this feedback form. 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/n07o4Q" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Fill out the Feedback Form</a></div><p>Your input will help us understand your needs and ensure that we continue delivering valuable and enjoyable content.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/06/image-24.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="453" height="316"></figure><p>As we embark on this journey together, your thoughts, suggestions, and feedback are vital. We want to know what resonates with you, what you'd like to see more of, and how we can improve. 🤗</p><p>In the meantime, please feel free to explore our existing content on the blog.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore the ReFi DAO Blog</a></div><p>We want to express our deepest gratitude to all the roundup contributors who have been a driving force behind our weekly updates. We appreciate every contribution you've made. 🙌</p><p>Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. 💚</p>

item.title: A Journey Through the ReFi Costa Rica Local Node 🦥🦜
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey regens! </em>👋<em> <br><br><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna">Anna</a> here, social media and comms lead at <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist">ReFi DAO</a>, sharing the experience I had while visiting the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiCostaRica_">ReFi Local Node in Costa Rica</a>. After months of working remotely on the Local Nodes cohort experience along with the ReFi DAO team, meeting all the incredible humans behind the Costa Rica Local Node made me realize the impact that Local Nodes are already having in real life. Today, I would like to share with you the magic of regeneration in Costa Rica. </em>✨</p><p><em>Let's go on a small adventure together, shall we? 🦜</em>☕</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-13-57.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="960" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-13-57.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-13-57.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-13-57.jpg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Criptocantina in <a href="https://www.facebook.com/senderocr/">Casa Sendero</a>, Barrio Escalante</em></figcaption></figure><h2 id="discovering-san-jos%C3%A9-%E2%9B%B0%EF%B8%8F%F0%9F%8C%8B">Discovering San José ⛰️🌋</h2><p>At the end of June, I had the privilege of meeting the dynamic team behind the ReFi Costa Rica Local Node. The experience started by discovering the rich culture and history of the country, walking the streets of San José.</p><p>The journey through Costa Rican culture began at <a href="https://www.sikwacostarica.com/">Sikwa</a>, a beautiful restaurant serving ancestral food prepared by chef <a href="https://www.instagram.com/pabloelcocinero/">Pablo Bonilla</a>. The concept of safeguarding and researching how to grow and prepare vegetables and fruits that would otherwise be forgotten was truly revealing. Imagine the amount of different tastes and nutrients we are missing on, just because they are not included in supermarket offers. May permaculture and going back to actually harvesting our own food and including ancestral vegetables and fruits make our nutrition richer than ever?</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-30-00-1.jpg" width="1280" height="960" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-30-00-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-30-00-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-30-00-1.jpg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-29-44-1.jpg" width="960" height="1280" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-29-44-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-29-44-1.jpg 960w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-29-27.jpg" width="960" height="1280" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-29-27.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-29-27.jpg 960w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><em><a href="https://www.sikwacostarica.com/">Sikwa</a> - Costarican ancestral food</em></figcaption></figure><p>Costa Rica is blessed with potable tap water, and after living in Mexico for the past two years, it was the first thing I noticed. And it's actually something that shouldn't be a blessing. It should be a reality for every human being on this planet.</p><p>From the strong coffee culture to the breathtaking nature, to delicious food and cheerful people, I can say that my stay in San José made me feel at peace. It's a rich country in many aspects, and I can see many regenerative projects flourishing here. Costa Rica has no army, and therefore, the funds of one of the most lucrative businesses in the world can be re-directed to other goals.</p><blockquote>"In Costa Rica, no mother should cry because of having to send her son to war." - Janelle from <a href="https://verdesmonteverde.com/">Verdes Monteverde</a> during Criptocantina</blockquote><p>My gratefulness goes to <a href="https://twitter.com/muguika">Karla</a> and Ranulfo for giving me a detailed tour of the capital city, and to <a href="https://twitter.com/gaiaimpactcr">Ronny</a>, for guiding me through <a href="https://www.rescatewildlife.org/es/inicio/">Zooave</a>, an incredible Wildlife Rescue Center that made me face, for the first time, the reality of animal trafficking.<br><br>Sharing some pics from discovering San José below 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-46-33.jpg" width="960" height="1280" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-46-33.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-46-33.jpg 960w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-46-53.jpg" width="960" height="1280" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-46-53.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-46-53.jpg 960w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/photo_2023-07-07_08-47-11.jpg" width="960" height="1280" loading="lazy" alt Lab</a></em></figcaption></figure><hr><h2 id="where-do-we-go-from-here-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Where Do We Go From Here? 🌱</h2><p>Reflecting on my experiences, I realize that Costa Rica's potential in fostering a blend of regenerative principles and web3 technology is immense. Our future, filled with promise and innovation, is ready for us to step in. Meeting in person and hearing the stories that each and every project had to share, followed by a warm hug or a shared meal, made me understand that we are much more than a digital project. </p><p>We are all humans, and we need human interactions to regenerate our reality. Go out there, meet with other people sharing the same vision, and start regenerating together. My heart is full, and I am beyond grateful for all the support I got from the ReFi DAO team to embark on this journey. Let's go! 🔥 </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/1e08391c-47a9-4ec7-bd74-78051f2eb5fb_1024x683.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1024" height="683" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/1e08391c-47a9-4ec7-bd74-78051f2eb5fb_1024x683.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/1e08391c-47a9-4ec7-bd74-78051f2eb5fb_1024x683.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/1e08391c-47a9-4ec7-bd74-78051f2eb5fb_1024x683.jpg 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Photo by José Tenorio of <a href="https://www.instagram.com/ideas.sueltas.lab/" rel="nofollow ugc noopener">Ideas Sueltas Lab</a></em></figcaption></figure>

item.title: To Network State or Not to Network State | ReFi DAO Forum 🗣️
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p>In the ever-evolving world of Web3 &amp; Crypto, one concept has ignited a firestorm of debate and discussion: <strong>the Network State</strong>. In mid-2022, <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balaji_Srinivasan">Balaji Srinivasan</a> - the controversial thinker, investor, and former CTO of Coinbase - introduced the idea in his book, '<a href="https://thenetworkstate.com/">The Network State: How To Start a New Country</a>'. In this audacious proposition, he sparked widespread intrigue and a movement of communities and entrepreneurs seeking to build this new type of organisation...</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/What-is-a-Network-State--by-Balaji-Srinivasan---ReFi-DAO-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/What-is-a-Network-State--by-Balaji-Srinivasan---ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/What-is-a-Network-State--by-Balaji-Srinivasan---ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/07/What-is-a-Network-State--by-Balaji-Srinivasan---ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/07/What-is-a-Network-State--by-Balaji-Srinivasan---ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em><a href="https://thenetworkstate.com/the-network-state-in-one-sentence">The Network State in One Sentence</a></em></figcaption></figure><p>Taking this concept in a new direction, in February 2023 ReFi DAO announced a vision for a network state <strong>as a vehicle for planetary regeneration</strong>. The model imagined a globally dispersed, but deeply connected organization that takes form as a decentralized network of local startup communities with a mission to catalyze both inner and outer regeneration and pioneer a new paradigm. </p><p>The idea was born out of a sobering observation: existing institutions – be they nation-states, corporations, or civil society – have persistently fallen short in tackling the pervasive threats of climate change and other critical challenges of our time. The urgency for a leap in innovation across cultural, social, economic, and technological domains is crystal clear. Driven by this realization, ReFi DAO formulated a mission to bring about <strong>a global regenerative economy</strong>, fostered by a transformative global network of mission aligned local communities.</p><p>Yet despite its allure, the concept of a network state is not without controversy. It has sparked a captivating ideological and political debate, drawing in a wide diversity of perspectives. What exactly constitutes as a network state? Why has it become such a popular meme? What is it that is resonating with so many? And what are the lurking dangers, concerns, risks and critiques?</p><p>In this article, we set out to unravel these questions. Drawing upon the enlightening dialogues from the recent <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-group/ReFi-DAO-Forum/r/recbjJ1Wa9mZXW9JI">ReFi DAO Forum</a>, we will dive deeper into the heart of the network state concept - both its potential and its challenges. From this exploration, we will begin to embark on a journey of discovery and co-creation as we collectively sculpt a new vision for a ReFi DAO powered by and for our community. <a href="https://twitter.com/search?q=%23RegenCoordination&amp;src=typed_query">#RegenCoordiNATION</a>? First, some background... 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/01.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/01.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/01.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/07/01.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/07/01.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="refi-daos-evolving-organisation">ReFi DAO's Evolving Organisation</h1><p>Since 2021, ReFi DAO has been cultivating an ecosystem with hundreds of founders &amp; investors, an online community of thousands, and many dozen of events across the globe. 🌎 🌍 🌏 In this time, with a small core team at the helm, we have been able to build and iterate rapidly, testing new ideas in a live environment while responding to community feedback. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/35.png" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/35.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/35.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/07/35.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/07/35.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/ReFi-DAO-Network-State-July-2023.jpg" width="1315" height="1110" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/ReFi-DAO-Network-State-July-2023.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/ReFi-DAO-Network-State-July-2023.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/ReFi-DAO-Network-State-July-2023.jpg 1315w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>But now, the stakes are higher. With a significant online influence and a growing network of autonomous local communities, we've reached beyond our startup roots. We must transform our governance and organizational structure. We must become a community-first, community-led and community-owned organisation.</p><p>With this is mind, ReFi DAO is seeking to embark on a 12 to 24 months journey towards '<a href="https://www.colorado.edu/lab/medlab/exit-to-community">Exit-To-Community</a>' where ownership and governance will be distributed to key community members and contributors. This strategy seeks to decentralize wealth and voice across the network rather than concentrating it in a select few, and aims to ensure that the organization is co-owned and co-governed by the community that fuels it in a way that promotes inclusivity, dynamism, and enhances collective capacity.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-09-at-3.55.44-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1120" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-09-at-3.55.44-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-09-at-3.55.44-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-09-at-3.55.44-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-09-at-3.55.44-pm.png 2260w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>The newly launched <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-group/ReFi-DAO-Forum/r/recbjJ1Wa9mZXW9JI">ReFi DAO Forum</a> aims to act as a vehicle for this transition. We are inviting a diverse network of ReFi DAO stakeholders, alongside leaders from across the Web3, distributed governance, organizational and monetary policy sectors to help shape the vision and trajectory of ReFi DAO. Taking form in monthly <a href="https://www.liberatingstructures.com/">liberating structured</a> workshops, we aim to create space for open discussions, sense-making, and active co-creation, while promoting diversity, inclusivity, and creativity. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-group/ReFi-DAO-Forum/r/recbjJ1Wa9mZXW9JI#home-footer0" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join the ReFi DAO Forum</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-group/ReFi-DAO-Forum/r/recbjJ1Wa9mZXW9JI"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/49.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/49.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/49.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/07/49.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/07/49.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-group/ReFi-DAO-Forum/r/recbjJ1Wa9mZXW9JI#home-footer0"><strong>Join the ReFi DAO Forum</strong></a></figcaption></figure><p>Guided by principles from <a href="https://www.sociocracyforall.org/sociocracy-and-holacracy-a-comparison/">Holacracy and Sociocracy</a>, <a href="https://www.theblindspot.space/">Androgynous Organisations</a>, <a href="https://disco.coop/">Distributed Cooperatives (DisCO)</a>, <a href="https://bouckaert.nu/en/about-deep-democracy/#:~:text=Deep%20Democracy%20is%20a%20vision,includes%20alternative%20points%20of%20view.">Deep Democracy</a>, and more, the Forum will also act as a mechanism for consent-based governance with core ReFi DAO stakeholders, aiming to surface the community's thoughts, ideas, concerns, and tensions regarding ReFi DAO's actions and proposals.</p><p>The <a href="https://lu.ma/refi-dao-forum">first ReFi DAO Forum Meeting</a> kicked off on the 24th May and served as a springboard for the beginning of our community-led sense-making. Among the many insights and action points, there was a wellspring of thoughts and concerns around the idea of Network States, which brought us to our next session...</p><h1 id="to-network-state-or-not-to-network-state-%F0%9F%8C%90">To Network State or not to Network State? 🌐</h1><p>Kicking off the second ReFi DAO Forum meeting, a vibrant ensemble of changemakers, innovators, and thinkers from around the globe assembled. Each brought a unique perspective rooted in their diverse cultural backgrounds, professional experiences, and areas of expertise. From <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-kariuki-a6958619a/">Victor Kariuki</a>'s work on decentralized science in Kenya, to <a href="https://twitter.com/marsxrobertson">Mars Robertson</a>'s redefining of value from London; <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/timgoudzand/">Timothy Goudzand</a>' ReFi Leadership in <a href="__GHOST_URL__/the-refi-ecosystem-in-suriname/">Suriname</a>, to <a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_">Giulio Quarta</a>'s post-capitalist activism across Austria and Spain; <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika/">Karla Córdoba-Brenes</a>' transformative work on social currencies in Costa Rica, to <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthieu-hayoz-618b8339/">Matthieu Hayoz</a>'s groundbreaking nature-centric app development in Switzerland. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><a href="https://lu.ma/refi-dao-forum-2"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/ReFi-Forum-twitter-post.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/ReFi-Forum-twitter-post.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/ReFi-Forum-twitter-post.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/07/ReFi-Forum-twitter-post.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/07/ReFi-Forum-twitter-post.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-19-at-4.09.06-pm.png" width="2000" height="926" loading="lazy" alt srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-19-at-4.09.06-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/Screenshot-2023-07-19-at-4.09.06-pm.png 1000w, participants...</figcaption></figure><p>Coming together our aim was to delve into the concept of the Network State - its merits, drawbacks, and proposed alternatives - and dissect <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/ReFi-DAO-Network-State-Initial-Proposal-Hypothesis-Feb16th-2023-920abdb38fb34ca2aeeaae4d1f56c561?pvs=4">ReFi DAOs Initial Network State Draft Hypothesis from Feb16th 2023</a>. Let's dive in to some of the key insights and reflections.. But first, what actually is a network state?</p><h2 id="the-short-history-of-network-states">The Short History of Network States...</h2><p>The innovative but controversial conception of a network state was originally coined by <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balaji_Srinivasan">Balaji Srinivasan</a> in mid-2022 within his book, '<a href="https://thenetworkstate.com/">The Network State: How To Start a New Country</a>'. Balaji is a well-known entrepreneur and investor, he is the former CTO of Coinbase, co-founder of Earn.com (acquired by Coinbase), and has served as a board member of Andreessen Horowitz, a renowned venture capital firm.</p><p>As defined by Balaji, he characterises a network state as the next evolution of nation-states. He envisions them starting with the formation of highly-aligned online community that takes root around a strong shared proposition or 'moral innovation'. Subsequently the community goes on to acquire land or 'territory' in various locations, acting more like a decentralized network than a contiguous piece of land. The idea is based on the convergence of digital platforms and political entities that evolve from online communities based on shared propositions into actual physical states. </p><figure href="https://gitbook.jur.io/wiki-network-state/">Jur Network State Wiki</a></strong></figcaption></figure><p>Srinivasan compares network states to cryptocurrency's rise to recognition. Cryptocurrency started with numerical significance, gaining traction through increased use and market capitalization, before obtaining societal significance with acceptance and recognition from existing financial institutions (although this has understandably taken a bit of a knock in recent times!). Similarly, a network state could gain numerical significance (population, land ownership, income) and then strive for societal recognition in the form of diplomatic acknowledgment from existing states.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/image-13.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="640" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/image-13.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/image-13.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/image-13.png 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>The key innovations that make network states possible, according to Srinivasan, are existing internet &amp; Web3 technologies. They allow for the building of massive online communities, the start of billion-dollar digital currencies, and development of comprehensive global governance and coordination systems. As such, Balaji argues that such network states are already feasible today.</p><p>However. Given it's radical departure from traditional concepts of statehood and nation-building, as well as the contentious political nature of the concepts covered, Balaji's proposition has sparked widespread discussion and debate. Network states are still just an idea. It is not something that has ever been done before, and many questions and concerns remain. How would existing nations react to them? Would network states ever actually be acknowledged or receive legitimacy? And regardless of the theoretical feasibility, deeper questions also lurk. Do they represent a new frontier for economic and societal innovation? Or are they an elitist techno-libertarian fantasy with dystopian potential?</p><h2 id="part-1collective-visioning-%F0%9F%91%80">Part 1 - Collective Visioning 👀</h2><p>Before diving into the nuances of network state, to kick-off the Forum we first looked inwards to collectively imagine the future we want to inhabit and what is blocking us from getting there... Here is synthesis of key ideas shared:</p><p><strong>How do you envision a better future? What does it look like? How might we get there? </strong></p><ul><li><strong>Regeneration and Decentralized Science (DeSci):</strong> Participants imagine a future where regeneration and science play a central role. This extends to digital well-being, land regeneration, and fostering a culture around regenerative ecosystems. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-kariuki-a6958619a/">Victor Kariuki</a> highlighted the importance of nurturing education in regeneration, science, and web3 technologies. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/owen-langham-948647154/">Owen Langham</a> shared his interest in land regeneration and the challenge of including nature in balance sheets.</li><li><strong>Decentralization and Post-Capitalism</strong>: There's a call for a shift from traditional economic systems to alternatives that prioritize values, decentralization, and less monetary focus. This includes rethinking societal organization and incentives (<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ricaa/">Rica Amaral</a>), moving towards a post-capitalist future (<a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_">Giulio</a>), exploring social currencies and collaborative businesses (<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika/">Karla</a>), and seeing the potential of decentralization to enact change swiftly and effectively (<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/martincomas/">Martin</a>).</li><li><strong>Community Involvement and Democracy:</strong> A more democratic society where individuals have a continuous voice, not just during elections, is desired. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/daryledwards/">Daryl Edwards</a> focused on community contributions and meaningful collective action. Giulio envisions a future of solidarity, democracy, beauty, and abundance.</li><li><strong>High-Tech but High-Life:</strong> Several participants voiced support for the solarpunk movement, which combines a positive vision of the future, environmental sustainability, and the use of technology for the common good.</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/image-22.png" width="1024" height="1024" democratic, harmonious, conscious, decentralized, innovative, empowering, and inclusive. But what is blocking us from getting there?</p><p><strong>Where and how are current institutions, nation states and global systems failing us?</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Value Misalignment</strong>: <a href="https://twitter.com/marsxrobertson">Mars</a> highlighted how current systems fail to account for costs externalized to the future and nature, leading to a crisis. There is a lack of value placed on essential resources like clean air, rivers and abundant nature. <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant">Monty</a> also spoke about the need to redesign economic systems, calling for innovations in regenerative finance and the commons.</li><li><strong>Short-term Focus and Externalized Costs</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/daryledwards/">Daryl</a> pointed out that institutions fail in long-term planning and valuing future generations. There is also the issue of systemic drive for unsustainable growth, lack of global coordination, and lack of accountability - especially of international agreements.</li><li><strong>Inequality &amp; Exclusivity</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ricaa/">Rica</a> emphasized that current systems are not optimized for everyone and are instead being created by an elite to benefit the elite. These systems often lack local orientation and homogenize groups, voices, and dreams.</li><li><strong>Inadequate Institutions</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gospelofchange/">Jeremy Akers</a> mentioned how legacy institutions are built for the past and are ill-equipped to deal with the complexities of the modern world. He highlighted problems with centralization, institutional monoculture, and the lack of diversity, representation, and adaptability.</li></ul><p>These points provide an overview of the perceived failures of current systems. They highlight the need for systemic change, decentralization, redefining value, and improved representation and diversity in decision-making processes. The challenge lies in creating systems that can address these issues while remaining resonant and adaptable to the ever-changing complexities of the modern world...</p><h2 id="part-2network-states-%F0%9F%8C%90">Part 2 - Network States... 🌐</h2><p>Given the future that is being envisioned and some of the current blockers preventing us from getting there, we then dived into the world of network states to begin evaluating their applicability and dangers as a potential solution... Here is a synthesis of some key ideas shared:</p><p><strong>What are the attractive and exciting ideas surrounding the concept of a network state?</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Voluntary Participation and Mobility</strong>: As <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/alessandropalombo/">Alessandro Palombo</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/niklas-anzinger-50031653/">Niklas Anzinger</a> emphasized, Network States (NS) enable individuals to participate freely and leave at any moment. This flexibility promotes competition and innovation among different NS models. It also aligns with the idea of "voluntary association" that <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshuayongzh/">Joshua Yong</a> mentions.</li><li><strong>Innovation Catalyst Amidst System Failures</strong>: As recognized by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jbellison/">John Ellison</a>, <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant">Monty</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/alessandropalombo/">Alessandro</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/raamchandrasekharan/">Raam Chandrasekharan</a>, Network States present an opportunity for innovation in governance and institutions, acknowledging current systems' shortcomings. The potential for redefining state organization, fostering legal and regulatory innovation, and experimenting with alternative governance forms are seen as key opportunities offered by NS.</li><li><strong>Value-Driven and Collective Empowerment</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika/">Karla</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ricaa/">Rica</a> mention the attractiveness of a state or network built on shared values, rather than geographic location. This sentiment is echoed by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tereza-bizkova/">Tereza Bízková</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawn-alimohammadi-4b34b3139/">Shawn Alimohammadi</a> who highlight the idea of how an aligned community around a shared cause could facilitate collective action, and empower citizens to pioneer new forms of socio-ecological activism while promoting faster deployment and enhanced coordination.</li><li><strong>Environmental Regeneration</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sandraponcedeleon/">Sandra Ponce de León</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jbellison/">John</a> bring forth the idea of environmental regeneration and harmonious co-existence with the Earth. They suggest NS can play a significant role in this process by crowdfunding nature regeneration projects and redesigning the money system to be more regenerative.</li></ul><p>The overall consensus seems to be that NS offer an opportunity for radical innovation in governance and social organization, fuelled by decentralization, voluntary participation, technological advancements, and community alignment around shared values and goals.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/image-34.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1600" height="800" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/07/image-34.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/07/image-34.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/image-34.png 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://www.discoursemagazine.com/ideas/2022/02/09/from-nation-states-to-network-states/">From Nation-States to Network States </a>| <a href="https://www.discoursemagazine.com/">Discourse</a></figcaption></figure><p><strong>What are the dangers, concerns, or risks surrounding the concept of a network state?</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Exclusion and Inequality</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshuayongzh/">Joshua</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/timgoudzand/">Tim</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawn-alimohammadi-4b34b3139/">Shawn</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/raamchandrasekharan/">Raam</a> articulated concerns that Network States might inadvertently exacerbate socio-economic inequalities through exclusion of certain societal groups, wealth concentration, and accessibility challenges in emerging economies. Coupled with potential cultural, linguistic, and physical barriers, as well as risks of nationalist or anti-foreign bias, these could lead to neo-colonial practices &amp; conflict unless local stakeholders are actively included.</li><li><strong>Conflict and Abuse</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tereza-bizkova/">Tereza</a>, <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant">Monty</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/daryledwards/">Daryl</a> were also concerned about the potential for conflict, both within network states and with existing nation states. They worried about governance issues, extraction, and the potential for network states to replicate problems found in traditional systems. <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant">Monty</a>, in particular, highlighted the dangers of creating competitive exit-based states that are likely to further perpetuate dynamics of rivalry and conflict.</li><li><strong>Legitimacy and Recognition:</strong> <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sandraponcedeleon/">Sandra</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika/">Karla</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_">Giulio</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/martincomas/">Martin</a> expressed skepticism about whether network states could ever gain diplomatic recognition or legitimacy. They also questioned the focus on this goal, suggesting that it could be naive and unrealistic.</li><li><strong>Critique of the Underlying Philosophy</strong>: Several respondents including <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/raamchandrasekharan/">Raam</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/cifuenteslobo">Claudio</a>, and <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant">Monty</a> also expressed doubts about the philosophical underpinnings of network states and the underlying ideology of Balaji. They were skeptical of the focus on exit over engagement, the potential for falling back into extractive dynamics, and the risk of network states being a meme that is propagated by masculine-centric and egotistical elites.</li></ul><p>In general, while the respondents recognized the innovative potential of network states, they also cautioned against rushing into the concept without thoroughly examining its implications and potential risks. They advocated for careful consideration of issues like inequality, exclusion, conflict, and governance, and they emphasized the importance of community, inclusivity, and engagement over the pursuit of independence and diplomatic recognition.</p><h2 id="part-3a-refi-network-state-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Part 3 - A ReFi Network State? 🌱</h2><p>Now that we had explored both the potential and the concerns around the network state concept, we then embarked on an exercise to collectively scrutinise the <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/ReFi-DAO-Network-State-Initial-Proposal-Hypothesis-Feb16th-2023-920abdb38fb34ca2aeeaae4d1f56c561?pvs=4">original draft proposal</a> written in February 2022 of forming a ReFi Network State.
