item.title: AI, Nature and Web 3: The Path to a Regenerative Society │ ReFi Podcast Season 3 Ep. 1 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p>If there's one thing that's certain, it's that the world is in a constant state of change. As we inch closer to understanding our place within it, the need for a regenerative future becomes undeniably clear. The premiere episode of Season 3 of the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">ReFi Podcast</a> with <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin">Monty Merlin</a> brings this realization to the forefront, inviting us to embark on a transformative journey.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="john-ellisons-personal-reflection-%F0%9F%8C%BF">John Ellison's Personal Reflection 🌿</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/S3-pod---Youtube-thumbnail.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1280" height="720" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/09/S3-pod---Youtube-thumbnail.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/09/S3-pod---Youtube-thumbnail.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/S3-pod---Youtube-thumbnail.jpg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>In the first episode of Season 3, the host John Ellison shares the deep personal reflection that lies behind the new mission of Source Studios and the ReFi Podcast. </p><p>Over the past few months, John's identity within the ReFi ecosystem has grown. But with it came profound realizations about personal motivations, the duality of impact and greed, and the deeply embedded traumas of colonialism and societal inequalities. The path to self-awareness and introspection has been transformative. Now, rooted in Lisbon and connected with Studios all over the world, his mission is to redefine our understanding of family, community, and leadership.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="welcoming-monty-merlin-%F0%9F%A7%99%E2%80%8D%E2%99%82%EF%B8%8F">Welcoming Monty Merlin 🧙‍♂️</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/NM1JbNWDHHA?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="AI, Nature and Web 3: The Path to a Regenerative Society with Monty Merlin │ReFi Podcast S3 Ep. 1 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/NM1JbNWDHHA" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch</a></div><p>The guest of the premiere episode of Season 3 is the co-founder, product &amp; content Lead at <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist">ReFi DAO</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiLondon">ReFi London</a>, Monty Merlin.</p><p>Monty grew up amidst fervent discussions on environmental issues. His family, filled with passionate environmentalists, laid a strong foundation for him to form opinions, and ideas, and explore eco-centric concepts.</p><p>Monty's academic journey took him to the University of Bristol, where he explored integrated management combined with innovative practices. But what stands out is his final master's project – a dive into the world of startups, merging technology, economics, and philosophy. It was then that he chanced upon the world of cryptocurrency. But, rather than the traditional view, he saw an opportunity for crypto to have an environmental edge.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="an-unsettling-present-but-hopeful-future-%F0%9F%97%BA%EF%B8%8F">An Unsettling Present, But Hopeful Future 🗺️</h2><p>In this episode, Monty and John reflect on the undeniable changes around them, like the increasing number of forest fires and unprecedented heatwaves. Yet, amid this grim reality, John emphasizes that human-made systems are the root cause, implying they can also be the solution.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h3 id="envisioning-a-brighter-future-the-solarpunk-paradigm-%E2%98%80%EF%B8%8F"><strong>Envisioning a Brighter Future: The Solarpunk Paradigm </strong>☀️</h3><p>Amidst this sombre backdrop, the conversation took a hopeful turn. Monty introduced the captivating idea of a "solarpunk" future. Moving away from the grim, dystopian worlds often painted in popular culture, solarpunk imagines a harmonious coexistence of advanced technologies and nature. It's a vision where human innovations complement the environment, crafting ecologically abundant and holistic living spaces.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/53.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/09/53.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/09/53.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/09/53.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/53.jpg 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h3 id="the-fourth-industrial-revolution-%F0%9F%8C%90"><strong>The Fourth Industrial Revolution </strong>🌐</h3><p>The rise of AI marks a crucial phase in what many describe as the fourth Industrial Revolution. Historically, each industrial revolution has brought forward new tools, effectively enhancing our ability to automate processes and transform resources for improved productivity. A sentiment echoed by <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klaus_Schwab">Klaus Schwab</a>, the chairman of <a href="https://www.weforum.org/">WEF</a>, hints at the magnitude of change AI brings: "Those who control the technologies of this fourth Industrial Revolution will become the masters of this world."</p><p>The underlying notion is the perceptible shift in power dynamics as foundational structures of our society undergo transformation. But as AI begins to challenge our roles, we must confront existential questions: What does it mean to be human in an AI-driven world? As AI potentially disrupts a significant portion of jobs, what becomes our purpose in this vast tapestry of life?</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/NM1JbNWDHHA" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/NM1JbNWDHHA?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="AI, Nature and Web 3: The Path to a Regenerative Society with Monty Merlin │ReFi Podcast S3 Ep. 1 🎧"></iframe></figure><h3 id="ai-climate-and-humanity-%F0%9F%8C%8E"><strong>AI, Climate, and Humanity </strong>🌎</h3><p>While we grapple with the implications of AI, another overarching concern shadows our advancements – the ongoing climate crisis. Cities have turned into concrete jungles, a testament to human progress, but also a stark reminder of the strain we've put on nature.</p><p>However, there's an optimistic perspective, a silver lining. The AI super cycle, with its capital efficiency, might be the solution for striking a balance between growth targets and transitioning towards a regenerative society. If channeled correctly, the amalgamation of renewable energy and AI advancements could drive growth while ensuring the preservation of our environment. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI--Nature-and-Web3-The-Path-to-a-Regenerative-Society-with-Monty-Merlin-Season-3-Episode-1-e2916ii" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="tune-in-and-transform-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Tune In and Transform 🌱</h2><p>Your feedback is invaluable to us. We'd love to see your comments about the episode, we invite you to share your reflections on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">Twitter</a> or <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/">LinkedIn</a>. Together, we can further the dialogue, foster community, and take meaningful strides towards a regenerative future. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/J2d8e" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: In the premiere episode of the ReFi Podcast, John Ellison and Monty Merlin discuss the potential for redesigning systems and using advanced technology to create a regenerative future.

item.title: Environmental Asset Markets and Community Impact │ ReFi Podcast Season 3 Ep. 2 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p>In the latest episode of the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">ReFi Podcast</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a> of <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist">ReFi DAO</a> sits down with <a href="https://twitter.com/erde_kette">Sarah Baxendell</a> of <a href="https://twitter.com/regen_network">Regen Network</a> – a pioneer in the ReFi ecosystem. With a multi-faceted background touching everything from finance and supply chain management to hands-on agricultural practices and permaculture design, Sarah is currently the director of ecosystem at Regen Network. </p><p>During their conversation, John and Sarah touch on the intricate facets of the system Regen Network is pioneering, highlighting missing infrastructure links, and shedding light on the commendable milestones they've already set. The dialogue also ventures into the significant underrepresentation of women in the blockchain space and emphasizes the critical need for a collective, gender-inclusive approach.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/b-nbXl7u-Cs?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Environmental Asset Markets and Community Impact with Sarah Baxendell │Season 3 Episode 2 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/b-nbXl7u-Cs" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><hr><h2 id="sarahs-transformative-journey-to-climate-advocacy-%F0%9F%8C%BF">Sarah's Transformative Journey to Climate Advocacy 🌿</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/_MB26503-copy.jpg" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1335" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/09/_MB26503-copy.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/09/_MB26503-copy.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/09/_MB26503-copy.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/09/_MB26503-copy.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Sarah embarked on an unexpected journey towards climate activism after the <a href="https://www.weather.gov/mob/katrina">devastation of Hurricane Katrina</a> shook her, revealing the stark reality of climate change.</p><p>A mistaken invitation to a Radiohead concert unexpectedly steered her to the heart of the <a href="http://occupywallst.org/">Occupy Wall Street movement</a>. Surrounded by advocates for various causes, she felt a pull towards the climate change campaigners. With a background in sustainable design, Sarah swiftly integrated, focusing on eco-interventions in New York, from community gardens to permaculture design.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/-IiFVzMJnZo?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Funding NEEDS to go to those making IMPACT on the ground! #podcast #climateaction #regenerative"></iframe></figure><p>Sarah's path crossed serendipitously with <a href="https://terra-genesis.com/">Terra Genesis International</a>, forging an enduring bond with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/christian-shearer-b8877312/">Christian Shearer</a>, a member of their team, which led her to a pivotal role at Regen Network in 2019, marking another transformative chapter in her journey.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Environmental-Asset-Markets-and-Community-Impact-with-Sarah-Baxendell-e297gcs" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Environmental-Asset-Markets-and-Community-Impact-with-Sarah-Baxendell-e297gcs" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="the-vision-and-tech-behind-regen-network-%F0%9F%8C%B2">The Vision and Tech Behind Regen Network 🌲</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/image.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1896" height="795" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/09/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/09/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/09/image.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/image.png 1896w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><em>Source: <a href="https://www.regen.network/">https://www.regen.network/</a></em></figcaption></figure><p><a href="https://www.regen.network/">Regen Network</a> aims to establish a platform equipped with versatile tools that enable communities to design and communicate their restoration projects. The platform ensures that these projects are both scientifically rigorous and easily understandable, catering to a diverse audience from the scientific community to local elders. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regen.network/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Discover Regen Network</a></div><p>A pivotal aspect is its emphasis on decentralized local impact decision-making, allowing communities to have control and govern their own restoration endeavours. This decentralization ethos extends to its technical backbone: Regen Network is built on <a href="https://docs.tendermint.com/v0.34/introduction/what-is-tendermint.html">Tendermint</a> consensus, forming the foundational layer of the <a href="https://cosmos.network/">Cosmos ecosystem</a>. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Environmental-Asset-Markets-and-Community-Impact-with-Sarah-Baxendell-e297gcs" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Environmental-Asset-Markets-and-Community-Impact-with-Sarah-Baxendell-e297gcs" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="empowering-women-in-the-blockchain-space-%F0%9F%AA%B7">Empowering Women in the Blockchain Space 🪷</h2><p>Sarah, a fervent advocate for gender equality in the blockchain world, shared both shocking and inspiring experiences from her journey. While many events and meetings predominantly spotlight men, oblivious to the wealth of knowledge and expertise that women bring to the table, there are a few glimmers of hope.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/b-nbXl7u-Cs?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Environmental Asset Markets and Community Impact with Sarah Baxendell │Season 3 Episode 2 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/b-nbXl7u-Cs" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><p>Encouragingly, some events are realizing this gender gap, providing women the platform to lead technical presentations and voice their perspectives. However, Sarah's encounters and those of her peers unveil a deeper, more concerning underbelly. Reports of harassment, exploitation, and disrespect are alarmingly recurrent. The dominance of "mostly white boys on Zoom" is not just a superficial observation but a glaring reflection of the systemic bias. </p><p>Sarah’s stand is clear: organizations lacking female representation at decision-making levels need to introspect. By neglecting to promote women, they're perpetuating the problem. Addressing this imbalance isn’t just about equality; it's about valuing diverse perspectives that drive innovation.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Environmental-Asset-Markets-and-Community-Impact-with-Sarah-Baxendell-e297gcs" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Environmental-Asset-Markets-and-Community-Impact-with-Sarah-Baxendell-e297gcs" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="share-your-thoughts-%F0%9F%92%9A">Share your thoughts! 💚</h2><p>Would you like to share your perspective on this podcast episode? Please take a moment to join the conversation with your opinions via <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">Twitter</a> or <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">LinkedIn</a>. In this way, we can collectively deepen our understanding, nurture our community, and pave the way for a regenerative future.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/i139X" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: Sarah Baxendell's journey from corporate roots to climate activism intersects with her pivotal role at Regen Network, emphasizing community-driven environmental restoration and advocating for gender equality in the blockchain realm.

item.title: Regeneration, AI & Consciousness with Matt Cyrankiewicz │ ReFi Podcast Season 3 Ep. 3 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p>In an era marked by pressing global challenges and escalating uncertainties, the wake-up call for unity, collaboration, and purposeful action has never resounded louder. In the latest episode of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">ReFi Podcast</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a> sits down with <a href="https://twitter.com/matcy_">Matt Cyrankiewicz</a>, founder of <a href="https://twitter.com/hkekoo">HOO KOO E KOO</a> &amp; <a href="https://twitter.com/FutureQuestDAO">Future Quest</a> and they delve deep into the heart of collaboration, stressing the pivotal role of communities and every individual within them.</p><p>Through an enlightening journey from self-reflection to global vision, the discussion sheds light on the essence of what it means to truly care, not just for oneself but for the entire human collective. Join us as we navigate the transformative power of collective action, deep human connections, and the simple joys of everyday moments, setting forth a beacon of hope and a blueprint for a brighter, more sustainable future.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regeneration--AI--Consciousness-with-Matt-Matt-Cyrankiewicz-e29e0c9" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Regeneration--AI--Consciousness-with-Matt-Matt-Cyrankiewicz-e29e0c9" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="matts-transformative-journey-of-self-discovery-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Matt's Transformative Journey of Self-Discovery 🌱</h2><p>Matt's life reads like a tale of exploration and self-discovery. Beginning in Ireland with studies in multimedia, his trajectory shot from marketing to design, achieving rapid success. However, beneath the material achievements lay discontent. Searching for answers, Matt journeyed across India and Sri Lanka, arriving to Silicon Valley. It was during these travels that he confronted a spiritual void, leading him back to a rediscovery of spirituality on his own terms. From a sceptical teenager to a soul awakened, Matt's story is a reminder of the transformative power of introspection. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/mQKHsc3eaqw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Regeneration, AI &amp; Consciousness with Matt Cyrankiewicz │Season 3 Episode 3 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/mQKHsc3eaqw" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><hr><h2 id="from-silicon-valley-to-hoo-koo-e-koo-%F0%9F%8C%90">From Silicon Valley to HOO KOO E KOO 🌐</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/image-2.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1888" height="726" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/09/image-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/09/image-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/09/image-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/image-2.png 1888w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Embarking on a journey across 60 countries, inspired by the digital nomad wave, Matt embraced a limited workweek ethos. Yet, the undeniable environmental and social issues he witnessed created a dissonance. <a href="https://hookooekoo.co/">HOO KOO E KOO</a>, the project he founded, was soon reoriented with a mission: 'building a better future'. As it evolved, his personal quest veered towards the essence of happiness. Long-standing melancholy from his teen years, intertwined with my religious scepticism, gave way as he rediscovered spirituality outside traditional doctrines. Embracing Buddhism and plant medicine, he found an equilibrium.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regeneration--AI--Consciousness-with-Matt-Matt-Cyrankiewicz-e29e0c9" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Regeneration--AI--Consciousness-with-Matt-Matt-Cyrankiewicz-e29e0c9" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="future-quests-bold-beginning-in-web3-%F0%9F%90%89">Future Quest's Bold Beginning in Web3 🐉</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt loading="lazy" width="1807" height="704" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/09/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/09/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/09/image-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/09/image-1.png 1807w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>In response to the landscape of 2020, Matt and his team created <a href="https://future.quest/">Future Quest</a>, a community-based accelerator for high-impact climate projects leveraging web3, gamification and science.<br><br>Pioneering into the Web3 realm, they amalgamated concepts from <a href="https://futurehorizon.to/events/fh20221">Future Horizon Rio</a> and decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs). With an initially crude deck titled "An Ugly Deck for a Beautiful Future," the project garnered a staggering 1.7 million in commitments. Despite the shadows of the bear market, Future Quest flourished. They not only funded but also facilitated connections among passionate founders, ultimately supporting 17 organizations with sizable contributions. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regeneration--AI--Consciousness-with-Matt-Matt-Cyrankiewicz-e29e0c9" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Regeneration--AI--Consciousness-with-Matt-Matt-Cyrankiewicz-e29e0c9" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><hr><h2 id="the-essence-of-community-and-conservation-%F0%9F%8C%B3">The Essence of Community and Conservation 🌳</h2><p>In contemporary discussions, it's easy to dismiss the sentiment of love and care as mere "hippie" ideals. Yet, the undeniable truth remains that genuine affection and mutual respect form the cornerstone of human societies. Children, devoid of love, suffer, emphasizing that beyond the race for peak performance and biohacking, the human soul thrives on connection. </p><p>As we witness a resurgence of collaborative communities, it becomes apparent that the way forward lies in compassionate togetherness. But while humans remain resilient, our environment is not.</p><p>The serenity of our environment directly influences human well-being. Thus, as much as we need to ensure the survival of endangered species, it's equally crucial to nurture human bonds and acknowledge their interdependence with the natural world. This balance, once achieved, is the key to a harmonious future.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/mQKHsc3eaqw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Regeneration, AI &amp; Consciousness with Matt Cyrankiewicz │Season 3 Episode 3 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/mQKHsc3eaqw" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><hr><h2 id="share-what-you-think-%F0%9F%92%9A">Share what you think! 💚</h2><p>Would you like to share your thoughts on this podcast episode? We'd love it if you'd engage in the discussion by sharing your views on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com">Twitter</a> or <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com">LinkedIn</a>. Together, we can enhance our insights, strengthen our community, and chart a course towards a sustainable future.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/dadpO" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: In the latest ReFi Podcast episode, John Ellison discusses the urgent need for unity and collaboration with Matt Cyrankiewicz, emphasizing the crucial role of communities and each member.

item.title: ReFi Week at Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) 🐑 + Annual Meeting Update! 💫
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><strong><em>Hello ReFi Nation! </em><em>Anna and Monty here with an update on the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/a-gathering-for-the-regenerative-leaders-join-us-for-an-unprecedented-event/"><em>ReFi Annual Meeting</em></a></em><em> we proposed in July and an exciting invitation for something new...</em></strong></p><h1 id="annual-meeting-update">Annual Meeting Update</h1><p>ReFi is currently at a pivotal juncture. Amidst challenging times, we believe there is a strong need to bring community together, and facilitate cross-sector collaboration and coordination. We need to reach beyond our bubble and build bridges with diverse industry professionals, government officials, NGO leaders, investors and activists. This was a core part of our thesis for a <a href="__GHOST_URL__/a-gathering-for-the-regenerative-leaders-join-us-for-an-unprecedented-event/">ReFi Annual Meeting 2023</a>. See below 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/a-gathering-for-the-regenerative-leaders-join-us-for-an-unprecedented-event/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Annual Meeting: A Gathering for Leaders of a Regenerative Society 🌿</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Join us from November 15 to 19 for the first ReFi Annual Meeting for leaders of the regenerative economy ecosystem.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">John Ellison</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/07/F0dJ2ESakAAQC_B.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/xAN9KrBix_4xAwE2l7kX-hRiFh4-Qrr3OYjiFY5EX3Qm3Cn2T-q3SfHgLwlnZVlg8tZzwOGWILKOgJqv8G1lk1GD85qtjLb4Qwm9vTJ8n5rOQCcLAm8MkvySBSmTu6XKaCBhmjCRM6-ZxP-QdUHIoLU" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="602" height="353"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Idea for the </span><a href="__GHOST_URL__/a-gathering-for-the-regenerative-leaders-join-us-for-an-unprecedented-event/"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">ReFi Annual Meeting 2023</span></a></figcaption></figure><p>This vision still stands, however, given market conditions and reduced spend for events, we have decided to adapt the Annual Meeting for this year to focus on gathering the leaders of ReFi at the pioneering regenerative village in Alentejo, Portugal from Oct 27 to 3 Nov. Here are the details👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/ReFi-Week-banner-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/ReFi-Week-banner-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/ReFi-Week-banner-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/ReFi-Week-banner-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/ReFi-Week-banner-1.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="refi-week-tdf-regenerating-the-earth-together-%F0%9F%8C%B1">ReFi Week @TDF: Regenerating the Earth Together 🌱</h1><p>From October 27th until November 3rd, Portugal will be host to a transformative gathering of key ReFi leaders &amp; practitioners, both local and global. In partnership with <a href="https://www.refilisboa.com/">ReFi Lisboa</a>, <a href="https://www.bankless.community/" rel="noreferrer">Bankless DAO</a>, <a href="https://www.silvi.earth/">Silvi Protocol</a>, <a href="https://www.regensunite.earth/">Regens Unite</a>, and the <a href="https://crypto-commons.org/">Crypto Commons Association</a>, the <a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/">Traditional Dream Factory (TDF)</a> and <a href="https://www.refidao.com/">ReFi DAO</a> are inviting you to come together with us for a week-long co-living event focused on regeneration, co-working, co-creation, community-building, and celebration.</p><p>This week will be about much more than a series of professionally facilitated workshops and activities, it’s a unique opportunity to collaboratively envision and initiate the next chapter of ReFi DAO and to craft a roadmap for implementing ReFi technologies worldwide. This week promises to be a fertile ground where creativity meets collaboration, setting the stage for a global regenerative society.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/events/refi-week-regenerating-the-earth-together" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get your ticket</a></div><h2 id="location-activities-%E2%9C%A8">Location &amp; Activities ✨</h2><p>If you are not already familair, you will be welcomed to the <em>Traditional Dream Factory (TDF)</em> in Abela, Portugal— an emergent '<a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/ye6fI3GDY2FJA6mNbxru2L_97OjMalhdbVjKOunq2EI">ReFi Village</a>' known for its inspirational spirit and commitment to regenerating the Earth. At TDF, we will explore and partake in the world’s pioneering experiment of an entirely on-chain regenerative village! Read more below 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/ye6fI3GDY2FJA6mNbxru2L_97OjMalhdbVjKOunq2EI"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Villages: Web3-Enabled Communities for People and Planet</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">People are increasingly looking to live in ways that are more sustainable, resilient, and regenerative. ReFi Villages present a compelling solution to change how we live, work, and relate to one another.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/publication-images/juOTsjFEhLa_EJH2-yT5B.png?height=800&amp;width=800" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/nft/UMYsan7npw5Xd2d94sSaD.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/"><img src="https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/yIIknBcMd1rxb5q8v_iMv-Try2RjMwOrscPdg63Pt7AIbhj3-lci40msGOt00ctaPlesQ6NTRiC2AvDPux-INWcjg9q_Pe385Bjnm09Ea1mqGRaIa4_abKPowJC6WbqWtLpoPo8RZy4WDjybQmTeVKU" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="602" height="413"></a><figcaption><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/</span></a></figcaption></figure><p>TDF offers a unique canvas for connection, collaboration, and creation in the ReFi space. Join us for a transformative experience!</p><h3 id="agenda-outline">Agenda Outline</h3><p>❗️<strong><em>Please note:</em><em> this is a draft proposed agenda and is subject to change. The final agenda will be co-created with participants to ensure a dynamic and engaging experience for all.</em><br><br>Oct 27th - 29th: Planting &amp; Celebrating 🌱 🎊</strong><br>Festivities will begin with a grand tree-planting event over the weekend alongside a vibrant Earth Party filled with cacao, melodies, and rituals.</p><p><strong>Oct 30th - Nov 2nd: CoWorking Week 📝 🤝</strong><br>Immerse yourself in a balanced week of harvest activities, coworking sessions, shared mealtimes, and open-space workshops and discussions. Participate as you wish in a mix of work, leisure, community co-creation, and introspection.</p><p><strong>Nov 2nd: Closing Ceremony &amp; Pizza Party 🎉 🍕</strong><br>We’ll conclude with a reflective closing ceremony and a casual Pizza Party, celebrating our shared experiences and looking forward to future ReFi possibilities.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/events/refi-week-regenerating-the-earth-together" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Buy your ticket</a></div><h3 id="why-join-refi-week">Why Join ReFi Week?</h3><ul><li>Connect with like-minded ReFi leaders.</li><li>Engage with the ReFi community and changemakers.</li><li>Participate in unique discussions and networking opportunities.</li><li>Deepen your ReFi knowledge while taking a break from conventional conferences.</li><li>Support and co-live with the TDF community.</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/VkoqvPcaRpk?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Traditional Dream Factory"></iframe></figure><h3 id="more-things-to-do-in-lisbon">More things to do in Lisbon!</h3><p>November is also a bustling month in Lisbon, brimming with other vibrant events and activities. The city will be hosting a series of gatherings including ETH Lisbon 2023, Nearcon, and Websummit. With a dynamic atmosphere and an array of cultural, technological, and social events unfolding, there’s never been a better time to visit!</p><p>🗓️ 3-5 Nov 🔗 <a href="https://soliditydeveloper.com/eth-lisbon-2023">ETH Lisbon 2023</a><br>🗓️ 7-10 Nov 🔗 <a href="https://near.org/nearcon23.near/widget/Index">Nearcon</a><br>🗓️ 13-16 Nov 🔗 <a href="https://websummit.com/?utm_source=google&amp;utm_medium=cpc&amp;utm_campaign=20024687400&amp;utm_content=149253884358&amp;utm_term=tech%20events&amp;gclid=Cj0KCQjw1OmoBhDXARIsAAAYGSHNd3PKL2vn8iQXw9VDZ6pmkgmQ-ryBtEygeIrpV6EQ-DW0ifcZNDUaAkOfEALw_wcB">Websummit</a></p><h2 id="tickets-accommodation-%F0%9F%8E%9F%EF%B8%8F">Tickets &amp; Accommodation <strong>🎟️</strong></h2><p>Whether you prefer a week of all-inclusive glamping or bringing your own tent for the weekend, TDF has options to suit your style, budget, and needs! Each accommodation package includes locally sourced farm-to-table meals to engage with fellow participants over co-created breakfast, lunch, and dinners!</p><p>Space is limited at the TDF site, so make sure to secure your spot promptly! Visit the ticket booking page for registration 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/events/refi-week-regenerating-the-earth-together"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Week: REGENERATING THE EARTH TOGETHER</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">From the 27th of October to the 3rd of November, the picturesque town of Abela, Portugal, will be home to a transformative confluence. In partnership with ReFi Lisboa, Silvi Protocol, and Regens Unite, the Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) and ReFi DAO are inviting key ReFi leaders —both local and glo…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/favicon.ico" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://cdn.oasa.co/photo/6501ad776bb4b23c655e4f02-place-lg.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/events/refi-week-regenerating-the-earth-together" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Book your stay!</a></div><h2 id="closing-note">Closing Note</h2><p>In a world that is constantly changing and evolving, it is imperative to adapt, reflect, and remain committed to our shared goals and community. We are so excited to invite you to join us at TDF and answer a call to action in co-creating a brighter future. Your presence, support, and enthusiasm is hugely appreciated 💚 </p><p>Should you have any questions or ideas, or if there’s someone in your network who would be a valuable addition to this gathering, please do let us know. We eagerly anticipate connecting, collaborating, and celebrating with you in Abela!</p><p>See you there regen!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/events/refi-week-regenerating-the-earth-together" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get your ticket</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: Join us for ReFi Week at TDF in Portugal from Oct 27 - Nov 3! This transformative gathering will bring together leading ReFi minds for a week of collaboration, learning, and regeneration activities. Secure your spot for this unparalleled convergence of innovation and sustainability!

item.title: The Brazilian Ecosystem of Regenerative Finance PT II
item.dc:creator: Marcelo Silva
Tereza Bizkova
item.content:encoded: <p>Hey Regens! 👋</p><p>Today, we have <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcelo-silva-0581b9216/" rel="noreferrer">Marcelo Silva</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/luizhadad/" rel="noreferrer">Luiz Hadad</a>, with editing help from <a href="https://twitter.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer">Tereza Bizkova</a>, here for a ReFi Community History.<br><br>Marcelo, a PhD researcher, co-founded ReFi Spring, founded Blockchain Na Escola, and advises the UNESCO-SOST Transcriativa board. Luiz is an impact entrepreneur, big wave surfer, and co-founder of Cambiatus and Play4Change. <br><br>In this article, we delve into Brazil's ReFi ecosystem, examining its unique niches and significance within the global ReFi landscape. 🌿</p><h2 id="setting-the-scene">Setting the Scene</h2><p>As the heart of the Amazon rainforest and the country with the largest water reserves, Brazil is known as the <a href="https://iucngreenlist.org/country/brazil/" rel="noreferrer">world's most biodiverse country</a>. But as it strives to protect its natural assets, it navigates challenges related to economic growth, illegal mining, and external pressures on its oil reserves. </p><p>In short, Brazil's vital role in global ecological preservation confronts a dichotomy: <strong>safeguarding the environment versus addressing its citizens' needs</strong>, especially when global support comes with strings attached.</p><p>This dilemma has made Brazil a fertile ground for innovation. The civil society, the private sector, and the government all take turns in proposing novel solutions. This is also one of the reasons Brazil has become a fintech powerhouse boasting thousands of startups. As <a href="https://camilarioja.com/" rel="noreferrer">Mila Rioja</a> (Celo Foundation Lead for Latam) put it, the country is truly a "maverick". </p><p>So, what does this mean for web3, and specifically for the ReFi ecosystem? Web3 is a movement centered on services, products, and communities rooted in blockchain technology. Within this realm, ReFi (Regenerative Finance) bridges climate action and decentralized finance. But, as the co-author, <a href="https://thatsgnar.ly/luizhadad"><strong>Luiz Hadad</strong></a>, points out at every opportunity, the emphasis on climate and finance is a typically Global North view. We have the right to approach regeneration through our unique lens. </p><p>The Venezuelan ReFi advocate <a href="https://twitter.com/SuaNex" rel="noreferrer">Susana González</a> shares a <a href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-60/" rel="noreferrer">similar sentiment</a>: "It is essential to recognize the Global South's unique challenges and leverage its people to build the foundations of independence." So, in search of what ReFi means for us in Brazil, let's look at some key actors and the problems they're trying to solve.</p><h2 id="the-four-pillars-of-the-brazilian-refi-ecosystem">The Four Pillars of the Brazilian ReFi Ecosystem</h2><p>Brazilian initiatives within or in alignment with ReFi can primarily be categorized into four niches:</p><ul><li>🎉 Events and communities (as discussed in our <a href="__GHOST_URL__/the-brazilian-ecosystem-of-regenerative-finance-pt-i/" rel="noreferrer">previous article</a>)</li><li>💼 Established financial entities and companies</li><li>🚀 Emerging startups</li><li>🌟 Noteworthy projects</li></ul><p>This time, we'll be diving into the latter three. In the ReFi sector, Moss and AmbiFy are standout players, bridging the gap between traditional markets and web3. Moss actually became the first Brazilian entity to list a tokenized carbon credit globally. Meanwhile, AmbiFy steadily navigates its path deeper into the web3 space. Additionally, while aligning with ReFi values, the Amaz Fund and Gaia Group are yet to integrate blockchain into their operations. </p><p>Let's explore them all in greater detail. 👇</p><h2 id="moss">Moss</h2><p><a href="https://moss.earth/pt-BR"><strong>Moss</strong></a> first came into existence as a trading and brokerage company that achieved the authorization to do business within APX and IHS Markit (both later bought by Verra) in 2020. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/image_share.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1050" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/image_share.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/image_share.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/image_share.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/image_share.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>After extensive research, Moss became the first Brazilian company to list a tokenized carbon credit. However, facing a bear market and a scandal that caused Verra to suspend tokenized credit acceptance, Moss returned to the traditional market.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.53.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="872" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.53.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.53.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.53.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.53.png 2216w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Together with Verra, Moss <a href="https://www.reuters.com/article/crypto-currency-carbontrading-environmen-idUSL8N2ZM7XE" rel="noreferrer">challenged Reuters' claims</a> regarding the adequacy of their model to verify forest protection. Yet, in spite of the dispute, Moss remains the first major Brazilian firm to sell tokenized carbon credits. Their MCO2 token is available on EVM-compatible exchanges, detailed on the <a href="https://dune.com/kruger/MCO2" rel="noreferrer">Dune Platform</a>.</p><h2 id="ambify"><strong>AmbiFy</strong></h2><p>While AmbiFy's Web3 journey is newer than Moss's, they're versed in the business. The company is a branch of the Brazilian Ambipar corporate, which has a long history in carbon compensation and a market cap of around $500 million.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.16.17.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1696" height="574" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.16.17.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.16.17.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.16.17.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.16.17.png 1696w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Ambipar handles traditional infrastructure, while <a href="https://www.ambify.com/" rel="noreferrer">AmbiFy</a> manages on-chain, navigating the carbon market and diverse tokenizations. Their site mentions the $ABFY token runs on Binance Smart Chain, yet we couldn't find it on BSCscan.</p><p>Despite challenges, Moss and Ambify are at the forefront of Brazil's corporate ReFi ecosystem, and their journey offers valuable insights. Transitioning from web3 to a conventional perspective on finance and regeneration, notable players include Saúva Jataí, Gaia, and the AmazFund.</p><h2 id="sa%C3%BAva-jata%C3%AD"><strong>Saúva Jataí</strong></h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/QS_Sauva.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1024" height="409" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/QS_Sauva.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/QS_Sauva.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/QS_Sauva.png 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Launched in 2019 through collaboration between conscious investors, the <a href="https://sauvajatai.com/quem-somos/" rel="noreferrer">Saúva Jataí group</a> adopts a venture philanthropy model. </p><p>Saúva is a nonprofit focused on aiding other nonprofits. It endorses projects like Muda Outras Economias and Alegrias social currencies, educational efforts like Educar+, Waldorf schools Cirandas and INOV, and Agroforest endeavors like Arte na terra and Organicidade. They also champion cultural entities like Fundição Progresso, Cordão do Boitatá, and the Yawanawa in the Amazon.<br><br>Jataí invests in business creation and evolution, emphasizing ESG, regeneration, redistribution, and venture philanthropy. </p><h2 id="the-gaia-group"><strong>The Gaia Group</strong></h2><p><a href="https://grupogaia.com.br/">The Gaia Group</a> comes from a bold initiative from its founder,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/joao_pacifico/"> João Pacifico</a>: an investment fund that only invests in regenerative projects. Composed by Gaia Impacto and Planeta, the fund the fund manages over U$5 billion in Brazil, directing all profits to social and environmental endeavors.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/JP7.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1086" height="652" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/JP7.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/JP7.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/JP7.png 1086w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Their portfolio is filled with initiatives from the <a href="https://mst.org.br/">Landless Workers Movement</a> (the MST), which is a social movement that is also the largest producer of organic food in Latin America.</p><p>Even without blockchain, Gaia operates at the nexus of finance and regeneration.</p><h2 id="the-amazfund"><strong>The AmazFund</strong></h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-02-a-s-14.56.24.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="666" height="268" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-02-a-s-14.56.24.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-02-a-s-14.56.24.png 666w"></figure><p>Managing 75 million hectares of forest and benefiting 241,000 people, the <a href="https://www.amazonfund.gov.br/en/home/" rel="noreferrer">AmazFund</a> disbursed over $476 million in 2023 alone. It stands as a primary backer of innovation bridging entrepreneurship, protection, and regeneration of the Amazon Forest.</p><p>As AmazFund and other key players push for innovation, they face resistance from their peers to fully embrace the transparency and decentralization offered by web3.</p><p>But, between them and smaller nonprofits, a few middle players are building global solutions from Brazilian soil.</p><h2 id="the-middle-players">The Middle Players</h2><p>These projects merge nature and social regeneration. Here are some pioneering examples:</p><p><a href="https://agroforestdao-ptbr.web.app/"><strong>AgroForestDAO</strong></a> - A Brazilian-founded global organization focused on supporting agroforestry worldwide.<br><a href="https://www.knotstudios.net/"><strong>KnotStudios</strong></a> - A game studio focusing on promoting regeneration and onboarding through games.<br><a href="https://site.detrash.io/pt"><strong>DeTrash</strong></a><strong> </strong>- Founded by Philip, it rewards recyclers with its token $ReCy.<br><a href="https://www.cambiatus.com/"><strong>Cambiatus</strong></a> - Founded by Karla Cordoba and Ranulfo Paiva, a platform that allows communities to create social currencies that foster planetary regeneration.<br><a href="https://ekonavi.com/"><strong>Ekonavi</strong></a> - A social media platform for agroforestry and permaculture that rewards the farmers and project stewards with Ecotoken.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/302274578_477993521002303_2471986335634164_n.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="960" height="270" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/302274578_477993521002303_2471986335634164_n.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/302274578_477993521002303_2471986335634164_n.png 960w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><br><a href="https://simbiotica.finance/"><strong>Simbiótica Finance</strong></a> - A startup ranking on-chain impact tokens.<br><a href="https://linktr.ee/riocryptohub"><strong>Rio Crypto Hub</strong></a> - Organizing free monthly web3 events for over a year, with 30+ events to date.<br><a href="http://bioca.eco"><strong>Bioca.eco</strong></a> - Providing transparency and traceability to agricultural supply chains.<br><a href="https://onepercent.io/"><strong>One percent </strong></a>- Providing software solutions for business and blockchain for a fairer global economy; creators of Moss's tokenized carbon credit protocol.<br><a href="https://www.instagram.com/refaz_brasil/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>ReFaz</strong></a> - A consulting office focused on regenerative economics and blockchain technology.<br><a href="https://thatsgnar.ly/surfguru"><strong>SurfguruDAO</strong></a><strong> </strong>- An initiative from <a href="http://www.surfguru.com.br">Surfguru</a> and <a href="http://www.gnars.com">Gnars DAO</a> where surfers share content and co-create NFTs with projects like <a href="https://thatsgnar.ly/surfguru/initiatives/precious-plastic-espirito-santo">Precious Plastic Espirito Santo</a>, <a href="https://thatsgnar.ly/surfguru/initiatives/limpeza-de-praias-beach-cleanups">Beach Cleanups</a>, and <a href="https://thatsgnar.ly/surfguru/initiatives/vuss-vivendo-um-sonho-surf">Vivendo um Sonho Surf</a>.<br><a href="https://www.borderless.money/pt" rel="noreferrer"><strong>BorderlessMoney</strong></a> - A decentralized financial protocol that redefines how Social Investments are made, using income-generating strategies and contributing to social causes.</p><p>While the ReFi ecosystem in Brazil primarily centers on nature and its community champions diversity and inclusion, most of its founders and investors are white-western males from a handful of countries.</p><p>This dominant group often frames ReFi as synonymous with <strong>environmental-social development</strong>. And although this approach is a key way to address global social changes, it's important to remember that other perspectives exist. Sometimes, as said by one of the most efficient social entrepreneurs in Rio de Janeiro, <a href="https://www.instagram.com/osvaldin_the_cryator_iltda/"><strong>Osvaldinho</strong></a><strong> (<a href="https://www.instagram.com/studiokrya/"><strong>Studio Krya</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/2050_____/"><strong>2050</strong></a>)</strong>, “It is not about development, but involvement.” 🤝</p><p>When building new solutions, it's thus crucial to consider their implications and the power dynamics they foster. Many Brazilian initiatives recognize this, pushing past the narrow carbon-centric view and harnessing web3 for local social impact.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/photo_2023-10-02-15.24.44.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="707" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/photo_2023-10-02-15.24.44.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/photo_2023-10-02-15.24.44.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/photo_2023-10-02-15.24.44.jpeg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">The original picture is part of the article about </span><a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Ecological Benefits.</span></a></figcaption></figure><p>In the ReFi ecosystem, this isn't a side note or "almost ReFi." It's about healing something as vital as nature in Brazil: <strong>the social fabric</strong>.</p><p>The country still grapples with profound social issues from colonization's legacy. These manifest in our everyday interactions, and it takes a special kind of courage to address them. In the Global South, the mission is, therefore, to regenerate severely damaged relationships, create fairer social dynamics, and redistribute power in society. And there's already a variety of projects working on that.</p><p>Some pioneers in this field are <strong>Neduc Coroadinho Social</strong>, <strong>Play4Change</strong>, <strong>Educar+</strong>, <strong>Muda Outras Economias</strong>, and <strong>Blockchain Na Escola</strong>. Let's take a closer look at each.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Logo-Muda.svg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="119" height="42"></figure><p><a href="http://www.muda-oe.com/index.html">Muda Outras Economias</a> is a social currency rewarding members for mindful actions like tree planting, reading, attending cultural events, or engaging with the Muda network. </p><p>It also fosters a marketplace for goods and services, promoting regenerative farming. In cities like Rio, Belo Horizonte, and Goiás, members can buy organic food baskets using MUDA currency.</p><p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/blockchainnaescola/">Blockchain Na Escola</a> is the first educational project to produce content for regular public schools following all the educational legislation of Brazil. They've provided over <a href="https://opensea.io/collection/101-badges?search[stringTraits][0][name]=Creator%20ID&amp;search[stringTraits][0][values][0]=cl2531ne5472209l90a6trnr3&amp;search[sortAscending]=true&amp;search[sortBy]=UNIT_PRICE">30k certifications on-chain</a> via basic courses on the 101.xyz platform. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.27.35.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="731" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.27.35.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.27.35.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.27.35.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.27.35.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Boosted by a <a href="https://prezenti.xyz/" rel="noreferrer">Prezenti</a> grant, they've grown in Salvador (Bahia) and Belo Horizonte (Minas Gerais), conducting training in schools and forming partnerships for sustained expansion in Salvador and Lauro de Freitas.B</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-16.46.19.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1392" height="812" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-16.46.19.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-16.46.19.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-16.46.19.png 1392w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><a href="https://play4change.io/">Play4Change</a> works to integrate underserved Brazilian communities into web3. Partnering with <a href="https://cointimes.com.br/" rel="noreferrer">Cointimes</a>, they aim to connect members to opportunities, achieving social transformation through web3. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.02.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1994" height="918" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.02.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.02.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.02.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-25-a-s-09.30.02.png 1994w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/carol-santos-734382132/">Carol Santos</a>, once part of Play4Change and now leading the <a href="https://www.instagram.com/projeto.educar.mais">Educar+</a> project, has become Ethereum Brasil's Community Leader, underscoring their influence.</p><p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/projeto.educar.mais">Educar+</a> is a great example of <a href="https://br.beincrypto.com/ong-educar-muda-vidas-com-web3/">how web3 can be used to transform communities</a>. They recently opened a <a href="https://thenationview.com/cryptocurrency/153741.html">Polygon Tech House</a>, and it's bringing hope to many young Brazilians at Complexo do Chapadão, where the project is located.</p><p>This list doesn't cover the entire ecosystem but showcases pioneers in fields like UBI, education, impact onboarding, and fair markets.</p><h2 id="education-igniting-brazils-web3-revolution">Education: Igniting Brazil's Web3 Revolution</h2><p>It's also vital to spotlight projects and individuals making web3 more accessible and understandable. Here are some of the most disruptive:</p><p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/zulumartimiano.eth/">Zulu Martiniano</a>, <a href="https://linktr.ee/amichelagalvao">Michela Galvão</a>, <a href="https://modularcrypto.xyz/" rel="noreferrer">Modular Crypto</a>, <a href="https://cursedstone.com/">Cursed Stone</a>, <a href="https://www.banklessbr.com/">Bankless Brasil</a>, <a href="https://www.instagram.com/inaiaraflorencio/">Inaiara Florêncio</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/fcarva_eth">Felipe Carva</a> &amp; <a href="https://discord.com/invite/BFRmUaQEt9">Unstable Labs</a>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-09.46.57.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1240" height="762" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-09.46.57.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-09.46.57.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Captura-de-Tela-2023-10-03-a-s-09.46.57.png 1240w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Cursed Stone is a Web3 game where you earn tokens and even an action figure of your character.</span></figcaption></figure><p>Raising awareness and educating on blockchain's potential is a powerful form of activism, setting the stage for transformative leaps forward.</p><p>The role of content creators who guide communities and discuss tech's role in shaping better futures is essential. That's why it's also important to highlight the pioneering efforts of Brazil's <strong>Chainlink, Ethereum, Polygon</strong>, and <strong>Celo </strong>communities, who have organized events to democratize crypto access. </p><h2 id="the-definitive-institutional-refi-sandbox"><strong>The Definitive Institutional ReFi Sandbox</strong></h2><p>Diving into Brazil's ReFi scene prompts larger questions about its impact on the global web3 and ReFi landscapes. 🌎</p><p>Brazil's abundant natural resources, coupled with the tech to tokenize them, paves the way for experimenting with real-world asset (RWA) stablecoins. With a crypto-friendly legal framework shaped by the Federal Government and Central Bank, Brazil stands ready to trial game-changing crypto uses, like stable tokens backed by real assets over fiat, BTC, or ETH. </p><p>This shift indicates ReFi as more than just ESG 3.0, emphasizing non-financial metrics. The Brazilian ReFi's swift ascent suggests a soon-to-emerge potent institutional testing ground for ReFi solutions.</p><h2 id="enjoyed-this-article-lets-spread-the-word-%F0%9F%93%A2">Enjoyed This Article? Let's Spread the Word... 📢 </h2><p>Please help to share this article, especially with regens in South America and the rest of the Global South.</p><p></p>
item.excerpt:encoded: The Brazilian initiatives building within (or aligned with) ReFi can be mapped in four different niches, in this article, we explore three of them mentioning some examples.

item.title: Diversity, Equity, Justice and Inclusion with Gilberto Morishaw │Season 3 Episode 5 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Nation! 👋 <br><br><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna">Anna</a> here, excited to bring you another episode of the ReFi Podcast, where we not only discuss but also reflect deeply upon matters of regeneration, diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice.</em></p><p>In this episode, <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a> of <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist">ReFi DAO</a> had the pleasure of welcoming <a href="https://twitter.com/bertmangil">Gilberto Morishaw</a>, a dear friend and the Head of Impact, Equity, and Inclusion at <a href="https://twitter.com/Kolektivo">Kolektivo</a>. Gilberto's roots in Curaçao and his life in Amsterdam have painted his worldviews with unique shades, providing him with rich insights into regeneration from a holistic perspective.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Diversity--Equity--Justice-and-Inclusion-with-Gilberto-Morishaw-Season-3-Episode-5-e2a2hor" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Diversity--Equity--Justice-and-Inclusion-with-Gilberto-Morishaw-Season-3-Episode-5-e2a2hor" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>Gilberto shares his viewpoint on the work Kolektivo is doing in Curaçao. Born and raised on this beautiful island, he provides us with an insider’s perspective, presenting a vivid picture of the on-ground realities and challenges in Curaçao. Through his eyes, we explore the true essence of regeneration as Kolektivo sees it— a process entangled with the lives and roles of the people in the community.</p><p>What are we all working towards? What does the end state of our collective regeneration mission look like? These are complex questions, and our dialogue with Gilberto attempts to shed light on these. The conversation is a tapestry of thoughts, ideas, and visions about the future we are building, the purpose driving our actions, and the destination we envision for our communities and the Earth.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v&#x3D;53qWdM2HQHY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/53qWdM2HQHY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen title="Diversity, Equity, Justice and Inclusion with Gilberto Morishaw │Season 3 Episode 5 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><ul><li>02:21 Meditation and alignment</li><li>06:25 Building regenerative communities</li><li>11:04 Tokenization and regenerative systems</li><li>14:24 Justice, equity, diversity, inclusion</li><li>19:57 Diversity and innovation in economics</li><li>22:39 Going fast, not going deep</li><li>26:10 Urgency and doom in climate crisis</li><li>29:59 Conservation and indigenous stewardship</li><li>34:43 Dancing with the devil in capitalism</li><li>38:53 Web3 and public verifiable impact</li><li>42:24 Redefining wealth</li><li>45:18 Transitioning economic systems for equity</li><li>48:15 Overcoming comfort for future growth</li><li>52:07 Holding yourself in love</li><li>56:25 Lack of end state</li><li>59:03 Mainstreaming blockchain technology</li><li>01:03:20 Inclusion and regeneration</li><li>01:06:19 The world is changing</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Diversity--Equity--Justice-and-Inclusion-with-Gilberto-Morishaw-Season-3-Episode-5-e2a2hor" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen on Spotify 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Diversity--Equity--Justice-and-Inclusion-with-Gilberto-Morishaw-Season-3-Episode-5-e2a2hor" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%F0%9F%8C%9F">Join the Conversation 🌟</h2><p>We await your thoughts and feedback on this episode. Dive deep into the topic, reflect, and join the conversation on Twitter and LinkedIn. We're looking forward to meeting you on the other side of the discussion.</p><p>And if this episode has resonated with you, make sure to share it and spread the word! Thank you. 💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/SX22D" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter 🐦</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: Dive into discussions on regeneration, diversity, equity & inclusion in the latest episode of ReFi Podcast with Gilberto Morishaw from Kolektivo. 🌟

item.title: Internet of Impact: IXO And ReFi Cape Town with Shaun Conway & Shawn Alimohammadi │ReFi Podcast Season 3 Ep. 6 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><strong>Hey ReFi Nation! </strong>👋</p><p><em>We are incredibly excited to share another episode of ReFi Podcast featuring <a href="https://twitter.com/shaunbconway" rel="noreferrer"><em>Dr. Shaun Conway</em></a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/0xRegennshawn" rel="noreferrer"><em>Shawn Alimohammadi</em></a> of <a href="https://twitter.com/ixoworld" rel="noreferrer"><em>IXO</em></a>: a blockchain built with the <a href="https://v1.cosmos.network/sdk" rel="noreferrer"><em>Cosmos SDK</em></a> for a tokenized impact economy.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/02ytuaoJovA" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/02ytuaoJovA?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Internet of Impact: IXO &amp; ReFi Cape Town with Shaun Conway &amp; Shawn Alimohammadi │Season 3 Episode 6🎧"></iframe></figure><p>Dr. Shaun shares his vision of a sustainable world harmonizing people and planet through decentralized ledgers. On the other side Shawn, a ReFi Local Node movement pioneer, has actively initiated regeneration seeds in Cape Town, inviting local leaders to partake in this vision.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Internet-of-Impact-IXO--ReFi-Cape-Town-with-Shaun-Conway--Shawn-Alimohammadi-Season-3-Episode-6-e2actn9" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Internet-of-Impact-IXO--ReFi-Cape-Town-with-Shaun-Conway--Shawn-Alimohammadi-Season-3-Episode-6-e2actn9" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>In this episode, they introduce IXO’s innovative system, addressing the current impact economy’s fractured models. With AI integration, they’ve improved the verification process of ground-level impact claims, promoting accuracy and reliability while highlighting a technology layer explicitly designed for the impact economy. They also share the progress, successes and challenges of the <a href="https://twitter.com/reficapetown" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Cape Town</a> Local Node.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/SHanYyy7tiU" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/SHanYyy7tiU?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="IXO: A blockchain for people’s NEEDS. #podcast #web3 #blockchain #technology #regeneration #earth"></iframe></figure><p>Through IXO, access to Asian and African markets becomes seamless, paving the way for multi-billion-dollar capital flows essential for renewable energy and nature preservation endeavours, especially amidst the voluntary carbon market's declining growth.</p><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>00:00 - Teaser<br>00:50 - Introduction<br>4:38 - Meditation<br>7:44 - The Tokenized Impact Economy<br>10:54 - We Don't Know What Matters for Planetary Health<br>13:00 - A Public, Verifiable Proof of Making Good in the World<br>19:20 - The Local Currencies Experiment<br>22:55 - Presenting IXO<br>34:11 - Why Would a Project Choose IXO?<br>48:11 - What is Coming Next for IXO?<br>55:14 - The Culture of ReFi Cape Town<br>1:03:57 - How Can You Access the Power of IXO?</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Internet-of-Impact-IXO--ReFi-Cape-Town-with-Shaun-Conway--Shawn-Alimohammadi-Season-3-Episode-6-e2actn9" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Internet-of-Impact-IXO--ReFi-Cape-Town-with-Shaun-Conway--Shawn-Alimohammadi-Season-3-Episode-6-e2actn9" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%F0%9F%8C%9F"><strong>Join the Conversation </strong>🌟</h2><p>Your insights and reactions to this episode are incredibly valuable! Explore the topics, ponder their implications, and then join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/?originalSubdomain=pt" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>. We can’t wait to see your unique perspective.</p><p>Should this episode strike a chord within you, don’t hesitate to share it far and wide, amplifying its reach and impact. Thank you for your support! 💙</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/O5e2A" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: This episode of ReFi Podcast introduces IXO's innovative blockchain system for a tokenized impact economy, with features enhancing the verification of impact claims and facilitating significant capital flows for renewable energy and preservation efforts in Asian and African markets.
