item.title: Last 3 Days to Support ReFi DAO on Giveth's QF Round! 🚨👐
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p>Hey ReFi Nation! 👋</p><p>We are incredibly grateful to have the chance to participate in <a href="https://giveth.io/qf" rel="noreferrer">Giveth's Optimism Quadratic Funding Round</a>, running until October 23rd!<br><br>During this QF round, there is the chance to support projects with a donation through <a href="https://www.optimism.io/" rel="noreferrer">Optimism</a>. The magic of quadratic funding comes into play here, as your contribution will be matched, thereby exponentially increasing its impact! A substantial $25,000 in matching funds will be distributed among all participating projects at the end of the round.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-dao-unlocking-a-global-regen-coordination" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Donate Now</a></div><p>How does quadratic funding work, you may ask? <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin" rel="noreferrer">Monty</a> has explained it in this short video. 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/mdgDI1K3iQA?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="What is Quadratic Funding?⁉️ 🤨"></iframe></figure><p>The beauty of quadratic funding lies in the fact that the more individual donations a project receives, no matter the size, the larger its matched funds grow. This means that every single contribution, no matter how small, has the potential to make a significant difference. Imagine, your donation of 1 DAI could transform into $15! 😮</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-dao-unlocking-a-global-regen-coordination" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Donate Now</a></div><h2 id="unlocking-a-global-regen-coordination-%F0%9F%A4%9D">Unlocking a Global Regen CoordiNATION 🤝</h2><p>In the landscape of decentralized finance and blockchain technology, ReFi DAO stands tall as a beacon of hope and innovation, dedicated to regenerating the Earth. What began as a founder-led startup community during the 2021 ReFi boom has now blossomed into the cultural epicentre of ReFi.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/QmdqvShWib6fmj2GL7RfYYrxiYry7r4DwEWopKayWrkFhN.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/QmdqvShWib6fmj2GL7RfYYrxiYry7r4DwEWopKayWrkFhN.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/QmdqvShWib6fmj2GL7RfYYrxiYry7r4DwEWopKayWrkFhN.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/QmdqvShWib6fmj2GL7RfYYrxiYry7r4DwEWopKayWrkFhN.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/QmdqvShWib6fmj2GL7RfYYrxiYry7r4DwEWopKayWrkFhN.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Since its inception, ReFi DAO has facilitated an impressive array of events, spreading its roots across the globe:</p><ul><li>Supported over 75 events in 58 cities worldwide.</li><li>Reached over 60k+ listeners.</li><li>Provided invaluable support to over 300 founders.</li></ul><h2 id="laying-the-groundwork-for-a-regen-coordination-%F0%9F%93%8D"><strong>Laying the Groundwork for a Regen CoordiNATION </strong>📍</h2><p>2023 marks a pivotal year for ReFi DAO as we lay the foundations for a global network of regenerative communities, which we fondly refer to as 'Local Nodes'. These local communities are meticulously interconnected through our online community and are equipped with the most advanced tools of our time, blending the digital and physical realms in perfect harmony. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/QmPZAVkLQEA8ftsRtaz666VLiS3xtN6so8NFH3SYcBHaaF.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1079" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/QmPZAVkLQEA8ftsRtaz666VLiS3xtN6so8NFH3SYcBHaaF.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/QmPZAVkLQEA8ftsRtaz666VLiS3xtN6so8NFH3SYcBHaaF.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/QmPZAVkLQEA8ftsRtaz666VLiS3xtN6so8NFH3SYcBHaaF.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/QmPZAVkLQEA8ftsRtaz666VLiS3xtN6so8NFH3SYcBHaaF.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Central to our vision is the formation of a 'Regen CoordiNATION', a robust network of communities fueled by shared values, mutualism, and voluntary association. This powerful alliance, consisting of <a href="https://twitter.com/greenpillnet" rel="noreferrer">GreenPill Network</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/regensunite" rel="noreferrer">Regens Unite</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/crypto4commons" rel="noreferrer">Crypto Commons Association</a>, and others, seeks to foster a collaborative ecosystem, where shared knowledge, resources, and expertise converge to unlock positive-sum synergies. This united front will pave the way for a flourishing, pluralistic regenerative society.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-dao-unlocking-a-global-regen-coordination" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Donate Now</a></div><h2 id="how-to-donate-to-giveths-qf-round-%F0%9F%8C%B1">How to Donate to Giveth's QF Round? 🌱</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/F8ArHRfXcAAMiQU.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/F8ArHRfXcAAMiQU.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/F8ArHRfXcAAMiQU.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/F8ArHRfXcAAMiQU.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/F8ArHRfXcAAMiQU.jpg 2048w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><strong>Making a donation on Giveth is really easy:</strong></p><ol><li>Find the projects you like on <a href="https://giveth.io/qf" rel="noreferrer">Giveth</a>. There are 125 incredible projects to choose from!</li><li>Click on "Donate", switch your wallet to Optimism, and select the token of your choice.</li><li>Ensure your <a href="https://passport.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin Passport</a> is verified and has a score of at least 5 <strong>before October 23rd</strong> to ensure that your donation is eligible for matching!</li><li>Donate!</li></ol><p>In a couple of quick steps, you have supported many projects that will continue building a brighter future for all. 💚</p><h2 id="thank-you-%F0%9F%92%9A">Thank you! 💚</h2><p>We invite you to be a catalyst for change and join us in creating a sustainable future together. Your support not only fuels our mission but also amplifies the collective power of our community. Let's unite, take action, and make a significant impact that will resonate for generations to come.</p><p>With gratitude and hope,</p><p>Anna &amp; Monty</p><p>The ReFi DAO Team</p>

item.title: Building Regenerative Villages with Samuel Delesque │ S3 E8 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>In this week's episode of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a> had the opportunity to sit down with <a href="https://twitter.com/samueldelesque" rel="noreferrer"><em>Sam Delesque</em></a>, a software engineer turned regen village builder, who is at the forefront of constructing a network of regenerative villages. </em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Building-Regenerative-Villages-with-Samuel-Delesque-Season-3-Episode-8-e2b038s/a-aah3t6s" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Building-Regenerative-Villages-with-Samuel-Delesque-Season-3-Episode-8-e2b038s" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h2 id="stewardship-in-the-age-of-regeneration-%F0%9F%90%91">Stewardship In The Age Of Regeneration 🐑 </h2><p>The conversation between John and Sam takes us to the <a href="https://twitter.com/tdfinyourdreams" rel="noreferrer">Traditional Dream Factory</a> (TDF), located in Abela, just an hour and a half south of Lisbon. There, Sam and his team have created an incredible co-living and co-working space that is harmoniously integrated with a permaculture farm and is already making significant strides in reforesting the area with hundreds of trees. </p><p>Importantly, this project is not an isolated endeavour, but is in collaboration with the local village of Abela, ensuring that the benefits of this regenerative approach are shared and enjoyed by the wider community.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-20.jpg" width="1350" height="1800" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/tdf-20.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/tdf-20.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-20.jpg 1350w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-23.jpg" width="1800" height="1013" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/tdf-23.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/tdf-23.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/tdf-23.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-23.jpg 1800w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-14.jpg" width="1193" height="1800" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/tdf-14.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/tdf-14.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-14.jpg 1193w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-9.jpg" width="1198" height="1800" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/tdf-9.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/tdf-9.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-9.jpg 1198w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-2.jpg" width="1350" __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-2.jpg 1350w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-6.jpg" width="1800" height="1199" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/tdf-6.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/tdf-6.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/tdf-6.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-6.jpg 1800w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><p><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Traditional Dream Factory</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><p>As we dive into our conversation with Sam, we get an inside look at his vision for a new model of living - one that moves away from the traditional concept of ownership and instead embraces stewardship in the age of regeneration. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/byXrG0eS3wg?si=yPjDsBC3-21Wihp1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/byXrG0eS3wg?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Building Regenerative Villages with Samuel Delesque │ Season 3 Episode 8 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:00:00] Teaser<br>[00:00:48] Introduction<br>[00:03:22] Guided Meditation<br>[00:06:09] Money's Shift: From Degenerative Finance to Regenerative Crypto with OASA<br>[00:07:33] The Big Picture of Oasa: From Ownership to Stewardship<br>[00:10:18] Oasa &amp; TDF: What? How? And For Whom?<br>[00:13:21] How To Get Involved with the Traditional Dream Factory<br>[00:16:00] The Story Behind Starting a Network Of Villages<br>[00:18:14] Balancing Life Between Web3 and Nature<br>[00:21:30] The Story of Separation<br>[00:24:03] Building Closer &amp; TDF<br>[00:33:20] The Problems Of The Land In Abela<br>[00:37:29] Sam’s Personal Journey&nbsp;<br>[00:43:08] Changing The Root Characteristics Of Money<br>[00:45:08] Nature Backed Society<br>[00:48:39] Capital Moving Towards a Regenerative State<br>[00:50:31] Getting Involved<br>[00:51:48] Upcoming: ReFi Week At TDF<br>[00:53:35] Sam’s Work and What’s Next</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Building-Regenerative-Villages-with-Samuel-Delesque-Season-3-Episode-8-e2b038s/a-aah3t6s" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><h2 id="the-story-of-separation-%F0%9F%8C%B3">The Story of Separation 🌳</h2><p>Sam sheds light on the "Story of Separation", a narrative that has become deeply ingrained in our educational and societal institutions, portraying humans as separate entities from nature, living within the confines of a technological industrial civilization. This separation, however, is a fallacy, as we are fundamentally composed of and connected to the natural world. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-4-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1800" height="1199" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/tdf-4-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/tdf-4-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/tdf-4-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/tdf-4-1.jpg 1800w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Traditional Dream Factory</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p>Every breath we take is a testament to our interconnectedness with nature; the oxygen we inhale is a gift from the surrounding plants, and our exhalation, in turn, becomes their inhalation. This circularity is evident in all natural systems, and understanding our integral role in this circle can profoundly change our self-perception.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/byXrG0eS3wg?si=yPjDsBC3-21Wihp1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><h2 id="upcoming-refi-week-tdf-%F0%9F%8F%95%EF%B8%8F">Upcoming: ReFi Week @ TDF 🏕️</h2><p>With the upcoming <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-week-at-tdf/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Week</a>, taking place from October 27th to November 3rd at TDF, there will be ample opportunity to immerse yourself in this world, as leaders from across the ReFi space come together to share their insights and ideas.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/ReFi-Week-at-TDF-with-ReFi-DAO--Regens-Unite--ReFi-Lisboa--Silvi-Protocol--Crypto-Commons-Association-2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="800" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/ReFi-Week-at-TDF-with-ReFi-DAO--Regens-Unite--ReFi-Lisboa--Silvi-Protocol--Crypto-Commons-Association-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/ReFi-Week-at-TDF-with-ReFi-DAO--Regens-Unite--ReFi-Lisboa--Silvi-Protocol--Crypto-Commons-Association-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/ReFi-Week-at-TDF-with-ReFi-DAO--Regens-Unite--ReFi-Lisboa--Silvi-Protocol--Crypto-Commons-Association-2.png 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>This week isn't just about workshops and activities. It's a special chance for all of us to come together, dream up, and start writing the next chapter of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO</a>. We're going to figure out how we can use ReFi technologies all around the world. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/events/refi-week-regenerating-the-earth-together?ref=blog.refidao.com" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get Your Ticket 🎫</a></div><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation ✨</h2><p>We want to hear from everyone as we talk about the future of our planet and explore the many ways we can make a difference now. Let's keep up these important conversations and work together to create real change.</p><p>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>, or find a local <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi community in your area</a>!</p><p>If you enjoyed this episode, please consider leaving us <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>! 🤸 Thank you! 💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/Ac8zJ" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter 🐦</a></div>

item.title: A Leadership Transition at ReFi DAO: Paving The Way for New Growth
item.dc:creator: John Dass
item.content:encoded: <p>I am super excited to announce a major milestone in ReFi DAO’s evolution as an organization: both Daryl Edwards and I are stepping down from leadership to pave the way for the next generation of leaders at ReFi DAO. </p><p>After nearly two years of service, we will be shifting into an advisory capacity, while <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin" rel="noreferrer">Monty Merlin</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer">Anna Kaic</a> step into leadership to steward this next season of growth. We also want to use this opportunity to call forward leaders in ReFi who feel called to steward this movement towards its full potential!</p><p>With a solid brand, vibrant online community and a network of local nodes in place, we are in an amazing position to continue this path of progressive decentralization while honoring local sovereignty and laying the foundations of a global movement for the next cycle.</p><h2 id="what-we%E2%80%99re-up-to%E2%80%A6">What we’re up to…</h2><p>After nearly 16 years of building startups I am going to take a break to regenerate myself, spend time in nature and make space for my next contribution in the growing regenerative movement. Daryl is going to focus on providing executive coaching and advisory services to various web3 and climate tech startups.</p><blockquote>Monty and Anna are an incredible duo to lead ReFi DAO into the future. They have the conviction, consistency, heart, openness, and drive that is exactly what ReFi DAO needs going forward.<br><br>—&nbsp;Daryl Edwards</blockquote><h2 id="refi-dao%E2%80%99s-origin-story">ReFi DAO’s origin story</h2><p>Before handing over the baton, I wanted to quickly recap my personal journey founding this organization with the hopes of honoring all the amazing people and organizations that made this journey possible!</p><h3 id="refi-dao-the-cultural-epicenter-of-refi"><strong>ReFi DAO: The Cultural Epicenter of ReFi</strong></h3><p>Thanks to the support of this amazing community across Gitcoin, Celo Foundation and Climate Collective—we’ve been able to lay the foundations of the cultural epicenter for the ReFi movement, both in-person and online. Our hope is that these building blocks can be leveraged through each cycle to deepen the capacity of this network to make publicly-verifiable impact in the physical world—leveraging the most powerful tools of our time…</p><p>Emerging in response to the influx of talent inspired by the Toucan x Klima launch in 2021, ReFi DAO was initially an online startup community of early-stage founders. Our vision expanded significantly in late 2022 as we saw the power of combining our online community with ReFi Spring and their network of in-person events.</p><p>Today, we're proud to support a global network of founders, investors, and community builders who are using the power of decentralized technologies to solve the most pressing challenges of our time.</p><p><strong>Impact in numbers</strong>:</p><ul><li>Supported 300+ founders across 3 cohorts</li><li>Engaged 60k+ listeners across 48 episodes</li><li>Enabled 75+ events across five continents</li><li>Formed 40+ local nodes in key communities across the globe</li><li>Deployed over $55k in grant capital to Local Nodes via Gitcoin</li></ul><h3 id="glimpsing-refi-from-the-edge">Glimpsing ReFi from The Edge</h3><p>My journey into ReFi began in August 2021 after exiting my pandemic startup <a href="https://goodery.co.uk/">Goodery</a>. I had started building a list of all the projects using blockchain to finance climate action and found inspiration in the work of <a href="celo.org">Celo</a>, <a href="https://regen.network/">Regen Network</a>, <a href="https://nori.com/">Nori</a> and <a href="https://moss.earth/en">Moss</a>… along the way I stumbled across a project called Klima DAO which led me to CO2ken (now known as <a href="https://twitter.com/ToucanProtocol">Toucan Protocol</a>). This search drew me deep down the ReFi rabbit hole and within a few months I found myself invited to serve as an Interim Head of Growth at Toucan.</p><p>This gifted me a unique perspective on the cutting edge of the movement while introducing me to dozens of top founders, investors and community builders from around the world. The vision I gained during this time is distilled in the “<a href="https://je.mirror.xyz/S-dpms92hw6aiacUHoL3f_iAnLVDvbEUOXw7wpy7JaU">What Is ReFi?</a>” post on mirror I co-wrote with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/annahollidaywatson/">Dr. Anna Watson</a>.</p><p>I am forever grateful to <a href="https://twitter.com/Toucanrob">Rob</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/raphabenoi">Raphaël</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/johnx25bd">John</a> at Toucan who invested in me and helped me navigate the early days of this very complicated and exciting movement. 🙏🏼</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-podcast-s3-halfway.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1500" height="383" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/refi-podcast-s3-halfway.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/refi-podcast-s3-halfway.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-podcast-s3-halfway.jpg 1500w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="refi-podcast-making-sense-of-regenerative-finance">ReFi Podcast: Making sense of Regenerative Finance</h3><p>Around the same time I joined Toucan, I kicked off ReFi Podcast as a personal journey to make sense of the complex web of ideas and technologies emerging from the ReFi movement. Huge gratitude to all the devoted listeners and amazing guests as well as Toucan, <a href="https://celo.org/">Celo Foundation</a>, <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective</a> and <a href="https://app.ens.domains/momus.eth">The Momus Collective</a> for their support. Also shout out to my brilliant co-hosts <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnx25bd/">John Hoopes</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/simarmangat/">Simar Mangat</a>! 👏</p><p>We’re almost halfway through Season 3 and have an amazing line-up for the rest of the year—<a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast">follow</a>, <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast">subscribe</a> and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@refidao">watch the shorts</a>. Check out some of this season’s episodes below:</p><ul><li><a href="https://pod.fo/e/1f8beb">Liquid Climate Finance with Rez and Stenver from Solid World</a></li><li><a href="https://pod.fo/e/1f6c31">Internet of Impact with Shaun &amp; Shawn of IXO &amp; ReFi Cape Town</a></li><li><a href="https://pod.fo/e/1f4367">Diversity, Equity, Justice &amp; Inclusion with Gilberto Morishaw of Kolektivo</a></li><li><a href="https://pod.fo/e/1f239d">Ultragreen Money with Tim from cLabs</a></li><li><a href="https://pod.fo/e/1efff6">Regeneration, AI &amp; Consciousness with Matt from Future Works</a></li><li><a href="https://pod.fo/e/1ed89e">Environmental Asset Markets &amp; Community Impact with Sarah from Regen Network</a></li></ul><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-spring-events.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1500" height="383" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/refi-spring-events.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/refi-spring-events.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-spring-events.jpg 1500w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="refi-spring-a-network-of-in-person-events">ReFi Spring: A network of in-person events</h3><p>At the same time, we began supporting the formation of a network of in-person ReFi events, a genius idea from <a href="https://twitter.com/FelixFritsch2">Felix</a> at the <a href="https://twitter.com/crypto4commons">CCA</a>. Huge shout out to <a href="https://twitter.com/FelixFritsch2">Felix Fritsch</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_">Giulio Quarta</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/HerewardReFi">Hereward McGillvray,</a> <a href="https://twitter.com/MarceloReFi">Marcelo Silva</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/samueldelesque">Sam Delesque</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/jeremyanew">Jeremy Agnew</a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/radi_triz">Bea Fonseca</a> for all their contributions across our collective journey! Creating a cohort-based program to support local ReFi events in the global south wasn’t easy, but it was a pivotal piece of the puzzle that became ReFi DAO.</p><p>This network of in-person wouldn’t have been possible without the support of <a href="https://climatecollective.org/">Climate Collective</a> and amazing folks like <a href="https://twitter.com/ejcwalters">Ed Walters</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/annalerner">Anna Lerner</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/anranga95">Nirvaan Rangathan</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/CGeoffWilson">Craig Wilson</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/alison-filler/">Alison Filler</a>! 🙏🏼</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/founders-circles-Large.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="484" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/founders-circles-Large.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/founders-circles-Large.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/founders-circles-Large.jpeg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="founders%E2%80%99-circles">Founders’ Circles</h3><p>The beating heart of ReFi DAO in our first season was Daryl’s work supporting early-stage entrepreneurs through Founders’ Circles. We hosted three cohorts attracting over 300 founders with brilliant entrepreneurs like <a href="https://twitter.com/HelenaMerk">Helena</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/douglasqian">Douglas</a> from Spirals, <a href="https://twitter.com/mr_adrianxyz">Adrian</a> from <a href="https://twitter.com/senken_io">Senken</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/KennedyWNganga">Kennedy</a> from <a href="https://twitter.com/shambanetwork">Shamba</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/magentaceiba">Magenta</a> from <a href="https://twitter.com/OurBloomNetwork">Bloom Network</a> and many more! I’m super grateful to Daryl, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/maximilian-hachtmann-15ba1b20b/">Maximilian Hachtmann</a> and all the other stewards for their service in this time!</p><p>This venture was made possible by Gitcoin’s quarterly climate round and the massive community support around us. Big shout out to <a href="https://twitter.com/benwest">Ben West</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/checkfit">Pranav Khanna</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ColeenChase">Colleen Chase</a>, Jon Ruth and all the donors who contributed to this work!</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-dao-blog-Large.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="670" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/refi-dao-blog-Large.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/refi-dao-blog-Large.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-dao-blog-Large.jpeg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="refi-dao-blog">ReFi DAO Blog</h3><p>From the first post in December 2021, we’ve been able to leverage bounties to co-create an audience of over 3300 weekly readers with a diverse network of over <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-roundup-2023/">51 content contributors</a> from around the world. Big shoutout to coordinators Monty and <a href="https://twitter.com/Linggih_ngurah">Nura Linggh</a> (who has now spun up his own dMRV startup called <a href="https://nuraling.bio.link/">Pleno</a> 👀)!</p><p>Anna Kaic and others will be rebooting a simplified version of the roundup, coming soon!</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-knowledge-graph-Large.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="322" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/refi-knowledge-graph-Large.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/refi-knowledge-graph-Large.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-knowledge-graph-Large.jpeg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="refi-knowledge-graph">ReFi Knowledge Graph</h3><p>The earliest ReFi DAO website was a list of impact and web3 projects. Thanks to the hard work of Monty Merlin and a collaboration with <a href="https://twitter.com/simbiotica_fi">Simbiotica</a> and <a href="https://www.notion.so/A-Leadership-Transition-at-ReFi-DAO-Paving-The-Way-for-New-Growth-19f8996cf0954d6bbd415b3cc3d04d35?pvs=21">Catalist Network</a> we’ve expended this list towards the goal of becoming a global graph of all the key people, projects, content, deals and events across the ReFi Nation. We also built a localized knowledge graph at ReFi Lisboa as an initial map of the regenerative ecosystem in the city. Super excited to see where this goes and how it continues to evolves to serve network mapping across all our network of local nodes!</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Qrm_Wj4X7qUfzvkKaLcMX-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/Qrm_Wj4X7qUfzvkKaLcMX-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/Qrm_Wj4X7qUfzvkKaLcMX-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/10/Qrm_Wj4X7qUfzvkKaLcMX-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/Qrm_Wj4X7qUfzvkKaLcMX-1.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="local-node-incubator">Local Node Incubator</h3><p>As we began looking at our long-term vision, we saw the power of experimenting with network state architecture, namely: An online community with shared values that gathers locally for collective action. To build the first component of this system, we partnered with the brilliant team at Commons Stack to build out the Local Node Prize to incubate autonomous local startup communities that would onboard talent and capital into ReFi through regular events.</p><p>This was the first major milestone of decentralization for the network, using our own treasury to fund the localization of ReFi communities using quadratic funding. Big shout out to Daryl and Anna for their contributions to the Alpha incubator program that supported over 24 local nodes!</p><p>Since then, we’ve run two Gitcoin featured rounds and allocated over $55k of grant capital thanks to the support from previous donors, <a href="https://celo.org/">Celo Foundation</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloEurope">Celo Europe DAO</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/KnktDAO">Konekti DAO</a>. Huge shout out to the folks at <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiMedellin">ReFi Medellín</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiCostaRica_">ReFi Costa Rica</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiTulum">ReFi Tulum</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/reficapetown">ReFi Cape Town</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPhangan">ReFi Phangan</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiMiami">ReFi Miami</a> and of course my friends at <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiLisboa">ReFi Lisboa</a> for helping to bring this vision to life!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-dao-forum-Large.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="720" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/refi-dao-forum-Large.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/refi-dao-forum-Large.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/refi-dao-forum-Large.jpeg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="refi-dao-forum">ReFi DAO Forum</h3><p>With the local node architecture in place, we began hosting formal Forum discussions to evolve as organization using a consent-based governance model. Through this model we discussed new concepts such as network societies and coordiNATIONs in place and made a collective decision to shift away from the network state framing to adopt the more cooperative, inclusive and regenerative terminology that we hold today.</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/monty-pod-photo-Large.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1280" height="873" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/monty-pod-photo-Large.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/monty-pod-photo-Large.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/monty-pod-photo-Large.jpeg 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="monty-merlin%E2%80%99s-magic-%F0%9F%AA%84">Monty Merlin’s magic 🪄</h2><p>Since joining ReFi DAO in November of 2022, Monty has become a key contributor through leading <a href="__GHOST_URL__/tag/roundup/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Roundup</a>, <a href="https://www.refidao.com/ecosystem" rel="noreferrer">Website &amp; Knowledge Graph</a>, <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/working-group/refi-dao-forum/r/recbjJ1Wa9mZXW9JI" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO Forums</a>, and <a href="https://linktr.ee/refilondon" rel="noreferrer">ReFi London</a>—not to mention his persistent contributions to the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/" rel="noreferrer">Ecological Benefits Framework</a> (EBF). His passion for startups, environmentalism and effective governance makes him the perfect fit to steward the vision of ReFi DAO for the next chapter. It’s been an honor to see Monty speaking on the conference circuit and becoming a leader across the ReFi movement!</p><blockquote>"Growing up in a family at the forefront of the 1980s green consumer movement, sustainability principles have always guided me. This foundation propelled me into the realms of technology, economics, and philosophy, ultimately leading me to the transformative field of ReFi. A pivotal moment was connecting with John after my Tedx talk '<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9-4HW3iPtfo" rel="noreferrer">Can Crypto Regenerate the World?</a>' <br><br>His mentorship and endless inspiration have been a true blessing, as has the support of Daryl, whose work on Founders Circles and entrepreneurial mentorship has helped shape my journey. Monumental gratitude also extends to Anna, whose communication and enthusiasm are unmatched, and to the wider ReFi DAO community who have been our backbone of support.<br><br>As we step into the next chapter of ReFi DAO, I am incredibly excited to co-create a ReFi ecosystem that harmonizes humans, nature, and technology. The challenges ahead are immense, but so are the opportunities. I am inspired by the incredible people and organizations working towards these solutions. <br><br>Let's unite, old and new, to drive our vision of a global regenerative society. Together, we can fortify the ReFi movement, plant seeds of regeneration across our web of local nodes and online communities, and forge a future that's not just sustainable, but truly thriving. <br><br>Come get involved!"<br><br>— Monty Merlin</blockquote><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/image_2023-10-25_07-07-54.png" class="kg-image" alt="Anna Kaic representing ReFi DAO at ReFi Costa Rica with one of the pioneering nodes in the network." loading="lazy" width="1024" height="683" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/10/image_2023-10-25_07-07-54.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/image_2023-10-25_07-07-54.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/10/image_2023-10-25_07-07-54.png 1024w"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Anna Kaic (green and white dress) representing ReFi DAO at ReFi Costa Rica with one of the pioneering nodes in the network.</span></figcaption></figure><h2 id="anna-kaic%E2%80%99s-gifts-%F0%9F%8E%81">Anna Kaic’s gifts 🎁</h2><p>Since joining ReFi Spring in January 2023, Anna has been a rock solid support for our community, marketing and operations. She’s helped us bridge the gap to different communities through her work in Spanish and Portuguese alongside the amazing folks at ReFi LatAm and has been a steady drum beat on quarterly Gitcoin rounds. Being at the forefront of a content-driven community, Anna’s developed an amazing capacity to <a href="__GHOST_URL__/visiting-refi-costa-rica/">tell stories</a> and bring people together online towards a shared vision of the future. I’m also super excited to see how Anna continues to flourish as she embarks upon her journey with Urbanika across Central and South America!</p><blockquote>“Working on the first cohort of the Local Node Incubator with Daryl Edwards has been eye-opening for me. We were able to get so many insights about the challenges that different Nodes are facing in their local communities and this has fortified the belief in the power of regeneration coming from local startup communities.<br><br>I am incredibly grateful for the amazing journey I’ve had so far with the ReFi DAO team. John, Monty and Daryl have been of great support in my professional, but also personal journey. With this team I found a place to express myself, while sharing beautiful and hard times. Very excited to see what’s coming up for Monty, myself and this amazing community we’ve all built together! We will be focusing on serving the network of ReFi DAO and showing up every day to do our best work.<br><br>— Anna Kaic</blockquote><hr><h2 id="sewing-seeds-for-generations-to-come">Sewing seeds for generations to come</h2><p>I’ve been so grateful to have supported the growth of the ReFi movement over the last couple years alongside so many talented leaders. What began as a spark of possibility has now sewn the seeds of regeneration in startup communities all over the world. It might be hard for us to see on the frontlines, but what we have created together is nothing short of remarkable.</p><p>From the corners of a niche movement on the fringes of the internet, we are contributing to the evolution of the world’s financial markets alongside human consciousness as we recognize what we really need to survive:</p><p><em>We need nature.<br>We need each other.<br>We need effective systems that value all of life.</em></p><p>Amidst the torrents of a highly extractive society, amidst rising temperatures, geopolitical instability and war—ReFi stands as a beacon of hope for leaders who believe in making the world a better place and have the courage to face these systemic challenges with their own hands.</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2000/2023/10/ReFi-Week-at-TDF-with-ReFi-DAO--Regens-Unite--ReFi-Lisboa--Silvi-Protocol--Crypto-Commons-Association-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="ReFi Week at Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) 🐑 + Annual Meeting Update! 💫" loading="lazy"></figure><h2 id="exploring-refi-dao-20-at-refi-week-%F0%9F%9A%80">Exploring ReFi DAO 2.0 at ReFi Week 🚀</h2><p>I very much look forward to exploring the next evolution of ReFi DAO as we co-create the mission, vision and values of this movement together with dozens of leaders from across ReFi at TDF over the next five days. We’re so grateful to have the support of members from <a href="https://regensunite.com/">Regens Unite</a>, <a href="gitcoin.co" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin</a>, <a href="https://www.silvi.earth/" rel="noreferrer">Silvi</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/thetreegens" rel="noreferrer">Treegens</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/dMeter4dmrv">dMeter</a> and other incredible organizations at this pivotal moment in our organization.</p><p>Subscribe to the blog and stay tuned for updates and opportunities to get involved in upcoming Forums, Local Node programs and Gitcoin grant rounds!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img item.title: Community, Capital and Regeneration with Philip Stehlik and Lena Bumke │ S3 E9 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Nation! 👋</em></p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer"><em>Anna</em></a><em> here from <a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi DAO</em></a>, excited to share the latest episode of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a>! In this episode, John sits down with two incredible humans, <a href="https://twitter.com/lenaoftomorrow" rel="noreferrer"><em>Lena Bumke</em></a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/pstehlik" rel="noreferrer"><em>Philip Stehlik</em></a>, who share a common vision of regeneration and building a better future for us all.</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Community--Capital-and-Regeneration-with-Philip-Stehlik-and-Lena-Bumke-Season-3-Episode-9-e2bdp8g" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Community--Capital-and-Regeneration-with-Philip-Stehlik-and-Lena-Bumke-Season-3-Episode-9-e2bdp8g" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><p>Philip Stehlik, founder of <a href="https://withearth.xyz" rel="noreferrer">Earth</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/centrifuge" rel="noreferrer">Centrifuge</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/taulia" rel="noreferrer">Taulia</a> is a serial entrepreneur and investor with extensive experience building successful, scalable projects. He has partnered with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ament/" rel="noreferrer">Maex Ament</a> on numerous ventures, and together they are now exploring the ReFi space. Their goal is to support founders who are building climate solutions that not only work at scale but also prioritize the well-being of both the founders themselves and the communities they serve.</p><p>Lena Bumke, on the other hand, is contributing to <a href="https://www.greaterthan.works/" rel="noreferrer">Greatherthan</a>, a pioneering initiative that focuses on organizational design, systems thinking, and building scalable systems. Greatherthan is at the forefront of exploring how we can create better systems that truly serve the needs of society and the planet.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Zkjr1Xb7ngM?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Community, Capital and Regeneration with Philip Stehlik and Lena Bumke │Season 3 Episode 9 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/Zkjr1Xb7ngM" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><h3 id="a-paradigm-shift-in-how-we-work-%F0%9F%91%90">A Paradigm Shift in How We Work 👐</h3><p>Lena shares Graterthan's approach, empowering and fostering a sense of ownership. Society places a heavy burden on us with its expectations and structures, but those who have managed to step outside the typical path, find themselves with less to unlearn as they move into self-organized systems. </p><p>These systems, which value agency and collaborative decision-making, allow individuals to fluidly pick up leadership roles when they can lead and follow when it feels right to do so. This contrasts sharply with hierarchical systems, where responsibility and authority are concentrated at the top, and individuals often find themselves waiting for approval and following orders without question. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1367" height="603" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image.png 1367w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><a href="https://www.greaterthan.works/"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://www.greaterthan.works/</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Community--Capital-and-Regeneration-with-Philip-Stehlik-and-Lena-Bumke-Season-3-Episode-9-e2bdp8g" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Community--Capital-and-Regeneration-with-Philip-Stehlik-and-Lena-Bumke-Season-3-Episode-9-e2bdp8g" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><h3 id="a-journey-to-meaningful-living-%F0%9F%8C%84">A Journey to Meaningful Living 🌄</h3><p>One of the biggest lessons Philip learned as he stepped out of the startup space and into a more communal way of living and working was the importance of taking the time to build strong, trust-based relationships. In the startup world, everything is about moving fast and getting results quickly. But when you're living and working in close proximity with other people, you need to take the time to truly understand each other and build a foundation of trust.</p><p>In the startup world, it's easy to get caught up in the rush and excitement of creating something new. But if you don't take the time to step back and reflect, it's easy to lose sight of what's truly important. By stepping out of the startup space and into a more communal way of living, Philip was able to find a better balance between work and life. He was able to slow down and appreciate the small moments, and this has made a big difference in his overall happiness and well-being. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Zkjr1Xb7ngM?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Community, Capital and Regeneration with Philip Stehlik and Lena Bumke │Season 3 Episode 9 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/Zkjr1Xb7ngM" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:00:00] Teaser<br>[00:00:39] Introduction<br>[00:02:49] Lena’s Personal Journey<br>[00:07:25] Who is Philip Stehlik?<br>[00:12:41] Building Regenerative Organizational Systems<br>[00:16:06] Taking a Break From the Treadmill<br>[00:19:18] Community Building Between Life And Work<br>[00:24:50] Organizations Dealing With People’s Wounds and Traumas<br>[00:29:50] Inner Regeneration And Working On Regenerative Systems<br>[00:38:10] Tough Times For ReFi&nbsp;<br>[00:41:15] What’s Coming Next?<br>[00:33:20] Money: The Primary Coordination Vehicle<br>[00:44:15] Is the Venture Capital Model Fit For ReFi?<br>[00:55:21] Pieces of Advice for Early-Stage Founders<br>[00:59:03] The Future Is Now</p><h3 id="join-the-conversation-%F0%9F%92%9A">Join The Conversation 💚</h3><p>We're eager to gather insights from all of you as we delve into the future of our planet and investigate the multitude of methods we can employ to instigate change at this very moment. </p><p>Engage with us on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>, or connect with a local <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local" rel="noreferrer">ReFi community</a>!</p><p>If this episode resonated with you, we'd be grateful if you could leave us <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your preferred podcast platform</a>! Your support means the world to us! 🤸 </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/js4UK" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: John Ellison talks with Lena Bumke and Philip Stehlik about building a regenerative future through scalable systems, climate solutions, and community well-being. They discuss decentralized models and societal collaboration. Leave a review to share your thoughts!
