item.title: Rising From The Depths - Andy Kirchner’s Story Of Regeneration In Curaçao │ S3E10 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Welcome to a special episode of the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a>. We are excited to share with you a new format, "Regenerative Stories" where we dive deep into the lives of the leaders in the ReFi movement, exploring the deep concept of connection between personal healing and global sustainability.</em></p><p><em>In this episode, we're delving into the life of <a href="https://twitter.com/AndyKirchner" rel="noreferrer"><em>Andy Kirchner</em></a>, facilitator at <a href="https://twitter.com/Kolektivo" rel="noreferrer"><em>Kolektivo</em></a> and leader in the ReFi movement whose childhood tapestry was woven with diverse cultural threads with his life in Holland and Curaçao.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/mFJQwKP4yEb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Rising-From-The-Depths---Andy-Kirchners-Story-Of-Regeneration-In-Curaao--Season-3-Episode-10-e2bjnh4" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><em>Andy's journey unfolds through the recounting of an agonizing accident, a raw and visceral turning point that led him down a path of profound loss and, ultimately, to a place of rebirth. His is a story of rediscovery, a quest to find himself beyond adversity, to connect with the cycles of life that renew community and nature.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/7-oTcIqpv8U" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/7-oTcIqpv8U?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Rising From The Depths - Andy Kirchner’s Story Of Regeneration In Curaçao │ Season 3 Episode 10 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h3 id="the-cultural-mosaic-of-a-global-citizen">The Cultural Mosaic of a Global Citizen</h3><p>Andy's reflections on identity resonate with many who find themselves at the crossroads of cultures. "Born in Curaçao, raised by the world," he says, encapsulating the complexity of his multi-cultural upbringing. The dichotomy of identities - Latin, Curaçaoan, Dutch - presents an early life crisis not uncommon for those with mixed heritage. In the Dutch village of Sassenheim, Andy faced the stark reality of being different.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/0-_E0CCI8K6gTIktm_.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="640" height="640" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/0-_E0CCI8K6gTIktm_.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/0-_E0CCI8K6gTIktm_.jpg 640w"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://andykirchner.medium.com/introducing-andy-kirchner-8d476bb055e2" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Medium</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong><br><br>[00:00:58] Introduction to Regenerative Stories<br>[00:03:04] Andy’s Life Growing Up<br>[00:06:07] “I Was Born Poor, And I Will Die Poor”<br>[00:06:27] The Day When Everything Changed<br>[00:13:02] Give Yourself The Time To Breathe<br>[00:13:44] Fighting With The Demons<br>[00:18:14] Acts Of Service<br>[00:18:44] The Recycled Pirate&nbsp;<br>[00:22:31] A Moment To Think With Your Hands<br>[00:23:49] Getting Started In Web 3<br>[00:26:00] Building Kolektivo<br>[00:28:16] “Don’t Fight What You Can’t Win”&nbsp;</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/mFJQwKP4yEb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Rising-From-The-Depths---Andy-Kirchners-Story-Of-Regeneration-In-Curaao--Season-3-Episode-10-e2bjnh4" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><h3 id="the-recycled-pirate">The Recycled Pirate</h3><p>Andy's story of personal renaissance gains even more depth as he adopts the mantle of "The Recycled Pirate." No longer defined by his limitations, he redirected his attention toward creating sustainable art from discarded materials. With his hands, he crafted lanterns from cans, punctuating each with holes that not only let the light through but also allowed Andy to pierce through his own darkness, one dart at a time.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/1-TU28fwSC5FTDyWy1bdzmYw.webp" width="720" height="331" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/1-TU28fwSC5FTDyWy1bdzmYw.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/1-TU28fwSC5FTDyWy1bdzmYw.webp 720w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/73372255_2719514604749697_2634533132639928320_n.jpg" width="640" height="701" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/73372255_2719514604749697_2634533132639928320_n.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/73372255_2719514604749697_2634533132639928320_n.jpg 640w"></div></div></div><figcaption><p dir="ltr"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://medium.com/kolektivo-co/why-a-collective-impact-economy-is-important-for-cura%C3%A7ao-be4a71c4e718" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Medium</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><hr><h3 id="legacy-of-endurance">Legacy of Endurance</h3><p>Andy's story converges with the principles of coral reef resilience—how to create systems that are not only sustainable but can regenerate and thrive. He drew parallels to his own life, ensuring that whatever he built would not just survive the trials of time but outlive them. By collaborating with <a href="https://twitter.com/LuukDAO" rel="noreferrer">Luuk Weber</a>, Andy discovered the world of Web 3, DAOs and blockchain for impact. And that's how <a href="https://twitter.com/Kolektivo" rel="noreferrer">Kolektivo</a> was created.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/1-FVfqIxH4m3YFlKESH0HPOg.webp" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1100" height="550" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/1-FVfqIxH4m3YFlKESH0HPOg.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/1-FVfqIxH4m3YFlKESH0HPOg.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/1-FVfqIxH4m3YFlKESH0HPOg.webp 1100w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://medium.com/kolektivo-co/why-a-collective-impact-economy-is-important-for-cura%C3%A7ao-be4a71c4e718" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Medium</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><hr><h3 id="an-invitation-to-rise">An Invitation to Rise</h3><p>Andy's odyssey from an accident to becoming a beacon of hope and sustainability is more than inspirational—it's a testament to the human spirit's capacity for transformation. In the darkest depths, he found his light, and with it, he illuminated a path for us all: to rise, regenerate, and redefine our place within the community and the larger tapestry of life.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/7-oTcIqpv8U" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/7-oTcIqpv8U?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Rising From The Depths - Andy Kirchner’s Story Of Regeneration In Curaçao │ Season 3 Episode 10 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%F0%9F%8C%9F">Join the Conversation 🌟</h2><p>We'd love to hear your thoughts on this new format of ReFi Podcast, sharing Regenerative Stories.</p><p>Join the conversation and share your story on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>. What was the spark that motivated you to build a better future for all?</p><p>If you liked this episode, we'd be incredibly grateful for <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">a five-star rating on your podcast platform</a> of choice! Thank you. 💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/l8se3" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: Introducing "Regenerative Stories", a new format of ReFi Podcast where we dive deep into the lives of the ReFi leaders. This episode unveils Andy's journey from loss to leading regenerative change, blending personal healing with global action.

item.title: ReFi Local Nodes 2023 - Round Results & What's Coming Next?
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Welcome to the latest update in the evolving story of ReFi DAO and the global network of ReFi Local Nodes. Rooted in diverse communities, these nodes are pivotal in advancing a shared mission of using web3 for regeneration and sustainability. In this article, we'll explore the successful outcomes of our community grant rounds since May 2023, facilitated through the </em><a href="https://grants.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer"><em>Gitcoin Grants</em></a><em> platform and with the support of organizations such as the </em><a href="https://twitter.com/CeloOrg" rel="noreferrer"><em>Celo Foundation</em></a><em>, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/CeloEurope" rel="noreferrer"><em>Celo Europe DAO</em></a><em> and </em><a href="https://twitter.com/KnktDAO" rel="noreferrer">CeLatam</a><em>. As we look ahead, with Gitcoin Grants 19 (GG19) kicking off this week and the Local Node Beta Cohort coming soon, we're gearing up for a new cycle of growth and impact. Join us in this update as we chart the course for a regenerative and thriving future. Let's dive in... 🤿 👇</em></p><h1 id="refi-local-nodescommunity-grant-rounds-%F0%9F%97%BA%EF%B8%8F">ReFi Local Nodes - Community Grant Rounds 🗺️</h1><p>ReFi DAO aims to support a diverse, global decentralized network of local communities that share in our mission, vision and values of using the most powerful tools of our time to regenerate the earth. Since May 2023, we have organized grant rounds with the goal of incubating an initial cohort of Local Nodes by empowering them with starting resources to gather their teams, organize events, and cultivate a vision of regeneration in their cities. Now with two rounds completed, let's have a look at the results so far...</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-blue"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🔵</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">What is a ReFi Local Node?</strong></b><br>A ReFi Local Node is a community that meets regularly to learn, experiment and implement ReFi tools and solutions on the ground with the aim of building a local regenerative society in their country, city, town, or village. It is rooted in a specific place with a long-term commitment to regeneration. Starting with community building through gatherings and events, Local Nodes may choose to embark on a variety of regenerative projects and initiatives with the goal of nurturing a community-focused regenerative economy and society.<br><br><a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/Local-Node-Toolkit-1000a8af4ed94c11806f5e9991499355?pvs=4" rel="noreferrer">🔗 Learn More</a></div></div><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-blue"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❓</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">What is Gitcoin Grants?</strong></b><br><a href="https://twitter.com/gitcoin" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin</a> Grants empowers individuals and collectives in the web3 space to allocate funding toward projects and causes they believe in​ through innovative grants and crowdfunding mechanisms such as <a href="https://www.wtfisqf.com/" rel="noreferrer">quadratic funding</a>. While Program Rounds are managed by the Grants Program team, Community Featured Rounds are organized autonomously by organizations in order to support community initiatives. <br><br><a href="https://www.gitcoin.co/about" rel="noreferrer">🔗 Learn More</a></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-3.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1060" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/image-3.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/image-3.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/image-3.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-3.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">View current local nodes at </em></i><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local" rel="noopener noreferrer"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://www.refidao.com/community/local</span></a></figcaption></figure><h2 id="local-node-beta-round-april-2023">Local Node Beta Round (April 2023)</h2><p>During the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/roundup-64/" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin Beta Round</a>, ReFi DAO sponsored a $25k DAI match funding pool from our treasury for a featured round focused specifically on ReFi Local Nodes in the Global South.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/FABiu5AhpAR6LBLZxlGSfjOrHsHYj2J8VT4QJWPxbpk"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Announcing the ReFi DAO Local Node Prize! 🎉👏</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">We are using this Mirror to crowdfund for a match funding pool to support Local Nodes in the Global South. If you want to support a city in the Global South to launch its own token and treasury with a unique vision of regeneration, we would be super grateful for your contribution!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/publication-images/juOTsjFEhLa_EJH2-yT5B.png?height=800&amp;width=800" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/nft/PJdy221Jxxmc1OWAXgIKA.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><h3 id="beta-round-results">Beta Round Results</h3><p>The 14 newly formed Local Nodes joined the Local Node Alpha Cohort - an 8-week incubation program run by <a href="https://twitter.com/daryljedwards" rel="noreferrer">Daryl Edwards</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer">Anna Kaic</a>. The program covered all the topics necessary for launching a ReFi Local Node - from the creation of a business model, to fundraising, communication and marketing. This also led to the first iteration of the <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/Local-Node-Toolkit-1000a8af4ed94c11806f5e9991499355?pvs=4" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Local Node Toolkit</a> - a series of guides designed to help leaders of local nodes achieve a specific outcome in their community.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FvyUFAZWcAMSl2k?format=jpg&amp;name=large" width="1816" height="881" loading="lazy" alt="Image"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Gitcoin-Beta-Round-Results.png" width="900" height="1400" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Gitcoin-Beta-Round-Results.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Gitcoin-Beta-Round-Results.png 900w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h2 id="local-node-gg18-round-august-2023">Local Node GG18 Round (August 2023)</h2><p>During <a href="https://www.gitcoin.co/blog/announcing-gitcoin-grants-18" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin Grants 18</a> (GG18) we organized a second Gitcoin Featured Round in order to support the existing Local Nodes and foster the emergence of new nodes around the Globe. We were immensely grateful to receive $30k of match funding through the support of <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloOrg" rel="noreferrer">Celo Foundation</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloEurope" rel="noreferrer">Celo Europe</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/KnktDAO" rel="noreferrer">CeLatam</a>. Their contribution stands as a testament of commitment to fostering a sustainable digital economy. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/local-node-applications-are-open/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Local Node Beta Round on GG18 | Applications are LIVE! 🪩 🎉</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What’s going on ReFi fam? John Ellison here! 👋 I am super excited to announce the ReFi Local Node Beta Cohort with a $30k cUSD match funding pool on Gitcoin GG18 thanks to the generosity of Celo, Celo Europe DAO and KNKT DAO! 🌎🌍🌏 Our mission is to build a global regenerative</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">John Ellison</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/08/30k-cusd-beta-round.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>Before diving in to the results of this round, lets take a moment to learn more about our sponsors... 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/FoundersBlog_Header_resized.png" width="1516" height="864" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/FoundersBlog_Header_resized.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/FoundersBlog_Header_resized.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/FoundersBlog_Header_resized.png 1516w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/64c1742d33dea5bd1e8d8b07_OpenGraph.webp" width="1200" height="630" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/64c1742d33dea5bd1e8d8b07_OpenGraph.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/64c1742d33dea5bd1e8d8b07_OpenGraph.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/64c1742d33dea5bd1e8d8b07_OpenGraph.webp 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-11.41.30-am.png" width="1178" height="526" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-11.41.30-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-11.41.30-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-11.41.30-am.png 1178w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><ul><li><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/celo-foundation/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>The Celo Foundation</strong></a> was founded in 2017 to support the growth and development the Celo blockchain - a decentralized, open source, mobile-first platform to help build a carbon-negative financial system that creates the conditions of <em>prosperity for all</em>. The Foundation is guided by the Celo community and contributes to education, technical research, environmental health, community engagement, and ecosystem outreach—activities that support and encourage an inclusive financial system.</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://celo.org/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">More about Celo</a></div><ul><li><a href="Celo Europe" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Celo Europe DAO</strong></a> plays a crucial role in accelerating&nbsp;Celo&nbsp;in&nbsp;Europe through empowering mission-driven entrepreneurs and creators by helping them build innovative solutions that harness the power of the Celo Ecosystem.</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.celodao.eu/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Find out more about Celo Europe</a></div><ul><li><a href="https://twitter.com/KnktDAO" rel="noreferrer"><strong>CeLatam</strong></a> (Previously <a href="https://twitter.com/KnktDAO" rel="noreferrer">Konekti DAO</a>) is dedicated to linking developers, entrepreneurs, and opportunities for the growth of the Latin American Celo ecosystem.&nbsp;</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/KnktDAO" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Celatam</a></div><p>Celo's support significantly bolsters the mission of ReFi DAO, together we aim to establish a global regenerative economy rooted in local startup communities. </p><h3 id="gg18-round-results-%F0%9F%8F%85">GG18 Round Results 🏅</h3><p>With the $30k of match funding for the <a href="during the Gitcoin Grants 18 Local Node Featured Round!" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Local Node Featured Round</a>, during GG18 we saw the emergence of <strong>18 new Local Nodes worldwide</strong>. The round also collected over <strong>1550 contributions</strong> totalling over <strong>$6700+ in additional donations</strong>. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-1.png" width="1196" height="665" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-1.png 1196w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-12.25.05-pm.png" width="2000" height="1278" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-12.25.05-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-12.25.05-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-12.25.05-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-12.25.05-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x10be322de44389ded49c0b2b73d8c3a1e3b6d871" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">View the past round on Gitcoin</a></div><p>Huge congratulations to all nodes that took part and a special mention to some of the top-performing nodes whose contributions were particularly remarkable - <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiMedellin" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Medellín</a> (109 contributions), <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPhangan" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Phangan</a> (68 contributions), <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiMexico" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Mexico</a> (69 contributions), <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiCostaRica_" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Costa Rica</a> (63 contributions), <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiLagos01" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Lagos</a> (70 contributions), <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiTanzania" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Tanzania</a> (62 contributions), <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiLisboa" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Lisboa</a> (59 contributions), and <a href="https://twitter.com/refiistanbul" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Istanbul</a> (58 contributions). </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Social-Media-Post-1.png" width="900" height="1400" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Social-Media-Post-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Social-Media-Post-1.png 900w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Social-Media-Post-1--2--3.png" width="900" height="1400" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Social-Media-Post-1--2--3.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Social-Media-Post-1--2--3.png 900w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>Kudos to every Local Node for their outstanding efforts and dedication throughout Gitcoin Grants 18. We can't wait to see you at the ReFi Local Node Beta Cohort and are excited to back each of you in your mission. 👏</p><h2 id="gitcoin-grants-19-gg19">Gitcoin Grants 19 (GG19)</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="https://assets-global.website-files.com/6433e6f821ae13dd37394322/654c080e9a8002a60ec97730_Frame_427318859.png" class="kg-image" alt="Announcing: Gitcoin Grants 19 | Gitcoin Blog" loading="lazy"><figcaption><a href="https://www.gitcoin.co/blog/announcing-gitcoin-grants-19"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://www.gitcoin.co/blog/announcing-gitcoin-grants-19</span></a></figcaption></figure><p>Now, with Gitcoin Grants 19 kicking off this week, <strong>established ReFi Local Nodes</strong> will be eligible for Gitcoin's core <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29">Web3 Community and Education</a> round with $200,000 in available match funding, and depending on the activities of the node, may also be eligible for the <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561">Climate Solutions</a>, <a href="https://builder.gitcoin.co/#/chains/424/rounds/0xe60a569ec8aac2045d9fda306dc2a16cc1e52a90">Open Civics</a>, or <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0xc34745b3852df32d5958be88df2bee0a83474001">Web3 Social</a> rounds... This presents a wonderful opportunity for the wider community to engage and support. We heartily invite everyone to contribute to this <a href="https://grants.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer">round of donations</a> and support the mission of ReFi Local Nodes. Get your <a href="https://passport.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin Passport </a>ready now!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://passport.gitcoin.co/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get Gitcoin passport</a></div><p>ReFi DAO global will also be in the upcoming <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29-223" rel="noreferrer">Web3 Community and Education</a> round and we would be super grateful for any support!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29-223"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.31.36-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1262" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.31.36-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.31.36-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.31.36-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.31.36-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29-223" rel="noreferrer"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">ReFi DAO Global in the Web3 Community &amp; Education Round</span></a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29-223" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi DAO &amp; Local Nodes</a></div><h1 id="whats-next-for-refi-dao">What's Next for ReFi DAO?</h1><p>With a spirited online community and a global network of local nodes, ReFi DAO is set to continue its journey of community development and growth in a way that honours network autonomy while laying the groundwork for a universal movement for the upcoming cycle. Here are some key next steps 👇</p><h2 id="community-driven-evolution">Community-driven Evolution</h2><p>As we forge ahead, the co-creation of ReFi DAO's future is paramount. Central to this evolution will be the collective effort to redefine our Mission, Vision, and Values, ensuring they resonate with the diverse voices of our global community. This process isn't just about refining words; it's about embodying the principles that will guide our actions and decisions. <a href="https://lu.ma/ReFiDAOForum-4" rel="noreferrer">Register for upcoming the session 🔗</a>. Alongside this, we are dedicated to developing clear organizational and governance structures that reflect our commitment to transparency, inclusivity, and efficiency. This structural evolution will be supported by the implementation of new coordination tools and infrastructure, designed to streamline our processes and enhance collaboration across our network.</p><p>In this spirit, we are excited to continue our ReFi DAO Forum online sessions. These are designed to be interactive platforms where ideas can flourish, strategies can be formulated, and meaningful connections can be forged to shape the trajectory of ReFi DAO. Register for the upcoming session &amp; subscribe for updates on ReFi DAO Global events here:&nbsp;<a href="https://lu.ma/refidao" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><strong>lu.ma/refidao</strong></a></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.57.53-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1307" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.57.53-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.57.53-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.57.53-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-2.57.53-pm.png 2170w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/refidao" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Subscribe for updates</a></div><h2 id="local-node-beta-cohort">Local Node Beta Cohort</h2><p>Continuing our effort to support and incubate Local Nodes, January 2024 is the planned launch of the 8-week Local Node Beta Cohort. We are preparing a series of sessions with industry experts to provide comprehensive insights and guidance to both new and established Local Nodes. The Cohort will equip the Local Nodes with essential tools and knowledge, ranging from preparing effective business models to strategies in communication, marketing, and fundraising. This foundational training is aimed at steering towards a successful journey of local and global regeneration.</p><p><strong>Applications for the Local Node Beta Cohort are still open! </strong>If you are a founder interested in setting up a Local Node in your city, make sure to check out the <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/Local-Node-Toolkit-1000a8af4ed94c11806f5e9991499355?pvs=4" rel="noreferrer">Local Node Toolkit </a> and apply through the Tally form below!<strong> 👇</strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-1.02.06-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1882" height="1094" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-1.02.06-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-1.02.06-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-1.02.06-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-13-at-1.02.06-pm.png 1882w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Apply here --&gt; </span><a href="https://tally.so/r/mK5VYM"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://tally.so/r/mK5VYM</span></a></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/mK5VYM" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply to the Local Node Beta Cohort!</a></div><h2 id="new-partnerships-strengthened-alliances">New Partnerships &amp; Strengthened Alliances</h2><p>As we look towards the horizon, ReFi DAO can be seen as a conduit for action-oriented exchanges among regenerative DAOs, organizations, and communities. By deepening our alliances with entities such as&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/CeloOrg" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Celo</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/regensunite" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Regens Unite</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/greenpillnet" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">GreenPill Network</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/gitcoin" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Gitcoin</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/banklessDAO" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Bankless DAO</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/crypto4commons" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Crypto Commons Association</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/SilviProtocol" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Silvi Protocol</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/thetreegens" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Treegens</a>, <a href="https://thelexicon.org/" rel="noreferrer">The Lexicon</a>&nbsp;and many others, we will aim to unlock synergistic potentials and create a tapestry of interconnected initiatives that can drive meaningful change - a Regen CoordiNATION.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/10/QmPZAVkLQEA8ftsRtaz666VLiS3xtN6so8NFH3SYcBHaaF.png" class="kg-image" alt="Regen CoordiNATION" loading="lazy"></figure><h1 id="the-future-is-regenerative-lets-grow-%E2%9C%A8"><strong>The Future is Regenerative.</strong>&nbsp;Let's grow!&nbsp;<strong>✨</strong></h1><p>As we close this update, it's clear that ReFi DAO is not just witnessing growth but is actively helping to shape a movement defined by regeneration and sustainability. From the inspiring achievements of Local Nodes to ambitious plans for community-driven evolution and strategic partnerships, every step we take is a testament to our unwavering commitment to a regenerative future. These efforts are more than just individual achievements; they represent the collective will and dedication of a community united by a common vision. As we continue to evolve, we remain grounded in our mission to leverage the transformative power of web3 for a regenerative future. Thank you for being a part of this journey. We invite you to stay engaged, contribute your voice, and join us as we embark on the next exciting phase of ReFi DAO's evolution.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://linktr.ee/refidao" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get Invovled</a></div>

item.title: The Ecological Benefits Framework with Douglas Gayeton and Monty Bryant │ Season 3 Episode 11 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>In the latest episode of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a><em>, host </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a><em> welcomes two guests who are at the forefront of sustainable innovation. Joining him are </em><a href="https://twitter.com/DGayeton" rel="noreferrer"><em>Douglas Gayeton</em></a><em> from </em><a href="https://twitter.com/TheLexicon_org" rel="noreferrer"><em>The Lexicon</em></a><em> and </em><a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin" rel="noreferrer"><em>Monty Bryant</em></a><em> from </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi DAO</em></a><em>, who will be diving deep into the groundbreaking concept of the </em><a href="https://twitter.com/EcoBenefitFrame" rel="noreferrer"><em>Ecological Benefit Framework</em></a><em> (EBF).</em></p><p><em>Our discussion with Douglas and Monty promises to be an enlightening journey, revealing the inspiring potential of the EBF to unite people from various backgrounds under a shared vision of a better, more sustainable future.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/The-Ecological-Benefits-Framework-with-Douglas-Gayeton-and-Monty-Bryant--Season-3-Episode-11-e2btop1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/The-Ecological-Benefits-Framework-with-Douglas-Gayeton-and-Monty-Bryant--Season-3-Episode-11-e2btop1" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode, you will:</strong></p><p>🌍 Discover the Ecological Benefit Framework (EBF) and its impact in bringing together over 200 organizations to identify six crucial benefits for worldwide ecological initiatives.<br><br>🤝 Understand the connection between EBF, ESG, Carbon Markets, and how they can work together to promote sustainable development.<br><br>💡 Gain insights from Douglas Gayeton and Monty Merlin on the importance of various forms of capital in advancing positive environmental change.</p><p>As you tune into this episode, we hope it ignites your interest in sustainable change and offers new perspectives on how we can collectively work towards this goal. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/8_2XIBBq7xE?si=nvt9EdnCpeP6ZMFX" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/8_2XIBBq7xE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="The Ecological Benefits Framework with Douglas Gayeton and Monty Bryant │ Season 3 Episode 11 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:01:58] What Is EBF And What Is It For?<br>[00:08:39] Monty’s Journey Building EBF<br>[00:10:49] The Response to EBF<br>[00:15:03] A New Framework to Measure Impact<br>[00:18:23] Use Case For EBF: Biochar &amp; Biodiversity<br>[00:23:38] A Digital Handshake For The Planet<br>[00:30:41] How Can EBF Be Valued From A Financial Perspective&nbsp;<br>[00:34:58] Financing Ecological Benefits: The Simulator With The Lexicon<br>[00:40:57] The Connection Between ReFi And EBF<br>[00:43:40] The Role Of Blockchain In The Implementation Of EBF<br>[00:52:52] Where Is EBF Heading<br>[00:55:55] The ReFi Local Node Model &amp; EBF<br>[01:01:20] The Participatory Guarantee System<br>[01:04:12] The Connection Between ReFi And EBF<br>[01:04:45] Douglas’ Secret Sauce<br>[01:08:21] A New Opportunity</p><p><strong>❗️The </strong><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" rel="noreferrer"><strong>ReFi EBF Grant</strong></a><strong> is live on GG19! Consider supporting their work.</strong></p><h2 id="the-emergence-of-the-ecological-benefit-framework-ebf-%F0%9F%8C%B1">The Emergence of the Ecological Benefit Framework (EBF) 🌱</h2><p>Douglas began by introducing the Ecological Benefit Framework (EBF), a concept that was born out of an unplanned yet remarkable journey. He recounted his 15-year experience in the sustainability sector, starting as a storyteller in TV shows, explaining sustainability and its key practitioners. This path led him to create artworks, exhibits, and books to articulate the core principles of sustainability.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/lexicon_pbs_640x360.jpg" width="640" height="360" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/lexicon_pbs_640x360.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/lexicon_pbs_640x360.jpg 640w"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/screen-shot-2011-08-20-at-4-54-35-pm.jpg" width="1000" height="635" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/screen-shot-2011-08-20-at-4-54-35-pm.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/screen-shot-2011-08-20-at-4-54-35-pm.jpg 1000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/static.kcet.kcet.production.k2.m1.brightspot.jpg" width="448" height="252" loading="lazy" alt=""></div></div></div><figcaption><p><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.pbs.org/food/shows/the-lexicon-of-sustainability/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">The Lexicon of Sustainability</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><p>Douglas's work caught the attention of the <a href="https://www.usda.gov/" rel="noreferrer">U.S. Department of Agriculture </a>(USDA), leading to a collaboration on the "growing organic" platform. This initiative aimed to transition farmers from conventional to organic agriculture. Interestingly, the project evolved into helping the USDA redefine their approach to communicating with farmers.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text">What is EBF?<br><br>The <b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Ecological Benefit Framework (EBF) </strong></b>is a unifying, neutral protocol co-created with academics, practitioners, and stakeholders. It broadens the scope of carbon markets to encompass a suite of ecological benefits: <b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">air, water, soil, biodiversity, equity, and carbon</strong></b>. <br><br>The EBF serves as a '<b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">digital handshake</strong></b>' for sustainability efforts, providing a common language and criteria for diverse ecological initiatives while fostering the development of methodologies to measure these outcomes.</div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><div><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">" <a href="https://twitter.com/EcoBenefitFrame?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@EcoBenefitFrame</a> is a digital handshake for the planet." 🤝<br><br>Did you check out the latest episode of <a href="https://twitter.com/hashtag/ReFi?src=hash&amp;ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">#ReFi</a> Podcast with <a href="https://twitter.com/DGayeton?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@DGayeton</a> of <a href="https://twitter.com/TheLexicon_org?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@TheLexicon_org</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@MontyMerlin</a> of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@ReFiDAOist</a>?<br><br>🎧 <a href="https://t.co/sODAc2UTsp">https://t.co/sODAc2UTsp</a><br><br>📺 <a href="https://t.co/9CpMfkTNLs">https://t.co/9CpMfkTNLs</a> <a href="https://t.co/B4zxnpXsTX">pic.twitter.com/B4zxnpXsTX</a></p>— ReFi Podcast (@ReFiPodcast) <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast/status/1725658333489528930?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">November 17, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></div></figure><h3 id="the-six-pillars-of-ecological-benefits-%F0%9F%A4%9D">The Six Pillars of Ecological Benefits 🤝</h3><p>One of the significant achievements Monty highlighted was the ability to distill complex environmental concepts into six simple, yet powerful words: <strong>air, water, soil, biodiversity, equity, and carbon</strong>. This approach contrasted sharply with the often verbose and unfocused nature of traditional Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports or the narrow focus of carbon markets. By boiling down impact projects to these fundamental elements, Monty underscored the framework's effectiveness in conveying the essence of ecological impact.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="883" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.jpg 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">S</span><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">ource: </em></i><a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">A Common Framework for ReFi | EBF Activator x ReFi DAO 🌱 by Monty Bryant</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><h2 id="beyond-green-rhetoric-measuring-real-impact-%F0%9F%8D%83">Beyond Green Rhetoric: Measuring Real Impact 🍃</h2><p>They emphasized the evolution from simply discussing sustainability in abstract terms to measuring tangible impacts on the ground. This shift is crucial in transitioning from the 'Green Wave' of sustainability to a more grounded approach. By quantifying the actual effects on the planet, this framework aligns finance and resources towards initiatives that generate the most ecological benefits.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/The-Ecological-Benefits-Framework-with-Douglas-Gayeton-and-Monty-Bryant--Season-3-Episode-11-e2btop1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/The-Ecological-Benefits-Framework-with-Douglas-Gayeton-and-Monty-Bryant--Season-3-Episode-11-e2btop1" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h2 id="refi-and-regeneration-a-holistic-approach-%F0%9F%92%A7">ReFi and Regeneration: A Holistic Approach 💧</h2><p>Monty sees the framework as a solution to realign regenerative finance (ReFi) with the goal of regenerating the planet. This holistic perspective is essential for directing global efforts towards sustainable practices that have a meaningful impact. He views this framework as a potential universal language to coordinate global actions in saving the planet.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/8_2XIBBq7xE?si=nvt9EdnCpeP6ZMFX" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/8_2XIBBq7xE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="The Ecological Benefits Framework with Douglas Gayeton and Monty Bryant │ Season 3 Episode 11 🎧"></iframe></figure><h2 id="support-refi-ebf-on-gitcoin-grants-19-%F0%9F%8C%9F">Support ReFi EBF On Gitcoin Grants 19 🌟</h2><p>With an aim to activate EBF into the heart of the ReFi ecosystem, ReFi EBF is a strategic partnership between ReFi DAO and&nbsp;<a href="https://thelexicon.org/" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">The Lexicon</a>.&nbsp;With the funds raised from the <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" rel="noreferrer">GG19 grant proposal</a>, they will be specifically focusing on supporting the development and deployment of EBF in ReFi projects, tools and initiatives.</p><p>The mission is to seamlessly integrate the Ecological Benefits Framework with Web3 and the ReFi ecosystem, fostering a community fluent in EBF and enabling a fully&nbsp;<strong>EBF-empowered ReFi landscape</strong>. Through the application of EBF, the ReFi ecosystem can unlock an array of tools, ideas, opportunities and connections to achieve substantial progress in realizing regenerative impact goals.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi EBF</a></div><p>EBF represents more than just a set of principles—it's a call to action. This framework could unlock the potential to coordinate worldwide efforts to preserve the environment.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1124" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/Holistic-Regenerative-Systems---Social--Environmental---Economic-Regeneration-2.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">S</span><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">ource: </em></i><a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">A Common Framework for ReFi | EBF Activator x ReFi DAO 🌱 by Monty Bryant</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%F0%9F%8C%9F"><strong>Join The Conversation </strong>🌟</h2><p>What are your thoughts on the role of EBF in shaping the future of global sustainability? How do you see EBF impacting sustainability efforts in your local community? We'd love to hear your thoughts! </p><p>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>, and if you liked this episode, please consider <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">leaving us a five-star review</a>. </p><p>Your feedback is invaluable, and we'd love to hear your thoughts on this innovative approach to global sustainability. Thank you! 💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/40t0j" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share on Twitter 🐦</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: In the latest ReFi Podcast episode, we welcomed Douglas Gayeton from The Lexicon and Monty Bryant from ReFi DAO to discuss the Ecological Benefit Framework (EBF). Get ready for an enlightening discussion on the potential of the EBF to foster unity and promote a sustainable future.

item.title: ReFi DAO is LIVE On Gitcoin Grants 19! 🎉🪩
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi DAO</em></a><em> has evolved from its early days as a startup community to become a hub for regenerative finance on a global scale. We are now fostering a growing network that includes entrepreneurs, events, podcasts, and a wealth of online resources. <br><br>As we enter a new phase with dynamic leadership, our focus will intensify on the development of our community, expanding educational efforts, and fostering Local Node projects. This is why we are incredibly excited to be a grantee of the </em><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29" rel="noreferrer"><em>Web3 and Community Round</em></a><em> during </em><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/" rel="noreferrer"><em>Gitcoin Grants 19</em></a><em>!🌱 <br><br>Your support is essential as we enter this new chapter, and we are incredibly grateful for each and every donation. ✨</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29-223" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Donate Now</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-10.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1894" height="767" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/image-10.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/image-10.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/image-10.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-10.png 1894w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="embracing-a-new-era-of-growth-and-innovation-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Embracing a New Era of Growth and Innovation 🌱</h2><p>From its inception as a startup community, ReFi DAO has evolved into a pivotal hub for regenerative finance, fostering a network that connects entrepreneurs, events, podcasts, and online resources. This growth trajectory has positioned ReFi DAO as a hub in the ReFi landscape.</p><h3 id="recent-milestones-empowering-communities-and-spreading-knowledge-%F0%9F%93%B0">Recent Milestones: Empowering Communities and Spreading Knowledge 📰</h3><p>We are committed to nurturing grassroots initiatives. During the last two Gitcoin Grants rounds, thanks to the generous support of the <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloOrg" rel="noreferrer">Celo Foundation</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/CeloEurope" rel="noreferrer">Celo Europe</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/CeLatamOrg" rel="noreferrer">CeLatam</a>, we have allocated $55,000 to ReFi Local Node communities. These funds have been instrumental in catalyzing community-led projects and stimulating ecosystem growth at a local level.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-blue"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">What are Local Nodes?</strong></b><br><br>Local Nodes represent communities undertaking radical experiments to unlock a regenerative economy. They are platforms for leaders and individuals committed to building community and making a positive impact in their city.</div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/30k-cusd-beta-round-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1039" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/30k-cusd-beta-round-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/30k-cusd-beta-round-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/30k-cusd-beta-round-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/30k-cusd-beta-round-1.jpg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><strong>Other achievements we'd like to highlight:</strong></p><ul><li>Serving over 300 entrepreneurs</li><li>Enabling 75+ events in 58 cities</li><li>Reaching 60k+ listeners on the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Podcast</a></li><li>Fostering the formation of 40+ Local Nodes worldwide</li></ul><h4 id="refi-week-a-convergence-of-minds-and-ideas-%F0%9F%8C%B3">ReFi Week: A Convergence of Minds and Ideas 🌳</h4><p>The organization's <a href="__GHOST_URL__/regeneration-at-refi-week/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Week</a> at the <a href="https://twitter.com/tdfinyourdreams" rel="noreferrer">Traditional Dream Factory</a> in Alentejo, Portugal marked a significant milestone, uniting thought leaders and community members for a series of workshops and collaborative sessions. This event fostered a platform for sharing insights, co-creating solutions, and sparking innovation within the ReFi space.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/ReFi-Week-Retrospective-3-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1128" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/ReFi-Week-Retrospective-3-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/ReFi-Week-Retrospective-3-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/ReFi-Week-Retrospective-3-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/ReFi-Week-Retrospective-3-1.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h4 id="ongoing-educational-initiatives-%F0%9F%93%9A">Ongoing Educational Initiatives 📚</h4><p>Educational outreach remains a cornerstone of ReFi DAO's mission. By consistently publishing informative content on the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO Blog</a>, we continue to educate and inspire both global and local ReFi communities.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-5.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1384" height="541" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/image-5.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/image-5.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-5.png 1384w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="a-new-chapter-leadership-transition-and-future-directions-%E2%AD%90">A New Chapter: Leadership Transition and Future Directions ⭐</h2><p>A major transition occurred during ReFi Week, with <a href="https://twitter.com/daryljedwards" rel="noreferrer">Daryl Edwards</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer">John Ellison</a> stepping down from leadership roles. This shift paves the way for new leadership to guide ReFi DAO into its next chapter.</p><p><strong>The future of ReFi DAO is focused on:</strong></p><ul><li>Community-driven evolution</li><li>Advancing educational outreach</li><li>Supporting Local Node Growth</li><li>Pioneering action-centric community collaborations</li></ul><p>Join us in driving positive change and be a part of our journey. Your donation to our Gitcoin Grant will play a pivotal role in empowering our initiatives and making a lasting impact. Every contribution, big or small, helps us move closer to our goals! 💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/424/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29/0x98720dd1925d34a2453ebc1f91c9d48e7e89ec29-223" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Donate Now</a></div><h3 id="how-to-donate-on-gitcoin-grants-19-%F0%9F%AA%A9">How To Donate On Gitcoin Grants 19 🪩</h3><p>The Project Rounds on Gitcoin Grants Round 19 are now live on the <a href="https://publicgoods.network/" rel="noreferrer">Public Goods Network (PGN)</a>, offering a great opportunity for everyone to contribute with lower gas fees. In order to support your favourite projects on GG19, you'll need to take the following five steps: </p><p>1️⃣<strong> Refresh your Gitcoin Passport stamps </strong><a href="https://passport.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>HERE</strong></a>. This is very important in order for your donation to be eligible for matching, using the <a href="https://www.wtfisqf.com/" rel="noreferrer">full power of quadratic funding</a>. ✨</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-7.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1381" height="696" href="https://docs.publicgoods.network/using-pgn/adding-pgn-to-a-wallet" rel="noreferrer">HERE</a></p><p>3️⃣ <strong>Bridge some ETH to the PGN network.</strong> Some of the options to do so are the <a href="https://bridge.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer">PGN bridge on Gitcoin</a> and <a href="https://www.layerswap.io/app" rel="noreferrer">Layerswap</a>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card There are 3 Gitcoin Project rounds on the Public Goods Network and 9 Community rounds on <a href="https://www.optimism.io/" rel="noreferrer">Optimism</a>, <a href="https://arbitrum.io/" rel="noreferrer">Arbitrum</a> and PGN to choose from! </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-9.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1796" height="988" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/image-9.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/image-9.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/image-9.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/image-9.png 1796w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>5️⃣ <strong>Make your donation and celebrate on Twitter. </strong>Share the projects you are supporting and spread the word about GG19 with your community.
