item.title: AI Co-pilots For Voluntary Carbon Markets with Niklas Terrahe from Ivy Protocol │ S3E12 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Nation! 👋</em></p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer"><em>Anna</em></a><em> here from </em><a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi DAO</em></a><em>, excited to share the latest episode of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a><em>! In this episode, host </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a><em> guides us in an in-depth conversation with </em><a href="https://twitter.com/NiklasTerrahe" rel="noreferrer"><em>Niklas Terrahe</em></a><em>, the visionary behind </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ivy_protocol" rel="noreferrer"><em>Ivy Protocol</em></a><em>.</em></p><p><em>This episode is a deep dive into the complex world of the voluntary carbon market. It's an ecosystem filled with both daunting challenges and exciting opportunities, particularly in this era where aligning economic progress with environmental stewardship is more critical than ever. Our discussion revolves around how we can evolve the environmental asset market in a way that it not only benefits the economy but also realigns it with nature.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/EZ89mq3TUEb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI-Co-pilots-For-Voluntary-Carbon-Markets-with-Niklas-Terrahe-from-Ivy-Protocol--Season-3-Episode-12-e2c61dh" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><em>This episode also spotlights Ivy Protocol's latest innovation – an AI co-pilot. This integrated large language model is revolutionizing the way project developers and buyers interact with the carbon market. With vast amounts of data at its disposal, the co-pilot simplifies an otherwise intricate asset class, enabling a clearer and more efficient path through the complexities of environmental assets.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/Y6Tmic-4j5o" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Y6Tmic-4j5o?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="AI Co-pilots For Voluntary Carbon Markets with Niklas Terrahe from Ivy Protocol │ Season 3 Ep 12 🎧"></iframe></figure><h2 id="the-journey-of-ivy-protocol-%F0%9F%8C%B1">The Journey Of Ivy Protocol 🌱</h2><p>In its current form, Ivy Protocol can be described as the <a href="https://www.angellist.com/" rel="noreferrer">AngelList</a> of the carbon markets. This analogy helps us grasp its fundamental function – providing a backend system for early-stage funding in the realm of carbon projects. The platform is not just about funding; it encompasses reporting and other management systems integral to project development. The focus, as of now, is predominantly on the funding aspect of project development cycles, streamlining and supporting this crucial phase for environmental projects.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/6419f6e6986ddb6868000c3c_open-graph-min--2-.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/6419f6e6986ddb6868000c3c_open-graph-min--2-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/6419f6e6986ddb6868000c3c_open-graph-min--2-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/6419f6e6986ddb6868000c3c_open-graph-min--2-.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/6419f6e6986ddb6868000c3c_open-graph-min--2-.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.ivyprotocol.com/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Ivy Protocol</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p><strong>Beyond Funding: A Vision for the Future</strong> ⭐</p><p>While Ivy Protocol's current functionality is impressive, its aspirations go much further. The team at Ivy envisions the platform evolving into what they describe as "the operating system of the web" for carbon markets. This evolution entails expanding its functionalities and features to cater comprehensively to project developers. The goal is to <strong>offer a one-stop solution for managing data, reporting, cap table management, and stakeholder engagement, all within a single, integrated platform.</strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://ivyprotocol.medium.com/ivy-protocol-and-hamerkop-a-partnership-empowering-early-stage-project-developers-62de00ce1ce3"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/1-gNo5IkR3OAkz3HL8JDn8xg.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1358" height="369" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/1-gNo5IkR3OAkz3HL8JDn8xg.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/1-gNo5IkR3OAkz3HL8JDn8xg.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/1-gNo5IkR3OAkz3HL8JDn8xg.png 1358w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://ivyprotocol.medium.com/ivy-protocol-and-hamerkop-a-partnership-empowering-early-stage-project-developers-62de00ce1ce3" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Medium</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p><strong>Data Integration and Trust Building </strong>🏗️</p><p>A pivotal aspect of Ivy Protocol's future is its focus on data integration. The aim is to transition into a data layer that provides deep insights into project performance. Currently, critical data points in the carbon market are often trapped in less accessible formats like Excel sheets and PDFs. Ivy Protocol intends to liberate and leverage this data, offering buyers trust and transparency by presenting comprehensive performance insights.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><div><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">Aghhh, LLMs! They've been sprouting up EVERYWHERE, right? 👨🏼‍🌾 But hold onto your watering cans... 🚿&nbsp;here's a juicy plot twist 🤯 LLMs could be the missing element the VCM's ecosystem’s been waiting for! <a href="https://t.co/1QJUdIO72t">pic.twitter.com/1QJUdIO72t</a></p>— Ivy (@ivy_protocol) <a href="https://twitter.com/ivy_protocol/status/1704114023749349638?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">September 19, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></div></figure><p><strong>In this episode, we cover:</strong></p><p>[00:02:20] Who is Niklas Terrahe?<br>[00:06:56] The Epiphany Moment<br>[00:08:08] What Is Ivy Protocol?<br>[00:09:46] The Challenges In The Carbon Markets<br>[00:12:02] The Criticisms Towards The Voluntary Carbon Market<br>[00:14:51] Mangroves and Blue Carbon<br>[00:18:42] How To Start A Mangrove Restoration Project<br>[00:23:51] IA Co-piloted Regeneration&nbsp;<br>[00:30:34] The Process Of Building Ivy's Co-pilot<br>[00:35:25] The Legacy Market &amp; The Digital Native Asset Issuance<br>[00:40:34] Unlocking The Next Stage Of Evolution<br>[00:45:32] Aligning Nature With Our Economy<br>[00:53:00] The Ivy Protocol Team<br>[00:54:55] Supporting Ivy Protocol On Their Journey</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/EZ89mq3TUEb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/AI-Co-pilots-For-Voluntary-Carbon-Markets-with-Niklas-Terrahe-from-Ivy-Protocol--Season-3-Episode-12-e2c61dh" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h2 id="niklas-inner-journey-%F0%9F%AA%B7">Niklas' Inner Journey 🪷</h2><p>Niklas recognizes the push from his younger self to work relentlessly, overshadowing other aspects of life. Yet, there's a contrasting voice urging him to maintain balance and care for himself. This tug-of-war is an aspect many young entrepreneurs face, reflecting the pressure to excel and the necessity of self-preservation.</p><p>Niklas explains his personal motivational model. He describes the initial excitement when starting a new venture or learning a new concept, followed by the realization of complexities and challenges. This understanding leads to a dip in motivation, which he actively manages by focusing on high-level visions to maintain his drive. He believes that connecting daily tasks to a grander vision is not just a strategy but a mastery of life. He experiments with avoiding deep dives into certain topics to maintain motivation. Recognizing that this isn't always feasible, he stresses its importance in keeping him focused and driven.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/Y6Tmic-4j5o" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Y6Tmic-4j5o?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="AI Co-pilots For Voluntary Carbon Markets with Niklas Terrahe from Ivy Protocol │ Season 3 Ep 12 🎧"></iframe></figure><h3 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation ✨</h3><p>What are some of the most significant opportunities that today’s era faces in evolving an environmental asset market that can realign nature with the economy?</p><p>How can integrated tools like Ivy's co-pilot transform the way we approach and understand the complexities of the voluntary carbon market? <br><br>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>! And if this episode resonated with you, please consider <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">leaving us a five-star review</a> on your favourite podcast platform. ⭐</p><p>Your thoughts and feedback are incredibly valuable. Thank you! 💚</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://ctt.ac/XNDfg" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Share On Twitter 🐦</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: Niklas Terrahe from Ivy Protocol and host John Ellison delve into the intricate world of the voluntary carbon market, exploring the significant opportunities that AI presents for it in today's era.

item.title: ReFi & Ecological Benefits Framework - Whats Next?
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <h1 id="overview">Overview</h1><h3 id="tldr">TLDR</h3><p>Starting with six words –&nbsp;<strong>Air, Water, Soil, Biodiversity, Equity, and Carbon</strong>&nbsp;– the Ecological Benefits Framework (EBF) is an adaptive way for anyone to explain impact with a simple and intuitive visual language. From here, we have the opportunity to create holistic approaches for aligning economic activity with the regeneration of our planet. <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" rel="noreferrer">ReFi EBF</a> is a partnership between&nbsp;<a href="https://linktr.ee/refidao">ReFi DAO</a>&nbsp;&amp;&nbsp;<a href="https://www.thelexicon.org/">The Lexicon</a>&nbsp;to intertwine and enhance the Ecological Benefits Framework within the ecosystem of Regenerative Finance (ReFi) and Web3 technology. We seek to fuel a transformative initiative, uniting diverse stakeholders under a common language and framework, and propelling us from an era of extraction to the age of regeneration.&nbsp; As the EBF community aims to embark on ambitious initiatives in 2024, collective participation is key and there are many ways to be involved! </p><p>But first...</p><h3 id="support-refi-ebf-in-gg19">Support ReFi EBF in GG19!</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.12.51-am.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1173" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.12.51-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.12.51-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.12.51-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.12.51-am.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><strong>ReFi EBF is live in the Gitcoin Grants 19 (GG19) Climate Solutions Round - </strong><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" rel="noreferrer"><strong>ReFi EBF: Activating the Ecological Benefits Framework 🐉</strong></a><strong> -your support would be hugely valued!</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi EBF</a></div><hr><h1 id="background">Background</h1><p>For the past 12 thousand years, we have perfected an economic system based on extraction.</p><p><strong>Now, everything is converging …</strong></p><ul><li>Climate change.</li><li>Water scarcity.</li><li>Biodiversity loss.</li><li>Rampant inequity.</li><li>Lack of trust in carbon markets.</li><li>Fractured ESG reporting.</li></ul><p>... and&nbsp;<strong>everything’s at stake</strong>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Sy4XSADQ6.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Sy4XSADQ6.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Sy4XSADQ6.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Sy4XSADQ6.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/Sy4XSADQ6.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="where-do-we-go-from-here">Where do we go from here?</h2><p>In the face of a complex web of existential crises, carbon and other impact markets have the potential to be a key part of the solution. Yet carbon markets themselves face a number of fundamental challenges currently hindering their impact and growth - opacity, misinformation, extraction, fragmentation and the resulting lack of trust. Furthermore, it is abundantly clear that carbon remains&nbsp;only one&nbsp;part of the challenge. In&nbsp;overcoming<strong> </strong>'<a href="https://www.sei.org/perspectives/move-beyond-carbon-tunnel-vision/" rel="noreferrer">carbon tunnel vision</a>', holistic approaches are desperately needed to tackle biodiversity loss, growing inequality, and a range of other social, environmental and economic challenges.</p><p><strong>How should we value carbon alongside other social and ecological impacts? Can we express the value of our ecosystems holistically? Can we realign human activity with the health of people, planet, and the biosphere? </strong></p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/EBF7.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/EBF7.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/EBF7.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/EBF7.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/EBF7.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="a-new-paradigm-%F0%9F%8C%B1">A New Paradigm 🌱</h1><p>In September 2022, hundreds of stakeholders across carbon markets, ReFi, blockchain, Web3, conservation, regenerative agriculture, and corporate ESG reporting began an&nbsp;<a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">activator</a>&nbsp;led by&nbsp;<a href="https://thelexicon.org/" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">The Lexicon</a>&nbsp;to develop a more equitable framework in response to climate change (and much more). The process mobilzed experts across distinct value chains to activate a new framework that can align carbon markets, financial decision-making, ESG reporting and the expansive impact economy...</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/EBF11.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/EBF11.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/EBF11.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/EBF11.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/EBF11.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><em>You can </em><a href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><em>read more about this activator</em></a><em> in the article below 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/ecological-benefits-activator/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">A Common Framework for ReFi | EBF Activator x ReFi DAO 🌱</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What actually is ReFi? What is Regeneration? How should we measure &amp; compare projects?</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Monty Merlin Bryant</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/ReFi-DAO-x-The-Lexicon---Ecological-Benefits-Framework-Activator--EBF-.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>The focus of this process was&nbsp;<strong>EBF - </strong>the&nbsp;<strong>Ecological Benefits Framework</strong>&nbsp;- and it begins with six words:</p><ul><li>Air.</li><li>Water.</li><li>Soil.</li><li>Biodiversity.</li><li>Equity.</li><li>(And carbon.)</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/04/The-Ecological-Benefits--EBF--Framework-2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><p>Starting from here, <strong>EBF can provide a foundational new architecture to radically transform global carbon and ecological benefits markets</strong> both by increasing transparency, trust, quality, and equity, and by accelerating the coordinated delivery of positive financial and environmental impacts. By developing a shared framework, <strong>EBF can create alignment across public and private sectors to support the rapid deployment of strategic capital</strong> for activities that create measurable, holistic and life-affirming ecological impacts.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/HYLDaLihsXY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="EBF: a digital HANDSHAKE for the PLANET. 🤝 #podcast #regeneration #climatechange #web3podcast"></iframe></figure><p>Bluetooth is an enabling technology. It is the digital handshake that lets your mobile phone talk to your car, your refrigerator, and even your front door. Can we create a digital handshake for the planet?</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/EBF9-lq.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/EBF9-lq.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/EBF9-lq.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/EBF9-lq.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/EBF9-lq.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><hr><h3 id="dive-deeper-on-the-ecological-benefits-framework-with-refi-podcast-season-3-episode-11-%F0%9F%8E%A7">Dive deeper on the Ecological Benefits Framework with ReFi Podcast Season 3 Episode 11 🎧</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/8_2XIBBq7xE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="The Ecological Benefits Framework with Douglas Gayeton and Monty Bryant │ Season 3 Episode 11 🎧"></iframe></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/the-ecological-benefits-framework-with-douglas-gayeton-and-monty-bryant-season-3-episode-11/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">The Ecological Benefits Framework with Douglas Gayeton and Monty Bryant │ Season 3 Episode 11 🎧</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">In the latest ReFi Podcast episode, we welcomed Douglas Gayeton from The Lexicon and Monty Bryant from ReFi DAO to discuss the Ecological Benefit Framework (EBF). combination of funding from&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/Ripple" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Ripple</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://twitter.com/BxClimate" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">EBF Gitcoin Grant</a>, many key milestones have been reached. Phase 1 of the EBF roadmap is concluding.</p><h2 id="phase-i-highlights">Phase I Highlights...</h2><h4 id="a-universal-language-to-explain-ecological-benefits-practices-%E2%9C%85">A Universal Language to Explain Ecological Benefits &amp; Practices ✅</h4><p>The Lexicon helped EBF members develop <a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/lex-icons/" rel="noreferrer">Lex Icons</a>, an eminently useful, peer-reviewed visual language of over 2500+ terms and machine-readable icons that bridge cultural barriers, increase literacy, and help establish consensus for how we create positive impacts to meet the globe’s greatest challenges.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.39.06-am.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1064" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.39.06-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.39.06-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.39.06-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-10.39.06-am.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/lex-icons/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore Lex Icons</a></div><h4 id="completion-of-24-ebf-case-studies-from-around-the-world-%E2%9C%85"><strong>Completion of 24 EBF Case Studies from Around the World </strong> ✅</h4><p>An open call for ecological benefit projects from across the globe led to hundreds of submissions, from ocean plastic removal in Indonesia to forestry projects in Sri Lanka. The activator selected and on-boarded 24 diverse project case studies with an EBF analysis that showcases their unique contributions and impacts.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/EBF18.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1121" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/EBF18.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/EBF18.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/EBF18.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/EBF18.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/case-studies/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore Case Studies</a></div><h4 id="digital-fingerprints-for-ebf-projects-%E2%9C%85">Digital Fingerprints for EBF Projects ✅</h4><p>A groundbreaking step forward has been the creation of digital fingerprints for EBF projects. This innovative approach provides a standardized yet personalized format for entities to express their positive impacts visually and interactively. The use of <a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/lex-icons/" rel="noreferrer">Lex Icons</a> further enhances this by providing a clear and standardized language to improve literacy and decision-making across the entire value chain.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/EBF12.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/EBF12.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/EBF12.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/EBF12.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/EBF12.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/case-study/reseed/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore EBF Digital Fingerprint</a></div><h4 id="financing-ecological-benefits-interactive-simulator-%E2%9C%85">Financing Ecological Benefits Interactive Simulator ✅</h4><p>The interactive “Financing Ecological Benefits” simulator has been developed to illuminate the complex dynamics between the financial markets and ecological projects. Leveraging the insights from our 24 case studies, this tool demonstrates the mechanisms through which financial instruments can value ecological benefits, thereby shaping how various purchasers — from sovereign nations to philanthropic institutions — can support and invest in these vital attributes.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/EBF14.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/EBF14.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/EBF14.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/EBF14.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/EBF14.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/simulator/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">EBF Financing Interactive Simulator</a></div><p>But all of this is just the beginning. In order to create maximum impact, we must individually and collectively work to align diverse sectors and stakeholders in support of building and adopting these common language &amp; frameworks.. The more thought-leading people and organizations that join this process the better!</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/ReFi-EBF-Cover-2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="732" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/ReFi-EBF-Cover-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/ReFi-EBF-Cover-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/ReFi-EBF-Cover-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/ReFi-EBF-Cover-2.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="refi-ebfactivating-ecological-benefits-in-the-refi-ecosystem">ReFi EBF - Activating Ecological Benefits in the ReFi Ecosystem</h1><p>Through application of EBF, the ReFi ecosystem can unlock an array of new ideas, opportunities, tools and connections to achieve substantial progress in realizing regenerative impact goals. But how can we foster a community fluent in EBF, stimulate shared alignment and adoption, and enable a fully&nbsp;<strong>EBF-empowered ReFi landscape</strong>? With support from a diverse set of stakeholders, ReFi EBF is a partnership between&nbsp;<a href="https://linktr.ee/refidao">ReFi DAO</a>&nbsp;&amp;&nbsp;<a href="https://www.thelexicon.org/">The Lexicon</a> to infuse the Ecological Benefits Framework (EBF) into the heart of the ReFi &amp; Web3 ecosystem. </p><h3 id="aims-and-outcomes">Aims and Outcomes</h3><p>We believe that EBF will serve as a foundational framework for evaluating genuine ecological impact within the Web3 &amp; ReFi domain, and beyond. The ReFi EBF project aspires to:</p><ul><li><strong>Support &amp; Incubate</strong>: Catalyze and support EBF-aligned projects and initiatives within the ReFi ecosystem.</li><li><strong>Educate &amp; Communicate</strong>: Deploy educational campaigns and media to spread the EBF mission.</li><li><strong>Fund &amp; Foster</strong>: Direct grant funds to encourage and assist promising ReFi EBF projects and initiatives.</li></ul><h3 id="support-refi-ebf-%F0%9F%99%8F">Support ReFi EBF 🙏</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.38.57-am.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="987" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.38.57-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.38.57-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.38.57-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.38.57-am.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a></figure><p><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" rel="noreferrer"><strong>ReFi EBF: Activating the Ecological Benefits Framework 🐉</strong></a> is live in the Gitcoin Grants 19 (GG19) Climate Solutions Round - your support and contribution can make a substantial difference. Initiatives...</h2><p>With Phase 1 of the EBF roadmap complete, there are some exciting plans for what is coming next!</p><h4 id="i-building-trust-and-markets">I. BUILDING TRUST (AND MARKETS)</h4><p>Foster a marketplace for projects with positive ecological impacts, blending both quantitative and qualitative measurement methods. Key initiatives include a MRV Curated Library to compile effective methodologies, development of iMRV to incorporate indigenous knowledge, micro-grants to encourage innovative methodologies, and EBF-Enabled certification for exemplary projects.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.19.20-am.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="681" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.19.20-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.19.20-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.19.20-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.19.20-am.png 2320w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h4 id="ii-building-consensus-and-adoption">II. BUILDING CONSENSUS (AND ADOPTION)</h4><p>Building consensus and adoption through sector-specific translation tools. These tools will standardize frameworks for impact investments and corporate ESG reporting, improve carbon market interoperability, and align the UN Sustainable Development Goals with the six ecological benefits.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.22-am.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="669" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.22-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.22-am.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.22-am.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.22-am.png 2320w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h4 id="iii-developing-the-ebf-commons">III. DEVELOPING THE EBF COMMONS</h4><p>Development of an EBF Commons to establish a sustainable organisation for the ongoing stewardship of the EBF framework with diverse stakeholders and beneficiaries. Getting there involves the c0-creation of governance and organisational structures, diverse revenue streams and membership benefits, and integrating across existing and future market platforms and partners.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.51-am-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="655" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.51-am-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.51-am-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.51-am-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/11/Screenshot-2023-11-28-at-11.20.51-am-1.png 2304w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>For the undertaking of phase II, a new activator program is being planned for 2024...</p><h1 id="come-get-involved">Come Get Involved!</h1><p>The journey towards a regenerative future is not a solitary one. It requires the confluence of innovative minds, committed organizations, and dedicated individuals all working in unison. Our shared mission to establish a common language and framework for ecological benefits is more than just a collaborative effort—it is a movement that thrives on the collective support and action of each one of us.</p><p>As the EBF community aims to embark on ambitious initiatives in 2024, it is inviting new stakeholders to join in this transformative journey. Follow <a href="https://twitter.com/EcoBenefitFrame" rel="noreferrer">@EcoBenefitFrame</a> for updates, <a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/" rel="noreferrer">subscribe to the newsletter</a>, or <a href="https://www.canyouchangethefuture.org/meet-the-team/" rel="noreferrer">reach out to the team</a>! Furthermore, support the ReFi EBF grant, and be a part of shaping an ecosystem of regeneration, resilience, and rebirth for our planet.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-98" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support ReFi EBF</a></div><p><strong>Transformational new systems for public good require collective action AND collective support. Together, let's turn the Age of Regeneration into our new reality.</strong>&nbsp;🌱</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div
