item.title: Launching Planta-R and Vagabonds Podcasts! 🎙️📻🎉
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>In an ecosystem where content is produced predominantly in English, we are incredibly excited to announce two new, groundbreaking podcasts, part of the </em><a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/" rel="noreferrer"><em>Source Studios</em></a><em> network – </em><a href="https://twitter.com/podplanta_r" rel="noreferrer"><em>Planta-R</em></a><em> in Portuguese and </em><a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod" rel="noreferrer"><em>Vagabonds</em></a><em> in Spanish! 👏</em></p><p><em>The introduction of regeneration-focused content in Spanish and Portuguese opens up a new realm of inclusivity and perspective in the global financial conversation.</em></p><p><em>Spanish and Portuguese, spoken by hundreds of millions across the globe, are more than just languages. They are cultural bridges, connecting diverse communities with unique experiences and viewpoints. By embracing these languages in the space of regenerative finance and regeneration in general, we unlock insights, strategies, and wisdom that were previously unheard.</em></p><p><em><strong>Without further ado, let's discover Planta-R and Vagabonds!</strong> </em>🎉🎙️👇</p><hr><h2 id="planta-r-a-blueprint-for-a-regenerative-future-%F0%9F%AA%B7"><strong>Planta-R: A Blueprint for a Regenerative Future 🪷</strong></h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1-.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1080" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1-.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1-.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1-.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.instagram.com/podplanta_r/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Instagram</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/podplanta_r/" rel="noreferrer">Planta-R</a>, breaks new ground by offering content in Portuguese, expanding the reach and impact of the transformative message of regenerative projects to a global audience, and transcending language barriers.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/podplanta_r" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Planta-R on Twitter 🐦</a></div><p><strong>The name 'Planta-R'</strong> is a play on words with profound significance in Portuguese. <em>"Plantar"</em> means "to plant," signifying the sowing of seeds of inspiration through ReFi stories from Portuguese-speaking communities. Simultaneously, <em>"Planta"</em> can also mean "blueprint," representing the aim to draft a blueprint for a regenerative future where technology and sustainability are intertwined harmoniously.</p><h3 id="meet-the-host-rica-amaral%F0%9F%8E%99%EF%B8%8F%F0%9F%91%8F"><strong>Meet the Host: Rica Amaral🎙️👏</strong></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Rica-orb-pfp-dark.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="693" height="682" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/Rica-orb-pfp-dark.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Rica-orb-pfp-dark.jpg 693w"></figure><p>At the helm of Planta-R, we are honoured to have <a href="https://twitter.com/ricaa" rel="noreferrer">Rica Amaral</a>. Rica is a pioneer in the regenerative ecosystem with a passion for sustainable development and expertise in financial systems which makes him the ideal voice to guide us through the complex yet fascinating world of ReFi. </p><p>His unique perspective, cultivated through extensive experience and a deep understanding of both technology and finance, brings a refreshing and insightful approach to the podcast.</p><p>With Rica behind the mic, Planta-R becomes a platform for learning, inspiration, and transformative ideas coming from humans of different and often underrepresented backgrounds. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.instagram.com/podplanta_r/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Planta-R on Instagram 📸</a></div><h3 id="the-first-episode-of-planta-r-is-live-%F0%9F%91%87%F0%9F%AA%A9">The First Episode of Planta-R Is LIVE! 👇🪩 </h3><p>Join Rica in a captivating conversation with <a href="https://twitter.com/SZapelao" rel="noreferrer">Susanne Zapelão</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/anacatarinaneves/" rel="noreferrer">Catarina N. </a>from <a href="https://twitter.com/impactmarket" rel="noreferrer">impactMarket</a>. This episode delves deep into the transformative power of unconditional basic income and its potential to revolutionize communities. The discussion gives an insight into how such financial models can contribute to sustainable and equitable growth.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/QpxzmSJNbx8?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="O poder da renda básica incondicional - planta-R podcast"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">TIP:</strong></b> If you don't speak Portuguese or Spanish, you can still enjoy the episode by turning on the automated captions on YouTube. 😉</div></div><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/lWhVEPhmnQw?si=sWIx5801innMNOyK" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/lWhVEPhmnQw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="O poder da renda básica incondicional com Catarina e Susanne da ImpactMarket│ T1 Ep01 🎧"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/planta-r/episodes/O-poder-da-renda-bsica-incondicional-com-Catarina-e-Susanne-da-ImpactMarket-Temporada-1-Episdio-01-e2ckvlb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/planta-r/embed/episodes/O-poder-da-renda-bsica-incondicional-com-Catarina-e-Susanne-da-ImpactMarket-Temporada-1-Episdio-01-e2ckvlb" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h3 id="acknowledging-the-support-behind-the-scenes-%E2%9D%A4%EF%B8%8F"><strong>Acknowledging the Support Behind the Scenes ❤️</strong></h3><p>A heartfelt shoutout to <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jbellison/" rel="noreferrer">John Ellison</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/lee-rael-1918b213/" rel="noreferrer">Lee Rael</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-lisboa/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Lisboa</a>, and <a href="https://www.bairroupfilms.com/" rel="noreferrer">Bairro Up Films</a> for their invaluable support in bringing this project to life. Their contributions have been instrumental in realizing the vision of Planta-R.</p><hr><h2 id="pura-vida-with-the-vagabonds-podcast-in-spanish-%F0%9F%8C%B4%F0%9F%A5%A5"><strong>Pura Vida With The Vagabonds Podcast In Spanish 🌴🥥</strong></h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="1600" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/image-1.png 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Alongside Planta-R we are incredibly excited to present <a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod" rel="noreferrer">Vagabonds</a>, a podcast in Spanish where curiosity meets passion, and the topics of regeneration and technology come alive. This podcast stands as a space for individuals seeking to renew their connections with the planet, others, and themselves. It's more than just a series of discussions; it's an inspiration to<strong> join a global movement of like-minded vagabonds.</strong></p><p>The Vagabonds Podcast will feature a mosaic of passionate individuals from various fields, each contributing their unique perspectives on regeneration. These guests are pragmatic visionaries, tirelessly working to bring their passions to fruition. They will offer diverse viewpoints, providing a rich learning experience.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Vagabonds on Twitter 🐦</a></div><p>Check out the pilot episode, where <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika/" rel="noreferrer">Karla</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ranulfosobrinho/" rel="noreferrer">Ranulfo</a> share more about the idea and mission of Vagabonds. 👇 </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/5VBUOV2zHGV3tF9bHsLwQn?si=INavnoqxRJSF-I8KiYS-fA" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe style="border-radius: 12px" width="624" height="351" title="Spotify Embed: Impacto y Regeneración con los Vagabonds - Con Karla y Ranulfo | Temporada 01 | Episodio 01" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="" allow="autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; fullscreen; picture-in-picture" loading="lazy" src="https://open.spotify.com/embed/episode/5VBUOV2zHGV3tF9bHsLwQn/video?si=3Q6v6K3tTimvjCJYidKGkw&amp;utm_source=oembed"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/nIeuh_qNmNI?si=zsHBcZUj83JHgTRL" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/nIeuh_qNmNI?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Impacto y Regeneración con los Vagabonds - Con Karla y Ranulfo | Temporada 01 | Episodio 01"></iframe></figure><h3 id="but-why-vagabonds-%F0%9F%A4%94"><strong>But, why 'Vagabonds'? 🤔</strong></h3><p>The name <strong>'Vagabonds'</strong> encapsulates the essence of the podcast. It <strong>symbolizes a journey of exploration, not just geographically but also intellectually and spiritually.</strong> The term represents the quest for knowledge and the desire to tread new paths in the realms of regeneration and technology.</p><h3 id="meet-the-hosts-karla-and-ranulfo-%F0%9F%8E%99%EF%B8%8F%F0%9F%8E%A4"><strong>Meet the Hosts: Karla and Ranulfo 🎙️🎤</strong></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><ul><li><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika/" rel="noreferrer">Karla Córdoba Brenes</a><strong>:</strong> A communicator by profession, Karla's journey traverses three distinct life stages - from a marketing and advertising professional to an NGO worker focusing on environmental issues, and now, a technology enthusiast. Her multifaceted career reflects her perpetual quest for improvement and learning. Karla's interests are diverse, from gardening and cooking to engaging deeply with complex topics.</li><li><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ranulfosobrinho/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Ranulfo Paiva Barbosa</strong></a><strong>:</strong> Involved with blockchain technology and other DLTs since 2009, Ranulfo brings a Brazilian-Costa Rican perspective, adding depth and detail to the discussions. With a Ph.D. and a postdoctoral degree in Economics and Environmental Cryptoassets for Sustainability, his insights span various domains, emphasizing the importance of adaptability and the regeneration of ideas. </li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.instagram.com/p/C0ej9RarxGp/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Vagabonds on Instagram 📸</a></div><h3 id="where-does-our-clothing-come-from-%F0%9F%91%95-s1ep2">Where does our clothing come from? 👕 S1Ep2</h3><p>How does the industry that dresses us every day work? <strong>Episode 2 of Vagabonds is now live!</strong> Karla and Ranulfo are joined by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/oscar-hernandez-venegas-425490130/?originalSubdomain=cr" rel="noreferrer">Oscar Toribio Hernández</a>, an agricultural engineer, artist, fashion designer, entrepreneur, leader and change agent from the world of luxury, zero-waste fashion, from Costa Rica.</p><p>In this episode, they delve into the complex layers of the fashion industry, from the agricultural roots to the final product, and understand how ethical practices can transform not only garments but also lives and environments. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/3fnHE6mUGJwukonU8DGtMN?si=fFhhHuJwSESObP76mH8drA" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe style="border-radius: 12px" width="624" height="351" title="Spotify Embed: Historias Detrás de la Moda - Con Toribio de Toribio&amp;Donato | Temporada 01 | Episodio 02" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="" allow="autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; fullscreen; picture-in-picture" loading="lazy" src="https://open.spotify.com/embed/episode/3fnHE6mUGJwukonU8DGtMN/video?si=fFhhHuJwSESObP76mH8drA&amp;utm_source=oembed"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="thank-you-for-your-support-%E2%9D%A4%EF%B8%8F%F0%9F%8E%99%EF%B8%8F">Thank you for your support! ❤️🎙️</h2><p>Planta-R and Vagabonds are at the forefront of a new era of regenerative ecosystems, reaching broader audiences with their engaging and thought-provoking conversations in Spanish and Portuguese.</p><p>Your support is invaluable to us. By sharing these podcasts within your communities and following <a href="https://twitter.com/podplanta_r" rel="noreferrer">Planta-R</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod" rel="noreferrer">Vagabonds</a> on social media, you help amplify our message and mission. <br><br>We deeply appreciate your support. 🙏</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: We are celebrating the launch of two incredible podcasts in Spanish and Portuguese - Vagabonds and Planta-R! Here is an overview of what you can expect!

item.title: Regeneration Inside & Out with Moniek van Erven from Oyasin │S3Ep14 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>What's good ReFi Nation! 👋</em></p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer"><em>Anna</em></a><em> here from </em><a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi DAO</em></a><em>, sharing the latest episode of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a><em> right before the weekend. 🪩 <br><br>In this episode, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a><em> welcomes </em><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/moniek-van-erven" rel="noreferrer"><em>Moniek van Erven</em></a><em>, a dynamic figure who bridges the worlds of finance and spiritual regeneration. Moniek is a visionary who has journeyed deep into the realms of personal transformation. Through her company </em><a href="https://www.oyasin.co/" rel="noreferrer"><em>Oyasin</em></a><em>, she has been guiding entrepreneurs, executives and leaders through deep healing and transformation with sacred medicine. </em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Regeneration-Inside--Out-with-Moniek-van-Erven-from-Oyasin-Season-3-Episode-14-e2cv6ug" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regeneration-Inside--Out-with-Moniek-van-Erven-from-Oyasin-Season-3-Episode-14-e2cv6ug" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>John met Moniek during his own quest for inner regeneration, a path that led him through nature's serene embrace and the profound insights of sacred medicine. This experience not only realigned his sense of self but also deepened his commitment to a larger mission of bringing about positive change in the world.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/C7dYUoL2lZY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/C7dYUoL2lZY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Regeneration Inside &amp; Out with Moniek van Erven │Season 3 Episode 14 🎧"></iframe></figure><p>Moniek's story is captivating. From spearheading projects in diverse locations like India, South Africa, and Portugal, to her evolution into a guiding force for leaders seeking to make a significant impact, her journey is a testament to the power of looking inward to effect outward change. In this conversation, John and Moniek delve into how personal transformation is integral to making a meaningful difference in the world.</p><p>Prepare yourself to be intrigued by Moniek's unique approach to combining her financial expertise with her work in sacred medicine, particularly her focus on helping leaders reflect their ambitions in their personal experiences, thoughts, emotions, and relationships.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/_DSC5510.webp" width="480" height="780" loading="lazy" alt=""></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/_DSC5455.webp" width="480" height="780" loading="lazy" alt=""></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/3V9A0882.webp" width="480" height="780" loading="lazy" alt=""></div></div></div><figcaption><p dir="ltr"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.oyasin.co/"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://www.oyasin.co/</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong><br><br>[00:03:03] Guided Meditation<br>[00:07:15] Who is Moniek van Erven?<br>[00:11:43] 20 Minutes of Stillness<br>[00:19:52] One Giant Leap<br>[00:26:13] A Force For Good<br>[00:31:02] The Fear Of The Unknown<br>[00:40:52] Ayahuasca Medicine And Its Role In The Amazon<br>[00:47:55] The Great Divide In Our Society<br>[00:57:55] An Invitation To Create Time<br>[01:08:56] Money: The Primary Coordination Vehicle<br>[01:10:40] Your Unique Gifts<br>[01:20:46] Getting In Touch</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/C7dYUoL2lZY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/C7dYUoL2lZY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Regeneration Inside &amp; Out with Moniek van Erven │Season 3 Episode 14 🎧"></iframe></figure><h2 id="one-giant-leap-%E2%9B%B0%EF%B8%8F">One Giant Leap ⛰️</h2><p>Moniek launched a technology incubator for black-owned businesses in South Africa, named "<a href="https://www.bizcommunity.com/Article/196/708/165838.html" rel="noreferrer">One Giant Leap</a>." This venture provided support to diverse enterprises, from township waste management to city-based IT companies. Her role evolved from offering business advice to nurturing the personal growth of business leaders, recognizing the intrinsic link between an entrepreneur's identity and their business.</p><p>A pivotal moment came with an initiative in India, where instead of accepting a lucrative offer from the United Nations, Moniek chose to empower local women by giving them the assets of the company. This decision reflected a deep commitment to purpose over profit highlighting the importance of self-care and balance, integrating entrepreneurial and spiritual paths, and embracing a holistic approach to success and service.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Regeneration-Inside--Out-with-Moniek-van-Erven-from-Oyasin-Season-3-Episode-14-e2cv6ug" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regeneration-Inside--Out-with-Moniek-van-Erven-from-Oyasin-Season-3-Episode-14-e2cv6ug" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><h2 id="join-the-freediving-medicine-retreat-in-tulum%F0%9F%8C%8A">Join the <strong>Freediving &amp; Medicine Retreat In Tulum🌊</strong></h2><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/_DSC5480.webp" width="480" height="780" loading="lazy" alt=""></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/_DSC5563.webp" width="460" height="620" loading="lazy" alt=""></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/_DSC5473-1.webp" width="480" height="780" loading="lazy" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/1681603131535_JPG.webp" width="326" height="211" loading="lazy" alt=""></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/268276_08724186e3dc4540b4b65743368c8b75-mv2.webp" width="1760" height="440" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/268276_08724186e3dc4540b4b65743368c8b75-mv2.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/268276_08724186e3dc4540b4b65743368c8b75-mv2.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/12/268276_08724186e3dc4540b4b65743368c8b75-mv2.webp 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/268276_08724186e3dc4540b4b65743368c8b75-mv2.webp 1760w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><p dir="ltr"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.oyasin.co/"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://www.oyasin.co/</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><p>Oyasin is organising a transformative retreat in Mexico, where can experience a unique blend of freediving and sacred medicine ceremonies, enriched with holistic healing practices. <br><br>Dive into the serene cenotes of Yucatan, learning to trust your body and embrace tranquillity. Beyond freediving, the retreat offers heart-opening cacao ceremonies, breathwork, temazcal, water prayers, and ancient healing rituals.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.oyasin.co/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Find out more</a></div><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation! ✨</h2><p><strong>Can the journey of self-regeneration redefine how we approach global challenges?</strong></p><p><strong>How does reconnecting with nature influence our perspective on global regeneration?</strong></p><p>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiDAOist?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>! Loved the episode? We would be incredibly grateful if you could show your support by <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">leaving a five-star review</a> on your favourite podcast platform. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</p><p>Thank you! 🙏</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Check out the latest ReFi Podcast episode featuring Moniek van Erven, a luminary in finance and spiritual regeneration. Through Oyasin, Moniek guides entrepreneurs and leaders in profound personal transformation and healing, utilizing sacred medicine to facilitate deep change.

item.title: A New Chapter - Whats Next? | Forum #4 Insights
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <blockquote class="kg-blockquote-alt"><em>What's next for the ReFi DAO community in 2024? </em></blockquote><p><em>This was the central question at ReFi DAO Forum meeting #4, a gathering of ReFi Local Node leaders, key contributors, and leaders from the broader ecosystem. The meeting provided a space to check in, explore our community's current state, identify necessary actions, and envision future developments. It was an opportunity for members to share insights, contribute ideas, and invite passionate individuals to join the ReFi DAO 2.0 organizing team. It marked a crucial step in shaping our collective trajectories. In this article, we share an overview of some key opportunities, challenges and next steps identified by the community for 2024. Let's dive in 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Untitled-design-78--1-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1000" height="545" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/Untitled-design-78--1-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Untitled-design-78--1-1.png 1000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">What is the ReFi DAO Forum?</strong></b><br>How do we collectively shape the future of ReFi DAO? This pivotal question drives the ReFi DAO Forum. Our focus is on developing systems powered by the community's collective intelligence in sense-making, problem-solving, idea generation, and governance. We aim to empower each member to contribute actively to our collective journey. Over the next 12 months, we'll co-create ReFi DAO v2, a critical phase for establishing community-driven governance and ownership. The ReFi DAO Forum notion space and facilitated online gatherings serve as our current medium for co-creation and collaboration in guiding the evolution of this ecosystem.</div></div><p>If you want to contribute to this collective visioning and join us in 2024. Please take a moment to fill in the co-creation form, we'd love to share this new journey with you! 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/mKV4rK" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">ReFi DAO Co-Creation Form</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/world.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1512" height="821" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/world.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/world.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/world.png 1512w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="local-node-updates">Local Node Updates</h1><p>During the forum, we got the chance to hear exciting updates from some of the leading Local Nodes in our community. here's a summary of key insights 👇</p><p><strong>🇲🇽 ReFi Mexico City:</strong> <a href="https://twitter.com/olahworld" rel="noreferrer">Oscar</a>, co-founder of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiMexico" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Mexico City</a>, shared the aim to deploy an NFT minter for enhanced synchronization across Nodes, leveraging the Nodes' growth and city outreach. Their focus includes broadening community engagement through initiatives like "Meatless Monday" and integrating web3 tools for community support.</p><p>🌊 <strong>ReFi Tulum: </strong><a href="https://twitter.com/sandramp" rel="noreferrer">Sandra</a>, co-founder of <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiTulum" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Tulum</a> shared that the Node will continue to focus on innovative and impactful initiatives. They will advance the <a href="https://twitter.com/UnlockContent" rel="noreferrer">NFT Boutique</a> to keep promoting a circular, regenerative economy and incentivize actions for reducing plastic waste. Their ongoing city cleanups will keep combining community action with education, backed by web3 incentives. The Node will also persist in its plastic transformation technology efforts, using <a href="https://twitter.com/petgasmx" rel="noreferrer">PetGas</a> to mitigate plastic waste. </p><p>🇨🇷 <strong>ReFi Costa Rica:</strong> In 2024, <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiCostaRica_" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Costa Rica</a> aims to expand on its successful 2023 pilot of the ReFi Incubator for Collaborative Businesses. <a href="https://twitter.com/muguika" rel="noreferrer">Karla</a>, co-founder of the Node, shared that this initiative is part of their broader goal to transform Costa Rica into a world-leading ReFi Lab, fostering regeneration and sustainability. Looking ahead, their main focus is to raise funds to support more emerging ReFi projects in Costa Rica.</p><p><em>❗️STAY TUNED! At the beginning of 2024, we are planning to share an update article with all the amazing work done by across the entire ReFi Local Node network during this year.</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F_vbXgKWEAEA7HG.jpg" width="1024" height="1024" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/F_vbXgKWEAEA7HG.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/F_vbXgKWEAEA7HG.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F_vbXgKWEAEA7HG.jpg 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/GAmg24zXUAAKlwL.jpg" width="1200" height="1600" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/GAmg24zXUAAKlwL.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/GAmg24zXUAAKlwL.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/GAmg24zXUAAKlwL.jpg 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F_HCv26XEAA6grB.jpg" width="2000" height="1711" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/F_HCv26XEAA6grB.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/F_HCv26XEAA6grB.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/12/F_HCv26XEAA6grB.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F_HCv26XEAA6grB.jpg 2100w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F8lFi5aWcAAsMsD.jpg" width="1576" height="1600" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/F8lFi5aWcAAsMsD.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/F8lFi5aWcAAsMsD.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F8lFi5aWcAAsMsD.jpg 1576w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F87Kf02XEAA1T47.jpg" width="2000" height="1500" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/F87Kf02XEAA1T47.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/F87Kf02XEAA1T47.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/12/F87Kf02XEAA1T47.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/F87Kf02XEAA1T47.jpg 2048w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p><strong>For more about the ReFi local node network, what's coming next, and <u>how to start one</u>, check out this recent article 👇 </strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-on-gitcoin/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Nodes - Round Results &amp; What’s Coming Next?</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Welcome to the latest update in the evolving story of ReFi DAO and the global network of ReFi Local Nodes. Rooted in diverse communities, these nodes are pivotal in advancing a shared mission of using web3 for regeneration and sustainability. In this article, we’ll explore the successful outcomes of our</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Anna Kaic</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1200/2023/11/ReFi-DAO-Gitcoin-GG19-Banner3.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>There is still time to register for the Local Node Beta Cohort Incubator in 2024!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/mK5VYM" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply to found a ReFi Local Node in 2024</a></div><hr><h1 id="top-opportunities-for-2024">Top <u>opportunities</u> for 2024?</h1><p>Forum participants were invited to share perspectives on top opportunities and initiatives for their projects and ReFi DAO as a whole in 2024. Here's a synthesis of the key points and insights:</p><ol><li><strong>New Business and Ecosystem Development</strong>: There's a strong focus on developing new business opportunities, particularly in areas like regenerative tourism, ecosystem services, community currency systems, and circular economy initiatives. <a href="https://twitter.com/sandramp" rel="noreferrer">Sandra</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_" rel="noreferrer">Giulio</a> emphasize the desire for sustainable applications of these concepts.</li><li><strong>DAO and Technology Integration</strong>: Many participants, including <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/raamchandrasekharan/" rel="noreferrer">Raam</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tereza-bizkova/" rel="noreferrer">Tereza</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/CorinnaSchlicht" rel="noreferrer">Cori</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/afolabi-aiyeloja/" rel="noreferrer">Afo Wefa</a>, express a commitment to DAO-ification and leveraging technology to enhance community governance, knowledge sharing and impact verification.</li><li><strong>Network Strengthening and Collaboration</strong>: <a href="https://twitter.com/louizfe" rel="noreferrer">Luiz</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/MontyMerlin" rel="noreferrer">Monty</a>, and Valentin highlight the importance of strengthening global networks and building bridges between different ecosystems. This includes partnerships with other organizations and ecosystems like Celo, as well as launching incubators and collaborative projects.</li><li><strong>Local and Global Impact</strong>: The responses show a balance between local and global initiatives. <a href="https://twitter.com/yamine_x" rel="noreferrer">Yamine</a> focuses on environmental actions and helping local nodes acquire land, while <a href="https://twitter.com/WasabiNetwork" rel="noreferrer">Wasabi</a> suggests leveraging first-world connections for third-world projects. There's also a push for impact tokenization, as mentioned by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawn-alimohammadi-4b34b3139/" rel="noreferrer">Shawn</a>, as well as projects like <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/10/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561/0x5eb890e41c8d2cff75ea942085e406bb90016561-76" rel="noreferrer">EBF Hypercerts</a> mentioned my Monty.</li><li><strong>Education and Community Engagement</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/mayazdentzel/" rel="noreferrer">Maya</a>, Anastasia, and others emphasize the importance of education, both within the ReFi DAO community and beyond. This includes onboarding non-web3 activists and educating teenagers on various topics, including web3 and sustainability.</li><li><strong>Project Launches and Development</strong>: Several participants, like Steven, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tntyzhao/" rel="noreferrer">Tian</a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/muguika" rel="noreferrer">Karla</a>, are looking forward to launching or developing specific projects. These range from ReFi incubators to venture studio DAOs focused on circular economics.</li><li><strong>Event Organization and Community Building</strong>: Many participants plan to organize events and workshops, like <a href="https://twitter.com/raybankless" rel="noreferrer">RayBankless</a>'s IRL workshops and a Regen Week mentioned by <a href="https://twitter.com/sandramp" rel="noreferrer">Sandra</a>. These events aim to foster community engagement and knowledge sharing.</li></ol><hr><h1 id="top-challenges-for-2024">Top <u>challenges</u> for 2024?</h1><p>The challenges for 2024 identified by the ReFi DAO Community Forum participants encompass a variety of areas, including financial sustainability, organizational structure, community engagement, and balancing technological and real-world initiatives. Here's a synthesis of the key points and insights:</p><ol><li><strong>Financial and Business Sustainability</strong>: A common challenge noted by many, including <a href="https://twitter.com/sandramp" rel="noreferrer">Sandra</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/raamchandrasekharan/" rel="noreferrer">Raam</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/thetokenjedi" rel="noreferrer">Scott</a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/CorinnaSchlicht" rel="noreferrer">Cori</a>, is the need for sustainable revenue models and funding sources. This includes the challenges of monetization, establishing consistent revenue streams, and securing seed funding.</li><li><strong>Organizational and Structural Challenges</strong>: Participants like <a href="https://twitter.com/sandramp" rel="noreferrer">Sandra</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/mayazdentzel/" rel="noreferrer">Maya</a>, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tereza-bizkova/" rel="noreferrer">Tereza</a> highlight the need for better organization, clarity of offerings, and long-term strategic planning. There's also an emphasis on building stronger community dynamics and team cohesion.</li><li><strong>Cultural and Perception Issues</strong>: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/mayazdentzel/" rel="noreferrer">Maya</a> brings up the public perception problem of crypto, which affects the culture around ReFi. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawn-alimohammadi-4b34b3139/" rel="noreferrer">Shawn</a> also notes personal and cultural challenges in communicating with impact providers.</li><li><strong>Team Building and Management</strong>: Challenges related to team dynamics and management are mentioned by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tntyzhao/" rel="noreferrer">Tian</a>, Anton, and <a href="https://twitter.com/raybankless" rel="noreferrer">RayBankless</a>. This includes finding committed team members, coordinating tasks, and balancing responsibilities.</li><li><strong>Capital and Partnership Development</strong>: <a href="https://twitter.com/louizfe" rel="noreferrer">Luiz</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/yamine_x" rel="noreferrer">Yamine</a> focus on attracting value-aligned capital and finding long-term partners, respectively. The emphasis is on aligning financial and partnership resources with the community's values and goals.</li><li><strong>Scaling and Expanding Initiatives</strong>: Challenges in scaling up initiatives and expanding their reach are mentioned by several participants, including Anastasia and Valentin. This includes onboarding more individuals into web3, expanding teams, and acquiring necessary resources like land.</li><li><strong>Maintaining Integrity and Values</strong>: <a href="https://twitter.com/GiulioQuarta_" rel="noreferrer">Giulio</a> highlights the challenge for the ReFi movement to take advantage of financial opportunities without compromising values or losing ownership of the tools developed.</li></ol><hr><h1 id="so-what-next-for-refi-dao-in-2024">So what next for ReFi DAO in 2024?</h1><p>Based on further insights gathered from the forum, here are the strategically most important next steps for ReFi DAO to consider, address, and act upon:</p><ol><li><strong>Official DAO Formation and Token Launch</strong>: A primary step is the formalization of ReFi DAO as a decentralized autonomous organization. This includes launching a token to facilitate governance, funding, and incentivization within the community.</li><li><strong>Global Collaboration Platforms</strong>: Implementing strategies for global coordination of the ReFi DAO network includes creating robust systems for knowledge exchange, mentorship, community resource allocation, and collaborative opportunity development.</li><li><strong>Sustainable Revenue Models and Funding Strategies</strong>: Establishing sustainable revenue streams is crucial. This involves exploring various models such as advisory services, partnerships with regenerative initiatives, and identifying reliable sources of funding for ongoing work.</li><li><strong>Community Building and Governance Structures</strong>: Strengthening the community by building a robust network of contributors, and implementing effective governance models, such as reputation weight governance, is essential. This includes ensuring radical transparency and decentralization in decision-making processes.</li><li><strong>Local Node Empowerment and Support</strong>: Activating and supporting local nodes with value-aligned frameworks and technology is vital. This could involve local economy enablement, community currency initiatives, and offering consistent support to local nodes.</li><li><strong>Event Organization and Global Engagement</strong>: Organizing global ReFi events, retreats, and workshops will foster community engagement and knowledge sharing. These events should focus on best practices for node governance, innovation in ReFi, and global collaboration.</li><li><strong>Innovation in Digital Platforms</strong>: Developing innovative digital tools and platforms, such as a ReFi hiring platform, token exchange or a Local Node NFT Minter, will facilitate talent acquisition, community referrals, and creative collaborations within the network.</li><li><strong>Knowledge Sharing and Synergy Creation</strong>: Building out a knowledge graph and creating synergies with networks like the <a href="https://twitter.com/regensunite" rel="noreferrer">Regens Unite</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/greenpillnet" rel="noreferrer">Greenpill Network</a> will enhance the efficiency and impact of the community’s initiatives. This includes avoiding duplication of efforts and learning from each other.</li><li><strong>Addressing Cultural and Perception Challenges</strong>: Addressing the public perception problem of crypto and integrating real-life projects with technology solutions will be key. This includes bridging the gap between tech-heavy solutions and trust in real-life impact projects.</li><li><strong>Focus on Local and Global Impact Balance</strong>: Balancing initiatives that have both local and global impact, ensuring that local nodes are empowered while contributing to a global decentralized network, is important for the holistic growth of ReFi DAO.</li></ol><p>Additionally, as proposed and developed by <a href="https://twitter.com/thetokenjedi" rel="noreferrer">Scott Morris</a>, we plan to utilise the Co-Production Canvas as an organizational mapping tool for visualising value flows and recognizing contributions through a profit-sharing system. By integrating collaborators, offerings, community, and accounts, the Canvas holds potential to envision a comprehensive, equitable, and collaborative approach to ReFi DAO's future operations.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-10.40.09-am.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1780" height="1786" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-10.40.09-am.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-10.40.09-am.png 1780w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Canvas developed by Scott Morris and originated from Zebras Unite cooperative patronage system</span></figcaption></figure><p>In summary, the strategic focus for ReFi DAO in 2024 will be on formalizing as a DAO, developing global collaboration platforms, creating sustainable revenue models, strengthening community and governance, supporting local nodes, organizing impactful events, innovating with digital tools, managing strategic partnerships, and working together to build a regenerative future.</p><hr><h1 id="come-join">Come join!</h1><p>In order to help achieve these ambitious targets and initiatives we have formed an initial working group of global contributors to help facilitate key operations and drive the further DAOification of ReFi DAO in 2024. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-3.17.51-pm.png" width="2000" __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Screenshot-2023-12-15-at-3.17.51-pm.png 2062w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>As we embrace this new chapter for ReFi DAO your input and involvement is key! If you want to be involved and help co-vision ReFi DAO's future, consider taking a couple of minutes to fill in this form 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/mKV4rK" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">ReFi DAO Co-Creation Form</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Nuraling_a_modern_forum_with_people_seated_on_the_floor_in_a_ci_c1cdae55-4790-40a0-ac94-e066a8a7c828-copy.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1014" height="366" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/Nuraling_a_modern_forum_with_people_seated_on_the_floor_in_a_ci_c1cdae55-4790-40a0-ac94-e066a8a7c828-copy.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/Nuraling_a_modern_forum_with_people_seated_on_the_floor_in_a_ci_c1cdae55-4790-40a0-ac94-e066a8a7c828-copy.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/Nuraling_a_modern_forum_with_people_seated_on_the_floor_in_a_ci_c1cdae55-4790-40a0-ac94-e066a8a7c828-copy.png 1014w"></figure><p><em>As we draw this year to a close, I'd like to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone in the ReFi DAO community for their dedication and innovative spirit. Your contributions and visions are helping to realise a more sustainable and regenerative future. Wishing each one of you a happy, prosperous, and rejuvenating New Year. May 2024 bring us closer to our collective goals and continue to inspire positive change in the world. </em>💚</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Exploring the future of ReFi DAO in 2024, this article delves into key opportunities and challenges identified by the community, spotlighting initiatives like DAO formation, sustainable revenue models, and global collaborative efforts to drive impactful change in the regeneration economy.

item.title: Introducing Planta-R with Rica Amaral │ S3Ep15 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>In the latest episode of ReFi Podcast, we welcome a special guest and friend: </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ricaa" rel="noreferrer"><em>Rica Amaral</em></a><em>. A ReFi pioneer, active in the space since 2017, he has recently launched a new podcast for the Portuguese-speaking community, part of the </em><a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer"><em>Source Studios</em></a><em> network - </em><a href="https://twitter.com/podplanta_r" rel="noreferrer"><em>Planta-R</em></a><em>.</em></p><p><em>Rica takes us on a journey through the transformative landscape of the Portuguese-speaking community's involvement in ReFi. The podcast, a space of innovative ideas, focuses on conversations with predominantly female leaders who are driving change in their local contexts through the power of Web 3 and sowing the seeds of regeneration. </em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/7ziKwCgwFFb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Introducing-Planta-R-with-Rica-Amaral--Season-3-Episode-15-e2d9p32" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode, you will:</strong></p><p>🔍 Delve into Rica's unique perspective, having been a part of this movement before it was even known as ReFi</p><p>🗣️ Explore Rica’s key learnings and insights gained through conversations with figures like <a href="https://twitter.com/SZapelao" rel="noreferrer">Susanne</a> from <a href="https://twitter.com/impactmarket" rel="noreferrer">Impact Market</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/DjimoSerodio" rel="noreferrer">Djimo</a> from <a href="https://twitter.com/SilviProtocol" rel="noreferrer">Silvi Protocol</a></p><p>🌐 Get an overview for those interested in the unique contributions that the Portuguese-speaking community is making to the global movement of regeneration.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/AQ7W6guOF4E" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/AQ7W6guOF4E?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Introducing Planta-R with Rica Amaral │ Season 3 Episode 15 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="planta-r-blueprinting-a-regenerative-tomorrow-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Planta-R: Blueprinting a Regenerative Tomorrow 🌱</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1--1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1000" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1--1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/403970128_240041195567713_1914379373477223956_n-1--1.jpg 1000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Planta-R innovatively provides content in Portuguese, broadening its influence and delivering the powerful narrative of regenerative initiatives to audiences worldwide, overcoming language boundaries. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/podplanta_r" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Planta-R on Twitter</a></div><p>The name 'Planta-R' holds deep meaning in Portuguese. Derived from "Plantar," it symbolizes planting seeds of motivation with ReFi stories from Portuguese-speaking communities. Additionally, "Planta" translates to "blueprint," reflecting the goal of creating a design for a future where technology and sustainability coexist seamlessly.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.instagram.com/podplanta_r/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Planta-R on Instagram</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card kg-card-hascaption"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/lWhVEPhmnQw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="O poder da renda básica incondicional com Catarina e Susanne da ImpactMarket│ T1 Ep01 🎧"></iframe><figcaption><p dir="ltr"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Watch the first episode of Planta-R with </em></i><a href="https://twitter.com/SZapelao" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Susanne</em></i></a><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"> and Catarina of ImpactMarket</em></i></p></figcaption></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text">If you don't speak Portuguese, you can still enjoy this podcast by turning on the on the automated captions on YouTube. </div></div><hr><h2 id="harmonizing-humanity-with-nature-the-future-of-regenerative-economies-%F0%9F%8C%8E%F0%9F%8C%8D%F0%9F%8C%8F">Harmonizing Humanity with Nature: The Future of Regenerative Economies 🌎🌍🌏</h2><p><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer">John</a> and Rica discuss the concept of survival, intrinsic to human nature and playing a pivotal role in the evolving dynamics of capitalism, especially as we begin to acknowledge the intrinsic value of nature. This shift is not only about recognizing natural resources but also about valuing humans as an integral part of the natural ecosystem. The transition towards a regenerative economy, one that can flourish and sustain itself on a global scale, hinges on this very principle.</p><p>A sustainable future calls for a system of systems, where both the environment and human societies thrive. It's about planning for the long-term - not just five or two years, but for generations to come.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/7ziKwCgwFFb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Introducing-Planta-R-with-Rica-Amaral--Season-3-Episode-15-e2d9p32" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:02:29] Who is Rica Amaral And What Is Planta-R?<br>[00:07:53] Regenerative Stories From The Portuguese-speaking Community<br>[00:11:19] ReFi Anchored In Local Cultures<br>[00:16:24] The Evolution Of ReFi&nbsp;<br>[00:23:57] Rica’s Journey at Celo<br>[00:28:17] Where Are We Now In ReFi?<br>[00:32:04] Silvi’s Evolution<br>[00:36:30] Shifting Capitalism<br>[00:40:05] The Natural Capital Economy<br>[00:45:13] Inner And Outer Regeneration<br>[00:47:50] The Volatility Of ReFi<br>[00:54:49] Learn More About Planta-R</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/AQ7W6guOF4E" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/AQ7W6guOF4E?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Introducing Planta-R with Rica Amaral │ Season 3 Episode 15 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="the-second-episode-of-planta-r-is-now-live-%F0%9F%8E%89">The Second Episode Of Planta-R Is Now LIVE! 🎉</h2><p>Join Rica in the second episode of Planta-R, where he dives into the challenging journey of building communities with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/beatriz-fonseca-600716149/" rel="noreferrer">Beatriz Fonseca</a> from the <a href="https://twitter.com/tdfinyourdreams" rel="noreferrer">Traditional Dream Factory</a>. Discover how the TDF, an innovative co-living project in Portugal, combines regeneration, blockchain, and human collaboration. In this episode, we explore the challenges and triumphs of creating a community from scratch, focusing on a regenerative economic model.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/YyrIJ9ju_u0?si=jY8rZVKhzAoikoIz" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/YyrIJ9ju_u0?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Criar Comunidades Regenerativas com Beatriz Fonseca | Temporada 1 Episódio 2 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation! ✨</h2><p>What if local languages are the missing link in the adoption of the most powerful tools of our time?</p><p>Can local languages be the key to democratizing blockchain knowledge?</p><p>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/82011839/admin/feed/posts/" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>! And if you liked this episode, please consider leaving <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">a 5-star review on your favourite podcast platform</a>. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</p><p>We are incredibly grateful for your support. 💚</p><p></p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Welcome to a special episode of ReFi Podcast, where we sit down with Rica Amaral, a pioneer in using blockchain for social and ecological justice, on his new podcast 'Planta-R'.

item.title: Being Other with Hanae Bezad │ S3Ep16 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Nation! 👋</em><br><br><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer"><em>Anna</em></a><em> here from </em><a href="https://twitter.com/refidaoist" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi DAO</em></a><em>, sharing the latest episode of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a><em> right before the holidays! ❄️ <br><br>In this episode, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a><em> sits down with a truly inspiring human, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/Beehane" rel="noreferrer"><em>Hanae Bezad</em></a><em>. A serial entrepreneur, changemaker, public speaker, and now an author, Hanae has recently published her new book, "Being Other." </em></p><p><em>We find ourselves in a pivotal era of human civilization, standing on the brink of systemic collapse. Now, more than ever, we need leaders who can step up to the immense challenges we face. Hanae's book "Being Other" is a call to action. It urges us to rise above the traumas and transgressions of our time and to lead the change with compassion and understanding. </em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/nJuV2UpuKFb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Being-Other-with-Hanae-Bezad--Season-3-Episode-16-e2diin4" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode you will:</strong></p><p>📘 Discover the inspiring journey of Hanae Bezad, as she navigates through her experiences as an entrepreneur, speaker, and author, revealing her groundbreaking approach to leadership and systemic change.</p><p>🌍 Explore the critical issues facing our civilization, including the brink of systemic collapse, and how new models of regenerative leadership can lead to transformative change and a more interconnected humanity.</p><p>💡 Gain valuable insights into the role of technology and community in conservation and biodiversity preservation, particularly through Hanae's work with the <a href="https://sovereignnature.com/" rel="noreferrer">Sovereign Nature Initiative</a>, and how web 3 and online gaming communities are contributing to this vital cause.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/ghE9TQ6WBBY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ghE9TQ6WBBY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Being Other with Hanae Bezad │ Season 3 Episode 16 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%AA%B7-embracing-oneness">🪷 Embracing Oneness</h2><p>Hanae highlights the importance of staying true to our human commitment to fostering interconnectedness. She acknowledges the challenges posed by emotional baggage and trauma that many carry, underscoring the transformative power of purpose and collective effort in bringing happiness and hope. The journey, as she admits, is fraught with difficulties, particularly in financial spaces where commodification and modular systems dominate, often repressing innovative voices and ideas.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/image-4.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1743" height="543" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/image-4.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/image-4.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2023/12/image-4.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/image-4.png 1743w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://beehane.org/home-2/about/"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">https://beehane.org/home-2/about/</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%93%97-being-other-and-the-journey-of-biwoc-leadership">📗 Being Other' and the Journey of BIWOC Leadership</h2><p>In her book "Being Other," Hanae confronts the overlooked creative leadership of Black, Indigenous, Women of Colour (BIWOC), bringing to light their unique experiences and challenges in the global landscape. This book is not only a synthesis of empirical observations from Hanae's professional life but also a reflection of her personal journey as a traveler, expatriate, repatriate, and self-described notorious migrant. Through her narrative, she uncovers the systemic oppression and white privilege that pervade different spheres of life. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/395028456_705415774400416_3507340263365626470_n.jpg" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/395028456_705415774400416_3507340263365626470_n.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/395028456_705415774400416_3507340263365626470_n.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/395028456_705415774400416_3507340263365626470_n.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/394529775_3530784130516022_742105160637800128_n-1.jpg" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/394529775_3530784130516022_742105160637800128_n-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/394529775_3530784130516022_742105160637800128_n-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/394529775_3530784130516022_742105160637800128_n-1.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><p dir="ltr"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.instagram.com/p/CyxakJVh7p5/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Instagram</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><p>With over a decade of experience working with creatives and entrepreneurs who've felt marginalized, Hanae shares stories of resilience and othering, including her own. From confronting workplace discrimination to challenging patriarchal norms, this book offers a raw, honest portrayal of the struggles and triumphs of BIWOC. It's a clarion call for societal change and an acknowledgment of the need for diverse, authentic leadership that embraces the otherness as a source of strength and innovation. "Being Other" is a journey of understanding, healing, and empowerment, urging readers to recognize and celebrate the value of diverse voices and stories in shaping a more inclusive world.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/nJuV2UpuKFb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Being-Other-with-Hanae-Bezad--Season-3-Episode-16-e2diin4" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers: </strong><br>[00:03:54] A Snapshot of COP28<br>[00:09:09] The Sovereign Nature Initiative<br>[00:13:47] “Being Other”<br>[00:21:34] The Time Is Now<br>[00:26:24] Breaking Down The Components Of Our Identity<br>[00:29:45] Learning Compassion<br>[00:33:45] Being In The Middle Of Systemic Challenges<br>[00:37:26] Changes In Web3 To Nurture A Place Of Belonging<br>[00:41:21] A Source Of Wisdom For Leaders In ReFi<br>[00:46:42] Paving Our Way To A Regenerative Future<br>[00:51:45] Reconnecting With The Truth Of Your Body<br>[00:56:48] Intergenerational Trauma<br>[01:03:12] A Peek Into “Being Other”</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/ghE9TQ6WBBY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ghE9TQ6WBBY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Being Other with Hanae Bezad │ Season 3 Episode 16 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation ✨</h2><p><strong>Are we ready to confront and change the deep-seated injustices and biases inherent in our current systems?</strong></p><p>Join the discussion on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>! Enjoyed this episode? We'd be immensely thankful if you could express your support by <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">leaving a five-star review</a> on your preferred podcast platform. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</p><p>Wishing you all some beautiful holidays!</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: John chats with Hanae Bezad, a dynamic figure in entrepreneurship and change-making, now the author of "Being Other."

item.excerpt:encoded: In 2023, ReFi DAO Global's network of ReFi Local Nodes spread to more than 20 countries. This article celebrates the incredible achievements of the Nodes, while they share their plans for the upcoming year. 🌍🌱🎉

item.title: Giveth's Giving Season: 4 Days Left To Donate 🎁

item.title: Unlocking The Value Of Carbon With Robin Klemens │ S3Ep17 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><strong><em>How might the integration of carbon credits into mainstream banking catalyze a shift towards more sustainable, nature-centric economic models?</em></strong></p><p><em>Today, we are excited to share insights from the latest episode of the ReFi Podcast, where host </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a><em> sits down with </em><a href="https://twitter.com/RobinKlemens" rel="noreferrer"><em>Robin Klemens</em></a><em>, the visionary CEO and founder of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/kumo_earth" rel="noreferrer"><em>KUMO</em></a><em>, a lending marketplace redefining the financial landscape with its approach to environmental sustainability.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/L25PwN9t4Fb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Unlocking-the-value-of-carbon-with-Robin-Klemens--Season-3-Episode-17-e2dvb7t" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>KUMO's journey began with a bold vision: to transform the very concept of money into a force for good, allowing individuals to use a currency that not only facilitates transactions but actively contributes to protecting and restoring nature. KUMO has evolved from a natural capital-backed stable coin project into a pioneering lending marketplace, where people can use tokenized carbon credits to secure loans in FIAT currencies like US dollars or Euros. Its innovative lending model is a game-changer for project developers in the voluntary carbon market and has caught the eye of top-tier banks <a href="https://www.morganstanley.com/" rel="noreferrer">Morgan Stanley</a>.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/pyGD1fZfe8U" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/pyGD1fZfe8U?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Unlocking the value of carbon with Robin Klemens │ Season 3 Episode 17 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode, you will:</strong></p><p>🌱 Learn about KUMO's transformation from a natural capital-backed stablecoin to an innovative lending protocol using carbon credits.</p><p>🏦 Discover how KUMO's approach is attracting top-tier banks to invest in nature as a valuable asset in their portfolios.</p><p>💡 Gain insights into the challenges of climate change and how regenerative finance is evolving to meet these challenges using Web3 technologies.</p><hr><h3 id="revolutionizing-climate-finance-with-a-unique-lending-marketplace">Revolutionizing Climate Finance With A Unique Lending Marketplace</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/image.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1134" height="517" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/image.png 1134w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>KUMO is uniquely designed to bridge the gap between project developers in the voluntary carbon market and climate financiers. KUMO's pioneering approach involves collateralizing both spot and forward carbon credits to provide secure loans. This model significantly reduces the financial risks and lowers costs associated with climate projects, thereby making a substantial impact on the climate finance barriers.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/allcot_kumo-launches-lending-marketplace-for-carbon-activity-7143594683615686656-M5ID"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ALLCOT on LinkedIn: KUMO launches lending marketplace for carbon credits live from COP28</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Together with KUMO, the carbon finance technology platform, we unveiled at COP28 the first ever carbon credit secured loan, marking a monumental leap towards…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://static.licdn.com/aero-v1/sc/h/al2o9zrvru7aqj8e1x2rzsrca" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">LinkedIn</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">ALLCOT</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/sync/D4E27AQH6f6GUUCVqvQ/articleshare-shrink_800/0/1703957123432?e=2147483647&amp;v=beta&amp;t=NWuhKXhIuFpdQOiuUS6F-AsNhTy5EnPNF8pPW8aBB20" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>An important aspect of KUMO's launch is its attraction of institutional capital. This is a critical indicator of the platform's potential and credibility. Institutional investors' interest in KUMO underscores the growing recognition of the importance of sustainable and regenerative investments. It signals a paradigm shift in how financial markets view and engage with climate-related projects, moving from a niche interest to a mainstream financial consideration.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1206" height="540" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/image-1.png 1206w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Borrower Solution / Source: </span><a href="https://www.kumo.earth/borrower-solution" rel="noreferrer"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">KUMO</span></a></figcaption></figure><p>KUMO represents a significant breakthrough in the world of ReFi. Its innovative lending model, focused on carbon credit collateralization, is a game-changer for project developers in the voluntary carbon market.</p><hr><h2 id="cop-28-a-milestone-for-kumo-and-the-carbon-market">COP 28: A Milestone For KUMO And The Carbon Market</h2><p><a href="https://unfccc.int/cop28" rel="noreferrer">COP 28</a> emerged as a pivotal event for KUMO, marking a significant moment in the journey of addressing the urgent needs of project developers within the carbon market. The <a href="https://unfccc.int/cop28" rel="noreferrer">United Nations' conference</a> underscored a revelation: the financial industry's interest in the carbon markets. This interest was previously uncertain, especially given the market's imperfections and associated risks. However, the appetite for involvement in these markets has become increasingly evident, much to the benefit of project developers who are in dire need of funding.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><div><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">KUMO launches a lending marketplace for carbon credits live from COP28 and takes the first step to unlock $10 Billion in dormant value to help bridge the sustainable finance GAP! Watch this video to see history take place!<a href="https://t.co/OcjywPmbFK">https://t.co/OcjywPmbFK</a></p>— KUMO (@kumo_earth) <a href="https://twitter.com/kumo_earth/status/1737484384146436321?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">December 20, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></div></figure><p>Traditionally, these developers had limited options: either resort to expensive equity money or pre-sell their carbon credits at substantial discounts. Such pre-purchase agreements often led to project developers merely functioning as service providers, without the ability to participate in any potential appreciation of their credits. KUMO's introduction of an alternative funding solution at COP 28 provided a breath of fresh air for these developers. It offered them a way to leverage future emissions as collateral, thereby gaining better access to funding while still engaging actively in the market.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/L25PwN9t4Fb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Unlocking-the-value-of-carbon-with-Robin-Klemens--Season-3-Episode-17-e2dvb7t" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:02:34] Check-in With Robin<br>[00:03:24] What Is KUMO?<br>[00:04:01] The Original Vision Of A Nature-Backed Currency<br>[00:07:48] The Obstacles In Bringing The Vision To Life<br>[00:18:20] The Market Response &amp; COP28<br>[00:22:54] AHA Moments With Institutional Actors<br>[00:29:04] The Composability Layer<br>[00:37:06] The Partnership With Solid World<br>[00:39:00] Unpacking The Black Hat<br>[00:46:31] What’s Coming Next?<br>[00:49:48] Unlicking A Unique Value<br>[00:55:11] Staying Centered And Grounded</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/pyGD1fZfe8U" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/pyGD1fZfe8U?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Unlocking the value of carbon with Robin Klemens │ Season 3 Episode 17 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation ✨</h2><p><strong>Can a nature-backed currency truly revolutionize our approach to regeneration, transforming financial transactions into acts of environmental restoration?</strong></p><p>Join the discussion on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>! Did you enjoy this episode? We would be incredibly grateful it if you could show your support by <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">leaving a five-star review</a> on your favourite podcast platform. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</p><p>Wishing you all a year of positive change! 💚</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Diving into finance's future with KUMO's CEO Robin Klemens. This episode of ReFi Podcast reveals KUMO's innovative approach, using tokenized carbon credits for loans, focusing on environmental sustainability. This pioneering concept is attracting attention from giants like Morgan Stanley.
