item.title: Sovereign Nature Initiative with Ale Mazzi │ S3Ep19 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><strong>Can the integration of biodiversity conservation and Web3 technology pave the way for a new era in environmental awareness and action?</strong></p><p>Check out the latest episode of ReFi Podcast, where<a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"> John Ellison</a> welcomes <a href="https://twitter.com/AleMazzi333" rel="noreferrer">Alessandro Mazzi</a>, the head of partnerships and field research at the <a href="https://twitter.com/sovereignnature" rel="noreferrer">Sovereign Nature Initiative</a>, based in Lisbon. With a background in international law, Ale made a significant shift towards conserving nature's most precious ecosystems.</p><p>Here is what you can expect. 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/nun7LkJTpGb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Sovereign-Nature-Initiative-with-Ale-Mazzi--Season-3-Episode-19-e2eh06f" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>The Sovereign Nature Initiative is at the forefront of innovative thought leadership, skillfully navigating the complex intersections of culture, community, data, and conservation. Their efforts demonstrate a profound comprehension of how these crucial elements interplay in the vital task of safeguarding our planet. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/UTZKtmQ1hvE" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/UTZKtmQ1hvE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Sovereign Nature Initiative with Ale Mazzi │ Season 3 Episode 19 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p><ul><li>🌱 <strong>Learn About Conservation Innovations:</strong> Discover how advanced technologies and community initiatives are being leveraged for the conservation of vital ecosystems.</li><li>🤝 <strong>Explore Partnerships in Action:</strong> Gain insights into the powerful collaboration between the Sovereign Nature Initiative and various global organizations, driving impactful conservation efforts.</li><li>🌐 <strong>Understand the Web3 Connection:</strong> Unravel the intriguing role of Web3 in biodiversity conservation and how it's shaping the future of environmental stewardship.</li></ul><hr><h2 id="the-sovereign-nature-initiative-%F0%9F%8C%B1">The Sovereign Nature Initiative 🌱</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/SNI_About_Badge.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1200" height="630" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/SNI_About_Badge.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/SNI_About_Badge.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/SNI_About_Badge.jpg 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://sovereignnature.com/about" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Sovereign Nature Initiative</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><blockquote><strong>"Sovereign Nature is gamifying eco-data.</strong>We’re building a pipeline to connect ecological data to digital creatives, bring meaning and add a green value chain to digital &amp; physical assets: gaming assets, fashion items, art and event tickets." </blockquote><p>In an era where ecological consciousness is a necessity, the Sovereign Nature Initiative (SNI) stands at the forefront, pioneering innovative approaches to environmental stewardship. At its core, SNI is about revolutionizing the interaction between humanity and nature through the powerful lens of technology. Through the gamification of ecological data, they are transforming passive environmental awareness into active, engaging participation.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/nun7LkJTpGb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Sovereign-Nature-Initiative-with-Ale-Mazzi--Season-3-Episode-19-e2eh06f" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><strong>What does gamifying eco-data mean?</strong> It's about applying game design elements to environmental data interaction, making the process engaging and motivational. This approach doesn't just aim to present data; it aims to involve people in a narrative, turning them from passive observers into active participants in the global conservation effort.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/Connect.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1680" height="1120" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/Connect.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/Connect.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/01/Connect.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/Connect.jpg 1680w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>SNI created <strong>a collection of 400 NFT avatars</strong> each embodying the essence of a real lion and serving as a testament to the player's contribution to conservation efforts. Players engage in a journey of discovery, where unlocking the full potential of their lion companions requires delving into the rich tapestry of lion ecology and conservation strategies. Through this digital lion, SNI was able to generate $100k for the <a href="https://www.kenyawildlifetrust.org/" rel="noreferrer">Kenya Wildlife Trust</a> - Kenya’s principal predator conservation trust.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/UTZKtmQ1hvE" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/UTZKtmQ1hvE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Sovereign Nature Initiative with Ale Mazzi │ Season 3 Episode 19 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="the-soundwaves-collection-launch-w-walletconnect-%F0%9F%94%89%F0%9F%8C%8A">The Soundwaves Collection Launch w/ WalletConnect 🔉🌊</h2><p>Marking the launch of the cutting-edge <a href="https://web3inbox.com/" rel="noreferrer">Web3Inbox app</a>, <a href="https://walletconnect.com/" rel="noreferrer">WalletConnect</a>, in partnership with SNI, is introducing the Soundwaves Collection. This series of NFTs captures the essence of whale communications, turning their bio-acoustic data into visual art. These NFTs are symbols of support for<a href="https://www.biodiversite-martinique.fr/acteurannuaire/aquasearch-martinique" rel="noreferrer"> Aquasearch</a>, a dedicated marine wildlife conservation organization based in Martinique.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/WC_featureimage.webp" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/WC_featureimage.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/WC_featureimage.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/WC_featureimage.webp 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://sovereignnature.com/features/wallet-connect-web3-messaging" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Sovereign Nature Initiative</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">We're thrilled to announce our partnership with <a href="https://twitter.com/WalletConnect?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">@WalletConnect</a> celebrating the launch of <a href="https://twitter.com/hashtag/Web3Inbox?src=hash&amp;ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">#Web3Inbox</a> - web3's new messaging app! 🐳🌊<br><br>Early eligible users get exclusive access to a fully immersive, SNI-powered <a href="https://twitter.com/hashtag/SoundwavesNFT?src=hash&amp;ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">#SoundwavesNFT</a> experience, receiving the world's first NFTs tied to… <a href="https://t.co/RDJ0FuQjLo">pic.twitter.com/RDJ0FuQjLo</a></p>— Sovereign Nature Initiative (@sovereignnature) <a href="https://twitter.com/sovereignnature/status/1747269029558206563?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">January 16, 2024</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:08:08] Why Does Biodiversity Matter?<br>[00:12:30] The Sovereign Nature Initiative<br>[00:18:43] Species-Specific Data<br>[00:27:36] The In-game Community<br>[00:42:16] IRL Cultural Experiments<br>[00:49:30] The Kenya Wild Trust<br>[00:55:08] Hope and Optimism in Conservation<br>[01:05:37] Becoming Architects Of Life<br>[01:17:27] Alpha - Partnership With WalletConnect</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/UTZKtmQ1hvE" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/UTZKtmQ1hvE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Sovereign Nature Initiative with Ale Mazzi │ Season 3 Episode 19 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation ✨</h2><p><strong>How can we bridge the gap between modern society and the harmonious relationship with nature that indigenous cultures have maintained for millennia?</strong></p><p><strong>Can the gamification of eco-data transform passive environmental spectators into proactive conservation stewards?</strong></p><p>Share your thoughts on this episode via <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>!<br><br>And if you enjoyed this episode, please consider leaving a five-star review on <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">your preferred podcast platform</a>.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Your support is hugely appreciated!</p><p>Thank you! 💚</p>

item.title: Redesigning Money with Karla Córdoba-Brenes │ S3Ep20 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Fam! 👋</em></p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer"><em>Anna</em></a><em> here, sharing the latest episode of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Podcast</em></a><em>, where </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison </em></a><em>welcomed </em><a href="https://twitter.com/muguika" rel="noreferrer"><em>Karla Córdoba-Brenes</em></a><em>, a multifaceted entrepreneur and visionary behind an array of groundbreaking ventures. </em></p><p><em>Karla is not just the founder of </em><a href="https://twitter.com/_cambiatus" rel="noreferrer"><em>Cambiatus</em></a><em>, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiCostaRica_" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Costa Rica</em></a><em>, and </em><a href="https://twitter.com/vagabondslabs" rel="noreferrer"><em>Vagabonds Labs</em></a><em> but also the new co-host of the podcast "</em><a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod" rel="noreferrer"><em>Vagabonds</em></a><em>," which delves into the narrative of regeneration in Latin America and the Spanish-speaking world. Alongside her co-host, husband, and business partner, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/ranulfovm" rel="noreferrer"><em>Ranulfo</em></a><em>, Karla has embarked on a remarkable journey, engaging with pioneering leaders across various industries who are charting their unique courses in the realm of regeneration.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/LKQ17999CGb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Redesigning-Money-with-Karla-Crdoba-Brenes--Season-3-Episode-20-e2eqsa5" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>One of Karla's initiatives, Cambiatus, is a pioneer in crafting tools for community currencies. This innovative approach allows local communities to establish new forms of money that truly resonate with their intrinsic values and priorities. Moreover, Karla gives us a sneak peek into her upcoming projects within the <a href="https://www.starknet.io/en" rel="noreferrer">Starknet ecosystem</a>. Her work is at the cutting edge of technology, incorporating elements like zero-knowledge proofs to serve communities more effectively. Karla’s dedication and innovative spirit never cease to amaze.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/e0JNMgp4RQc" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/e0JNMgp4RQc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Redesigning Money with Karla Córdoba - Brenes │ Season 3 Episode 20 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode, you will:</strong></p><ul><li>🌱 Discover how Karla is pioneering the path of regeneration in Latin America, diving into stories that bridge language barriers and cultural divides.</li><li>💡 Learn about the innovative financial solutions Karla is spearheading with Cambiatus, enabling communities to create currencies that reflect their core values and support local initiatives.</li><li>🔄 Gain insights into Karla's personal journey of resilience and regeneration, understanding how pivotal life moments have shaped her perspective and fueled her mission to drive positive change.</li></ul><hr><h2 id="exploring-regeneration-in-spanish-vagabonds-podcast-%F0%9F%8C%B4">Exploring Regeneration in Spanish: Vagabonds Podcast<strong> 🌴</strong></h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="1600" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/image-1.png 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Vagabonds</a> is a podcast in Spanish where curiosity meets regeneration and technology. It's a space for individuals seeking to renew their connections with the planet and an open invitation to <strong>join the global movement of vagabonds</strong>.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Follow Vagabonds on Twitter</a></div><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌎</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Why "Vagabonds"?</strong></b> The name signifies a journey of exploration, not just in terms of physical geography but also intellectual and spiritual exploration. The term "vagabond" represents the pursuit of knowledge and the desire to venture into uncharted territories, particularly in the realms of regeneration and technology.</div></div><p>Vagabonds spotlight the regenerative scene in the Spanish-speaking world, but it also serves as the first Spanish podcast in the family. It's an invitation to venture into the regenerative realm, encouraging a broader audience to embrace blockchain and technologies for planetary and personal regeneration. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407725494_664356445567643_63134300574372214_n.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg" width="1080" height="1080" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2023/12/407438225_7036889626391820_1060732487475522456_n.jpg 1080w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><p><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Vagabonds Podcast Hosts: </em></i><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/muguika" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Karla</em></i></a><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"> and </em></i><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ranulfosobrinho" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Ranulfo</em></i></a></p></figcaption></figure><p>Is a celebration of regeneration, featuring conversations with leaders from diverse fields including technology, fashion, and community business. It delves into a variety of topics from the technicalities of artificial intelligence and supply chains to the more personal narratives of entrepreneurship and the transformative journey from specialist to business leader. Emphasizing regenerative principles, Karla and Ranulfo explore how these innovators make impactful decisions, create products, and build services. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/LKQ17999CGb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Redesigning-Money-with-Karla-Crdoba-Brenes--Season-3-Episode-20-e2eqsa5" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="cambiatus-pioneering-regenerative-solutions-through-technology-%F0%9F%97%BA%EF%B8%8F">Cambiatus: Pioneering Regenerative Solutions Through Technology 🗺️</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/6372a00b63630e37270167b0_Cambiatus_Map_Communities_Nov2022.webp" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1406" height="1018" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/6372a00b63630e37270167b0_Cambiatus_Map_Communities_Nov2022.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/6372a00b63630e37270167b0_Cambiatus_Map_Communities_Nov2022.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/6372a00b63630e37270167b0_Cambiatus_Map_Communities_Nov2022.webp 1406w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Organizations using Cambiatus</em></i></figcaption></figure><p><a href="https://www.cambiatus.com/" rel="noreferrer">Cambiatus</a> is a blockchain-based platform and project that focuses on creating tools and solutions to support the development of community currencies and collaborative economies. The project was initiated in 2017 and has since evolved to adapt to changing technology and community needs.</p><p>At its core, Cambiatus aims to empower local communities to create and manage their own digital currencies. These community currencies are designed to reflect the values and priorities of the specific community using them. It allows communities to establish their own local economies, promote collaboration, and support local initiatives, including art, ecological restoration, and more.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/LKQ17999CGb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Redesigning-Money-with-Karla-Crdoba-Brenes--Season-3-Episode-20-e2eqsa5" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>Karla shares that, as technology advances, Cambiatus looks ahead to "Cambiatus 2.0" and embraces cutting-edge solutions such as Starknet's tech and zero-knowledge proofs. The project's ultimate goal is to enable communities to take control of their local economies and create positive impacts by connecting people and solving problems in a collaborative and regenerative way.</p><hr><p><strong>This episode covers:</strong></p><p>[00:03:22] The Launch of Vagabonds Podcast<br>[00:05:51] Englightning Conversations&nbsp;<br>[00:09:24] High-Level Overview Of Karla’s Ventures<br>[00:22:00] The Catalyst Moment For Well-Being<br>[00:28:58] The Ruth Cause Of Our Current Condition<br>[00:34:07] Redesigning Money<br>[00:40:40] Sacred Economics<br>[00:46:06] Implementing Blockchain-Backed Community Currencies<br>[00:50:45] Starknet, Vagabond Labs and Zero Knowledge Proof</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/e0JNMgp4RQc" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/e0JNMgp4RQc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Redesigning Money with Karla Córdoba - Brenes │ Season 3 Episode 20 🎧"></iframe></figure><p></p><hr><h2 id="refi-costa-rica-%F0%9F%8C%B1">ReFi Costa Rica 🌱</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/Untitled-design-133-.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/Untitled-design-133-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/Untitled-design-133-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/01/Untitled-design-133-.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/Untitled-design-133-.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>2023 was a year marked by significant strides for the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiCostaRica_" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Local Node in Costa Rica</a>, with the inaugural <a href="https://refisanjose.substack.com/p/i-encuentro-refi-costa-rica-2023" rel="noreferrer">Encuentro ReFi Costa Rica</a> forging a synergy between leaders and interested people in the web3 space. This synergy was further catalyzed by a pioneering incubator program, meticulously designed to nurture and accelerate ReFi initiatives. </p><p>In 2024, ReFi Costa Rica will be working on the establishment of the ReFi Collaborative Business Incubator, a visionary platform set to attract pivotal seed capital and propel the ongoing and future projects into their next evolutionary phase. Complementing this is the commitment to sustain the monthly ReFi Meetups, a collaborative effort with <a href="https://asoblockchain.org/news/cripto-cantina-series-april-2023/" rel="noreferrer">Cripto Cantina</a>.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/LKQ17999CGb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Redesigning-Money-with-Karla-Crdoba-Brenes--Season-3-Episode-20-e2eqsa5" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join The Conversation ✨</h2><p><strong>How can the principles of regeneration and community-driven economies reshape our traditional understanding of wealth and prosperity?</strong></p><p><strong>In what ways might the integration of blockchain technology and community currencies, challenge and transform the current financial systems and power structures?</strong></p><p>Share your thoughts on this episode via <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>!<br><br>And if you enjoyed this episode, please consider leaving us a five-star review on <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">your preferred podcast platform</a>.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Your support is hugely appreciated!</p><p>Thank you! 💚</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Karla, the visionary behind Cambiatus, ReFi Costa Rica and Vagabonds Podcast, is pioneering regeneration by empowering communities with innovative local currencies and technology-driven solutions.

item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Fam! 👋</em></p><p><em>Anna and Monty here with an invitation to <strong>join us on February 12th @ 4 PM UTC</strong> at the </em><a href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Local Nodes 2024 Kickoff call</em></a><em>, where we will introduce and provide updates on what's coming next for ReFi DAO, the DAO-ification process, the upcoming Local Node Incubator, and the first Collaboration Circles Cohort. This call is open to all the Local Node founders, ReFi enthusiasts and anyone else who wants to get involved with ReFi DAO! 👇</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Reserve Your Spot 📆</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Nodes 2024 Kickoff - Beta Incubator and Collaboration Circles 🌱 · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What’s next for ReFi DAO? Join this call for details on the ReFi DAO-ification process, the upcoming Local Node Beta Incubator, and Collaboration Circles Cohort 0? See you there! 👀</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%23232524&amp;color1=%233b3a43&amp;color2=%23748398&amp;color3=%23e8e8f3&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Fxh%2F249f83d3-4f18-439f-ba04-9ca35b97cd50&amp;name=ReFi%20Local%20Nodes%202024%20Kickoff%20-%20Beta%20Incubator%20and%20Collaboration%20Circles%20%F0%9F%8C%B1" alt=""></div></a></figure><p><em>Here is a peek at what you can expect from this call. </em>⬇️</p><hr><h2 id="refi-dao-ification-process-%F0%9F%A4%9D">ReFi DAO-ification Process 🤝</h2><p>After a fruitful <a href="__GHOST_URL__/a-new-chapter-refi-dao-forum-4/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO Forum in December 2023</a>, where we aligned with the community on the objectives for 2024, the ReFi DAO-ification group has continued working on the Value Flow Compass, proposed and developed by <a href="https://twitter.com/thetokenjedi?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Scott Morris</a>. By integrating collaborators, offerings, community, and accounts, the Canvas holds the potential to envision a comprehensive, equitable, and collaborative approach to ReFi DAO's future operations.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Screenshot-2023-12-14-at-4.48.23-pm-1.png" width="1000" height="670" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/02/Screenshot-2023-12-14-at-4.48.23-pm-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Screenshot-2023-12-14-at-4.48.23-pm-1.png 1000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-05-at-6.12.17-pm.png" width="1274" height="1384" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-05-at-6.12.17-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-05-at-6.12.17-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-05-at-6.12.17-pm.png 1274w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div><figcaption><p><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">The Compass developed by Scott Morris and originated from Zebras Unite cooperative patronage system</em></i></p></figcaption></figure><p>During the Kick-off call, we will share updates on the current state of the Value Flow Compass, how to get involved, and share a public draft of the new <strong>ReFi DAO Mission, Vision,</strong> <strong>Values </strong>statement for review. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Reserve Your Spot 📆</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Nodes 2024 Kickoff - Beta Incubator and Collaboration Circles 🌱 · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What’s next for ReFi DAO? Join this call for details on the ReFi DAO-ification process, the upcoming Local Node Beta Incubator, and Collaboration Circles Cohort 0? See you there! 👀</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%23232524&amp;color1=%233b3a43&amp;color2=%23748398&amp;color3=%23e8e8f3&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Fxh%2F249f83d3-4f18-439f-ba04-9ca35b97cd50&amp;name=ReFi%20Local%20Nodes%202024%20Kickoff%20-%20Beta%20Incubator%20and%20Collaboration%20Circles%20%F0%9F%8C%B1" alt=""></div></a></figure><hr><h2 id="refi-local-nodes-beta-incubator-%F0%9F%8C%8E%F0%9F%8C%8E%F0%9F%8C%8F">ReFi Local Nodes Beta Incubator 🌎🌎🌏</h2><p>2023 was marked by the passion and progress of ReFi Local Nodes across the globe. Check out <a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU" rel="noreferrer">Regenerative Journeys: ReFi Local Nodes 2023&nbsp;Roundup</a> to learn more! 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-impact-2023/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Regenerative Journeys: ReFi Local Nodes 2023 Roundup ✨</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">In 2023, ReFi DAO Global’s network of ReFi Local Nodes spread to more than 20 countries. This article celebrates the incredible achievements of the Nodes, while they share their plans for the upcoming year. 🌍🌱🎉</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Monty Merlin Bryant</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1200/2024/01/ZJOfsSw8YJG7exui15Jab.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>Now, after a successful <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-on-gitcoin/" rel="noreferrer">Alpha Cohort</a>, we are pleased to invite both new and established Nodes to the Beta Cohort Incubator - a seven-week journey with a diverse range of leaders sharing insights and sessions tailored to guide you through the process of successfully establishing and maintaining a thriving Node. We have an exciting agenda to share with you 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join the Kick-Off</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Nodes 2024 Kickoff - Beta Incubator and Collaboration Circles 🌱 · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What’s next for ReFi DAO? Join this call for details on the ReFi DAO-ification process, the upcoming Local Node Beta Incubator, and Collaboration Circles Cohort 0? See you there! 👀</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%23232524&amp;color1=%233b3a43&amp;color2=%23748398&amp;color3=%23e8e8f3&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Fxh%2F249f83d3-4f18-439f-ba04-9ca35b97cd50&amp;name=ReFi%20Local%20Nodes%202024%20Kickoff%20-%20Beta%20Incubator%20and%20Collaboration%20Circles%20%F0%9F%8C%B1" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>Thinking of starting a Local Node in your city? There is still time to apply. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://tally.so/r/mK5VYM" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Apply Now</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://tally.so/embed/mK5VYM?hideTitle=1&amp;alignLeft=1" width="800" height="600" frameborder="0" marginheight="0" marginwidth="0" title="Tally Forms" scrolling="auto"></iframe><script>var d=document,w="https://tally.so/widgets/embed.js",v=function(){"undefined"!=typeof Tally?Tally.loadEmbeds():d.querySelectorAll("iframe[data-tally-src]:not([src])").forEach((function(e){e.src=e.dataset.tallySrc}))};if("undefined"!=typeof Tally)v();else if(d.querySelector('script[src="'+w+'"]')==null){var s=d.createElement("script");s.src=w,s.onload=v,s.onerror=v,d.body.appendChild(s);}</script></figure><hr><h2 id="introducing-the-collaboration-circles-%F0%9F%8E%89">Introducing The Collaboration Circles 🎉</h2><p>With a diverse array of ReFi DAO global contributors and Local Nodes across the globe, how can we cultivate structures for meaningful, participatory, and productive collaboration across ReFi DAO? Following on from the Beta Incubator, we are excited to share a new program for ReFi CoordiNATION... </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Collaboration-Circles.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/02/Collaboration-Circles.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/02/Collaboration-Circles.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/02/Collaboration-Circles.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Collaboration-Circles.jpg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Join to learn more 👇 </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024Kickoff" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Reserve Your Spot 📆</a></div><h1 id="see-you-there-%F0%9F%8C%B1">See you there! 🌱</h1><p>As we gear up for the ReFi Local Nodes 2024 Kickoff, we stand before the start of an exciting journey. Whether you're a seasoned founder, an enthusiastic newcomer, or simply intrigued by the transformative potential of decentralized collaboration, this gathering promises to be a nexus of inspiration, learning, and communal growth. </p><p>Join us as we unveil the blueprint of a regenerative future and take a collective stride towards a more inclusive, collaborative, and impactful ReFi DAO. Your presence is the key to unlocking this new chapter. Together, let's shape the future of ReFi DAO and forge a legacy of regenerative innovation. See you on February 12th at 4 PM UTC!</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Dive into the future of ReFi DAO at our 2024 Kickoff on February 12th @ 4 PM UTC. Be part of the transformative journey with the Local Node Beta Incubator, DAO-ification, and Collaboration Circles Cohort.

item.title: Building a Solar Flywheel with William Skinner │ S3Ep21 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>In the latest episode of the ReFi Podcast,</em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em> John Ellison</em></a><em> delves into an exciting conversation with </em><a href="https://twitter.com/0xWhiteLotus" rel="noreferrer"><em>William Skinner</em></a><em>, the founder behind </em><a href="https://twitter.com/HeliosReFi" rel="noreferrer"><em>Helios</em></a><em>. The platform, which will be launching soon, stands at the forefront of bridging investors with opportunities in renewable energy projects across global markets. Helios introduces an innovative decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol, enabling investors to tap into geographically diverse pools of renewable energy installations, with a spotlight on regions like India and Brazil. 🎧</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Building-a-Solar-Flywheel-with-William-Skinner--Season-3-Episode-21-e2fefsd" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Building-a-Solar-Flywheel-with-William-Skinner--Season-3-Episode-21-e2fefsd" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❗</div><div class="kg-callout-text">NOTE: This episode serves purely for educational purposes and is not intended as investment counsel or an offering of any service.</div></div><p>This dialogue not only signals a pivotal shift in how real-world assets integrate with the DeFi sphere, ushering in tangible, planet-positive yields but also underscores the broader impacts on communities. Moreover, it offers a deeper dive into William's personal and professional evolution since <a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Financing-Renewables-with-William-from-Helios-e1slvam/a-a93fcrb" rel="noreferrer">his last appearance on the show</a>, reflecting significant growth and insights. William also shares his ambitious vision for Helios: <strong>to become an "infinite pool of capital" dedicated to ongoing investments in renewable energy projects, aiming to funnel substantial funds globally to accelerate the decarbonization of our energy supply. </strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/DOvYiMDPILU" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/DOvYiMDPILU?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Building a Solar Flywheel with William Skinner │ Season 3 Episode 21 🎧"></iframe></figure><p><strong>In this episode, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p><p>🌱 Discover Helios, designed to connect investors with renewable energy opportunities in emerging markets.</p><p>📈 Learn about the integration of real-world assets into the DeFi space, offering yields that are beneficial for both the planet and its communities.</p><p>🚀 Hear about William Skinner's journey and Helios's ambition to become an infinite pool of capital for renewable energy projects worldwide.</p><hr><h2 id="the-next-generation-of-impact-investing-%F0%9F%8C%9E">The Next Generation Of Impact Investing 🌞</h2><p>Helios embodies the next generation of impact investing, utilizing web3 technology to enhance transparency, accessibility, and liquidity. It empowers individuals to easily invest in clean energy, offering tools to monitor projects in real time and secure stable returns, independent of market volatility. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://www.helios.eco/home"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/image.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1151" height="338" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/02/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/02/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/image.png 1151w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></a><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Souce: Helios</em></i></figcaption></figure><p>Helios champions the idea that profitable solutions are crucial for tackling climate change effectively and at scale, ensuring that making a positive environmental impact and achieving financial gains are not mutually exclusive. This approach democratizes the opportunity to contribute to planetary preservation while also benefiting financially.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Y__iRmk2350?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Helios is REVOLUTIONIZING investment in solar assets globally! ☀️ #podcast #solarenergy #web3"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/Building-a-Solar-Flywheel-with-William-Skinner--Season-3-Episode-21-e2fefsd" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Building-a-Solar-Flywheel-with-William-Skinner--Season-3-Episode-21-e2fefsd" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p><strong>This episode covers 👇</strong></p><p>[00:00:00] Teaser<br>[00:00:28] Introduction<br>[00:02:06] Check-in with William<br>[00:02:59] An overview of Helios<br>[00:04:10] The Scope of Helios’ Launch<br>[00:06:45] Getting Traction Today<br>[00:07:42] Risk Management at the Protocol Level<br>[00:08:55] The Cashflows Sustaining the Protocol<br>[00:16:57] Distributing the Shares<br>[00:21:01] Keeping the Team During Times of Uncertainty<br>[00:25:14] What Success Looks Like<br>[00:26:35] What’s coming up for Helios?<br>[00:30:36] How To Get Involved?</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/DOvYiMDPILU" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/DOvYiMDPILU?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Building a Solar Flywheel with William Skinner │ Season 3 Episode 21 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join the conversation ✨</h2><p><strong>Can the promise of Helios to merge profit with planetary well-being inspire a paradigm shift in how we approach the urgent challenges of climate change?</strong></p><p>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>!<br><br>And if you enjoyed this episode, please consider leaving us a five-star review on <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">your preferred podcast platform</a>.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Your support is hugely appreciated!</p><p>Thank you! 💚</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: In the latest Refi Podcast episode, John Ellison and William Skinner discuss Helios, a platform revolutionizing investment in renewable energy.

item.title: Welcome to the Local Node Beta Incubator! 🌱
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="tldr"><strong>TL;DR</strong></h3><p><em>Since 2023, ReFi Local Nodes have been a growing catalyst for local regeneration around the world. With the Local Node Beta Incubator kicking off on March 5th, we aim to further support this community and foster the emergence of a new wave of Local Nodes globally - the Beta Cohort. This is an open invitation for you, ReFi Leader, to join the movement towards a sustainable, equitable and inclusive future for all.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Register for Session 1 🚀</a></div><hr><h1 id="the-journey-so-far-%F0%9F%92%AB">The Journey So Far 💫</h1><p>Following the resounding success of our <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-on-gitcoin/" rel="noreferrer">Local Node Alpha Incubator</a> - which fostered the emergence of 14 Local Nodes, helped raise $55k of funding in <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-on-gitcoin/" rel="noreferrer">two Local Node Featured rounds on Gitcoin Grants</a>, supported the organization of <strong>30+ events </strong>and a diverse array of local node projects from <a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU?ref=blog.refidao.com#heading-refi-miami" rel="noreferrer">tree planting</a> to <a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU?ref=blog.refidao.com#heading-refi-tulum" rel="noreferrer">circular economy</a> to <a href="https://mirror.xyz/0x7340F1a1e4e38F43d2FCC85cdb2b764de36B40c0/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU#heading-refi-costa-rica" rel="noreferrer">project incubation</a> - we are thrilled to launch the second edition of the ReFi Local Node Incubator.</p><p>ReFi DAO's vision is to foster the further creation of successful Local Nodes around the world, each a testament to the power of community and collaboration in the face of global challenges.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023---2-.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1104" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/01/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023---2-.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/01/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023---2-.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/01/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023---2-.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/01/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023---2-.jpg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></a><figcaption><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU" rel="noreferrer"><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Regenerative Journeys: ReFi Local Nodes 2023&nbsp;Roundup</span></a></figcaption></figure><h3 id="read-more-about-local-nodes-impact-in-2023-%F0%9F%91%87"><strong>Read more about Local Nodes' impact in 2023 👇</strong></h3><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-impact-2023/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Regenerative Journeys: ReFi Local Nodes 2023 Roundup ✨</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">In 2023, ReFi DAO Global’s network of ReFi Local Nodes spread to more than 20 countries. This article celebrates the incredible achievements of the Nodes, while they share their plans for the upcoming year. 🌍🌱🎉</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Monty Merlin Bryant</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1200/2024/01/ZJOfsSw8YJG7exui15Jab.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><h1 id="introducing-the-beta-cohort-incubator-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Introducing The Beta Cohort Incubator 🌱</h1><p>The <a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" rel="noreferrer">Local Node Beta Cohort Incubator</a> is a program specifically designed to support the initiation, development, and growth of Local Nodes within the context of <a href="https://refi-dao.notion.site/ReFi-Wikipedia-Page-simplified-18405d71e6ef450f962e1a1c7b72105f?pvs=4" rel="noreferrer">Regenerative Finance (ReFi)</a>. It is structured as an 8-week-long curriculum aimed at equipping new and existing Local Nodes with the necessary knowledge, tools, and community support to effectively initiate local ecosystems of regeneration. The incubator will focus on various aspects of running a Local Node, including but not limited to facilitation skills, organizing impactful events, exploring innovative revenue streams and fundraising strategies, understanding the technicalities of on-chain finance, and utilizing a toolkit of essential resources tailored for Local Node operation.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node-2x.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/02/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node-2x.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/02/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node-2x.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/02/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node-2x.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node-2x.jpg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>By fostering the creation of Local Nodes around the world, the ReFi Local Node Incubator aims to craft solutions that are both impactful and sustainable, contributing to the broader vision of a regenerative economy. The Beta cohort specifically refers to a particular session or iteration of the incubator, signaling an ongoing process of refinement and development in the program's approach to supporting Local Nodes.</p><h2 id="who-is-it-for-%F0%9F%A4%94">Who Is It For? 🤔</h2><p>The first session of the Incubator is for <strong>anyone who wants to learn about Local Nodes</strong>. After this open session, interested participants will be prompted to <a href="https://tally.so/r/mK5VYM" rel="noreferrer">apply to become a ReFi Local Node</a>, and in this way will gain access to the remaining sessions. To summarise, the Beta Incubator is designed for anyone who has registered interest in becoming a ReFi Local Node, is already running a Local Node, or is aspiring to apply.</p><p>Join the first session to learn more 👇 </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Sign up for Session 1 🚀</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Node Incubator: Session 1 - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱 · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">ReFi Local Node Incubator: Session 1 - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%233a3943&amp;color1=%23222423&amp;color2=%2374889b&amp;color3=%23ebeaf8&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Fix%2F1a185b9d-7c0b-48ff-924f-842bb1ed8a49&amp;name=ReFi%20Local%20Node%20Incubator%3A%20Session%201%20-%20Uniting%20for%20Regeneration%20%F0%9F%8C%B1" alt=""></div></a></figure><h2 id="a-peak-at-the-curriculum-%F0%9F%A7%AD">A Peak At The Curriculum 🧭</h2><p>Taking inspiration from <a href="https://criterical.net/portfolio/cc-guide-book/" rel="noreferrer">People Powered Money</a>, the session curriculum will flow sequentially through several key themes that form the foundations for understanding and setting up an effective ReFi Local Node:</p><ul><li><strong>WHY</strong> - What is this all about? What is ReFi? What is a Local Node (its purpose), where has this come from?</li><li><strong>WHO</strong> - Stakeholders, levels of the system, and network structure (Global and Local CoordiNATION - from Macro to Mezzo to Micro)</li><li><strong>WHAT </strong>- The tech, tools, and solutions. Meeting local needs with local resources and fostering regeneration in the economy means working with systems for coordinating capital, currency and resource flows.</li><li><strong>HOW </strong>- From running small scale events, to ecosystem building, to facilitating coordination across multi-stakeholder and bioregional coalitions in cyclical processes of civic innovation, regeneration and adaptation - each requires technical knowledge, skills and know-how to do successfully. </li></ul><p>From this overarching structure, each individual session will be designed to empower participants with the knowledge, skills, and tools necessary to kickstart and run a successful ReFi Local Node. Participants will engage in hands-on exercises for co-designing solutions with their communities through facilitation skills and organizing impactful events. The journey will continue through exploring innovative revenue streams and fundraising strategies, the technicalities of on-chain finance and a toolkit of essential resources tailored for Local Node operation. </p><h5 id="join-session-1-to-learn-more-on-the-full-schedule-and-curriculum-%F0%9F%91%87">Join session 1 to learn more on the full schedule and curriculum! 👇</h5><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Register for Session 1 🚀</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Node Incubator: Session 1 - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱 · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">ReFi Local Node Incubator: Session 1 - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%233a3943&amp;color1=%23222423&amp;color2=%2374889b&amp;color3=%23ebeaf8&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Fix%2F1a185b9d-7c0b-48ff-924f-842bb1ed8a49&amp;name=ReFi%20Local%20Node%20Incubator%3A%20Session%201%20-%20Uniting%20for%20Regeneration%20%F0%9F%8C%B1" alt=""></div></a></figure><h2 id="inside-the-first-sessionuniting-for-regeneration-%F0%9F%8C%B1%E2%9C%A8">Inside the First Session - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱✨</h2><p>Kicking off on March 5th, the first session of the ReFi Local Node Incubator will serve as a comprehensive introduction to the program, setting the stage for what participants can expect as they embark on their journey towards fostering regenerative financial systems. Led by <a href="https://twitter.com/KaicAnna" rel="noreferrer">Anna Kaic</a> - the Local Node Lead at ReFi DAO, in collaboration with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/cscottmorris/" rel="noreferrer">Scott Morris</a> - the TokenJedi in Residence with 15 years experience as a political economist and systems engineer, and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gospelofchange/" rel="noreferrer">Jeremy (Creative Destruction) Akers</a> - master of <a href="https://www.liberatingstructures.com/" rel="noreferrer">Liberating Structures</a> and founder of <a href="https://twitter.com/WiseCrowdsLSDAO" rel="noreferrer">WiseCrowds DAO</a>, alongside various guest speakers, this session will delve into the essence of Regenerative Finance (ReFi) and the pivotal role of Local Nodes.</p><p>The session will also cover the core objectives of the incubator, outlining how it aims to support nodes at all stages through a modular, choose-your-own-adventure course structure. Attendees will be introduced to essential tools and resources and participants will gain a deeper understanding of ReFi's principles, how it aims to create virtuous cycles of value, and the critical role Local Nodes play in translating these concepts into tangible community-led actions. This first session is not just an introduction but <u>a call to action for all those interested in being at the forefront of the regenerative finance movement</u>, setting the tone for a journey of learning, development, and community building. Come get involved! 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Session 1 🚀</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Local Node Incubator: Session 1 - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱 · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">ReFi Local Node Incubator: Session 1 - Uniting for Regeneration 🌱</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%233a3943&amp;color1=%23222423&amp;color2=%2374889b&amp;color3=%23ebeaf8&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Fix%2F1a185b9d-7c0b-48ff-924f-842bb1ed8a49&amp;name=ReFi%20Local%20Node%20Incubator%3A%20Session%201%20-%20Uniting%20for%20Regeneration%20%F0%9F%8C%B1" alt=""></div></a></figure><hr><h2 id="uniting-for-regeneration-%F0%9F%97%BA%EF%B8%8F">Uniting for Regeneration 🗺️</h2><p>We believe in the power of community-based regeneration as a pathway to a sustainable future for all. This is why the first session of the Local Node Beta Cohort is open to the community, offering a glimpse into the curriculum and the journey ahead. This session is your opportunity to understand what it takes to kickstart a successful Local Node, to learn about the upcoming sessions, and to see how you can apply to become part of this transformative experience.</p><p>Join us for the first session, "<a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Uniting for Regeneration</strong></a>" and take the first step towards becoming a pivotal part of a global network of Local Nodes dedicated to the principles of regeneration.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/Beta-Cohort-Incubator-1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">RSVP</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-20-at-6.34.47-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1128" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-20-at-6.34.47-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-20-at-6.34.47-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-20-at-6.34.47-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/02/Screenshot-2024-02-20-at-6.34.47-pm.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure>
item.excerpt:encoded: Join a transformative journey towards fostering regenerative financial systems and community-led regeneration.

item.title: Will Singapore be the spark for ReFi to take off in Asia?
item.dc:creator: Shihan Fang
item.content:encoded: <h2 id="about-the-author"><strong>About the author</strong></h2><p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/fangshihan/" rel="noreferrer"><em>Fang Shihan</em></a><em> is the founder of </em><a href="https://www.buzzsprout.com/2186268" rel="noreferrer"><em>Regen Supply</em></a><em>, Asia’s first and only podcast dedicated to ReFi. She’s also the founder of the newly formed </em><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local-/refi-singapore/r/recGB7NDxCFakwR0Q" rel="noreferrer"><em>ReFi Singapore</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p><hr><p>Believe it or not, I stumbled upon ReFi purely by chance. I’d been freelancing as a cryptocurrency journalist, covering everything from DeFi, to stablecoins and metaverses, when I got wind of a company called Toucan Protocol.&nbsp;</p><p>That was sometime in October 2022, six months after the world’s largest registry for carbon credits, Verra, <a href="https://medium.com/@Particula.io/tokenization-of-carbon-credits-why-verra-no-longer-allows-tokenization-with-the-toucan-carbon-70c749c51d6c#:~:text=On%20May%2025th%2C%202022%20Verra,2022%20to%20early%20October%202022." rel="noreferrer">banned Toucan from tokenizing its carbon credits</a>, effectively annihilating its business. Another ReFi group called KlimaDAO was involved. I won’t go into detail but you can read the details of the entire ordeal in <a href="https://time.com/6181907/crypto-carbon-credits/"><u>TIME magazine</u></a>.&nbsp;</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://time.com/6181907/crypto-carbon-credits/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">The Crypto Industry Was On Its Way to Changing the Carbon-Credit Market, Until It Hit a Major Roadblock</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Crypto entrepreneurs hoped to revolutionize the carbon credit market to fight climate change. They’ve been met with resistance.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://time.com/favicon.ico" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Time</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Andrew R. Chow</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://api.time.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/GettyImages-139822346.jpg?quality=85" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>No one in Singapore was paying attention to Toucan or KlimaDAO at that time because like the rest of the world, bigger shitstorms were at hand. While the nascent tokenized carbon space was going through its moment of reckoning, the rest of the crypto world watched in horror as the TerraUSD stablecoin made its way from a dollar to zero.&nbsp;</p><p>And as I worked on the tokenized carbon story later in the year, FTX, then the world’s second largest cryptocurrency exchange, also collapsed, bringing the rest of the cryptocurrency market along with it. Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund, Temasek, was an investor with FTX, escalating the FTX debacle to one of national importance.&nbsp;</p><p>I<a href="https://www.techinasia.com/worldbank-support-blockchain-fix-carbon-market"><u> got the story about tokenized carbon </u></a>out by December with three takeaways:&nbsp;</p><ol><li>Tokenizing a worthless carbon credit will not make it worth anything more–market perception by the “wen-moon” community is something else</li><li>Singapore wants to position itself as a hub for carbon trading, green finance, and ESG policy</li><li>Singapore wants to be a crypto hub but only for institutional players</li></ol><p>A few months later, seeing that there was something in this ReFi thing after all, I took the plunge and launched <a href="https://www.buzzsprout.com/2186268" rel="noreferrer">Regen Supply</a>, Asia's first and only podcast dedicated to ReFi. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.buzzsprout.com/2186268"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Regen Supply</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The official podcast channel of Shihan Fang (Han). Regen Supply showcases inspiring initiatives in&amp;nbsp; climate innovation, and the people behind them.Follow my official Medium page for written stories: https://medium.com/@shihan.fangFollow me on…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://www.buzzsprout.com/rails/active_storage/representations/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRUQ2RVFVPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==----8a9b4b1bc245a46b538f72d4d9b2ab0a7fbe8ac1/Spotify_Cover_Art_v2f.jpg" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Buzzsprout</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://www.buzzsprout.com/rails/active_storage/representations/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRUQ2RVFVPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==----7c01cea9791a272b28ad9ad979e61898eb50a271/Spotify_Cover_Art_v2f.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>Being based in Singapore provided an opportunity to bridge crypto and sustainability. But the key challenge would be fostering knowledge exchange between the two sides.&nbsp;That's why last week, I took the second plunge and launched <a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local-/refi-singapore/r/recGB7NDxCFakwR0Q" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Singapore</a> with the intention of bridging that gap, and to nurture higher quality ReFi projects in Asia. </p><blockquote>One does not solve climate change simply by putting carbon on-chain.&nbsp;</blockquote><h2 id="defining-refi-is-a-work-in-progress"><strong>Defining ReFi is a work in progress</strong></h2><p>The definition of regenerative finance, or ReFi, can vary widely, depending on who you ask. Literature from the Web3 space, particularly those produced by the likes of Toucan, KlimaDAO, or Moss.Earth will define it as leveraging technology to solve climate change. Most of it refers to tokenizing existing carbon credits or issuing crypto-native carbon credits.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://blog.toucan.earth/what-is-refi-regenerative-finance/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">What is ReFi | Regenerative Finance explained</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Regenerative Finance (often shortened to ReFi) is a transparent, accessible, and inclusive alternative to traditional financial systems. We’ll explore the basics of ReFi, and look into what it can mean for individuals and businesses.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://blog.toucan.earth/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/01/tc_symbol_OnDark_color@2x-1.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Toucan Protocol</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Ela Khodai</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://blog.toucan.earth/content/images/size/w1200/2023/03/refi-1.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>Others, such as <a href="https://handprint.tech/"><u>Handprint</u></a>, an impact marketplace based in Singapore, refer to ReFi as leveraging finance to <a href="https://medium.com/@shihan.fang/think-positive-think-regeneration-chief-vision-officer-handprint-a5d815691573" rel="noreferrer">create positive impact and going beyond doing “less harm”</a>. Taking a leaf out of the Ant Forest/Alipay playbook, Handprint works on connecting banks and impact projects at a digital infrastructure level. Blockchain may, or may not, be involved.&nbsp;</p><p>The definition that I’ve settled on is understanding ReFi as a concept with three components: </p><ol><li>Finance</li><li>Getting to a regenerative economy</li><li>Technology as the bridge between 1 and 2</li></ol><p>My definition of a regenerative economy is this:&nbsp;</p><blockquote><em>A self-sustaining and self-renewing system that gives economic value to natural assets and the goods and services that nature provides.</em></blockquote><p>To bridge the gap between aspiration (the regenerative economy) and reality (our current extractive economy), I lean on the work of <a href="https://centerforneweconomics.org/people/jeremy-rifkin/" rel="noreferrer">Jeremy Rifkin</a>, an American economist and futurist who’s also advising the EU and China on their industrial and climate change policies.&nbsp;</p><p>In 2011, he wrote a seminal book called The Third Industrial Revolution, which provides details on the technological progress that is needed to move towards what he calls the New Economy.&nbsp;</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/81iUu00PFVL._AC_UF1000,1000_QL80_.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="The Third Industrial Revolution: How Lateral Power is Transforming Energy, the Economy, and the World : Rifkin, Jeremy: Amazon.sg: Books" loading="lazy" width="656" height="1000"></figure><p>The First Industrial Revolution was driven by coal and steam, and the Second Industrial Revolution by oil and telephony. The Third Industrial Revolution, according to Rifkin, will be driven by clean energy and decentralised digital infrastructure.&nbsp;</p><p>(Note: Those familiar with Rifkin’s work will note that he doesn’t say much about nature in his 2011 book. However, he dedicates his 2022 book called The Age of Resilience to the natural world, emphasising that humanity must adapt back to the rewilding earth, or be consumed by the climate disasters that will follow as the planet rebalances itself.)</p><h2 id="trends-in-asia"><strong>Trends in Asia</strong></h2><p>There are signs that the Third Industrial Revolution is underway in Asia, and many of these trends are happening in the Chinese-speaking world.&nbsp;</p><p>In Taiwan, electric scooter giant <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2023/04/18/gogoros-battery-swapping-stations-in-taiwan-are-now-virtual-power-plants/" rel="noreferrer">Gogoro</a> is working with energy solutions company Enel X, to stabilise the national grid using its 2,500 battery swap stations around the country. As the supply of renewable energy is intermittent–solar panels can’t produce electricity on an overcast day and wind turbines don’t run unless there’s wind–Gogoro’s battery swap stations pump electricity back into the grid during times of shortage, and serve as storage stations when there’s excess supply.&nbsp;</p><p>Startups experimenting on DePIN, or decentralised physical infrastructure, are also on the rise. While DePIN was first popularised by low-range wifi extension project Helium, founders are working on DePIN applications on other devices (consumer and industrial), and are even working on integrating AIoT. AIoT is defined as Artificial Intelligence of Things. Think of it as traditional IoT with an AI layer to smarten up the data.&nbsp;</p><p>Wanxiang Blockchain Labs and Hashkey Capital, both early investors in Ethereum and subsidiaries of Chinese car conglomerate Wanxiang Group, have set up an incubation platform called <a href="http://www.future3.io/#/home"><u>Future3 Campus</u></a> dedicated to furthering DePIN innovation.&nbsp;</p><p>Like ReFi, definitions of DePIN differ depending on who you ask. Friends at <a href="https://arkreen.com/"><u>Arkreen</u></a>, a Web3 platform to issue and retire crypto-native renewable energy credits, say that it’s the bridge between the physical world and Web3. I’d leave it as the bridge between the physical world and the decentralised digital space. Tokens should be optional.&nbsp;</p><p>Interest in real world asset (RWA) tokenization is also picking up, particularly for sustainability use cases such as tracking and tracing sustainable commodities or decarbonizing supply chains.&nbsp;</p><p>And with the voluntary carbon market now on high alert to ensure integrity, interest in digital measurement reporting and verification (dMRV) solutions is growing.&nbsp;</p><p>Singapore-based company <a href="https://arkadiahrestores.earth/" rel="noreferrer">Arkadiah</a> is doing just that. It is working to restore Asian tropical forests at scale, using end-to-end digitisation.&nbsp;Leveraging open source data from space agencies, Arkadiah provides carbon prospectors with pre-feasibility reports on potential project areas, and leverages dMRV for continued monitoring on the project when the project is live. </p><h2 id="regen-is-an-anagram-for-green"><strong>Regen is an anagram for Green</strong></h2><p>With 2023 as the hottest year on record and 2024 set to be even hotter, we’re working against the clock to decarbonise industries, restore the planet’s forests, and above all, pivot towards an economy premised on regeneration, rather than extraction</p><p>We need more regens. People who understand the problem at hand and what it takes to tackle the causes of climate change. We also need regen funds and accelerators like <a href="https://www.aya.foundation/about-us"><u>AYA Foundation</u></a> to scale ReFi solutions.</p><p>If you’re a climate tech entrepreneur, a climate activist with an entrepreneurial bent, or like myself, a storyteller that wants to change the narrative of the world, here’s my proposition to you.</p><p><a href="https://www.refidao.com/community/local" rel="noreferrer">Join your local ReFi DAO chapter</a>. If you’re in Singapore, join me in ReFi Singapore. If you’re located elsewhere in Asia, there’s ReFi Hong Kong and ReFi Phangan. And if you don’t have a chapter where you’re located, set up one.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://linktr.ee/refidao"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi DAO | Twitter | Linktree</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">A network society for the ReFi ecosystem. Get involved 👇</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://assets.production.linktr.ee/profiles/_next/static/logo-assets/apple-icon-180x180.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Linktree</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://linktr.ee/og/image/refidao.jpg" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>It doesn’t always have to involve a token.</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: With Singapore geared to be both the crypto and carbon trading hub of Asia, the confluence of both markets could create the spark for ReFi to take off.

item.title: Vision For a New $EARTH with Utkarsh Patel │ S3Ep22 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi Fam! 👋<br><br>Welcome back to another episode of ReFi Podcast where we're thrilled to bring you an insightful conversation with a visionary guest, </em><a href="https://twitter.com/solarpunkmaxi" rel="noreferrer"><em>Utkarsh Patel</em></a><em> from </em><a href="https://twitter.com/solarpunkdao" rel="noreferrer"><em>Solarpunk DAO</em></a><em>. Our discussion revolves around their recent groundbreaking release of $EARTH Coin, a token that embodies the ideals of a solarpunk future, enabling a seamless transition from petrochemical finance to regenerative finance. </em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/222e5d" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Vision-For-a-New-EARTH-with-Utkarsh-Patel--Season-3-Episode-22-e2gevkq" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-accent"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">❗</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">NOTE:</strong></b> This episode serves purely for educational purposes and is not intended as investment counsel or an offering of any service.</div></div><p>Utkarsh's story is fascinating and deeply inspiring. From a very young age, he has immersed himself in nature, striving to understand the underlying causes of today's most pressing environmental issues, such as climate change, biodiversity collapse, and topsoil degradation. His insights offer a unique perspective on how interconnected and complex these crises are, and how a solarpunk future can serve as a light of hope and action. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/eOUzAIxiT_M" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/eOUzAIxiT_M?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Vision For a New $EARTH with Utkarsh Patel │ Season 3 Episode 22 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="earth-a-currency-backed-by-climate-solutions-%F0%9F%8C%B1">$EARTH: A Currency Backed by Climate Solutions 🌱</h2><p>$EARTH coin is a pioneering initiative leveraging blockchain technology to fuel global climate action, with the goal of achieving zero CO2 emissions within 30 years by fostering a transition to a solarpunk infrastructure. This project seeks to overcome the capital mobilization challenges for climate-positive projects in sectors such as clean energy, regenerative agriculture, clean transport, and ecosystem conservation.
