By becoming a perpetual partner to these projects, $EARTH ensures they face no capital constraints, aligning closely with its mission to build a sustainable and regenerative future.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/image-2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1896" height="747" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/03/image-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/03/image-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/03/image-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/image-2.png 1896w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://solarpunkdao.earth/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">solarpunkdao.earth</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p>Distinctively, $EARTH introduces a novel approach to cryptocurrency, minting its currency against investments in climate solutions, rather than traditional mining methods. This creates a currency backed by tangible climate action and essential utilities for humanity, promoting a sustainable, circular economy. $EARTH stands out by directly linking its value to the impact on climate solutions, offering an innovative platform for global participants to contribute to a solarpunk paradigm shift towards a greener, more sustainable world.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/222e5d" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Vision-For-a-New-EARTH-with-Utkarsh-Patel--Season-3-Episode-22-e2gevkq" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>SolarpunkDAO also has introduced the Solarpunk Universe NFT collection, a digital tribute to the pioneers and visionaries sculpting this future in both the physical and digital domains.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><blockquote class="twitter-tweet"><p lang="en" dir="ltr">A Solarpunk future where :<br>💚We leverage technology for harmony with nature. <br>🌱Society is regenerative by default. <br>🌍 Natural ecosystems and their services are valued as critical scarce resources. <br> 🌇Goods and services addressing core needs are produced emission-free and are… <a href="https://t.co/l7jbb7oll8">pic.twitter.com/l7jbb7oll8</a></p>— $Earth 🔆🌱⚡🌍 (@solarpunkdao) <a href="https://twitter.com/solarpunkdao/status/1663485580867686400?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">May 30, 2023</a></blockquote> <script async="" src="https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js" charset="utf-8"></script></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers: </strong></p><p>[00:02:54] Check-in with Utkarsh <br>[00:03:56] Utkarsh’s Commitment To Climate Action <br>[00:14:07] What Is The Root Cause? <br>[00:28:38] $EARTH Coin and Real World Impact <br>[00:31:44] Project Supported By Solarpunk DAO <br>[00:35:21] Funding Traditional Projects <br>[00:40:55] Investing In Regeneration &amp; Meme Coins <br>[00:43:26] Taking The Leap Into The Solarpunk Future <br>[00:46:33] The Tokenomics Of $EARTH Coin <br>[00:51:03] $EARTH &amp; Glo Dollar <br>[00:57:32] How To Get Involved?</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/eOUzAIxiT_M" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/eOUzAIxiT_M?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Vision For a New $EARTH with Utkarsh Patel │ Season 3 Episode 22 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%F0%9F%99%8C"><strong>Join the Conversation 🙌</strong></h2><p>This episode is a deep dive into the heart of what it means to envision a better future and take concrete steps towards realizing it. Utkarsh's journey and the work of Solarpunk DAO remind us that while the challenges we face are daunting, the path to sustainability and regeneration is filled with opportunities for innovation and collaboration. Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>!</p><p>We hope you find this episode as enlightening and inspiring as we did. Your feedback means the world to us, so please don't hesitate to <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">leave us a five-star review</a> ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ and share your thoughts. Every review helps us continue to bring you content that makes a difference.</p><p>Thank you!</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Join us as we explore $EARTH Coin with Utkarsh Patel of Solarpunk DAO, showcasing how blockchain enables a shift to regenerative finance.

item.title: CELO Public Goods Ecosystem with Luuk Weber and Monty Merlin │ S3Ep23 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <h1 id="overview">Overview</h1><p>In the latest episode of the ReFi Podcast, host John Ellison, alongside <a href="https://twitter.com/LuukDAO" rel="noreferrer">Luuk Weber</a> from <a href="https://twitter.com/Kolektivo" rel="noreferrer">Kolektivo</a> and <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant" rel="noreferrer">Monty Merlin</a> from ReFi DAO, delves into the pivotal moment where the Celo Community Fund approved a budget of $1.6 million cUSD and 700,000 CELO towards growing its ecosystem of public goods in the first half of 2024.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/225591" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://pod.fo/e/225591"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Podcast: Public Goods Ecosystem with Luuk Weber and Monty Merlin │ Season 3 Episode 23 🎧</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Welcome to another episode of the ReFi Podcast! Today, we&amp;#39;re thrilled to feature Luuk Weber from Kolektivo and Monty Merlin from ReFi DAO, alongside seven other stewards who are making waves wi…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://pod.fo/assets/icons/apple-icon-180x180.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">podfollow</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://podfollow.com/1609683147/episode/6bef9b8740d41e47e9ccff5f6b53d2c4bbbe67d6/social?v=5&amp;pcv=5" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>Public goods, by their nature, are assets that offer shared universal benefits, accessible for all. Luuk and Monty, with deep context and insights, unravel the intrinsic value of public goods within Web3, emphasizing how their support is imperative for holistic economic stewardship and building for a regenerative paradigm. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/x1t1NwGCoNI" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/x1t1NwGCoNI?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Public Goods Ecosystem with Luuk Weber and Monty Merlin │ Season 3 Episode 23 🎧"></iframe></figure><h3 id="the-episode-sheds-light-on"><strong>The episode sheds light on</strong>:</h3><ul><li>How blockchain and regenerative economics translate into tangible impacts in the real world, including addressing crucial issues like climate change and social injustice.</li><li>The origins of Celo and it's future roadmap, including a journey towards 'coming home' to Ethereum as a Layer 2 and what this means for a coalition of blockchain ecosystems united in funding public goods.</li><li>The start of the Celo Public Goods initiative, the innovative mechanics to channel 1.6 million in cUSD and 700,000 in CELO, and the criteria for participation and ways to get involved!</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/225591" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen now!</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/image-3.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1001" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/03/image-3.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/03/image-3.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/03/image-3.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/image-3.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="what-is-celo">What is Celo?</h1><p>Celo is a blockchain ecosystem, that aims to scale Ethereum with real-world solutions, leading a thriving new digital economy for all. </p><blockquote><strong>Celo’s mission is to build a <em>regenerative</em> digital economy that creates conditions of <em>prosperity</em> for all. </strong></blockquote><p>Celo was designed to enable a new universe of financial solutions accessible to mobile users, creating a global financial ecosystem where an end-user can onboard into the Celo ecosystem with just a mobile number. Celo's commitment to ReFi and real-world impact has been integral since the chain's launch on Earth Day in 2020.</p><h2 id="why-celo-public-goods">Why Celo Public Goods?</h2><p>Amidst the ever-evolving Web3 landscape, Celo stands at a pivotal point where identifying and nurturing its public goods is more crucial than ever. With the passing of <a href="https://celo.stake.id/#/proposal/157" rel="noreferrer">CGP #157</a>, the Celo Public Goods initiative was formed to focus on nurturing impactful projects and initiatives that bolster ecosystem growth and community well-being. Their aim is to create a sustainable cycle of funding and support that aligns with Celo's mission of prosperity for all, rallies community engagement, and advances transparent and accessible on-chain funding for Celo projects.</p><p><strong>Learn more 👇</strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/x1t1NwGCoNI?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen="" title="Public Goods Ecosystem with Luuk Weber and Monty Merlin │ Season 3 Episode 23 🎧"></iframe></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://pod.fo/e/225591"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi Podcast: Public Goods Ecosystem with Luuk Weber and Monty Merlin │ Season 3 Episode 23 🎧</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Welcome to another episode of the ReFi Podcast! Today, we&amp;#39;re thrilled to feature Luuk Weber from Kolektivo and Monty Merlin from ReFi DAO, alongside seven other stewards who are making waves wi…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://pod.fo/assets/icons/apple-icon-180x180.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">podfollow</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://podfollow.com/1609683147/episode/6bef9b8740d41e47e9ccff5f6b53d2c4bbbe67d6/social?v=5&amp;pcv=5" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/225591" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen</a></div><h2 id="charting-a-path-toward-prosperity-for-all-%F0%9F%A7%AD">Charting a Path Toward Prosperity for All 🧭</h2><p>The Celo Community Fund's allocation of significant resources towards a public goods ecosystem represents a significant milestone for the Celo community and the broader Web3 space. As we look forward to the unfolding of this ambitious vision in the first half of 2024, Celo is reinforcing its role in creating a more equitable, thriving and regenerative future for all.</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: The latest ReFi Podcast episode highlights a transformative moment for the Celo community and its strategic investment in public goods.

item.title: Explore the Future of ReFi with "The State of ReFi" 2024 Report Breakdown
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><a href="https://carboncopy.news/" rel="noreferrer">CARBON Copy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.refidao.com/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO</a> recently joined forces to publish&nbsp;<a href="https://carboncopy.news/reports/The%20State%20of%20ReFi%20Report%202024.pdf" rel="noreferrer"><strong><em>The State of ReFi Report</em></strong></a>, giving an overview of existing ReFi efforts as well as the key narratives in the space as of 2024.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-21-at-6.52.40-pm.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1244" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-21-at-6.52.40-pm.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-21-at-6.52.40-pm.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-21-at-6.52.40-pm.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-21-at-6.52.40-pm.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Download full report at https://carboncopy.news/</span></figcaption></figure><p>Diving deep into the heart of Regenerative Finance, <a href="https://twitter.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer">Maya Dentzel</a> and <a href="https://twitter.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer">Tereza Bizkova</a> have broken down the key insights from this pivotal report in ReFi DAO's latest Mirror article. This is a call to action for enthusiasts and sceptics alike to understand the intricate layers and the undeniable potential of ReFi.</p><p>Check out the full breakdown and mint the article on Mirror 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/773-LX8Jl5-Snk4lRVABzJTNXjnPgVcHjglPcvdInZY"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Breaking Down “The State of ReFi” 2024 Report</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Regenerative economics, inspired by the work of John Fullerton, Herman Daly, and others, suggests our economy is a living system that can nurture our planet if implemented in the way. With the rise of web3, this concept has found new ground, leading to the birth of regenerative finance (ReFi). While still relatively new, ReFi has become a lively space filled with many projects, approaches, and actors looking to build more sustainable and inclusive economies.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://mirror.xyz/favicon.ico" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/publication-images/xfiTVwUgEDtxLZ7VvUk0O.png?height=603&amp;width=1206" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/773-LX8Jl5-Snk4lRVABzJTNXjnPgVcHjglPcvdInZY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read the Breakdown!</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: Dive into Maya Dentzel and Tereza Bizkova's insightful breakdown of "The State of ReFi" 2024 Report, offering a crucial lens on ReFi's challenges and opportunities as we propel towards sustainable innovation.

item.title: Regenerative Leadership with Dom Francks │ S3Ep24 🎧
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi fam! 👋<br><br>Welcome to the latest episode of ReFi Podcast, where we explore the fascinating intersection of executive coaching, wilderness exploration, and climate leadership. In this episode, host </em><a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto" rel="noreferrer"><em>John Ellison</em></a><em> sits down with </em><a href="https://twitter.com/DomFrancks" rel="noreferrer"><em>Dom Francks</em></a><em>, the Founder, Lead Guide &amp; Coach of </em><a href="https://www.vivify.life/" rel="noreferrer"><em>VIVIFY</em></a><em>, bringing a fresh perspective to the table as a wilderness guide dedicated to supporting climate leaders who often find themselves disconnected from nature, the world around them, and their highest calling.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/vakEC7C4kIb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regenerative-Leadership-with-Dom-Francks-from-VIVIFY-Season-3-Episode-24-e2gbga6" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><p>Dom's story is as intriguing as it is inspiring. With a background that spans studying at Stanford, nearly a decade of training to become a professional golfer, and contributing to a renewable energy company, Dom's path has been anything but linear. However, it's this diverse range of experiences that led him to discover his true passion: combining his love for the great outdoors with his skill in leadership coaching. Dom made the bold leap to become a full-time executive coach and wilderness guide, dedicating himself to helping individuals connect deeply with nature and understand their unique role in the regenerative transition.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/51dhGQi__hg" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/51dhGQi__hg?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Regenerative Leadership with Dom Francks │ Season 3 Episode 24 🎧"></iframe></figure><hr><h2 id="vivify-a-regenerative-leadership-program-%F0%9F%8C%B2">VIVIFY: A Regenerative Leadership Program 🌲</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-22-29-VIVIFY.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1893" height="502" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-22-29-VIVIFY.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-22-29-VIVIFY.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-22-29-VIVIFY.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-22-29-VIVIFY.png 1893w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.vivify.life/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">VIVIFY</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p>One of Dom's standout initiatives is the VIVIFY Regenerative Leadership Program. This 12-week journey is designed to connect leaders through an immersive 8-day retreat in the High Sierras. Participants have the opportunity to step away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, engage with the wilderness on a profound level, and emerge with a renewed sense of direction and energy. The program is a testament to Dom's belief in the transformative power of nature and its role in fostering leadership that can effectively address today's environmental crises.</p><p>Applications are now open for the VIVIFY Regenerative Leadership Program! Join an 8-day off-trail wilderness backpacking expedition in the majestic High Sierra. which also includes 3 months of online leadership coaching, both leading up to and following the immersive experience. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.vivify.life/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Discover More</a></div><hr><h2 id="join-the-journey">Join the Journey</h2><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-24-10-Dom-Francks.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1886" height="747" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-24-10-Dom-Francks.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-24-10-Dom-Francks.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-24-10-Dom-Francks.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/03/Screenshot-2024-03-28-at-19-24-10-Dom-Francks.png 1886w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source: </em></i><a href="https://www.domfrancks.com/" rel="noreferrer"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">domfrancks.com</em></i></a></figcaption></figure><p>For anyone interested in learning more about Dom Francks and his innovative approach to leadership and personal growth, <a href="https://www.domfrancks.com/" rel="noreferrer">his website</a> serves as a gateway to exploration. Whether you're a seasoned climate leader or simply someone seeking a deeper connection with nature and yourself, Dom's VIVIFY program could be the transformative experience you've been searching for.</p><p>As we wrap up this blog post, we invite you to reflect on your own connection to the natural world and your role in the broader environmental movement.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://spotifyanchor-web.app.link/e/vakEC7C4kIb" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen 🎧</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe src="https://anchor.fm/refipodcast/embed/episodes/Regenerative-Leadership-with-Dom-Francks-from-VIVIFY-Season-3-Episode-24-e2gbga6" height="102px" width="400px" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe></figure><hr><p><strong>This episode covers:&nbsp;</strong></p><p>[00:04:22] Who Is Dom Francks?<br>[00:08:50] Working on the Climate Crisis<br>[00:12:45] Immersing People In Nature<br>[00:18:27] Our Separation From Nature<br>[00:22:35] The Nature Pyramid<br>[00:28:42] VIVIFY’s Regenerative Leadership Program<br>[00:35:40] Changes Taking Place<br>[00:44:30] Tools For Regenerative Leadership<br>[00:49:50] Long-Term Regenerative Livelihood<br>[00:59:20] Communities Building A Regenerative Way Of Life<br>[01:04:20] Getting Involved</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtu.be/51dhGQi__hg" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Watch 📺</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/51dhGQi__hg?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Regenerative Leadership with Dom Francks │ Season 3 Episode 24 🎧"></iframe></figure><h2 id="join-the-conversation-%E2%9C%A8">Join the conversation ✨</h2><p><strong>In a world increasingly disconnected from the natural environment, how might reconnecting with the wilderness not only transform our leadership but also the way we approach the existential challenges of our time?</strong></p><p>Join the conversation on <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Twitter</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/refi-dao?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>!<br><br>And if you enjoyed this episode, please consider leaving us a five-star review on <a href="https://podcast.refidao.com/?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">your preferred podcast platform</a>.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Your support is hugely appreciated!</p><p>Thank you! 💚</p><p></p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Dive into the synergy of regenerative coaching, wilderness exploration, and climate leadership with Dom Francks, the visionary behind VIVIFY.

item.title: ☯ Androgynous Leadership and ReFi GYM!
item.dc:creator: Timothée Brès
item.content:encoded: <p><em>There are around 85% of men in web3 today. If we can match the level of cognitive complexity with a similar level of emotional maturity, we could help unlock the potential for life-serving and regenerative technologies at scale.</em></p><hr><p><em>In this community story, researcher </em><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/timothee-bres" rel="noreferrer"><em>Timothée Bres</em></a><em> dives into the work of Androgynous Leadership and introduces the ReFi GYM, an online school for leadership and men's work to learn how to combine effective collaboration with clear direction. This is an introductory article to a deeper work you can explore </em><a href="https://timotheebrs.medium.com/the-androgynous-organisation-2966547863d3" rel="noreferrer"><em>here</em></a>. </p><h1 id="reinventing-masculinity-for-the-future-of-leadership"><strong>Reinventing masculinity for the future of leadership </strong></h1><p><em>ReFi GYM is proud to collaborate on this course with ReFi DAO and support them as the first web3 organisation taking the "androgynous path" consciously.</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/zMHsJzXeWnioGrJ1dgEyg-oXIRdVb0U9w6JiizFREiKk_SdYiNuk_VnmjiXZbqNETxbQINK27jUjCbGwkDvepSctIRhwCv-t0wkFBQnCYqhFHAN1J8ejw0Qy4_mjnWDXErLel_0e9tlEs1whYe7StnI" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="903"></figure><p>In this era of poly-crisis and exponential technology, young male leaders and DAO founders tend to struggle with assuming leadership explicitly and in a healthy way. They face hurdles in establishing clear and empowering boundaries while providing unambiguous direction. </p><p>This gap frequently results in unwritten rules, shadowy power structures, and a toxic environment where avoiding conflict and playing power games become the norm. On the other side, these leaders may find it challenging to listen, delegate and truly trust and connect with their teams, stifling the group's collective intelligence, innovative capabilities, and creative energy.</p><p>ReFi GYM is supporting male founders and leaders in the development of emotional agility and the mastery of yin/yang dynamics at individual and collective levels. Reconciling power and vulnerability to develop high-trust cultures, teams and DAOs that can be both impactful AND values aligned at scale. </p><p><em>“We have all seen how often DAOs can go wrong. GYM provides a powerful pathway to cultivate healthy masculinity and learn the powers of androgynous leadership. This is a much-needed course for Web3 founders and leaders.” <strong>Monty Bryant&nbsp;- </strong><strong>Co-Founder ReFi DAO</strong></em></p><p><strong><em>Join a select group of 20 ReFi and web3 leaders over 6 weeks to unlock the power and wisdom of DAOs through mens work, androgynous leadership and archetypes.</em></strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/14pq9UnYCHgHMdUegCSyFAGjteC45nzRchHf4-KrIYzY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Waitlist</a></div><h1 id="introducing-androgynous-leadership-%E2%98%AF"><strong>Introducing Androgynous Leadership </strong>☯ </h1><p>Learning how to switch between leadership (yang) and followership (yin), and between the different leadership roles in the right way, at the right time is an art. This model works for both males &amp; females. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/05/Screenshot-2024-05-19-at-11.49.58.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1750" height="986" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/05/Screenshot-2024-05-19-at-11.49.58.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/05/Screenshot-2024-05-19-at-11.49.58.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/05/Screenshot-2024-05-19-at-11.49.58.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/05/Screenshot-2024-05-19-at-11.49.58.png 1750w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><ul><li><strong>Cosmic Lover: </strong>master of emotional intelligence, nurturing, care and team cohesion in service of collaboration. Listens actively and with compassion, the lover transforms sadness into motivation and conflicts into growth. </li><li><strong>Cyber Shaman</strong>: connected to the invisible between digital innovation and ancient wisdom, intuitive pioneers guiding the tribe through complexity.<strong> </strong>Transforms fear into a catalyst for radical innovation.</li><li><strong>Warrior of Gaia: </strong>manifests the vision through decisive actions, mastery, courage, discipline, assertiveness resilience and a commitment to excellence. Gets shit done. Protects what is sacred. Transform anger into focused action. </li><li><strong>King of Consciousness: </strong>grounded, stable, present with strong foundations. Clear direction and boundaries, fostering a culture of trust. Cultivates joy and hope through stability and order, ensuring that people feel secure, valued, and motivated to contribute to the shared vision.</li></ul><p><em>Androgynous Leadership is the key for DAOs to scale their impact while maintaining values alignment. And the key of <strong>androgynous organisations:</strong> teams that combine radical innovation, a clear structure (direction, boundaries, responsibilities) with an impact at scale and a collaborative culture of care.</em></p><h2 id="6-week-online-course"><strong>6-week online course</strong></h2><p>Every week, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dominik-foerster-bb453bb5/" rel="noreferrer">Dominik</a> and I will hold a 1h30 collective inquiry and practice space, bringing insights, wisdom, tools, embodied practices and various psycho-technologies we’ve been gathering over the last 10 years across many centralised and decentralised contexts. </p><h2 id="with-the-refi-gym-course-learn-how-to"><strong>With the ReFi GYM course, l</strong>earn how to </h2><ul><li>Develop high-trust and high-performance cultures</li><li>Ground yourself to increase presence and clarity</li><li>Balance directive and collaborative leadership</li><li>Scale your impact while increasing psychological safety</li><li>Develop your emotional agility and androgynous capacities</li><li>Create complementary and high-performance teams</li><li>Transform the most common pitfalls of DAOs into growth</li><li>Create your personal inner compass and values alignment tracker</li><li>Apply these principles at team/collective level</li></ul><p>For deeper explorations, every participant will have the option to join a practice pod with 5 other men (temporary men circle for 1h a week). Come by yourself or <strong>join as a pod,</strong> with your team for an even deeper experience at a special rate. </p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/14pq9UnYCHgHMdUegCSyFAGjteC45nzRchHf4-KrIYzY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Waitlist</a></div><hr><h1 id="the-androgynous-organisation-aka-tao-%E2%99%A1%F0%9F%9A%80"><strong>The Androgynous Organisation aka T.A.O. </strong> ♡🚀</h1><p>Androgynous Leadership, comes from T.A.O., a research/action project to address the blindspots and limitations of decentralised organisational models. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/KuAIuJJNIVALWkslwwFSvuqTHnssb4sLwabG5IDabjTuFjeGOiH6kjVB4osUb_XJgkO4m8Ea6CYHGVCInTrBFwXsB4oIrHFATmaIGDmKxz5soFdcYIrmkzdMQL7xPeW0uykOqvGpCgVAe3wSWwkIPIU" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="903"></figure><ul><li><strong>Hierarchy: </strong>From domination hierarchy, where power is clear but oppressive, to shadow hierarchy, where power is invisible and potentially manipulative.</li><li><strong>Communication:</strong> From aggressive communication and direct confrontation to passive-aggressiveness and conflict avoidance.</li><li><strong>Boundaries:</strong> From explicit and rigid to flexible but ambiguous boundaries leading to collaboration chaos, role confusion and lack of individual accountability.</li><li><strong>Decision Making:</strong> From autocratic decision-making that may be efficient but authoritarian, to participative decision making, where too many voices can slow down or prevent action through decision paralysis.</li><li><strong>Competition:</strong> From the shadows of competition, where predatory practices lead to burn out and negative externalities, to the shadows of collaboration, where groupthink may prevail and competition becomes implicit.</li></ul><h2 id="take-the-best-leave-the-rest"><strong>Take the best, leave the rest </strong></h2><blockquote>How to take the best of both centralised and decentralised models ?</blockquote><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/04/Screenshot-2024-04-02-at-17.07.39.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="975" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/04/Screenshot-2024-04-02-at-17.07.39.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/04/Screenshot-2024-04-02-at-17.07.39.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/04/Screenshot-2024-04-02-at-17.07.39.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/04/Screenshot-2024-04-02-at-17.07.39.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>To unlock impact AND values alignment at scale, androgynous leaders and organisations need to develop the capacity to tap into&nbsp;<strong>both</strong>&nbsp;polarities in function of the&nbsp;<strong>context.</strong></p><p>For example :</p><ul><li><strong>Androgynous hierarchy</strong>: combining natural, experience and competence based hierarchy with a decentralised structure and participative processes.</li><li><strong>Coopetition</strong>&nbsp;: combining healthy competition (explicit, respectful, playful) with deep and embodied collaborative practices.</li><li><strong>Androgynous Boundaries</strong>&nbsp;: clear and explicit but also flexible and empowering boundaries.</li><li><strong>Group Coherence</strong>&nbsp;: the collective capacity to hold intensity and the key to sync individual needs with collective alignment. </li><li><strong>Assertiveness</strong>: explicit, clear and compassionate communication (beyond dominant confrontation or passive aggressiveness).</li><li><strong>Emotional agility</strong>&nbsp;: capacity to express both sadness and anger in a healthy way. </li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/14pq9UnYCHgHMdUegCSyFAGjteC45nzRchHf4-KrIYzY" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Waitlist</a></div><p><em>Special thanks to Monty for the support and co-editing of this article. </em></p><p><em>The ReFi GYM is part of <strong>The Blindspot Project</strong>, an agency hosting the T.A.O. research/action project and proposing workshops, courses and immersive experiences, </em><a href="https://linktr.ee/theblindspot_project" rel="noreferrer"><em>learn more</em></a><em>. </em></p>
item.excerpt:encoded: To revitalize leadership within the web3 space, ReFi GYM introduces an innovative approach to transform organizational dynamics in the DAO space and beyond.

item.title: A New Way of Being with Vincent Daranyi from neoslife | BONUS Episode 🎧
item.dc:creator: John Dass
item.content:encoded: <p>I believe that the regenerative transition will be led by radical visionaries who have done the work of the heart and are willing to commit their lives to building a better future for generations to come. Many may not grasp this yet, but those who do will be the early adopters of an entirely new way of being where people learn to live in harmony with the earth.</p><p>neoslife may very well become the breakthrough experiment that becomes a successful model for scaling the regenerative village movement worldwide. If you're into cryptocurrencies, biohacking, remote working, and community living, you're going to want to check out what's going on at neoslife.</p><p>There are two spots left on the <a href="https://neos.life/investor">retreat from April 10-14</a>, as well as a community day on the 14th for those interested in getting involved. </p><p>After meeting Vincent Daranyi, the founder of neoslife, at a Heart Protocol ceremony last year, I have seen him shift into high gear to dedicate everything he's got to bringing a unique vision of a regenerative village to life on a gorgeous piece of land stretching across over 1,000 acres just 75 minutes’ drive from Lisbon.</p><p>If you're curious, like me, to understand what would motivate a Bitcoin maximalist to trade his sats for a regenerative village—I think you'll enjoy this show.</p><p>In this raw episode with Vincent, we unpack his journey from being an investment banker in London, to exiting his startup in Brazil, and embarking on a quest to answer life's deepest questions with the support of community, psychedelic medicines, and indigenous wisdom.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/22d899" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen to the show</a></div><h2 id="this-weeks-bonus-episode-of-refi-podcast-features-vincent-daranyi-%F0%9F%8E%A4"><strong>This week's bonus episode of ReFi Podcast features Vincent Daranyi 🎤</strong></h2><ul><li><strong>Vincent’s Journey:</strong> From corporate success in institutional finance to entrepreneurship and ultimately a quest for meaning which led him to explore cryptocurrencies, spirituality, psychedelics, and other means of inquiry.</li><li><strong>neoslife Vision:</strong> Located just 75 minutes from Lisbon, this 1,000-acre regenerative village is designed to be a sustainable model for human beings—combining best practices in agriculture, energy, and community living.</li><li><strong>Community and Innovation:</strong> Vincent discusses how neoslife integrates modern values inspired by decentralized currencies as well as holistic medicine and longevity science to foster a transformative community experience.</li><li><strong>Get Involved:</strong> Find out how you can be part of neoslife at the upcoming retreat from April 10th to 14th (only 2 spots remaining).</li></ul><p><strong>Vincent’s story mirrors the transition our entire society is undertaking: realizing the emptiness of our current systems and building new systems of value that reflect what truly matters for human and planetary health.</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/22d899" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen to the show</a></div><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/FERtHOVPtfE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="neoslife with Vincent Daranyi | BONUS Episode"></iframe></figure><p>This episode is more than just a conversation; it’s an invitation to dig deeper into what really matters and to co-create a movement towards a more sustainable and interconnected way of being.</p><p>No matter where you live, it's clear that regenerative villages will play an essential role in the transition away from fossil fuels, and there is much to learn from their leaders and early formations. As someone who loves Portugal deeply, I am excited to see neoslife emerge alongside <a href="https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/">TDF</a> and a few other early village experiments.</p><p>I have thoroughly enjoyed tuning into the cutting edge of the regenerative village movement in Portugal and learning about the role that tools like cryptocurrencies and psychedelics play in the formation of these communities. </p><p>Let’s see what we can learn and build together. 🤙</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://pod.fo/e/22d899" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Listen to the show</a></div><p>Hope you enjoy the episode! 🙏🏼</p><p>P.S. If you’re inspired by what you hear, don’t hesitate to reach out to Vincent directly at vincent@neos.life</p>

item.title: 🌱 Local Node Incubator - Beta Cohort Retrospective!
item.dc:creator: Anna Kaic
Scott Morris
Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hey ReFi fam, Anna, Scott and Monty here to provide a retrospective of the work we have been doing over the past 15 weeks to incubate a new cohort of ReFi Local Nodes to join the ReFi DAO Network. If you’ve been wondering how web3 can be harnessed for positive, practical, and transformative impacts in real life, this one’s for you!</em> <em>Let's Grow 🌱</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/XJeA2M62jHROWL8LLauqvXUm70OqlhyjAYc4pcUd2cw" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Collect on mirror.xyz ✨</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1141" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="overview">Overview</h1><p>All around the world people are realizing the necessity and urgency for systems change, especially as related to shifting away from extractive economics to more regenerative approaches that sustainably meet our needs. “ReFi Local Nodes” is how ReFi DAO refers to the people and organizations who have stepped up to lead and connect across these kinds of regeneration efforts in their own communities. Recently we concluded the final session of our “Beta Cohort” in the Local Node Incubator program. This program brought together both aspiring and established Local Nodes to explore the theory and practice of community-based organizing around regenerative finance and systemic transformation.</p><p>Some key highlights from the cohort included:</p><ul><li>Hosting <strong>13 sessions</strong>, totaling over <strong>20 hours</strong> of instructional content and exercises.</li><li><strong>Over 100 participants</strong> attended the sessions, with more than 25 consistently tuning in each week throughout the course.</li><li><strong>More than a dozen guest speakers</strong> provided insights on topics ranging from on-chain finance to local organizing strategies.</li><li>A total of <strong>182 POAPs</strong> were minted and issued to verified attendees.</li><li><strong>18 </strong><a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/0e76cf05ea894f3bba19cad59b2bb596?v=5e498d48a7824ea7817d8c7900d61e3f&amp;pvs=4"><strong><u>Local Node Profile</u></strong></a> pages were created using our new template, including 12 for newly incubated nodes.</li></ul><p>As a result of the program, we successfully incubated a new cohort of Local Nodes to join the network. See below for the updated Q2 2024 map and keep reading for the full retrospective!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1104" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/XJeA2M62jHROWL8LLauqvXUm70OqlhyjAYc4pcUd2cw" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Collect on mirror.xyz ✨</a></div><h1 id="beta-incubator-retrospective">Beta Incubator Retrospective</h1><p>The Beta Cohort of the Local Node Incubator provided an opportunity to introduce Local Node leaders to a range of critical subjects at the intersection of local community organizing and the potential of web3 as a platform for designing and aligning transformative financial systems for place-based regeneration. Dive in below for a session-by-session breakdown! 👇</p><h2 id="session-1-uniting-for-regeneration-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Session 1: Uniting for Regeneration 🌱</h2><p>Session 1 marked the inaugural gathering aimed at exploring the essence and motivations behind the ReFi movement and its implementation at the local level. We also used 'bio cards' to facilitate introductions and allow everyone to showcase their expertise across relevant areas. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1098" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="session-2-whyworking-with-purpose">Session 2: WHY - Working With Purpose</h2><p>The business of transforming systems is, as one might expect, complex. Our ability to create effective interventions in systems is often constrained by our understanding of what they are and what the transformative process involves. In this session, we introduced a high-level approach to systems (with a little help from the iceberg model) and that process in terms of the Why, the Who, the What, and the How.&nbsp;</p><ul><li><strong>The WHY</strong>: The purpose of the system and values-based motivations of stakeholders for engaging with it.</li><li><strong>The WHO</strong>: The many stakeholder classes and types involved in the system.</li><li><strong>The WHAT</strong>: The “thing” in terms of the system’s design and the interfaces we provide others via an app, platform, etc.</li><li><strong>The HOW</strong>: The way we engage communities in the co-creation and the ongoing operations of the organization.</li></ul><p>This framework also served as the logic for the content across the remaining sessions in the incubator.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/MC8zgWGUeQc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="❓Why, Who, What, How? | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-3-the-who">Session 3: The WHO</h2><p>The Who is all about the stakeholders and their relationship to the system. We created a new stakeholder mapping canvas tool to help local node operators get a clearer sense of these levels of relationship; as direct participants, partners, operators, external contributors, or others with indirect interest.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1273" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="session-4-the-whata-solution-stack-for-place-based-regeneration">Session 4: The WHAT - A Solution Stack for Place-Based Regeneration</h2><p>Local Nodes are situated between the global, wider world of web3 and the local needs of real-world people in communities. In other words, in the space between the macro and the micro: the mezzo. This means that far from being isolated, single-issue projects, they are ideally situated to serve as aggregators of many kinds of regenerative projects and programs and as enablers of those systems in their respective local contexts. Our guest speaker in this session was Ben West, previously of Gitcoin and now Thrive Protocol. Here’s how he described the way Gitcoin also embraced a pluralistic approach by hosting multiple rounds within each round Gitcoin offers:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/jnRK-cA895w?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🥞 Gitcoin Grants Stack with Ben West | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><p>Scott also shared his own 5 layer framework for categorizing the various components of a place-based system. The “compass” layer covers legal and governance considerations; the “capital” layer includes financial instruments and mechanisms (like Gitcoin); the “commerce” layer includes marketplaces and incentives (currencies); the “cooperative” layer includes operational elements such as the node’s own organization; and finally the “cost-benefit” layer includes <a href="https://wiki.p2pfoundation.net/Open_Value_Accounting"><u>open value accounting</u></a> for all of the above. </p><h2 id="session-5-the-what-pt-2regenerative-interventions-in-finance-and-commerce">Session 5: The WHAT pt 2 - Regenerative Interventions in Finance and Commerce</h2><p>In this session we hosted the legendary Will Ruddick for an introduction to the world of bottom-up, community-powered, “endogenous” finance and how bringing communities together around new financial facilities works. He shared about his work with Grassroots Economics Foundation in Kenya, and his learning journey around traditional practices of value creation and exchange there. Have a listen:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/c0i7AtirL7I?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🌱 Grassroots Economics with Will Ruddick | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><p>Reprising his <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v_mWaoBhAEA&amp;t=1s"><u>2014 TEDx talk</u></a>, Scott discussed how currencies are, as his mentor and advisor <a href="https://bernard-lietaer.org/"><u>Bernard Lietaer</u></a> so often put it: “an agreement within a community to use something as a medium of exchange.” By creating new agreements around what's fair and valued, communities can create as many new <em>current-sees</em> as they wish. We also discussed how digital marketplaces are powerful tools for making markets based on such agreements and values-based alignment.</p><h2 id="session-55-bonus-sessionintro-to-hypercerts-and-minting">Session 5.5: BONUS SESSION - Intro to Hypercerts and Minting</h2><p>As we face global challenges, the need for effective public goods funding becomes paramount. In this bonus session, we explored the innovative world of hypercerts—a cutting-edge tool poised to transform how we track, reward, and scale positive impact. Participants gained an understanding of hypercerts and got hands-on with the process of creating and minting their first hypercerts with real-world applications.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/hm-YiPrwYj4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="❗️Hypercerts?! | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-6-the-what-pt-3designing-for-impact-strategic-planning">Session 6: The WHAT pt 3 - Designing for Impact: Strategic Planning</h2><p>This session aimed to deepen understanding of essential systems for community development and inspired reflection on each node's mission and vision. The session began with Juan from ReFi Medellin and Karla from ReFi Costa Rica, two of the most mature Local Nodes that, in just one year, have made some incredible progress. They presented projects such as collaborations with the army in Colombia and incubators for local impact projects in Costa Rica. Following their presentations, attendees participated in brainstorming sessions and strategic canvas mapping, connecting their initiatives to the broader ReFi movement and fostering collaboration. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ZoXJcSYYuvs?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🇨🇴 ReFi Medellín &amp; Glo Dollar | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-65-bonus-session%E2%80%9Cit%E2%80%99s-raining-grants-in-web3%E2%80%9Dan-overview-and-brainstorm-of-opportunities">Session 6.5: BONUS SESSION - “It’s Raining Grants in Web3” - An Overview and Brainstorm of Opportunities</h2><p>In this bonus session, we explored a variety of current grant and fundraising opportunities for ReFi projects. We covered key programs such as Gitcoin Grants, Giveth's quadratic funding rounds, Optimism's RPGF and Cele Public Goods. The session concluded with a collaborative brainstorming to identify additional grant opportunities to benefit ecosystem projects, fostering innovation and collaboration.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/E3OkRmnfyI4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🔴 850M for Public Goods | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/H7cHXtn0Vyw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🟡 Celo Public Goods | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-7-the-how-pt-1co-creating-strategy-via-collaborative-engagement-with-multi-stakeholder-coalitions">Session 7: The HOW pt 1 - Co-creating Strategy via Collaborative Engagement with Multi-stakeholder Coalitions&nbsp;</h2><p>Moving from the What into the How, we were joined by Sage Gibbons of <a href="https://prosocial.world"><u>Prosocial.World</u></a> and turned our focus towards specific approaches and strategies for developing regenerative community systems with the communities for whom they are intended. Especially when we’re coming from a place of techno-optimism, where so much of “the solution” is technologically oriented, it is important to appreciate the value of bringing people together, creating new and deeper relationships between them, and inviting them into contexts where they can express their local context-informed needs and values in constructive ways that may inform future efforts and product development.&nbsp;</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/y4L0-IwWNw0?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🧠 Conscious Cultural Evolution with Sage Gibbons | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-8-the-how-pt-2practical-considerations-for-building-purpose-led-local-networks-innovations-in-on-chain-finance">Session 8: The HOW pt 2 - Practical Considerations for Building Purpose-led Local Networks + Innovations in On-chain Finance</h2><p>This session focused on the role that local currency and credit systems can play in re-circularizing the local economy and building up a sense of shared community identity. We were joined by Chris Hewitt of the <a href="https://hudsonvalleycurrent.org"><u>Hudson Valley Current</u></a> who shared about his journey from working in local print media to local currency and how opening up Tilda’s Kitchen, a cafe in upstate New York, has provided invaluable opportunities to build community, solidarity, and interest in joining the network of locals and businesses accepting Currents.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/6XwfeLLEhrY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="💷 Local Currency in Hudson Valley with Chris Hewitt | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-9-the-how-pt-3leadership-operations-conflict-management-with-gravity-dao-and-timothe%C3%A9">Session 9: The HOW pt 3 - Leadership, Operations &amp; Conflict Management with Gravity DAO and Timotheé</h2><p>We wrapped up the core content with a session more focused on the internal side of things. First we were joined by Juan from Gravity DAO, who shared their work creating a distributed conflict mediation service and the process they use in navigating conflicts. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/F-NsVxLC7jE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🤺 Conflict Resolution with Juan Bell of Gravity DAO | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><p>We were also joined by Timotheé of <a href="https://timotheebrs.medium.com/the-androgynous-organisation-part-2-media-action-ffd53f6359f7"><u>The Androgynous Organisation</u></a> (T.A.O.). He shared about the primal energies we bring into organizations through our own cultural and personal values, as well as the art of balancing leadership and followership, centralisation and decentralisation, crucial for scaling DAOs while aligning with core values and fostering a culture of care and radical innovation. As it happens, ReFi DAO recently voted on an MVP proposal for its own structure and governance which incorporates these values and approaches to working together.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/OTZJZQ6VqHc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="☯️ Centralised &amp; Decentralised with Timotheé Bres | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-10-finalebeta-cohort-celebration-closing-ceremony">Session 10: Finale - Beta Cohort Celebration &amp; Closing Ceremony</h2><p>Our final session took us on a reflective journey not so different from this summary, and provided an opportunity for a number of local node organizers to take the stage to share more about how they’re planning to move forward in their respective local communities. Monty also shared about the developments ReFi DAO at a global level and whats coming next...</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/RyyLr6pBAa0?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🌐 Network State to Regen Coordi-NATION | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/0pOlIfTWWgk?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🔎 Distributed Impact Tracking | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/XJeA2M62jHROWL8LLauqvXUm70OqlhyjAYc4pcUd2cw" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Collect on mirror.xyz ✨</a></div><h2 id="updated-node-developmental-stages">Updated Node Developmental Stages</h2><p>As a result of the program, we successfully incubated a new cohort of Local Nodes to join the network.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1811" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 1811w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>At the same time, we also proposed a new classification structure for ReFi Local Nodes, categorizing them into three stages: 🌱Seed, 🎋Sapling, and 🌳Canopy, aiming to reflect their development and impact within their communities.&nbsp;</p><ol><li><strong>🌱 Seed - Formative Stage: </strong>Seed nodes are typically focused on building a core team, identifying local needs, and crafting their vision. Founding members are laying the foundational principles that define the node’s unique purpose and direction.</li><li><strong>🎋 Sapling - Established Stage: </strong>Sapling nodes have sprouted and are actively engaging with their communities based on a well-defined vision. They are implementing key activities and projects with meaningful partnerships, expanding their influence with events, project rollouts, etc. often with secured funding.</li><li><strong>🌳 Canopy - Mature Stage: </strong>Canopy nodes are the most dedicated and influential Nodes that have reached a level of security and are making a significant impact on both local and broader regenerative practices. Akin to mature trees in a forest canopy, these Nodes provide shelter and support to their local community and projects, embodying the successful principles of regenerative finance.&nbsp;</li></ol><p>At each stage ReFi DAO aims to nurture nodes from their initial engagement through to becoming leaders in the ecosystem, encouraging a journey of continuous growth, community contribution, and sustainable impact.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/PQ50p4KOEOc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="💡From TVL to TVF | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="feedback-and-testimonials">Feedback and Testimonials</h2><p>Overall, the incubator received enthusiastic feedback from participants, emphasizing its strong community, networking opportunities, and high-quality content. Chris Georgen captured the essence of this sentiment by noting his highlight:</p><blockquote>“<em>Getting to know the ReFi DAO core team as well as other local node operators! There's a lot of camaraderie and it feels like a real potential for mutual support going forward.</em>” </blockquote><p>Here was how the course was rated by participants according to the course goals that were set at the outset of the program:</p><ul><li><strong>Q1</strong>: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend or a colleague? (Net Promoter Score -NPS) = 9.4/10</li><li><strong>Q2</strong>: The sessions and content were relevant for Nodes at all stages. = 9.0/10</li><li><strong>Q3</strong>: The Incubator helped me develop a better understanding of what being a Local Node means in practical terms. = 9.0/10</li><li><strong>Q4</strong>: The Incubator helped us develop strategies for organizing in local communities. = 8.9/10</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeRhl--mP-fwxCb34BYMkzPIdZnxHmMpfb67exqUPCDVGxKJUJ3xpwZzDAisG_kldSJzlyfbDR5Pix26t2Lh2Kqj2Uj0qPv54egWKypRWkf_L3Cch083nZy5EYnkoA6lGZvldz2PSKESUo0lpl2ROPaToAA?key=vt76-myXU_SSoRljFvWmrQ" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="914"></figure><p>The program received an average Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 9.4/10, indicating a high likelihood of participants recommending it to friends or colleagues. The sessions and content were rated highly relevant for nodes at all stages, scoring 9.0. Additionally, participants felt that the incubator significantly enhanced their understanding of what it means to be a Local Node in practical terms, also scoring 9.0. The program was effective in helping participants develop strategies for organizing in local communities, earning a score of 8.9.</p><p>At the same time, there were also several suggestions to enhance future cohorts. The idea of creating a start guide or a summary of the calendar, topics, and essential tools like Figma and Notion was proposed. Participants also highlighted the need for more practical examples of ReFi applications and additional sessions to enhance the hands-on learning experience. Feedback also focused on the structure of practical exercises, suggesting that additional guidance and activities could be beneficial.</p><h2 id="thank-you-to-stewards-and-organizers">Thank you to Stewards and Organizers!</h2><p>The success of the Local Node Beta Incubator was a testament to the dedication and hard work of its stewards and organizers. Huge thanks to Anna, Scott, Monty, and Jeremy as the course leads and organizers, and to the community stewards Karla, Susanne, Djimo, Tim, Tereza, and Adam who were instrumental in their mutual support. 💚</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png" width="2000" height="1445" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 2256w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png" width="1424" height="1310" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png 1424w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h3 id="anna-embracing-new-beginnings-at-general-magic">Anna Embracing New Beginnings at General Magic</h3><p>We are also announcing that Anna Kaic will be leaving ReFi DAO to embark on an exciting new journey with General Magic as a Grants Manager. Anna has expressed immense gratitude for her time at ReFi DAO, where she has learned invaluable lessons.&nbsp;</p><blockquote><em>“A special thanks to John Ellison and Daryl Edwards for being incredible mentors and to Monty Bryant for creating a great collaborative environment.” <strong>Anna Kaic </strong></em></blockquote><p>Anna is now off to make a positive impact in the world by helping impactful web3 projects secure the funding they need to thrive. We wish her all the best in her new role and are immensely grateful for her contributions to ReFi DAO.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/mnKnxZ7xBZM?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🪄 ReFi General Magic with Anna Kaic"></iframe></figure><h2 id="a-regenerative-path-forward">A Regenerative Path Forward </h2><p>The ReFi Local Node Beta Incubator successfully demonstrated the power of community-driven regenerative finance initiatives. Over 15 weeks, we cultivated a vibrant network of local nodes equipped with the knowledge and tools needed to foster systemic change in their communities. With a diverse range of sessions, high-quality content, and strong participant engagement, we have laid the foundation for sustainable, localized impact. As we celebrate the accomplishments of this cohort and bid farewell to Anna Kaic, we look forward to continuing our journey towards a regenerative future with the ongoing support and collaboration of our growing ReFi community. Let's keep the momentum growing! 🌱</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/XJeA2M62jHROWL8LLauqvXUm70OqlhyjAYc4pcUd2cw" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Collect on mirror.xyz ✨</a></div>
item.excerpt:encoded: The ReFi Local Node Beta Incubator has empowered a new cohort of local nodes to spearhead regenerative finance efforts in their communities. As we celebrate their progress and look ahead, our dedication to fostering systemic change and sustainable impact continues to grow.

item.title: Season 4 ReFi Podcast Announcement
item.dc:creator: Maya Dentzel
Tereza Bizkova
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="the-regeneration-nexus-is-here">The Regeneration Nexus Is Here! </h3><p>Get ready for a new chapter in the ReFi Podcast! 🎙️🎉</p><p>As <a href="https://twitter.com/climateXcrypto"><u>John</u></a>, who has hosted three fantastic seasons, launches an exciting new venture, we, Maya and Tereza, are thrilled to take over as hosts for Season 4 of the show!&nbsp;</p><h3 id="meet-the-hosts-%F0%9F%91%AF%E2%80%8D%E2%99%80%EF%B8%8F">Meet the Hosts 👯‍♀️</h3><p><a href="https://twitter.com/mayazdentzel"><u>Maya Z. Dentzel</u></a> is a California-based researcher, social entrepreneur, and aspiring yogi driven by the mission of building regenerative systems with emerging technologies. She has written about and managed projects around ReFi.</p><p><a href="https://twitter.com/TerezaBizkova"><u>Tereza Bízková</u></a> is a Colombia-based communications professional passionate about highlighting stories of impact. She is the co-founder of ReFi Medellín and contributes to projects like Funding the Commons, Crypto Altruism, and ReFi DAO.</p><h3 id="season-focus-%F0%9F%94%8E">Season Focus 🔎</h3><p>We're facing a multitude of overlapping global crises—from climate emergency to systemic inequities—that call for a profound rethinking of how we see the world. This new vision that adopts a holistic approach to economy as a living system, came to be known as <em>regeneration</em>.&nbsp;</p><p>Drawing from John’s remarks in the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArOijiSE7P4"><u>concluding episode</u></a> of Season 3, we expand on the idea that ReFi goes beyond Web3. In Season 4, we will explore the entire spectrum of regeneration, from the foundational philosophy and economic principles to practical implementations and innovative technologies that can propel the vision of a regenerative future further.&nbsp;</p><p>The theme of the new season is "<strong>The Regeneration Nexus</strong>," centered on a critical question: </p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text">How can we integrate best practices from <b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">economic and systems thinking, real-world impact, and innovative technologies</strong></b> to establish a<b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;"> regenerative paradigm</strong></b>?</div></div><p>By sitting down with visionaries of the new future and engaging with a diverse group of thought leaders—including economists, activists, researchers, and tech innovators—we plan to map out what leading minds believe is necessary to effectively regenerate the world today.&nbsp;</p><p>We aim for the new season of ReFi Podcast to establish a powerful regeneration front fit for today's challenges.</p><h3 id="the-regeneration-nexus-%F0%9F%8C%90">The Regeneration Nexus 🌐</h3><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/1y_AY8FFYxaMeP1pzDw39Ijp0SWEou1PoCWM5gvyGgL2rfck-sFx6DwgZzd_cMNpCa8vpkaVjuo0vKA7elyu3ZgaGaUDxZtQWSbVdqjZlOBgHlHsJXvHZVreW5p8TXtEBdSphrB7iS0pDu0g1iHY5d0" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="900"></figure><p>In season 4, we want to tell a unified story of regeneration around three key pillars:</p><ol><li>The Vision: <strong>Why </strong>do we need to reimagine<strong> </strong>the traditional economic and belief systems?&nbsp;</li></ol><p>First, we will explore the fundamentals of regeneration by examining economic theories and systemic changes needed, bringing insights from thinkers who are redefining the role of capital as a catalyst for a thriving planet.&nbsp;</p><ol start="2"><li>The Practice: <strong>What </strong>does effective regenerative change really look like? </li></ol><p>Next, we will highlight the inspiring work of individuals and organizations on the ground and share real-world stories of successful impact practices.</p><ol start="3"><li>The Tools: <strong>How </strong>can technological advances scale regenerative vision?</li></ol><p>Finally, we will dive into the role of emerging technologies and discuss how to implement them effectively to accelerate regeneration.&nbsp;</p><h3 id="stay-tuned-%F0%9F%93%A2">Stay Tuned! 📢</h3><p>Season 4 launches in a couple of weeks. We’ll share more details on the <a href="https://twitter.com/ReFiPodcast"><u>ReFi Podcast Twitter page</u></a> soon, so keep an eye out!</p><p>In the meantime, join us for our <a href="https://x.com/i/spaces/1mrGmyQnXRzGy/" rel="noreferrer"><strong><u>kickoff Twitter Space</u></strong></a><strong> on May 23 at 12:00 p.m. ET</strong>!&nbsp;Come connect with us, share your thoughts, and let us know what topics you're excited about for the upcoming season.</p><p>If you'd like to support us, check out our <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus"><u>new Giveth page</u></a>—your contributions will help us bring these important conversations to the forefront.</p><p>We are excited and honored to serve the ReFi community!</p><p>Hugs,<br>Tereza and Maya 💜</p>
