srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/GVXJdRNWMAEXKd0.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/10/GVXJdRNWMAEXKd0.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/10/GVXJdRNWMAEXKd0.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/10/GVXJdRNWMAEXKd0.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/GVWHucaW4AA28wZ.jpg" width="964" height="1033" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/GVWHucaW4AA28wZ.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/GVWHucaW4AA28wZ.jpg 964w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/GQHe7ZOW0AAw3Br.jpg" width="1536" height="2048" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/GQHe7ZOW0AAw3Br.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/10/GQHe7ZOW0AAw3Br.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/GQHe7ZOW0AAw3Br.jpg 1536w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h1 id="overview">Overview</h1><p>All around the world people are realizing the necessity and urgency for systems change, especially as related to shifting away from extractive economics to more regenerative approaches that sustainably meet our needs. “ReFi Local Nodes” is how ReFi DAO refers to the people and organizations who have stepped up to lead and connect across these kinds of regeneration efforts in their own communities. Recently we concluded the final session of our “Beta Cohort” in the Local Node Incubator program. This program brought together both aspiring and established Local Nodes to explore the theory and practice of community-based organizing around regenerative finance and systemic transformation.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1141" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-9.54.01-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>Some key highlights from the cohort included:</p><ul><li>Hosting <strong>13 sessions</strong>, totalling over <strong>20 hours</strong> of instructional content and exercises.</li><li><strong>Over 100 participants</strong> attended the sessions, with more than 25 consistently tuning in each week throughout the course.</li><li><strong>More than a dozen guest speakers</strong> provided insights on topics ranging from on-chain finance to local organizing strategies.</li><li>A total of <strong>182 POAPs</strong> were minted and issued to verified attendees.</li><li><strong>18 </strong><a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/0e76cf05ea894f3bba19cad59b2bb596?v=5e498d48a7824ea7817d8c7900d61e3f&amp;pvs=4"><strong><u>Local Node Profile</u></strong></a> pages were created, including 12 for newly incubated nodes.</li></ul><p>As a result of the program, we successfully incubated a new cohort of Local Nodes to join the network. See below for the updated Q2 2024 map and keep reading for a full retrospective!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1104" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2024--1x--1.jpg 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="incubator-retrospective">Incubator Retrospective</h1><p>The Beta Cohort of the Local Node Incubator provided an opportunity to introduce Local Node leaders to a range of critical subjects at the intersection of local community organizing and the potential of web3 as a platform for designing and aligning transformative financial systems for place-based regeneration. Dive in below for a session-by-session breakdown! 👇</p><h2 id="session-1-uniting-for-regeneration-%F0%9F%8C%B1">Session 1: Uniting for Regeneration 🌱</h2><p>Session 1 marked the inaugural gathering aimed at exploring the essence and motivations behind the ReFi movement and its implementation at the local level. It created space to establish expectations, set ground rules, and discuss the incubator content plan from a holistic perspective. We also used 'bio cards' to facilitate introductions and allow everyone to showcase their expertise across relevant areas. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1098" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.10.18-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="session-2-whyworking-with-purpose">Session 2: WHY - Working With Purpose</h2><p>The business of transforming systems is, as one might expect, complex. Our ability to create effective interventions in systems is often constrained by our understanding of what they are and what the transformative process involves. In this session, we introduced a high-level approach to systems (with a little help from the iceberg model) and that process in terms of the Why, the Who, the What, and the How.&nbsp;</p><ul><li><strong>The WHY</strong>: The purpose of the system and values-based motivations of stakeholders for engaging with it.</li><li><strong>The WHO</strong>: The many stakeholder classes and types involved in the system.</li><li><strong>The WHAT</strong>: The “thing” in terms of the system’s design and the interfaces we provide others via an app, platform, etc.</li><li><strong>The HOW</strong>: The way we engage communities in the co-creation and the ongoing operations of the organization.</li></ul><p>This framework also served as the logic for the content across the remaining sessions in the incubator.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/MC8zgWGUeQc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="❓Why, Who, What, How? | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-3-the-who">Session 3: The WHO</h2><p>The Who is all about the stakeholders and their relationship to the system. We created a new stakeholder mapping canvas tool to help local node operators get a clearer sense of these levels of relationship; as direct participants, partners, operators, external contributors, or others with indirect interest.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1273" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-10.22.48-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="session-4-the-whata-solution-stack-for-place-based-regeneration">Session 4: The WHAT - A Solution Stack for Place-Based Regeneration</h2><p>Local Nodes are situated between the global, wide world of web3 and the local needs of real-world people in communities. In other words, in the space between the macro and the micro: the mezzo. This means that far from being isolated, single-issue projects, they are ideally situated to serve as aggregators of many kinds of regenerative projects and programs and as enablers of those systems in their respective local contexts. Our guest speaker in this session was Ben West, previously of Gitcoin and now Thrive Protocol. Here’s how he described the way Gitcoin also embraced a pluralistic approach by hosting multiple rounds within each round Gitcoin offers:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/jnRK-cA895w?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🥞 Gitcoin Grants Stack with Ben West | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><p>Scott also shared his own 5 layer framework for categorizing the various components of a place-based system. The “compass” layer covers legal and governance considerations; the “capital” layer includes financial instruments and mechanisms (like Gitcoin); the “commerce” layer includes marketplaces and incentives (currencies); the “cooperative” layer includes operational elements such as the node’s own organization; and finally the “cost-benefit” layer includes <a href="https://wiki.p2pfoundation.net/Open_Value_Accounting"><u>open value accounting</u></a> for all of the above. This has helped him organize systems design thinking and gain a better understanding of requirements and how they interrelate over the years.</p><h2 id="session-5-the-what-pt-2regenerative-interventions-in-finance-and-commerce">Session 5: The WHAT pt 2 - Regenerative Interventions in Finance and Commerce</h2><p>In this session we hosted the legendary Will Ruddick for an introduction to the world of bottom-up, community-powered, “endogenous” finance and how bringing communities together around new financial facilities works. He shared about his work with Grassroots Economics Foundation in Kenya, and his learning journey around traditional practices of value creation and exchange there. Have a listen:</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/c0i7AtirL7I?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🌱 Grassroots Economics with Will Ruddick | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><p>Reprising his <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v_mWaoBhAEA&amp;t=1s"><u>2014 TEDx talk</u></a>, Scott also discussed how currencies are, as our dearly departed <a href="https://bernard-lietaer.org/"><u>Bernard Lietaer</u></a> put it “agreements within a community to use something as a means of exchange” which may be mapped and understood as existing on a spectrum between trust-less systems on one end and trust-full systems on the other. We also talked about the role digital marketplaces stand to play and how they may be understood as an expression of one or more common themes: locality, affinity, solidarity, and/or utility.&nbsp;</p><h2 id="session-55-bonus-sessionintro-to-hypercerts-and-minting">Session 5.5: BONUS SESSION - Intro to Hypercerts and Minting</h2><p>As we face global challenges, the need for effective public goods funding becomes paramount. In this bonus session, we explored the innovative world of hypercerts—a cutting-edge tool poised to transform how we track, reward, and scale positive impact. Participants gained an understanding of hypercerts and got hands-on with the process of creating and minting their first hypercerts with real-world applications.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/hm-YiPrwYj4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="❗️Hypercerts?! | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-6-the-what-pt-3designing-for-impact-strategic-planning">Session 6: The WHAT pt 3 - Designing for Impact: Strategic Planning</h2><p>This session aimed to deepen understanding of essential systems for community development and inspired reflection on each node's mission and vision. The session began with Juan from ReFi Medellin and Karla from ReFi Costa Rica, two of the Canopy Local Nodes that, in one year, have made incredible progress. They presented projects such as collaborations with the army in Colombia, cleanups, English courses, and incubators for local impact projects in Costa Rica. Following their presentations, attendees participated in brainstorming sessions and strategic canvas mapping, connecting their initiatives to the broader ReFi movement and fostering collaboration. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ZoXJcSYYuvs?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🇨🇴 ReFi Medellín &amp; Glo Dollar | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-65-bonus-session%E2%80%9Cit%E2%80%99s-raining-grants-in-web3%E2%80%9Dan-overview-and-brainstorm-of-opportunities">Session 6.5: BONUS SESSION - “It’s Raining Grants in Web3” - An Overview and Brainstorm of Opportunities</h2><p>In this bonus session, we explored a variety of current grant and fundraising opportunities for ReFi projects. We covered key programs such as Gitcoin Grants, Giveth's quadratic funding rounds, Optimism's RPGF and Cele Public Goods. The session concluded with a collaborative brainstorming to identify additional grant opportunities to benefit ecosystem projects, fostering innovation and collaboration.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/E3OkRmnfyI4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🔴 850M for Public Goods | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/H7cHXtn0Vyw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🟡 Celo Public Goods | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-7-the-how-pt-1co-creating-strategy-via-collaborative-engagement-with-multi-stakeholder-coalitions">Session 7: The HOW pt 1 - Co-creating Strategy via Collaborative Engagement with Multi-stakeholder Coalitions&nbsp;</h2><p>Moving from the What into the How, and joined by Sage Gibbons of <a href="https://prosocial.world"><u>Prosocial.World</u></a>, we turned our focus towards specific approaches and strategies for community systems in regeneration. Especially when we’re coming from a place of techno-optimism, where so much of “the solution” is technological, it is important to appreciate the value of bringing people together, creating new and deeper relationships between them, and inviting them into contexts where they can express their local context-informed needs and values in constructive ways that may inform future efforts and product development.&nbsp;</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/y4L0-IwWNw0?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🧠 Conscious Cultural Evolution with Sage Gibbons | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-8-the-how-pt-2practical-considerations-for-building-purpose-led-local-networks-innovations-in-on-chain-finance">Session 8: The HOW pt 2 - Practical Considerations for Building Purpose-led Local Networks + Innovations in On-chain Finance</h2><p>This session focused on the role that local currency and credit systems can play in re-circularizing the local economy and building up a sense of shared community identity. We were joined by Chris Hewitt of the <a href="https://hudsonvalleycurrent.org"><u>Hudson Valley Current</u></a> who shared about his journey from working in local print media to local currency and how opening up Tilda’s Kitchen, a cafe in Kingston, NY, has provided invaluable opportunities to build community, solidarity, and interest in joining the network of locals and businesses accepting Currents.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/6XwfeLLEhrY?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="💷 Local Currency in Hudson Valley with Chris Hewitt | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-9-the-how-pt-3leadership-operations-conflict-management-with-gravity-dao-and-timothe%C3%A9">Session 9: The HOW pt 3 - Leadership, Operations &amp; Conflict Management with Gravity DAO and Timotheé</h2><p>We wrapped up the core content with a session more focused on the internal side of things. First we were joined by Juan from Gravity DAO, who shared their work creating a distributed conflict mediation service and the process they use in navigating conflicts. </p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/F-NsVxLC7jE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="🤺 Conflict Resolution with Juan Bell of Gravity DAO | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><p>We were also joined by Timotheé of <a href="https://timotheebrs.medium.com/the-androgynous-organisation-part-2-media-action-ffd53f6359f7"><u>The Androgynous Organisation</u></a> (T.A.O.). He shared about the primal energies we bring into organizations through our own cultural and personal values, as well as art of balancing leadership and followership, centralisation and decentralisation, crucial for scaling DAOs while aligning with core values and fostering a culture of care and radical innovation. As it happens, ReFi DAO recently voted on an MVP proposal for its own structure and governance which incorporates these values and approaches to working together.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/OTZJZQ6VqHc?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="☯️ Centralised &amp; Decentralised with Timotheé Bres | ReFi Local Node Incubator"></iframe></figure><h2 id="session-10-finalebeta-cohort-celebration-closing-ceremony">Session 10: Finale - Beta Cohort Celebration &amp; Closing Ceremony</h2><p>Our final session took us on a reflective journey not so different from this summary, and provided an opportunity for a number of local node organizers to take the stage to share more about how they’re planning to move forward in their respective local communities. Monty also shared about the developments ReFi DAO at a global level and whats coming next...</p><h2 id="updated-node-developmental-stages">Updated Node Developmental Stages</h2><p>As a result of the program, we successfully incubated a new cohort of Local Nodes to join the network.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1811" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Local-Node-Network-2023-2024-updated.gif 1811w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>At the same time, we also proposed a new classification structure for ReFi Local Nodes, categorizing them into three stages: 🌱Seed, 🎋Sapling, and 🌳Canopy, aiming to reflect their development and impact within their communities.&nbsp;</p><ol><li><strong>🌱 Seed - Formative Stage: </strong>Seed nodes are typically focused on building a core team, identifying local needs, and crafting their vision. Founding members are laying the foundational principles that define the node’s unique purpose and direction.</li><li><strong>🎋 Sapling - Established Stage: </strong>Sapling nodes have sprouted and are actively engaging with their communities based on a well-defined vision. They are implementing key activities and projects with meaningful partnerships, expanding their influence with events, project rollouts, etc. often with secured funding.</li><li><strong>🌳 Canopy - Mature Stage: </strong>Canopy nodes are the most dedicated and influential Nodes that have reached a level of security and are making a significant impact on both local and broader regenerative practices. Akin to mature trees in a forest canopy, these Nodes provide shelter and support to their local community and projects, embodying the successful principles of regenerative finance.&nbsp;</li></ol><p>At each stage ReFi DAO aims to nurture nodes from their initial engagement through to becoming leaders in the ecosystem, encouraging a journey of continuous growth, community contribution, and sustainable impact.</p><h2 id="feedback-and-testimonials">Feedback and Testimonials</h2><p>Overall, the incubator received enthusiastic feedback from participants, emphasizing its strong community, networking opportunities, and high-quality content. Chris Georgen captured the essence of this sentiment by noting his highlight:</p><blockquote>“<em>Getting to know the ReFi DAO core team as well as other local node operators! There's a lot of camaraderie and it feels like a real potential for mutual support going forward.</em>” <strong><em>Chris Georgen</em></strong></blockquote><p>In feedback provided from participants, the organization, commitment from the organizing team, and deep insights gained were highlighted. The quality of information and the overall structure of the program received high praise, with supportive discussions and presentations being a significant benefit.</p><p>Here was how the course was rated by participants according to the course goals that were set at the outset of the program:</p><ul><li><strong>Q1</strong>: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend or a colleague? (Net Promoter Score -NPS) = 9.4/10</li><li><strong>Q2</strong>: The sessions and content were relevant for Nodes at all stages. = 9.0/10</li><li><strong>Q3</strong>: The Incubator helped me develop a better understanding of what being a Local Node means in practical terms. = 9.0/10</li><li><strong>Q4</strong>: The Incubator helped us develop strategies for organizing in local communities. = 8.9/10</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeRhl--mP-fwxCb34BYMkzPIdZnxHmMpfb67exqUPCDVGxKJUJ3xpwZzDAisG_kldSJzlyfbDR5Pix26t2Lh2Kqj2Uj0qPv54egWKypRWkf_L3Cch083nZy5EYnkoA6lGZvldz2PSKESUo0lpl2ROPaToAA?key=vt76-myXU_SSoRljFvWmrQ" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="914"></figure><p>The program received an average Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 9.4/10, indicating a high likelihood of participants recommending it to friends or colleagues. The sessions and content were rated highly relevant for nodes at all stages, scoring 9.0. Additionally, participants felt that the incubator significantly enhanced their understanding of what it means to be a Local Node in practical terms, also scoring 9.0. The program was effective in helping participants develop strategies for organizing in local communities, earning a score of 8.9.</p><p>At the same time, there were also several suggestions to enhance future cohorts. The idea of creating a start guide or a summary of the calendar, topics, and essential tools like Figma and Notion was proposed. Participants also highlighted the need for more practical examples of ReFi applications and additional sessions to enhance the hands-on learning experience. Feedback also focused on the structure of practical exercises, suggesting that additional guidance and activities could be beneficial.</p><h2 id="thank-you-to-stewards-and-organizers">Thank you to Stewards and Organizers!</h2><p>The success of the Local Node Beta Incubator was a testament to the dedication and hard work of its stewards and organizers. Huge thanks to Anna, Scott, Monty, and Jeremy as the course leads and organizers, and to the community stewards Karla, Susanne, Djimo, Tim, Tereza, and Adam who were instrumental in their mutual support. 💚</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png" width="2000" height="1445" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.09.59-AM.png 2256w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png" width="1424" height="1310" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/06/Screenshot-2024-06-05-at-11.08.06-AM.png 1424w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h3 id="anna-embracing-new-beginnings-at-general-magic">Anna Embracing New Beginnings at General Magic</h3><p>We are also announcing that Anna Kaic will be leaving ReFi DAO to embark on an exciting new journey with General Magic as a Grants Manager. Anna has expressed immense gratitude for her time at ReFi DAO, where she has learned invaluable lessons.&nbsp;</p><blockquote><em>“A special thanks to John Ellison and Daryl Edwards for being incredible mentors and to Monty Bryant for creating a great collaborative environment.” <strong>Anna Kaic </strong></em></blockquote><p>Anna is now off to make a positive impact in the world by helping impactful web3 projects secure the funding they need to thrive. We wish her all the best in her new role and are immensely grateful for her contributions to ReFi DAO.</p><h2 id="a-regenerative-path-forward">A Regenerative Path Forward </h2><p>The ReFi Local Node Beta Incubator successfully demonstrated the power of community-driven regenerative finance initiatives. Over 15 weeks, we cultivated a vibrant network of local nodes equipped with the knowledge and tools needed to foster systemic change in their communities. With a diverse range of sessions, high-quality content, and strong participant engagement, we have laid the foundation for sustainable, localized impact. As we celebrate the accomplishments of this cohort and bid farewell to Anna Kaic, we look forward to continuing our journey towards a regenerative future with the ongoing support and collaboration of our growing ReFi community. Let's keep the momentum going! 🌱</p>
item.excerpt:encoded: The ReFi Local Node Beta Incubator has empowered a new cohort of local nodes to spearhead regenerative finance efforts in their communities. As we celebrate their progress and look ahead, our dedication to fostering systemic change and sustainable impact continues to grow.

item.title: The Source of Source: A Vision for ReFi
item.dc:creator: Lee Rael
item.content:encoded: <p><em>This community story, written by </em><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/lee-rael-1918b213/?original_referer=https://www.google.com/&amp;originalSubdomain=za" rel="noreferrer"><em>Lee Rael</em></a><em>, introduces Lee’s personal journey into ReFi, his founding of a new media organization – Source Studios, and an exciting vision for growing the ecosystem in partnership with ReFi DAO.</em></p><h3 id="my-journey-in">My Journey In</h3><p>My introduction to ReFi came in March 2022 when I discovered <a href="https://toucan.earth/" rel="noreferrer">Toucan Protocol</a>. I had already been working in the sustainability and impact space for 13 years through my creative agency <a href="https://creativeseed.co.za/"><u>Seed</u></a>. I started exploring crypto in 2018 and delved into NFTs in late 2021 and early 2022. When I saw an open role at Toucan it resonated with me so deeply that I pursued it with determination, reaching out to multiple team members online until I secured the position. This marked my first real exposure to ReFi. The potential of tokenizing assets that have a positive impact on our planet captivated me. I realized that through ReFi, we could unlock funding, speed, and scale that traditional systems couldn't match.&nbsp;</p><p>I was also introduced to the concept of regeneration versus sustainability—highlighting that sustainability as a concept is just insufficient. We can do better. We need to rethink and recreate our systems to enable them to enrich the ecosystems they inhabit on a personal, community, and ecological level.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.23.31-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1124" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.23.31-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.23.31-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.23.31-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.23.31-AM.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><blockquote>It is my deep desire to be part of the solution. When I found ReFi I felt like I found a home, I was not alone in this mission to enact change.</blockquote><h3 id="the-birth-of-source">The Birth of Source</h3><p>After a year at Toucan, where I learned some of the nuances of ReFi and saw its potential first-hand, it was time to move on. I will be forever grateful for my time at Toucan, the amazing people I met, the things I learnt and the perspective shift it enabled for me. When I first onboarded at Toucan I met <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jbellison/?originalSubdomain=pt" rel="noreferrer">John Ellison</a>, who had then just founded ReFi DAO. John's vision for storytelling and a decentralized world aligned perfectly with my aspirations. Our conversations led to the birth of <a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/"><u>Source </u></a>with the initial intention to help produce podcasts within the ReFi community to help give voice to the regenerative stories of the ecosystem.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.32.06-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.32.06-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.32.06-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.32.06-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.32.06-AM.png 2000w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.24.15-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1120" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.24.15-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.24.15-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.24.15-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.24.15-AM.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>During that time we produced and launched the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLArKB4hKFyGFgwEYtARwXPf21oOH9eKSx" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Podcast Season 3</a> and two new podcasts – <a href="https://twitter.com/podplanta_r?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer"><em>Planta-R</em></a><em>&nbsp;</em>in Portuguese from ReFi Lisboa and <a href="https://twitter.com/vagabonds_pod?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer"><em>Vagabonds</em></a> in Spanish from ReFi Costa Rica.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/launching-planta-r-and-vagabonds-podcasts/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Launching Planta-R and Vagabonds Podcasts! 🎙️📻🎉</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">We are celebrating the launch of two incredible podcasts in Spanish and Portuguese - Vagabonds and Planta-R! Here is an overview of what you can expect!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Anna Kaic</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1200/2023/12/Untitled-design-73-.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>And in case you didn't catch it, The ReFi Podcast is about to enter into its 4th season with two exciting new hosts. We are watching on eagerly to see how this new chapter unfolds.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/season-4-refi-podcast-announcement/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Season 4 ReFi Podcast Announcement</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The Regeneration Nexus Is Here! Get ready for a new chapter in the ReFi Podcast! 🎙️🎉 As John, who has hosted three fantastic seasons, launches an exciting new venture, we, Maya and Tereza, are thrilled to take over as hosts for Season 4 of the show! Meet the Hosts 👯‍♀️ Maya Z.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Maya Dentzel</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1200/2024/05/ReFi-Podcast--6-.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><p>After these collaborations and many others, I witnessed first hand the challenges of growing a podcast audience and community. <a href="__GHOST_URL__/a-leadership-transition-at-refi-dao-paving-the-way-for-new-growth/" rel="noreferrer">Johns path was also diverging</a>, so I then decided to take Source forward myself and pursue a vision that had emerged..</p><blockquote><em>Imagine a platform that you can submit your content to that gives it instant exposure and reach to an audience looking for and interested in what you have to say?</em></blockquote><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/how.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="936" height="425" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/how.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/how.jpg 936w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h3 id="source-vision">Source Vision</h3><p>At Source, our mission is to amplify voices of regeneration in the broadest sense. In the ReFi ecosystem, this means identifying and promoting the individuals, projects, and groups with powerful visions of a better world, leveraging web3 mechanisms and ReFi values. We are committed to telling their stories and ensuring they reach the widest possible audiences.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.43.24-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1118" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.43.24-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.43.24-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.43.24-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.43.24-AM.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>We are currently building our platform and will soon have an MVP that we can share with the world. In the meantime we are growing a <a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/join-the-waitlist"><u>waitlist </u></a>and encourage anyone aligned with our mission to sign up. <strong>We are looking for people and organizations who are already developing content</strong>, this can be video, audio or written, and seek a broader reach and audience. This includes startups, non-profits, businesses, and independent content creators, anyone really. Additionally, those with a community or platform can join as distribution partners, helping us spread these crucial narratives even further.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.36.36-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.36.36-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.36.36-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.36.36-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.36.36-AM.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/join-the-waitlist" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Waitlist</a></div><p><em>Here is a sneak peak at some of the designs of the Source platform, this is the first public sharing of these and we are still in process 👇</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.35.22-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1118" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.35.22-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.35.22-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.35.22-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.35.22-AM.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Content-provider-Dashboard.jpg" width="1512" height="982" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Content-provider-Dashboard.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Content-provider-Dashboard.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Content-provider-Dashboard.jpg 1512w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Feeds.jpg" width="1512" height="982" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Feeds.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Feeds.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Feeds.jpg 1512w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h3 id="the-future-of-source">The Future of Source</h3><p>In its current design, Source is centralized, but we are beginning to explore what a decentralized media service might look like. This could involve creating a token of ownership to replace traditional funding and ownership mechanisms, implementing a bounty system to curate and reward expert contributions, and potentially adopting a DAO governance model. Although the complexity of DAOs is daunting, it offers a way for the Source platform's messaging and narrative to be co-created by a diverse group of stakeholders. If you feel called to explore this further and help shape what this might look like please get in touch.</p><p>We are also excited to announce that we will be <strong>piloting the Source platform in the ReFi ecosystem in partnership with ReFi DAO</strong>. This collaboration is a testament to our commitment to driving narrative change and promoting game-changing ideas to new audiences.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.21.15-AM.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1114" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.21.15-AM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.21.15-AM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.21.15-AM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Screenshot-2024-07-19-at-9.21.15-AM.png 2396w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>My long-term vision for Source is to act as an engine powering narrative change, disseminating transformative ideas far and wide. From my time at Toucan, I witnessed the stigma associated with crypto and how it hampers ReFi growth and adoption. By amplifying the stories emerging from the ReFi ecosystem and breaking out of its echo chamber, we can change perceptions and foster a broader understanding of its potential. If Source can play even a small role in altering these perceptions and bringing regenerative finance to the forefront, it would be a significant achievement.</p><h3 id="join-the-movement">Join The Movement</h3><p>The work we are doing at Source is more than just storytelling; it's about creating a movement. A movement that aligns with the principles of regeneration, decentralization, and empowerment. We invite you to join us on this journey, to contribute your voice, and to help us build a future where the stories we tell shape the world we want to see.</p><p><a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/join-the-waitlist"><u>Join the waitlist </u></a>to keep up to speed with our progress and developments.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.wearesource.earth/join-the-waitlist" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Join Waitlist</a></div>

item.title: ReFi Medellín with Tereza Bízková and Juan Giraldo | S3 BONUS episode
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <p>In this bonus episode of the ReFi Podcast, <a href="https://x.com/climateXcrypto">John Ellison</a> sits down with the new co-hosts of season 4, <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel">Maya Dentzel</a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova">Tereza Bízková</a>, along with her colleague <a href="https://x.com/0xj4an">Juan Giraldo</a> from <a href="https://x.com/ReFiMedellin">ReFi Medellín</a>, <a href="https://x.com/ReFiDAOist">ReFi DAO</a>’s local node. They discuss the incredible work being done in Medellín, Colombia, to drive the Web3 movement through community events and sustainable practices.</p><p>ReFi Medellín has hosted <strong>over 35 events</strong> in the past year, focusing on activities that bring people together and promote regeneration. From hikes and planting community gardens to urban farming and blockchain education, this local node is making a significant impact.</p><blockquote>“Living in Medellín, it’s easy to notice the need for ReFi. Colombia is the second most biodiverse country in the world, and there are many social issues. Seeing how Web3 can become a coordination tool for us was a huge motivation.” - Tereza</blockquote><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/lkYSvAwm5k4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="ReFi Medellín with Tereza Bízková and Juan Giraldo | S3 BONUS episode"></iframe></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/refipodcast/episodes/ReFi-Medelln-with-Tereza-Bzkov-and-Juan-Giraldo--S3-BONUS-episode-e2m69k1" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">🎵 LISTEN ON SPOTIFY</a></div><h2 id="key-takeaways-%F0%9F%9A%80">Key Takeaways 🚀</h2><ul><li><strong>Engaging Onboarding:</strong> ReFi Medellín uses activities like urban farming work, clean-up competitions, and free English classes to introduce Web3 concepts, addressing skepticism and access issues in the community.</li><li><strong>Tackling Financial Barriers:</strong> They offer low-interest, collateral-free loans based on community reputation, supporting local groups underserved by the traditional financial system.</li><li><strong>Collaborative Growth:</strong> By partnering with local NGOs like Salva Terra and engaging in global discussions, ReFi Medellín aims to create a robust network of partners to grow with.</li><li><strong>Intentional Fundraising:</strong> ReFi Medellín’s fundraising success via Gitcoin, Giveth, and Optimism RetroPGF is due to intentional work focused on monitoring opportunities, checking requirements, and spending significant time on community chats.</li></ul><p>Tune into the full episode on YouTube or Spotify, and follow ReFi Medellin on <a href="https://x.com/ReFiMedellin">Twitter</a>! 🌱</p><p>Inspired by ReFi Medellín? Make a difference by starting <a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-local-nodes-impact-2023/">a local node</a> in your community. 🌎</p><h2 id="sneak-peek-to-season-4-%F0%9F%91%80"><strong>Sneak Peek to Season 4 👀</strong></h2><p>In this episode, Maya and Tereza also offer a sneak peek into what’s coming for the <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus">next season of the ReFi Podcast</a>. Maya emphasizes their goal to expand on the concept of Regenerative Finance and delve deeper into the entire regeneration spectrum, including foundational philosophy, economic principles, and innovative technologies and projects.</p><p>Tereza echoes this new direction by introducing the season’s theme, “Regeneration Nexus,” with the aim to “tell an integral regenerative story.” She explains that this story will bring together three key elements: the system, economic thinking, and real-world impact.</p><p>Stay tuned for more, and follow the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC779ZMumuKc6-VMkku1tmyQ">ReFi Podcast</a> on YouTube and <a href="https://open.spotify.com/show/5RTHF6JVgQL1cgaVfvi7cv">Spotify</a>! 💜</p>

item.title: The Regen Coordi-Nation Genesis
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <h2 id="tldr">TLDR</h2><p>We are thrilled to announce the launch of the Regen Coordi-Nation – a pioneering collaboration between <a href="https://greenpill.network/">GreenPill Network</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.refidao.com/">ReFi DAO</a>, and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.celopg.eco/">Celo Public Goods</a> aiming to support a global movement of regenerative communities leveraging Web3 technology to address local needs and create real-world impact. Kickstarting the alliance with The Regen Coordi-Nation GG21 Genesis Round and $50K in matching funds, the round is open to applications from ReFi DAO Local Nodes, GreenPill Local Chapters, and Celo Regional DAOs. Key dates include the application period from July 24th to August 6th and the round start of August 7th. Together, we are embarking on a mission to demonstrate how community organization, innovative financial mechanisms, and Web3 can enable ecological and social regeneration on a global scale. </p><h2 id="the-power-of-local-communities">The Power of Local Communities</h2><p>Local communities are crucial to the success of regenerative finance. Connected globally, ReFi Local Nodes serve as hubs of opportunity where community members can learn, experiment, and implement ReFi solutions tailored to their local contexts. This cosmo-local network aims to foster innovation and adapt regenerative practices to meet diverse needs, ensuring effective and sustainable solutions grounded in lived experiences.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/What-is-a-ReFi-Local-Node.jpg 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>ReFi DAO has a history of supporting Local Nodes through Gitcoin funding rounds, including the Local Node Beta Round (April 2023) with $25k match funding, and a GG18 Round (August 2023) with $30k match funding. Most recently in the beginning half of 2024, we completed our second incubator program for our beta cohort of Local Nodes. You can read more about these initiatives and their impact in the articles below👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://gitcoin.mirror.xyz/RjqdZrPZaDiW_g0xqfey1xYW0OP5F502xo8vBojRFDQ"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Catalyzing Change: ReFi DAO’s Impact Through Gitcoin Funding Rou…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The Regenerative Finance (ReFi) movement has come a long way since its nascent days, growing from foundational ideas laid in 2017 through a surge in popularity and investment in 2021. ReFi addresses a fundamental issue: the traditional financial system often prioritizes short-term gains for capital holders at the expense of nature and biodiversity. By shifting towards sustainable and inclusive models, ReFi focuses on the holistic wellbeing of people and the planet and stands as a symbol of hope and transformation. Emerging from the Regenerative Economics and DeFi movements, ReFi leverages Web3, DLT, AI, and dMRV technologies to achieve its goals.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://gitcoin.mirror.xyz/favicon.ico" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/publication-images/OCYwPIlMBggXQGKozGmVt.png?height=800&amp;width=1600" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/pzwS5ape0Zqu5mnqKM60eIqMfBtLjQ18UEy1jiDeAHU"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Regenerative Journeys: ReFi Local Nodes 2023</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">🌱 Discover the Regenerative Finance revolution: How ReFi DAO is transforming communities worldwide for social and ecological harmony.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://mirror.xyz/favicon.ico" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/nft/NciUmo2_K0HVUrpyf5PDy.jpeg" alt=""></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/local-node-incubator/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">🌱 Local Node Incubator - Beta Cohort Retrospective!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The ReFi Local Node Beta Incubator has empowered a new cohort of local nodes to spearhead regenerative finance efforts in their communities. As we celebrate their progress and look ahead, our dedication to fostering systemic change and sustainable impact continues to grow.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w256h256/2022/12/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Anna Kaic</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1200/2024/05/2059.png" alt=""></div></a></figure><h2 id="uniting-for-regeneration">Uniting for Regeneration</h2><p>As well as ReFi DAO's efforts, <a href="https://greenpill.network/">GreenPill Network</a> has been continuing to invest in it’s Local Chapters — a “CoordiNation across Nations &amp; Cultures” that exports regenerative digital infrastructure to the world. At the same time, <a href="https://forum.celo.org/t/regional-dao-review-template-by-luukdao/7459">Celo Regional DAOs</a> have been active since 2022 as a program&nbsp;to empower local communities to spearhead Celo adoption and growth in their region.</p><p>Each of these networks share common overlapping values, missions, and identities. Yet at the same time, each has a unique proposition, unique audience, and unique resources &amp; capabilities. Inspired by <a href="https://blockchaingov.eu/?ref=blog.refidao.com">BlockchainGov</a>’s concept of a ‘Coordi-nation’ — voluntary interwoven networks of communities with aligned values and a shared identity — ReFi DAO, GreenPill Network and Celo Public Goods are coming together to form ‘The Regen Coordi-Nation.’</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-NATION.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1079" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-NATION.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-NATION.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-NATION.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-NATION.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Our roadmap includes both a Gitcoin Grants 21 (GG21) round with $50k matching, as well as a retroactive funding round later this year based on participation &amp; impact with at least $50k more in funding. A huge thank you to each of these parties in making this program possible – Celo Public Goods committing $50K, ReFi DAO and GreenPill Network each contributing $5K, and Gitcoin providing an additional $50K. </p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-GG21-Genesis-Round.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1721" height="418" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-GG21-Genesis-Round.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-GG21-Genesis-Round.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-GG21-Genesis-Round.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-GG21-Genesis-Round.jpg 1721w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h1 id="the-gg21-genesis-round">The GG21 Genesis Round</h1><p>The Regen Coordi-Nation GG21 Genesis Round is now <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/Regen-Coordi-Nation-Portal-2bfc9ecc725743878491812edccf4430?pvs=4" rel="noreferrer">open for applications</a> from ReFi DAO Local Nodes, GreenPill Local Chapters, and Celo Regional DAOs!</p><h3 id="key-dates">Key Dates</h3><ul><li><strong>Pre-round Application Period </strong>(<em>receive a decision by the start of the round)</em>: July 24th @ noon UTC - August 6th @ noon UTC</li><li><strong>Donation Period</strong>: August 7th @ noon UTC - 21st August @ 23:59 UTC</li><li><strong>Extended Applications</strong>: August 6th @ noon UTC - August 12th @ 23:59 UTC</li></ul><h3 id="eligibility-application-process">Eligibility &amp; Application Process</h3><p>Each local community must receive a nomination from the respective evaluation and governance processes of ReFi DAO, GreenPill, or Celo Public Goods (Celo PG). For ReFi Local Nodes, applicants must fill out their <a href="https://www.notion.so/refi-dao/0e76cf05ea894f3bba19cad59b2bb596?v=5e498d48a7824ea7817d8c7900d61e3f&amp;pvs=4" rel="noreferrer">Local Node Profile</a>, submit this as a proposal on the <a href="https://app.charmverse.io/refi-dao/welcome-refi-noder-15368963279191328" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO Charmverse</a> and then only apply to the round through <a href="https://grants.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin Grants</a> once approved. For full details on the eligibility and process for each network, visit the Regen Coordi-Nation Portal👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://refi-dao.notion.site/Regen-Coordi-Nation-Portal-2bfc9ecc725743878491812edccf4430?pvs=4" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Learn more &amp; apply!</a></div><h3 id="program-team-advisors-partnerships">Program Team, Advisors &amp; Partnerships</h3><ul><li><strong>Lead Operator</strong>: Monty Merlin Bryant (ReFi DAO, Trusted Seed, Celo Public Goods)</li><li><strong>Team</strong>: Scott Morris (ReFi DAO, FoxFire), Sejal Rekhan (GreenPill Network, Gitcoin), Izzy Lawrence (GreenPill Network), Luuk Weber (Kolektivo Labs, Celo Public Goods)</li><li><strong>Advisors</strong>: Lana Dingwall (RootedLABs, GreenPill Network), Benjamin Life (OpenCivics), Lau Na Mu (Celo Public Goods, Metrics Garden Labs)</li></ul><h3 id="partnerships-collaborations">Partnerships &amp; Collaborations</h3><ul><li><strong>MetaGov</strong>: Sharing insights for Web3 grants research and innovation.</li><li><strong>Glo Dollar</strong>: Planning for matching in USDGLO and enabling native Glo donations.</li><li><strong>$REGEN Tips</strong>: Exploring token multipliers and Proof of Regen integration.</li><li><strong>Open Civics</strong>: Exploring bio-regional coordination and finance facilities for local nodes.</li></ul><h2 id="join-us-for-the-kickoff-event">Join Us for the Kickoff Event</h2><p>We invite you to the <a href="https://lu.ma/k0y575ql" rel="noreferrer">Regen Coordi-Nation Kickoff</a>, an online gathering to bring together ReFi Local Nodes, GreenPill Chapters, and Celo Regional DAOs to discuss the details of our program and provide time for local leaders to meet across networks. Participants will also have the chance to engage in Q&amp;A sessions and discussions about the GG21 Genesis Round. Don’t miss this opportunity to connect with fellow regenerative community leaders and explore how we can collectively drive ecological, social, and economic regeneration using Web3 technology!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://lu.ma/k0y575ql"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Regen Coordi-Nation Kickoff · Zoom · Luma</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The Regen Coordi-Nation — a pioneering collaboration between GreenPill Network,&nbsp;ReFi DAO, and&nbsp;Celo Public Goods aimed at fostering a global movement of…</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://lu.ma/apple-touch-icon.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO Global</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://social-images.lu.ma/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,fit=cover,dpr=1,background=white,quality=75,width=800,height=419/api/event-one?calendar_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fcalendars%2F6y%2F35b392f0-8e71-48dc-9082-1069afb078a5&amp;calendar_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global%20Events&amp;color0=%23694548&amp;color1=%23292027&amp;color2=%23bf633e&amp;color3=%23f3e39d&amp;host_avatar=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Favatars%2Fhc%2Fb8a67eec-1837-44a1-958c-24f1e4729f16&amp;host_name=ReFi%20DAO%20Global&amp;img=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.lumacdn.com%2Fevent-covers%2Ft9%2F7b7a2cb4-37c9-4589-a46b-18fe36f85371&amp;name=Regen%20Coordi-Nation%20Kickoff" alt=""></div></a></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/k0y575ql" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Register now!</a></div><p>As we embark on this journey, we invite all eligible Local Nodes and Chapters to participate in the GG21 Genesis Round and contribute to this transformative initiative. Together, we can build a more sustainable, equitable future through innovative financial mechanisms and community-driven action.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-LOGO.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1024" height="1024" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-LOGO.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-LOGO.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/07/Regen-Coordi-Nation-LOGO.jpg 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure>

item.content:encoded: <p>Eleven #GG21 rounds are now live on <a href="http://grants.gitcoin.co">Gitcoin Grants</a> 🎉 This is your chance to fund and support projects that align with your vision for a regenerative future. </p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-blue"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌱</div><div class="kg-callout-text">The <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/14" rel="noreferrer">Regen Coordi-Nation Genesis Round</a> featuring ReFi DAO Local Nodes, GreenPill Network and more!</div></div><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/14" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Support Regen Coordi-Nation</a></div><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-blue"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/11" rel="noreferrer">Celo Real World Builders</a>, <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42161/388" rel="noreferrer">Climate Solutions</a>, <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42161/386" rel="noreferrer">OpenCivics</a>, and other impactful rounds!</div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/telegram-cloud-photo-size-4-5879910413087392475-x.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="500" height="563"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="http://grants.gitcoin.co" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore Rounds</a></div><h2 id="gg21-on-celo">GG21 on Celo</h2><p>Both the <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/14" rel="noreferrer">Regen Coordi-Nation Genesis Round</a> and <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/11" rel="noreferrer">Real World Builders</a> are live on the Celo Blockchain. New to Celo? This is how you can get involved 👇</p><h5 id="option-1centralized-exchange">OPTION 1 - Centralized Exchange</h5><p>CELO is listed on several major exchanges worldwide, including Binance, Coinbase, KuCoin, Bittrex, Huobi, Gate.io, Upbit, and OKX. You can <a href="https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/celo/markets/">see the full list here</a>. From any of these platforms, you can easily withdraw CELO into your personal wallet to get started.</p><h5 id="option-2bridging-from-other-chains">OPTION 2 - Bridging from Other Chains!</h5><ul><li>👉 <strong>Easiest Option:</strong> <a href="https://smolrefuel.com/?outboundChain=42220">SmolRefuel</a> – the simplest way to bridge to Celo.</li><li>👉 <strong>Other Great Options:</strong> <a href="https://v2.app.squidrouter.com/">Squidrouter v2</a> &amp; <a href="https://portalbridge.com/">PortalBridge</a> – reliable tools for bridging assets.</li><li>👉 <strong>Need Guidance?</strong> Check out this <a href="https://www.squidrouter.com/squid-school/celo-bridging-guide">SquidRouter Guide</a> on how to bridge to Celo using Squid (make sure to use v2!).</li></ul><h5 id="option-3ask-for-help">OPTION 3 - Ask for Help!</h5><p>The community is here to support you! If you have any questions or need help getting started, feel free to ask in the <a href="https://t.me/c/2214404857/12">Help &amp; Support channel</a> or send <a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant" rel="noreferrer">me</a> a direct message. We can even send you some tokens for gas to help you get started!</p><h5 id="glo-bonus">GLO BONUS</h5><p>Maximize your impact by swapping your CELO to GloDollar! You can <a href="https://www.glodollar.org/buy-glo-dollars">buy GloDollar here</a> or <a href="https://app.uniswap.org/swap?outputCurrency=0x4F604735c1cF31399C6E711D5962b2B3E0225AD3&amp;chain=celo">swap it here</a>.</p><p>🌟 Help us spread the word and ensure everyone has the resources to participate in and donate to GG21!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/image.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1024" height="1024" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/08/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/08/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/image.png 1024w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="refi-dao-in-gg21">ReFi DAO in GG21</h2><p>We would also be immensely grateful for any support for ReFi DAO's direct work in supporting the local node network, pioneering the Regen Coordi-Nation and much more. Thank you!</p><ul><li>👉 <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/projects/0x73e339b7cfb75775d6ba550e94d3877d4cba9938cd5a1e0217ff6ab7394977bd" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO Local Node Network in GG21</a></li><li>👉 <a href="https://tinyurl.com/ReFiDaoxTEC" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO x TEC - Pioneering a QF to KarmaGAP to RPGF Playbook</a></li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.03-PM-1.png" width="2000" height="885" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.03-PM-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.03-PM-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.03-PM-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.03-PM-1.png 2182w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.06-PM.png" width="2000" height="885" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.06-PM.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.06-PM.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.06-PM.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/Screenshot-2024-08-09-at-4.16.06-PM.png 2184w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h2 id="regen-bonus-%F0%9F%8D%84">Regen Bonus 🍄</h2><p>Donations to the rounds will also increase your $REGEN eligibility from Regen Tips. More details soon... In the meantime, mint your <a href="https://www.regen.tips/score" rel="noreferrer">proof-of-regen score</a>!</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regen.tips/score" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Proof-of-Regen</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/image-2.png" width="2000" height="1200" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/08/image-2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/08/image-2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/08/image-2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/image-2.png 2048w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/image-3.png" width="937" height="878" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/08/image-3.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/08/image-3.png 937w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>Join us in shaping a regenerative future—get involved, spread the word, and let’s make an impact together! 🌱✨</p>
