item.title: From ReFi to Regenera: My Journey in the Symphony of Regeneration 🌿
item.dc:creator: John Dass
item.content:encoded: <figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/VMGTbkeztFM?start=4&amp;feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Regenera: Wisdom for the Planetary Age"></iframe></figure><p>Beloved ReFi nation,</p><p>After 18 months of profound transformation, I am emerging from the ashes with something new to share. Many of you know me from my work with ReFi DAO and Toucan Protocol. Today, I want to reintroduce myself as John Dass—the voice crying out in the wilderness...</p><p>It is with this new voice, that I come to announce the launch of my new show <a href="https://www.regenera.xyz/" rel="noreferrer">Regen<em>era</em>: Wisdom for the Planetary Age</a>, a podcast born at the intersection of indigenous wisdom, modern science, and emerging technology. This isn't just another podcast—it's the fruit of a deep inner journey through death and rebirth, through ceremony and technology, through pain and transformation.</p><p>I am out of the studio, out of the home and into the wild—recording content at festivals, in villages and in indigenous communities.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regenera.xyz/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Subscribe now</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/why-regenera-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1334" height="256" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/why-regenera-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/10/why-regenera-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/why-regenera-1.jpg 1334w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="why-regenera">Why Regen<em>era</em>?</h2><p>While stepping back from Source stewardship at ReFi DAO (thank you ser Monty Merlin 🙏), I have been sitting with indigenous elders in sacred ceremonies, processing intergenerational trauma, and exploring how <em>open technology</em> can serve humanity's highest ideals. Through this journey, I've discovered that the bridge between web3 and true planetary regeneration lies in the integration of ancient wisdom with emerging innovation.</p><p><strong>Let me say this another way <em>indigenous wisdom is the KEY to unlock the power of web3. 🗝️</em></strong></p><p><strong>Yes, you heard me.</strong></p><blockquote> The vast treasure trove of <strong>intelligence</strong> locked away in the <strong>biodiversity hotspots</strong> of the world, sitting with <strong>indigenous elders</strong> and their communities—<strong>this is the key to everything</strong> that we <strong>aspire to achieve in ReFi</strong>.</blockquote><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regenera.xyz/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read more</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/whats-coming-1-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1485" height="348" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/whats-coming-1-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/10/whats-coming-1-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/whats-coming-1-1.jpg 1485w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="whats-coming-%F0%9F%A4%A9">What's Coming? 🤩</h2><ul><li>Deep dives with thought leaders across the regenerative movement</li><li>Daily indigenous wisdom drops on social</li><li>Sacred gatherings with elders like Grandmother Jyoti Ma</li><li>A new methodology called "Shared Dreaming" to co-create our vision of The Symbiocene (early access for paid subscribers, retreat Nov 1-3)</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide kg-card-hascaption"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/banner-event-image-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="479" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/banner-event-image-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/10/banner-event-image-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/banner-event-image-1.jpg 1600w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Join us in Ericeira, Portugal on November 2nd</span></figcaption></figure><h2 id="a-special-invitation-%F0%9F%A7%A7">A Special Invitation 🧧</h2><p>For those ready to go deeper, I'm hosting a 3-day retreat with Grandmother Jyoti Ma of The Fountain—a world-renowned spiritual teacher and elder working with <a href="https://motherearthdelegation.com/" rel="noreferrer">The Mother Earth Delegation of United Original Nations</a> and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CzDdZqACRO8&amp;t=1s" rel="noreferrer">The Mother's Message</a>. All regens are invited to join us on November 2nd for a gathering with Grandmother Jyoti Ma at House of The Rising Mojo in Ericeira, Portugal.</p><p>Let's dream of regeneration—together.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://lu.ma/lnzs8vfs" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Get tickets</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/zP7DVS0bYgM?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="An Evening with Grandmother Jyoti Ma | LIVE STREAM — NOV 2 16.00–21.00"></iframe></figure><h2 id="join-the-live-stream-on-youtube-nov-2-%F0%9F%94%B4">Join the live stream on Youtube Nov 2 🔴</h2><p>For those of you who cannot join us for the in-person retreat or gathering in Portugal, we have setup a live stream on Nov 2 from 16.00 to 21.00, Lisbon. Please do join us from a quiet space with reverence. We will be hosting Palestinians, Israelis, Ukranians, Russians—Muslims, Christians, Jews, and people of agnostic and atheist worldviews. It will be a powerful experience and a sneak peek into <a href="https://www.pilgrimage.love/" rel="noreferrer">The Pilgrimage</a>, a 64-day cycle journey from Stonehenge to Giza in Spring 2025.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://youtube.com/live/zP7DVS0bYgM?feature=share" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">LIVE STREAM</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/tech-consciousness-regeneration-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1484" height="706" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/10/tech-consciousness-regeneration-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/10/tech-consciousness-regeneration-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/10/tech-consciousness-regeneration-1.jpg 1484w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h2 id="technology-consciousness-regeneration-%F0%9F%95%B8%EF%B8%8F">Technology, Consciousness &amp; Regeneration 🕸️</h2><p>I still deeply believe that open technology—whether web3 or truly open AI—holds the keys to a regenerative future. But this kind of technology alone isn't enough. We need to weave it together with indigenous wisdom, community practice, and expanded consciousness.</p><p>This—is—<em>technology</em>.</p><p>Consciousness is the most <em>powerful technology in all of existence</em>. Indigenous communities understand this better than anyone else. We need to learn from them and align ourselves with the loving awareness <em>that permeates all things</em>. When we build systems from this place—THIS—is how we create symbiosis. It is not only a state of being, but a state of <em>doing</em> that accepts our true nature as a part of this vast tapestry of life.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regenera.xyz/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read more</a></div><h2 id="join-the-journey">Join the Journey</h2><ul><li><strong>Watch trailer</strong> 🎬: <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMGTbkeztFM" rel="noreferrer">Introducing Regenera: Wisdom for The Planetary Age 🌿</a> </li><li><strong>Livestream on Nov 2 </strong>🔴: <a href="https://youtube.com/live/zP7DVS0bYgM?feature=share" rel="noreferrer">An Evening with Jyoti Ma</a> on Youtube </li><li><strong>IRL Tickets 🎟️:</strong> <a href="https://lu.ma/lnzs8vfs" rel="noreferrer">An Evening with Jyoti Ma on Lu.ma</a> </li><li>Become a <strong>paid subscriber </strong>for retreat access, Shared Dreaming, community and exclusive content</li></ul><p>Thank you so much, ReFi nation, for being such a core part of this journey! While my recent movements may seem like a departure from the foundation upon which ReFi is built, I actually see this an <em>expansion</em>—an invitation to explore how our technology can serve the deeper calling of planetary regeneration <em>with loving awareness</em> at the core.</p><p>In gratitude and service,</p><p><br>John Dass</p><p>@iamjohndass on <a href="https://x.com/iamjohndass" rel="noreferrer">X</a>, <a href="https://instagram.com/iamjohndass" rel="noreferrer">IG</a>, <a href="https://www.facebook.com/john.ellison.12935756" rel="noreferrer">FB</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/iamjohndass/" rel="noreferrer">LI</a></p><p>P.S. Special thanks to all the <em>incredible leaders</em> who stepped up during my absence and continue to nurture the ReFi DAO network. I dance to your symphony of regeneration. 🙏</p><p><strong>If you want to catch up on the journey to Regenera and beyond, here are some of my top posts so far:</strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.regenera.xyz/p/myths-of-the-regenerative-era-part"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Myths of The Regenerative Era: Part I — The Eagle &amp; The Condor</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">What an ancient prophecy from The Americas teaches us about the regenerative age</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff4004741-714e-4784-a8d2-c1a8aacb2352%2Fapple-touch-icon-180x180.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Regenera with John Dass</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">John Dass</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1200,h_600,c_fill,f_jpg,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep,g_auto/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe54573a0-9ac8-4f5b-8daa-eadf0fd5ff6e_1280x731.jpeg" alt="" onerror="this.style.display = 'none'"></div></a></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://www.regenera.xyz/p/from-ashes-to-regeneration"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">From Ashes to Regeneration 🔥</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">An odyssey through love, loss, and the vision of a regenerative era. My first post on a new Substack sharing my journey sitting with sacred medicine alongside a group of leaders in Mexico during the OYASīN Awakening Retreat.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff4004741-714e-4784-a8d2-c1a8aacb2352%2Fapple-touch-icon-180x180.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">Regenera with John Dass</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">John Dass</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1200,h_600,c_fill,f_jpg,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep,g_auto/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fec6e1f0e-21ef-4262-8be8-c43e339498fd_1024x1024.webp" item.title: Regenerative Investing with Ebru Kaya │ S4Ep6 💸🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="can-investment-be-reimagined-as-a-force-for-regeneration">Can investment be reimagined as a force for regeneration?</h3><p>In Episode 6 of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://es.linkedin.com/in/ebru-kaya-9741432" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Ebru Kaya</strong></a>, co-founder of the <a href="https://www.regenerativeinvestinginstitute.org/" rel="noreferrer">Regenerative Investing Institute</a> and CEO of <a href="https://www.atreyu.global/" rel="noreferrer">Atreyu Investments</a>. Ebru’s work redefines the purpose of investment by <strong>centering on the potential of people and ecosystems</strong> over profit alone.</p><p>Ebru shares powerful insights on how investing can be done differently—investing that respects local knowledge, heals ecosystems, and values the “heartbeat” of a community. With her holistic approach, Ebru reveals that <strong>by investing in harmony with nature, we’re not only creating financial value but regenerating the natural and social systems</strong> on which we all depend. </p><p>Her approach moves from solving isolated problems to unlocking the full potential of communities and the environments that sustain them, <strong>setting a new standard for what investment can achieve.</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌿</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">"It’s not enough to solve isolated problems. Regenerative investing asks us to look deeper—to </em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">unlock the inherent potential</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"> within ecosystems, not impose solutions upon them."</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/NA8jhOT24Yo?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Regenerative Investing with Ebru Kaya | S4E6: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 6 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Beyond Profit: Tapping into the “Heartbeat” of Communities:</strong> Regenerative investing moves beyond financial metrics, focusing on meaningful indicators—like safer roads, access to education, and a thriving local culture. These “heartbeat” metrics, Ebru explains, truly capture a community’s well-being and resilience over time.</li><li><strong>Empowering Local Voices for Real Change:</strong> Ebru shows that listening to community knowledge, instead of imposing outside solutions, is critical to creating sustainable impacts. When investment aligns with local needs and values, it empowers people to make lasting changes from within.</li><li><strong>Shifting from “Extraction” to “Regeneration”:</strong> In a traditional economic model, communities and ecosystems are resources to exploit. Ebru’s approach flips this to treat them as interconnected assets, investing in their growth and restoration instead of depletion.</li><li><strong>Transforming Investment with Natural Systems Thinking:</strong> Inspired by how living systems operate, Ebru’s work is rooted in nature’s interconnectedness. By following principles like collaboration, balance, and resilience, regenerative investing promotes models where communities thrive along with the ecosystems around them.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 6</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6Snf48IIW7E2lC7UNGPVIy?si=7ed9d8ed88214d5b" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NA8jhOT24Yo" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p>And don’t forget! We’re hosting a<strong> live discussion on Episode 6 this Friday, Nov 1, at 11 AM ET! 🎙️</strong> Share your thoughts and dive deeper into the world of regenerative finance with us. 🌿</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1lPKqOyRWYbJb">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1lPKqOyRWYbJb</a></p><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: dMRV Innovation for Climate Resilience with Kennedy Ng'ang'a | S4E7 📊🎧
item.dc:creator: Maya Dentzel
Tereza Bizkova
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="can-digital-tools-drive-grassroots-climate-resilience">Can digital tools drive grassroots climate resilience?</h3><p>In Episode 6 of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://x.com/KennedyWNganga" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Kennedy Ng'ang'a</strong></a>, founder of <a href="https://shamba.network/" rel="noreferrer">Shamba Network</a>. Kennedy shares his journey of bringing blockchain and satellite data to Africa’s smallholder farmers through <strong>digital MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification)</strong>, aiming to make climate resilience data-driven, affordable, and community-centered.</p><p>Kennedy’s vision goes beyond tech for tech’s sake. He emphasizes that <strong>for digital tools to work, they must be practical and accessible</strong>, tailored to fit the daily realities of the communities they serve. </p><p>Shamba Network’s approach leverages <strong>satellite data as a climate resilience “oracle”</strong> to provide transparent, real-time insights for smallholder farmers. His work is a testament to the idea that when technology aligns with local needs, it can empower communities to lead their own regenerative journeys.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌦️</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">“For communities on the front lines of climate change, </em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">proactive resilience is key</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">. Rather than waiting for disaster, we’re leveraging data to trigger support ahead of time, so people can adapt, protect their resources, and emerge stronger.”</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/pYGIisTysUE?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="dMRV Innovation for Climate Resilience with Kennedy Ng'ang'a | S4E6: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 7 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Resilience Grows from Within:</strong> True climate resilience is community-led, supported by tools that respect local knowledge and empower people to make sustainable decisions for their land.</li><li><strong>Democratizing Climate Finance:</strong> Digital MRV allows smallholder farmers to access climate finance, leveling the playing field by making impact data transparent, affordable, and accessible.</li><li><strong>Proactive Climate Adaptation:</strong> Shamba Network’s anticipatory cash transfer model uses real-time data to trigger financial support for pastoralists before drought strikes, showcasing a proactive approach to resilience.</li><li><strong>Bridging Technology and Local Knowledge:</strong> Kennedy’s approach combines advanced data with community insights, fostering a “hybrid” model that respects both technological innovation and traditional practices.</li><li><strong>Rethinking Climate Verification:</strong> By bringing verification to the community level, digital MRV empowers smallholders to measure their impact reliably, making them active participants in the climate economy.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 7</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/1xULBLtfvGwRZTZBR821Dd?si=a211c0ba9bfa4ff5" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dmrv-innovation-for-climate-resilience-with-kennedy/id1609683147?i=1000675632018" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pYGIisTysUE" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p>And don’t forget! We’re hosting a<strong> live discussion on Episode 7 this Friday, Nov 8, at 11 AM ET! 🎙️</strong> Share your thoughts and dive deeper into the world of regenerative finance with us. 🌿</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1mrGmMmnQNqGy">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1mrGmMmnQNqGy</a></p><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: Building Bridges with Azeem Khan | S4E8 🛠️🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="what-does-it-take-to-move-crypto-beyond-speculation">What does it take to move crypto beyond speculation? </h3><p>In Episode 8 of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://x.com/azeemk_" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Azeem Khan</strong></a>—a key figure in the crypto space and co-founder and COO of <a href="https://www.morphl2.io/" rel="noreferrer">Morph</a>, an Ethereum Layer 2 project. Azeem brings a wealth of experience from roles across both corporate and philanthropic spaces, including his time as head of impact at <a href="https://www.gitcoin.co/" rel="noreferrer">Gitcoin</a> and, currently, as an advisor to <a href="https://juniper.unicef.io/" rel="noreferrer">UNICEF’s CryptoFund</a>. </p><p>With a commitment to balancing purpose with practicality, Azeem offers <strong>a candid take on how Web3 can bridge the gap between idealism and actionable impact</strong>. He discusses Morph’s mission to create<strong> accessible, user-friendly tools that are designed to meet broad community needs</strong>, challenging the tendency of crypto projects to focus on niche, insular applications.</p><p>Reflecting on his time with Gitcoin, Azeem <strong>addresses the controversial Shell deal that he led</strong>—a grants matching pool that drew both support and criticism. He explains how, with transparency and accountability, collaborations with legacy industries and organizations like Shell can bring much-needed resources into the ReFi space without compromising core community values.</p><p>Drawing on his advisory role with UNICEF, Azeem also <strong>highlights how crypto can be a lifeline for underserved communities</strong>. Through blockchain-based financial tools, he envisions a future where aid can be distributed directly and affordably, reducing reliance on costly intermediaries. His vision for Web3 extends beyond the technology itself, <strong>advocating for systems that make a real difference for people and communities that have been traditionally left out of financial systems</strong>.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🤝</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">"I thought the </em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Shell deal was one of the best things I've done in my career</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">. It was a half-million-dollar experiment, and Shell had no say in how the money was distributed—even if a grant aimed to sue Shell, they couldn’t stop it."</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/F_Uqmy6lqJs?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Building Bridges with Azeem Khan | S4E8: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 8 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Beyond Idealism to Impact:</strong> Azeem argues that Web3 and ReFi must move from lofty ideals to grounded solutions that address real-world needs. At Morph, his focus is on building accessible tools that serve communities broadly, pushing crypto beyond niche, tech-centered applications.</li><li><strong>Crypto for Underserved Communities:</strong> In his advisory role with UNICEF’s CryptoFund, Azeem sees blockchain as a tool to empower marginalized communities by providing direct, affordable financial access. He envisions crypto philanthropy as a way to bypass intermediaries, allowing aid to reach those who need it most.</li><li><strong>Balancing Purpose with Practicality:</strong> Azeem challenges the crypto space to find sustainable funding models for digital public goods. He advocates for practical solutions that enable public goods projects to thrive long-term without a reliance on short-term grants.</li><li><strong>Accountability in Web3:</strong> Azeem calls for greater transparency and integrity within the crypto industry, acknowledging that openly addressing flaws can help rebuild trust and position blockchain as a force for ethical, meaningful impact.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 8</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/2LrJ9sNKLA4tZl1lRhbSHC" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000676508872" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F_Uqmy6lqJs" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p>And don’t forget! We’re hosting a<strong> live discussion on Episode 8 this Friday, Nov 15, at 11 AM ET! 🎙️</strong> Share your thoughts and dive deeper into the world of regenerative finance with us. 🌿</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1ZkJzRdedEvJv">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1ZkJzRdedEvJv</a></p><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: Reflections on the Second ReFi Podcast S4 Miniseries: Exploring Real-World Impact 🌍🎙️
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <p>We’re excited to wrap up the <strong>second miniseries of Season 4 </strong>of <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, <em>“The Practice: What does effective regenerative change look like in the real world?”</em> This series focused on translating ideas into action, exploring the tools, systems, and relationships that make real-world impact possible.</p><p>Across four episodes, our guests—<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pete-corke-82063a3/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Pete Corke</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/ebru-kaya-9741432/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Ebru Kaya</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://ke.linkedin.com/in/kennedynganga" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Kennedy Ng’ang’a</strong></a><strong>, </strong>and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/theazeemkhan" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Azeem Khan</strong></a>—shared how they are bridging innovation with local realities, redesigning extractive systems, and empowering communities to lead regeneration.</p><p>Recurring themes emerged throughout: integrating traditional knowledge with decentralized tools, aligning financial incentives with ecological stewardship, and respecting cultural and environmental contexts. </p><p>From rethinking how we value forests to crafting regenerative investment strategies, these conversations underscored that<strong> effective change relies on collaboration, inclusivity, and systems designed for regeneration</strong>, not extraction.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/ReFi-Podcast--19-.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/11/ReFi-Podcast--19-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/11/ReFi-Podcast--19-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/11/ReFi-Podcast--19-.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/ReFi-Podcast--19-.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="%F0%9F%92%A1-key-themes"><strong>💡 Key Themes</strong></h2><p>Throughout these conversations, several key themes emerged, answering the guiding question: <strong>What Does Effective Regenerative Change Look Like in Practice?</strong></p><h3 id="%F0%9F%8C%B2-our-current-economic-system-is-designed-to-extract">🌲 <strong> Our current economic system is designed to extract </strong></h3><p><strong>Pete Corke</strong> illustrated how our current economic system is fundamentally designed for extraction, treating the preservation of natural systems like living forests as liabilities rather than assets. </p><p>This is driven by debt-based financial systems, which perpetuate a growth imperative that incentivizes destruction. A regenerative approach flips this formula: <strong>by purchasing extraction rights and converting them into regenerative assets, we can design systems that hold and protect the value of nature</strong>.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/11.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/11/11.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/11/11.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/11/11.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/11.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💡</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: Transforming extraction into regeneration requires financial systems that value and protect living ecosystems.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune in to Pete's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6f2on7Yvk5Ywe2iHqFzOT2?si=8k-IO2PBTbi2uWGiaTu2tQ&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000673863714&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://youtu.be/GpkKQcKhMW0?si=BRgbsRPmhgswL-Sc&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h3 id="%F0%9F%A7%A0-we-need-to-balance-logic-and-context-in-investing"> 🧠 We need to balance logic and context in investing</h3><p><strong>Ebru Kaya</strong> highlighted that regenerative investing goes beyond traditional impact investing by integrating deeper systemic principles. It starts with understanding the essence of a business, its entrepreneur, and the local context to ensure alignment with the ecosystem’s unique potential. This approach emphasizes <em>citizenship</em>—nurturing the environment and recognizing that thriving ecosystems enable flourishing businesses.</p><p>Regenerative investing also seeks a balance between left-hemisphere logic—focused on analysis and efficiency—and right-hemisphere thinking, which values context, relationships, and holistic understanding. <strong>Blending assertive (competitive) and integrative (collaborative) tendencies aligns financial strategies with the living systems of nature. </strong></p><p>The result is investments that not only deliver financial returns but also foster harmony, regeneration, and thriving ecosystems.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/12.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/11/12.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/11/12.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/11/12.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/12.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💸</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: Regenerative investing thrives on interconnectedness, balancing competitive and collaborative forces to nurture life.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune in to Ebru's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6Snf48IIW7E2lC7UNGPVIy?si=7ed9d8ed88214d5b&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NA8jhOT24Yo&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h3 id="%F0%9F%93%A1-technology-is-powerless-unless-it-meets-communities-where-they-are">📡 <strong>Technology is powerless unless it meets communities where they are</strong></h3><p><strong>Kennedy Ng’ang’a</strong> emphasized that technology is most impactful when it is grounded in local realities and designed to give communities control over its use. <strong>Tools like blockchain and satellite data can measure ecological contributions such as reforestation or soil health, but their effectiveness depends on being accessible and tailored to local needs.</strong></p><p>The real power of these tools lies in community ownership. When communities can shape how technologies are used and directly benefit from the outcomes, they become active drivers of regeneration, creating lasting impact and fostering a deeper connection to the ecosystems they depend on.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/9.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/11/9.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/11/9.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/11/9.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/9.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌍</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: Local ownership of technology ensures its alignment with the unique needs of communities and ecosystems.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune in to Kennedy's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/1xULBLtfvGwRZTZBR821Dd?si=a211c0ba9bfa4ff5&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dmrv-innovation-for-climate-resilience-with-kennedy/id1609683147?i=1000675632018&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pYGIisTysUE&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h3 id="%F0%9F%8C%89-building-bridges-matters-not-burning-them">🌉 <strong>Building bridges matters, not burning them</strong></h3><p><strong>Azeem Kha</strong>n emphasized that Web3’s ability to realize its potential lies in building bridges between traditional systems and decentralized innovation, rather than disrupting for the sake of change. <strong>By combining established methods with emerging technologies, Web3 can align incentives to create ecosystems where financial success drives social impact.</strong></p><p>Sustainable progress depends on systems that actively regenerate resources and reward collaboration, shifting away from reliance on charity or speculation. To achieve this, we must focus on developing mechanisms that embed such principles.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/10.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/11/10.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/11/10.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/11/10.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/11/10.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌿</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: Regenerative systems thrive when new tools enhance established practices, blending innovation with what’s proven to work.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune in to Azeem's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/2LrJ9sNKLA4tZl1lRhbSHC?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000676508872&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F_Uqmy6lqJs&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h2 id="%F0%9F%91%80-what%E2%80%99s-next"><strong>👀 What’s Next?</strong></h2><p>In the third miniseries, <strong><em>“The Tools: How can technological advances enhance and scale regenerative vision?”</em></strong> we’ll explore how emerging technologies like blockchain, satellite data, and Web3 tools are being used to drive regeneration.</p><p>This series will focus on practical examples of how technology can support ecological restoration, empower communities, and align financial systems with regeneration. We’ll look at how these tools can measure impact, bridge traditional systems with decentralized innovation, and create meaningful change at scale.</p><p>Join us as we unpack how technology is being used effectively to support a regenerative future and hear from those making it happen. Stay tuned! 🚀</p><p><strong>🎧 Listen to Season 4 now on your favorite platform:</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/show/5RTHF6JVgQL1cgaVfvi7cv" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147" rel="noreferrer">Apple Podcasts</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I63gGjNv2Ag&amp;list=PLArKB4hKFyGHwsAl-AntG1qc2cswK08Bw" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h2 id="%F0%9F%99%8F-support-us">🙏 Support Us </h2><p>Help us grow the <a href="https://x.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><strong>ReFi Podcast</strong></a> and reach even more listeners! You can directly support our work by <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">contributing on Giveth</a> or simply <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> to fuel the journey. Your support, no matter how small, makes a big impact. 🙌</p><p>Thank you for being part of this journey toward a regenerative future! 💜</p>

item.title: Regenerative Technology With Jessica Groopman & Danielle Lanyard | S4E9 💚🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="can-we-align-innovation-with-the-principles-of-living-systems">Can we align innovation with the principles of living systems?</h3><p>In Episode 9 of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jessicagroopman" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Jessica Groopman</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dlanyard" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Danielle Lanyard</strong></a>, co-founders of the <a href="https://www.regentech.co/" rel="noreferrer">Regenerative Technology Project</a>, for a thought-provoking conversation about how technology can align with living systems. This episode marks the start of our third miniseries, an exploration of <strong>how technological advancements</strong> can scale regeneration. </p><p>Jessica and Danielle discuss why the tech industry, despite its push for innovation, <strong>remains stuck in extractive, short-term models </strong>that prioritize profit over ecological and social well-being. They challenge this by grounding technology in living systems principles—<strong>interdependence, circularity, and fairness.</strong> This vision reimagines tools as drivers of regeneration, capable of restoring ecosystems, revitalizing local economies, and fostering inclusive collaboration.</p><p>But what does this look like in practice? 🤔</p><p>Jessica and Danielle highlight projects like <a href="https://materiom.org" rel="noreferrer">Materiom</a>, which uses machine learning to accelerate bio-based material innovation while avoiding over-extraction, and <a href="https://fairbnb.coop/" rel="noreferrer">FairBnB</a>, a cooperative platform that reinvests 50% of its fees into local communities. Blockchain-based eco-credit systems, like those from <a href="https://www.regen.network/" rel="noreferrer">Regen Network</a>, demonstrate how tech can drive ecosystem restoration and incentivize caretakers through localized collaboration.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🖥️</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">"The predominant </em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">business model of the digital economy is still surveillance and extraction</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">, and it’s fundamentally at odds with regeneration."</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/BQYeNtxzor4?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Regenerative Technology with Jessica Groopman &amp; Danielle Lanyard | S4E9: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 9 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Redefining technology’s purpose</strong>: Moving beyond centralized, top-down solutions to tools that adapt to local needs, foster collaboration, and reflect the interconnectedness of living systems.</li><li><strong>Barriers to transformation</strong>: Exploring challenges like short-term financial incentives, the dominance of techno-solutionism, and the cultural inertia of the tech industry.</li><li><strong>Learning from nature’s systems</strong>: How natural principles like feedback loops, localized flows, and adaptability can inspire more regenerative innovation.</li><li><strong>Practical examples of regeneration</strong>: Real-world projects that are already embedding these principles into design, offering glimpses of a future where technology supports life instead of depleting it.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 9</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/12QDlRIe0ZCbyZkGDqab0O?si=4eb48663f1d74296" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/regenerative-technology-with-jessica-groopman-danielle/id1609683147?i=1000678182878" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQYeNtxzor4" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p>And don’t forget! We’re hosting a<strong> live discussion on Episode 9 this Friday, Nov 29, at 11 AM ET! 🎙️</strong> Share your thoughts and dive deeper into the world of regenerative finance with us. 🌿</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1yoKMyjbwWDKQ">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1yoKMyjbwWDKQ</a></p><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: Embedding Culture Into Tech With Constanza Gomez Mont | S4E10 🏞️🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="what-if-technology-was-built-with-communities-not-on-them">What if technology was built <em>with </em>communities, not <em>on </em>them?</h3><p>In Episode 10 of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/constanzagomezmont" rel="noreferrer">Constanza Gomez Mont</a>, founder of <a href="https://es.cminds.co/constanzagomezmont" rel="noreferrer">C Minds</a>, a Latin American action tank advancing ethical AI. Constanza challenges the conventional mindset around technology, arguing that we’ve been using it to extract and control rather than regenerate. Technology, she believes, <strong>can either exploit or transform</strong>—depending on how we design and deploy it.</p><p>A key theme Constanza emphasizes is the need for<strong> cultural relevance in tech solutions</strong>. She talks about how, in Latin America, for example, where many traditional ways of life are deeply connected to the land, <strong>technology must be designed with local knowledge and context</strong>. This means rejecting the top-down, one-size-fits-all approach and instead creating systems that are built&nbsp;<em>with</em>&nbsp;communities, not&nbsp;<em>on</em>&nbsp;them.</p><p>For Constanza, regenerative systems are not only about sustainability—they’re about healing the land and empowering communities that have been <strong>left out of technological benefits</strong>. AI, machine learning, and blockchain, she argues, should be tools that reconnect communities with the land rather than extracting value from them. For example, AI can be used to create eco-friendly materials, and blockchain can track land stewardship and fairly compensate those working to restore ecosystems.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🤖</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">"When you start to think less about efficiency of AI and </em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">more of what value AI is creating</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">, you start to ask other type of questions."</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/jb6QSvEH44o?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Embedding Culture into Tech with Constanza Gomez Mont | S4E10: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 10 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Rethinking technology's role</strong>: Moving from efficiency-driven, extractive models to technology that regenerates ecosystems, empowers communities, and restores balance with nature.</li><li><strong>Cultural relevance in tech</strong>: Designing technology with local communities, leveraging their knowledge, and creating solutions that address their unique needs, especially in regions like Latin America.</li><li><strong>AI and blockchain for regeneration</strong>: Using AI to create sustainable materials and blockchain to track and reward ecosystem restoration, ensuring fair compensation for those caring for the land.</li><li><strong>Overcoming barriers to transformation</strong>: Tackling challenges such as short-term financial incentives, techno-solutionism, and the industry's resistance to shifting toward long-term, regenerative goals.</li><li><strong>Tech as a tool for healing</strong>: Viewing technology not as a force of extraction but as a means to reconnect people with the land and create sustainable, community-driven systems.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 10</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/3AcuS6B2wQZRFKbm6DbFvp?si=b71bd21ae9e84f9e" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/embedding-culture-into-tech-with-constanza-gomez-mont/id1609683147?i=1000678929685" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jb6QSvEH44o" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p>And don’t forget! We’re hosting a<strong> live discussion on Episode 10 this Friday, December 6, at 11 AM ET! 🎙️</strong> Share your thoughts and dive deeper into the world of regenerative finance with us. 🌿</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1nAJEpzoENeGL">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1nAJEpzoENeGL</a></p><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: Nature As Technology With Anna Lerner | S4E11 ⛰️🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="what-does-it-take-to-make-climate-finance-more-transparent-and-equitable">What does it take to make climate finance more transparent and equitable?</h3><p>In Episode 11 of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/anna-lerner-nesbitt-0569111" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Anna Lerner Nesbitt</strong></a>, CEO of <a href="https://climatecollective.org/" rel="noreferrer">Climate Collective</a>, a community of companies, labs and investors digitizing natural assets and climate solutions for large-scale climate impact. Drawing from her roles at the World Bank and Meta, Anna offers insights into the systemic challenges and opportunities within climate finance and technology.</p><p>Anna highlights that a <strong>significant portion of global climate finance remains tied to subsidies that harm ecosystems </strong>or comes with restrictive conditions, limiting its effectiveness. “We need to rethink how funding flows—redirecting harmful subsidies and designing mechanisms that prioritize measurable outcomes,” she says. She points to blockchain-backed biodiversity credits, such as those developed by Region Network and Terrasos, as a way to ensure verifiable conservation impacts through<strong> transparent, immutable data systems.</strong></p><p>While these innovations show promise, she<strong> critiques the broader industry’s reliance on technological solutions that often overlook local realities</strong>. She emphasizes that systems must integrate<strong> cultural relevance and governance structures</strong> to succeed. AI, she explains, holds great potential for scaling climate action, particularly in providing real-time monitoring of deforestation and ecosystem health. However, she stresses that these tools should enhance, not replace, local stewardship. </p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🤝</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">There’s so much</em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"> techno-enthusiasm </strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">where people go into communities thinking they have the solution, </em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">but they lack understanding </strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">of governance structures or how to safely manage data related to indigenous or local communities. </em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/hCT-undpnqU?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Nature as Technology with Anna Lerner | S4E11: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 11 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Fixing accountability at COP summits:</strong> Anna critiques the lack of follow-through at COP summits, calling for systems like blockchain to track climate pledges, ensure transparency, and drive measurable outcomes.</li><li><strong>Biodiversity credit markets for restoration:</strong> Emerging markets backed by blockchain are enabling industries to invest in nature-based solutions, bridging the gap between corporate commitments and tangible ecosystem restoration efforts.</li><li><strong>Blockchain-powered climate equity:</strong> Initiatives like Savimbo are using blockchain to create transparent payment systems for Indigenous communities, ensuring fair compensation for ecosystem restoration and addressing barriers like exclusion from formal banking systems.</li><li><strong>Indigenous-led innovation in technology:</strong> Collaborative efforts focus on integrating traditional ecological knowledge into technological solutions while ensuring data sovereignty and non-exploitative practices, setting new ethical standards.</li><li><strong>AI for measurable conservation:</strong> Projects like GainForest leverage AI, drones, and satellite imagery to provide real-time data on biodiversity and forest health, enabling actionable insights and scalable solutions for conservation.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 11</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6vuAx0w26V2jZCUV3ZOVrl" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000679769431" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCT-undpnqU" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p>And don’t forget! We’re hosting a<strong> live discussion on Episode 11 this Friday, December 13, at 11 AM ET! 🎙️</strong> Share your thoughts and dive deeper into the world of regenerative finance with us. 🌿</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1lDxLloegPbxm">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1lDxLloegPbxm</a></p><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: Web3 for Climate Action With Wes Geisenberger | S4E12 🌐🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="what-is-the-state-of-blockchain-adoption-in-climate-action">What is the state of blockchain adoption in climate action?</h3><p>In Episode 12, the final episode of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/wesgeisenberger" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Wes Geisenberger</strong></a>, Vice President of Sustainability &amp; ESG at the <a href="https://www.hbarfoundation.org/" rel="noreferrer">HBAR Foundation</a>. As part of the Hedera ecosystem, the HBAR Foundation supports innovations that aim to solve systemic challenges in sustainability and climate finance, from emissions tracking to biodiversity conservation.</p><p>Drawing on his experience at COP29, Wes highlights the <strong>growing recognition of blockchain’s potential in climate efforts</strong>—specifically in creating transparent carbon markets and ensuring accountability across stakeholders. But he’s clear that the real challenge isn’t just about building better tools; it’s about addressing issues like <strong>governance, capacity building, and accessibility to make these tools effective for everyone</strong>, from large institutions to local communities.</p><p>Wes also offers a reality check for the ReFi space. While blockchain has often been associated with tokenization and financialization, he argues that <strong>the focus is shifting to the data and systems behind these assets.</strong> For Wes, it’s not just about making financial tools easier to use but about creating frameworks that allow meaningful collaboration—whether it’s between governments under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement or corporations tracking their emissions in supply chains.</p><p>This episode is a call to rethink how we approach climate finance: not by chasing quick wins, but by <strong>building tools and frameworks that foster long-term impact and inclusion.</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🔍</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">"ReFi still exists, but I think a lot of folks have moved on from the branding because it was so focused on the financialization of assets. What I see happening is a shift as the industry becomes more mature—from financialization to data."</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/OQeshfOWdOw?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Web3 for Climate Action with Wes Geisenberger | S4E12: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from Episode 12 include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Reframing accountability in global climate finance:</strong> Traditional climate frameworks often lack mechanisms to enforce integrity. Wes explains how blockchain can go beyond tracking pledges to digitizing methodologies, automating validation, and enabling real-time transparency. The Hedera Guardian shows how these systems can help close gaps in trust.</li><li><strong>The missing piece in carbon markets: scalable methodologies:</strong> Carbon markets rely on solving issues like validation bottlenecks and inconsistent standards to scale effectively. Wes highlights how digitized, open-source methodologies can drive faster adoption, better standardization, and improved traceability, making carbon credits more practical and reliable.</li><li><strong>Shifting ReFi’s focus to systems, not assets:</strong> ReFi’s early focus on tokenization has limited its ability to scale. Wes calls for a move toward systemic innovation, where blockchain strengthens the infrastructure and data systems needed for meaningful collaboration across governments, corporations, and communities.</li><li><strong>Interoperability isn’t just technical—it’s systemic:</strong> Wes emphasizes that interoperability must address governance and methodology alignment. Tools like the Hedera Guardian can support cross-border collaboration by linking Article 6 compliance with voluntary carbon markets, enabling systems where data flows smoothly while addressing both global and local needs.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode 12</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/5cpXhk9ECMEbcwV8w2Aczc" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000681461647" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQeshfOWdOw" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. 💜</p>

item.title: ReFi DAO Wrapped 2024 & Whats Next?
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p><em>Hello ReFi family, </em><a href="https://linktr.ee/montybryant" rel="noreferrer"><em>Monty Merlin</em></a><em> here. As 2024 comes to a close, I’ve been reflecting on the journey we’ve embarked on this year at ReFi DAO and as part of the broader regenerative finance movement. The challenges we’ve faced, the milestones we’ve achieved, and the seeds we’re planting for the future. For me, 2024 has been a year of new beginnings, new relationships, and new foundations, setting the stage for what could be the most impactful chapter yet.</em></p><p><em>In this article, I want to share ReFi DAO’s story from the past year—our successes, our learnings, and our vision for whats next. Whether you’re new to ReFi or have been part of this movement from the beginning, I hope this retrospective offers inspiration and clarity as we collectively work toward a regenerative future.</em></p><p><em>Let’s dive in.</em></p><hr><h1 id="1-%E2%80%94-setting-the-scene">1 — Setting the Scene</h1><p>Founded in January 2021 during the early days of the Regenerative Finance (ReFi) movement, ReFi DAO emerged amid a wave of excitement, energy, and funding, and fuelled by a booming crypto market. At the time, ReFi was just beginning to gain traction as a movement, and ReFi DAO played a foundational role in supporting its development through initiatives like the <strong>ReFi Podcast</strong>, <strong>ReFi Blog</strong>, and <strong>Founders Circles</strong>.</p><p>Since those early days, ReFi DAO has grown into a cornerstone of regenerative finance public goods:</p><ul><li><strong>Nearly 100,000 downloads</strong> of the <a href="https://open.spotify.com/show/5RTHF6JVgQL1cgaVfvi7cv">ReFi Podcast</a>.</li><li><strong>100+ events supported in 58 cities worldwide</strong>, uniting regenerative communities.</li><li><strong>200+ articles and knowledge resources</strong> published on the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/">ReFi DAO Blog</a>.</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>ReFi DAO 1.0 reached a turning point in 2023 with the launch of the <strong>ReFi Local Node Network</strong>, a decentralized ecosystem of autonomous communities innovating on localized regenerative solutions. While this was a key milestone, 2023 also marked a challenging year. The <strong>bear market</strong> hit hard, depleting funding across the ecosystem. Despite efforts to secure new financial support, critical proposals fell through and ReFi DAO’s core team disbanded. Our future was uncertain.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-Local-Nodes-2023.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/A-challenging-time-1.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/A-challenging-time-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/A-challenging-time-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/A-challenging-time-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/A-challenging-time-1.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><h3 id="new-seeds-at-refi-week">New Seeds at ReFi Week</h3><p>Amid this uncertainty, <strong>ReFi Week</strong> at the Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) became a defining moment for ReFi DAO’s next chapter. During the gathering, <a href="__GHOST_URL__/a-leadership-transition-at-refi-dao-paving-the-way-for-new-growth/" rel="noreferrer">John Dass and Daryl Edwards announced their departures from leadership</a>, and John hosted a <a href="https://blog.maptio.com/taking-over-from-a-founder-ceo-why-it-goes-wrong-and-how-to-get-it-right-c424e7821f37">Source Transfer Ceremony</a> to symbolize the passing of core stewardship.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/a-leadership-transition-at-refi-dao-paving-the-way-for-new-growth/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">A Leadership Transition at ReFi DAO: Paving The Way for New Growth</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">I am super excited to announce a major milestone in ReFi DAO’s evolution as an organization: both Daryl Edwards and I are stepping down from leadership to pave the way for the next generation of leaders at ReFi DAO. After nearly two years of service, we will be shifting</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/icon/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO-2.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">John Dass</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/thumbnail/leadership-transition-1.jpg" alt="" onerror="this.style.display = 'none'"></div></a></figure><p>The week went on to be a key moment of collective renewal. Over 40 participants came together in a spirit of co-creation, collaboration, and envisioning a new path forward for ReFi DAO. Through these conversations and shared efforts, the <strong>ReFi DAO-ification Working Group</strong> was formed, tasked with reimagining and laying the groundwork for the next evolution of the organization.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-Week-1.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-Week-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-Week-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-Week-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-Week-1.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-Week-with-ReFi-DAO-1.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-Week-with-ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-Week-with-ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-Week-with-ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-Week-with-ReFi-DAO-1.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-ification-Working-Group.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-ification-Working-Group.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-ification-Working-Group.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-ification-Working-Group.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-ification-Working-Group.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>This pivotal gathering planted the seeds for what will become ‘ReFi DAO 2.0’…</p><hr><h1 id="2-%E2%80%94-a-new-chapter-in-2024">2 — A New Chapter in 2024</h1><p>2024 has been a year of forging new relationships, partnerships, and initiatives to support the regenerative finance movement. While the journey has required significant focus and effort, these new initiatives are creating a stronger foundation for ReFi DAO’s future.</p><p>Let’s take a closer look at some of the key highlights from this transformative year.</p><h2 id="refi-dao-x-carbon-copy">ReFi DAO x Carbon Copy</h2><p>In collaboration with ReFi DAO, <a href="https://carboncopy.news/">Carbon Copy</a> published the <strong>State of ReFi 2024 Report</strong>, providing a comprehensive overview of the top projects, trends, and narratives shaping the ReFi space. Building on this partnership, we’ve launched <strong>ReFi Recap</strong> promoted through ReFi DAO channels. This is a weekly series sharing curated insights, news, and updates from across the ecosystem. Remember the <a href="__GHOST_URL__/tag/roundup/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Roundup</a> anyone?</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="https://mirror.xyz/refidao.eth/773-LX8Jl5-Snk4lRVABzJTNXjnPgVcHjglPcvdInZY"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">Breaking Down “The State of ReFi” 2024 Report</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">Regenerative economics, inspired by the work of John Fullerton, Herman Daly, and others, suggests our economy is a living system that can nurture our planet if implemented in the way. With the rise of web3, this concept has found new ground, leading to the birth of regenerative finance (ReFi). While still relatively new, ReFi has become a lively space filled with many projects, approaches, and actors looking to build more sustainable and inclusive economies.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/icon/favicon-1.ico" alt=""></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/thumbnail/xfiTVwUgEDtxLZ7VvUk0O.png" alt="" onerror="this.style.display = 'none'"></div></a></figure><h2 id="local-node-incubator-beta-cohort">Local Node Incubator: Beta Cohort</h2><p>The <strong>ReFi Local Node Incubator </strong>was a program designed to empower communities worldwide to spearhead regenerative finance efforts tailored to their local needs. Led by Scott Morris and Anna Kaic, during <strong>13 sessions</strong> and over<strong> 100 participants</strong>, the program brought together aspiring and established local nodes to explore the theory and practice of regenerative finance.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div class="kg-gallery-row"><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-Node-Beta-Cohort---Incubator-3.jpg" width="2000" height="1125" loading="lazy" alt="" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-Node-Beta-Cohort---Incubator-3.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-Node-Beta-Cohort---Incubator-3.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></div><div class="kg-gallery-image"><img 720px) 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>The conclusion of this program also marked a new chapter for Anna Kaic, who transitioned to an exciting role with General Magic as Grants Manager. Anna’s leadership and dedication have been instrumental to ReFi DAO over the years, and her impact will continue to shape its journey in the years to come.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/local-node-incubator/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">🌱 Local Node Incubator - Beta Cohort Retrospective!</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">The ReFi Local Node Beta Incubator has empowered a new cohort of local nodes to spearhead regenerative finance efforts in their communities. As we celebrate their progress and look ahead, our dedication to fostering systemic change and sustainable impact continues to grow.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/icon/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO-3.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Anna Kaic</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/thumbnail/2059.png" alt="" onerror="this.style.display = 'none'"></div></a></figure><h2 id="refi-podcast-season-4">ReFi Podcast Season 4</h2><p>Taking over from John Dass, Season 4 of the <strong>ReFi Podcast</strong> introduced new hosts, Maya and Tereza, who have brought exciting new energy and vision to the series. This season has featured an incredible lineup of guests, diving into some of the foundational topics, ideas and leaders shaping the ReFi movement.</p><p>Key stats from Season 4 so far include:</p><ul><li><strong>11 episodes</strong>, accompanied by <strong>13 blog posts</strong> and <strong>41 YouTube shorts</strong>.</li><li><strong>23,826 plays</strong> on Apple Podcasts and Spotify in just the last 90 days.</li><li><strong>57 collectors</strong> on <a href="https://pods.media/refi-podcast" rel="noreferrer">Pods.media</a>, reflecting growing engagement in the class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-EBF.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125"
