Much more to come!</p><h2 id="octant-epoch-6-an-eoy-community-win">Octant Epoch 6: An EOY Community Win!</h2><p>During the end of 2024, ReFi DAO was shortlisted for <strong>Octant Epoch 6</strong>, joining a competitive cohort of 47 projects vying for funding to advance their missions. Through the collective efforts of our global community, <strong>ReFi DAO ranked 12th</strong> in the Snapshot voting phase, securing a place in the Allocation Window starting January 2025. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who supported us in this process!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-in-Octant-Epoch-6.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-in-Octant-Epoch-6.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-in-Octant-Epoch-6.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-in-Octant-Epoch-6.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-in-Octant-Epoch-6.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>If you haven’t yet already, now could be the perfect time to <strong>buy and lock some GLM in the Octant app</strong>. Doing so will enable you to participate in the governance of future Octant Epochs and initiatives. With some potential exciting opportunities for Regens on the horizon in 2025, this is your chance to help shape what’s next for the regenerative finance movement. 👀</p><h2 id="state-of-the-network-research-2024">State of the Network Research 2024</h2><p>In 2024, ReFi DAO conducted an extensive <strong>State of the Network Research</strong> project to assess the progress, challenges, and needs of Local Nodes across the globe. The research culminated in two key reports:</p><ul><li><strong>Successes, Core Activities, and Insights Report:</strong> Highlighting the achievements, best practices, and primary activities of Local Nodes, showcasing their impact on the ReFi movement.</li><li><strong>Challenges, Support, and Recommendations Report:</strong> Exploring common challenges faced by nodes, evaluating the support provided by ReFi DAO, and presenting actionable recommendations to strengthen the network.</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://refi-dao.notion.site/ReFi-DAO-2024-State-of-the-Network-Research-15ebf304370a801587f1c8d8b900da73?pvs=4" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore Reports</a></div><p>The insights from this research are already shaping ReFi DAO’s strategic direction for 2025, ensuring our initiatives align with the needs of the Local Nodes and the broader ecosystem. By responding to these findings, ReFi DAO is poised to provide even more effective support for communities driving regeneration at the ground level.</p><h2 id="refi-dao-holiday-lotto-join-the-fun">ReFi DAO Holiday Lotto: Join the Fun!</h2><p>Before we get into 2025, here’s a festive way to celebrate the season and support the regenerative finance movement: the <strong>ReFi DAO Holiday Lotto</strong>!</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/image.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1008" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/image.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/image.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>🎅 Kickstarted with $200 from <strong>Glo Dollar</strong> and <strong>ReFi DAO Global</strong>, the prize pool grows with every ticket sold. If no lucky numbers are drawn on Christmas Eve, the winnings are split evenly among all ticket holders.</p><p>🎟 <strong>Tickets are $10 USDGLO via the Base Network</strong>—you can bridge or swap tokens easily at <a href="https://jumper.exchange/">Jumper Exchange</a>. Every ticket sale helps fuel ReFi DAO Global initiatives or supports the ReFi Podcast, meaning your contribution goes straight back into building a regenerative future.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://refidao-lottopgf.vercel.app/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Enter the Lotto!</a></div><p>This is just the beginning—stay tuned for more LottoPGF experiments in 2025!</p><h1 id="3-%E2%80%94-2025-what%E2%80%99s-next">3 — 2025: What’s Next?</h1><p>2025 is poised to be a breakthrough year, with a number of ambitious initiatives on the horizon that will build on the foundations laid in 2024. Let’s take a look at some of the key milestones and plans for the year ahead.</p><h2 id="key-milestone-1-impact-data-commons">Key Milestone 1: Impact Data Commons</h2><p>In 2025, ReFi DAO &amp; Regen Coordination will launch the <strong>Impact Data Commons</strong>, a scalable system for tracking, verifying, and reporting impact across the ecosystem. By leveraging emerging standards like the <a href="https://www.commonapproach.org/common-impact-data-standard">Common Impact Data Standard (CIDS)</a> and integrating Web3 tools, this initiative aims to enhance transparency, accountability and effectiveness of impact measurement and reporting. Collaborations with organizations like&nbsp;<strong>MetaGov</strong>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<strong>DAOStar</strong>&nbsp;aim to position this as a&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.daostar.org/DAOIP/1">DAOIP standard</a>, embedding it into the Web3 ecosystem.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2025---Impact-Onchain.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2025---Impact-Onchain.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2025---Impact-Onchain.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2025---Impact-Onchain.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2025---Impact-Onchain.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Kicking off this initiative will be the <strong>Regen Coordination Retro &amp; Pilot Cohort</strong>, a collaborative learning journey designed to co-create and refine these frameworks alongside a curated selection of participating projects. Workshops, experiments, and shared learning sessions will explore and co-create how best to integrate these tools and frameworks into unique contexts. The pilot cohort will culminate in a planned <strong>GG23 Regen Coordination Retro Round</strong>, allocating $60,000 in retroactive rewards based on the verified impact data collected. Together, this collaborative effort will lay the foundation for scalable, data-driven coordination across the regenerative movement.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Regen-Coordination-Retro---Pilot-Cohort.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Regen-Coordination-Retro---Pilot-Cohort.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Regen-Coordination-Retro---Pilot-Cohort.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Regen-Coordination-Retro---Pilot-Cohort.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Regen-Coordination-Retro---Pilot-Cohort.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="key-milestone-2-%E2%80%94-local-refi-toolkit">Key Milestone 2 — Local ReFi Toolkit</h2><p>In 2025, ReFi DAO will evolve the <a href="https://www.notion.so/Local-Node-Toolkit-1000a8af4ed94c11806f5e9991499355?pvs=21">ReFi Local Node Toolkit V1</a> into the <strong>Regen Coordination Local ReFi Toolkit</strong>, expanding its scope to serve both the Local Node Network and the broader Regen Coordination ecosystem. This updated resource will incorporate contributions from allied networks like GreenPill Chapters, Celo Regional Hubs, and the BioFi Project, offering a shared repository of playbooks, guides, and tools. To further enhance the toolkit, a bounties program will encourage community contributions, ensuring localized resources and refinements. This initiative will empower communities and accelerate the adoption of regenerative solutions worldwide.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-ReFi-Toolkit.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-ReFi-Toolkit.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-ReFi-Toolkit.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-ReFi-Toolkit.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Local-ReFi-Toolkit.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="key-milestone-3-prosperity-passport">Key Milestone 3: Prosperity Passport</h2><p>In 2025, ReFi DAO will continue its partnership with&nbsp;<strong>Celo Public Goods (CeloPG)</strong>&nbsp;to advance the&nbsp;<strong>Prosperity Passport</strong>, an innovative platform for on-chain identity and reputation within the ReFi movement. Launching in January 2025, the Prosperity Passport will feature a variety of Celo and ReFi related badges, including the&nbsp;<strong>ReFi DAO Badge</strong>, an on-chain credential recognizing key contributors to ReFi DAO’s mission, including podcast guests, blog writers, event attendees, core stewards, and Local Node leaders.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---Prosperity-Passport.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---Prosperity-Passport.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---Prosperity-Passport.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---Prosperity-Passport.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO---Prosperity-Passport.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Ultimately, the further development of this tool could see it become central to ReFi DAO’s 2025 strategy. Imagine being able to aggregate the on-chain ReFi contributions and impacts of all members in an entire bioregion. Imagine how resources could flow seamlessly to local nodes and bioregions with the highest verifiable on-chain impact and contributions.</p><h2 id="key-milestone-4-refi-dao-20">Key Milestone 4: ReFi DAO 2.0</h2><p>The full launch of <strong>ReFi DAO 2.0</strong> in 2025 will mark a transformative evolution for ReFi DAO, designed to enhance its coordination, governance, and capacity to drive the regenerative finance movement forward. This milestone is about building the next generation of infrastructure, tools, and frameworks to empower a growing global network of regens and regenerative communities.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2.0.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2.0.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-2.0.jpg 1000w, core, ReFi DAO 2.0 aims to deliver:</p><ul><li><strong>Identity and Reputation Systems</strong>: Tools like the Prosperity Passport and ReFi DAO Points will form the backbone of contribution recognition and collaboration across the ecosystem, rewarding participation while creating new pathways for governance and resource allocation.</li><li><strong>Impact Tracking Frameworks</strong>: Initiatives like the Impact Data Commons will provide robust systems for measuring and verifying impact, enabling transparent, data-driven decision-making at scale.</li><li><strong>Governance and Legal Structures</strong>: Foundational documents, such as the ReFi DAO Constitution and Local Node Charter, will formalize relationships, values, and shared principles across the network, enhancing accountability and coherence.</li><li><strong>Advanced Tooling</strong>: Platforms like Guild.xyz for community onboarding, Hats Protocol for role management, and Gardens.fund for experimentation with community conviction voting will streamline collaboration and decision-making across the DAO.</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-gallery-card kg-width-wide"><div class="kg-gallery-container"><div 720px"></div></div></div></figure><p>The rollout of ReFi DAO 2.0 will be guided by a collaborative and iterative process, with community participation playing a central role. Workshops, feedback sessions, and pilot programs will ensure the tools and systems developed are reflective of the diverse needs of the community.</p><h2 id="building-the-refi-network-nation">Building the ReFi Network Nation</h2><p>Altogether, these milestones will further strengthen ReFi DAO as a <strong>Network Nation</strong>—a global ecosystem of decentralized communities and initiatives united by shared values and a common mission. This network will enable resources to flow to the places and people creating the most measurable impact, ensuring that regeneration happens from the ground up.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Network-Nation-1.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Network-Nation-1.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Network-Nation-1.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Network-Nation-1.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/ReFi-DAO-Network-Nation-1.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/Regen-Coordiation-Impact-Data-Commons-3.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/Regen-Coordiation-Impact-Data-Commons-3.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/Regen-Coordiation-Impact-Data-Commons-3.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/Regen-Coordiation-Impact-Data-Commons-3.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/Regen-Coordiation-Impact-Data-Commons-3.jpg 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="4-%E2%80%94-growing-together">4 — Growing Together</h1><p>The challenges we face as a planet—climate change, biodiversity loss, and social inequality—are massive. Up to <strong>$275 trillion USD</strong> is needed to address these crises by 2050. Yet within these challenges lies an unprecedented opportunity. The transition to a regenerative economy represents a chance to reshape how we steward resources, build resilient systems, and empower communities to thrive.</p><p>ReFi DAO’s work over the past year has laid some foundations for meeting these challenges. These building blocks are already enabling regeneration to happen at local and global levels, and 2025 offers the potential to scale this work even further. The work requires all of us. Whether you’re a builder, funder, or community member, there are many ways to get involved and help shape the future of this movement.</p><p>2025 could be a breakthrough year—not just for ReFi DAO, but for the regenerative finance movement as a whole. To everyone who has supported the movement, thank you. LFGrow 🌱</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-full"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2024/12/Thank-you.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1125" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2024/12/Thank-you.jpg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2024/12/Thank-you.jpg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2024/12/Thank-you.jpg 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2024/12/Thank-you.jpg 2400w"></figure>

Moving forward, I'll be publishing a new weekly roundup of key news and developments in the ReFi ecosystem - 'ReFi Recap'. </em></p><p>I hope you touched some trees during the weekend.<em> </em>Here's a recap of key happenings last week in the ReFi space, including the regen alphas you missed 👇</p><h2 id="%E2%9A%A0%EF%B8%8F-important-info">⚠️ Important Info</h2><p>If you have GLM locked, consider allocating some to <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/atlantis/" rel="noreferrer">Atlantis</a>, <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/regens-unite/" rel="noreferrer">Regens Unite</a>, and <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/refi-dao/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO</a> during the <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/octant/" rel="noreferrer">Octant</a> allocation window, which closes at 4 PM UTC on January 24, 2024.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://octant.app/home" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Octant Epoch 6 Allocation</a></div><h2 id="%F0%9F%A4%96-is-refai-the-future">🤖 Is ReFAI the future?</h2><p>The year 2025 kicked off with a surge of interest in AI agents within the ReFi sector, giving rise to what’s now known as ReFAI: Regenerative AI Finance. Leading the charge are projects like <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/refi-starter/" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Starter</a>, <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/detrash/" rel="noreferrer">Detrash</a>, and <a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/rifai-sicilia/" rel="noreferrer">RiFai Sicillia</a> along with builders like <a href="https://x.com/tmoindustries" rel="noreferrer">TMO</a>, <a href="https://x.com/regenavocado" rel="noreferrer">Regenavocado</a>, and <a href="https://x.com/owocki" rel="noreferrer">Kevin Owocki</a>. The big question remains: are AI agents delivering real-world use cases, or are we merely caught up in the hype? In the latest CARBON Copy <a href="https://paragraph.xyz/@carboncopy/is-refai-the-future" rel="noreferrer">newsletter</a>, we explore AI agents and their practical applications, particularly in simplifying crypto interfacing for ReFi.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://paragraph.xyz/@carboncopy/is-refai-the-future" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read full return<br><a href="https://x.com/solarpunkdao/status/1877585155520606541">https://x.com/solarpunkdao/status/1877585155520606541</a></li><li><a href="https://carboncopy.news/project/refi-dao/" item.title: ReFi Local Nodes Showcase 2024 ✨
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
Rica Amaral
item.content:encoded: <h2 id="a-year-of-growth-learning-and-impact"><strong>A Year of Growth, Learning, and Impact</strong></h2><p>As the regenerative finance movement continues to expand, 2024 has been a transformative year for <strong>ReFi DAO</strong> and its global network of Local Nodes. Together, these decentralized, community-driven hubs are tackling some of the world’s most pressing challenges—climate change, social inequality, and ecosystem degradation—while pioneering innovative solutions tailored to their local contexts. Across regions as varied as the Mediterranean coastline, African farmland, Latin American rainforests, and European urban hubs, these nodes exchange knowledge and inspiration, showing how a global movement can empower meaningful action on the ground.</p><p>This article offers a glimpse into the incredible work of ReFi Local Nodes, introducing the <strong>ReFi Local Node Showcase 2024 Database</strong>, insights from the <strong>State of the Network Research</strong>, and highlighting the foundational role of <strong>ReFi DAO Global</strong> in supporting this ecosystem.</p><h2 id="the-refi-local-node-showcase-2024"><strong>The ReFi Local Node Showcase 2024</strong></h2><p>Spanning continents and ecosystems, <strong>ReFi Local Nodes</strong> form a decentralized, regenerative network that addresses local challenges while contributing to a shared vision: a world where technology, community, and finance serves people and planet.</p><p>The <strong>ReFi Local Node Showcase 2024</strong> database is an interactive resource that allows you to explore the stories, activities, and visions of these pioneering communities. Whether it’s <strong>ReFi Costa Rica’s</strong> efforts to merge crypto philanthropy with grassroots activism, <strong>ReFi Barcelona’s</strong> innovative cooperative structure, or <strong>ReFi BayArea’s</strong> integration of real estate and solar energy into regenerative systems, each node offers a unique perspective on the power of localized action. Their diverse efforts span workshops, reforestation campaigns, urban regeneration projects, digital innovation, and much more—all while cultivating strong, resilient communities grounded in shared purpose and care.</p><p>Dive into the database to learn more about each node’s achievements, challenges, and future plans.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://refi-dao.notion.site/173bf304370a809cabbbf266d762d0a3?v=15a32b554deb430383de83f5c2c664ac" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">ReFi Local Node Showcase 2024</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="https://images.mirror-media.xyz/publication-images/_u6FuenFk8-P-hFF3B7DD.png?height=1576&amp;width=3095" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="3095" height="1576"></figure><h2 id="understanding-the-refi-movement-state-of-the-network-research"><strong>Understanding the ReFi Movement: State of the Network Research</strong></h2><p>As well as showcasing the achievements and plans of ReFi Local Nodes, we also went a layer deeper to fully assess key successes, challenges, and insights from across the entire global network. By interviewing and collaborating with nodes such as <strong>ReFi Costa Rica, ReFi Mexico, ReFi Lagos, ReFi Barcelona, ReFi Tanzania</strong>, and others, the research provided invaluable insights into how these communities are driving regeneration on the ground as well as the key challenges they face. This serves as a valuable resource for both established nodes seeking inspiration and new entrants eager to learn from their peers across the global network.</p><h3 id="key-successes-across-the-network"><strong>Key Successes Across the Network</strong></h3><ul><li><strong>Community Empowerment</strong>: Initiatives like <strong>Crypto Cantinas</strong> in Costa Rica and Web3 workshops in Uganda are equipping communities with the knowledge and tools to participate in the ReFi movement.</li><li><strong>Environmental Impact</strong>: Nodes such as <strong>ReFi Lagos</strong> and <strong>ReFi Sicilia</strong> have led impactful reforestation efforts, while <strong>ReFi Tanzania</strong> is addressing urban waste challenges through innovative verification and cleanup systems.</li><li><strong>Technological Innovation</strong>: Nodes are implementing and developing cutting-edge tools like Mexico’s <strong>Impact Market Maker</strong> and Lagos’ <strong>Project Osisi</strong> which are demonstrating the power of Web3 to track and scale regenerative activities transparently.</li></ul><h3 id="challenges-and-opportunities"><strong>Challenges and Opportunities</strong></h3><ul><li><strong>Funding Constraints</strong>: Many nodes rely on small grants, which limit their ability to scale. Developing sustainable revenue streams remains a priority.</li><li><strong>Contributor Retention</strong>: Maintaining long-term engagement among contributors is a shared difficulty, as many nodes operate without sufficient funding to fully compensate their teams.</li><li><strong>Technical Barriers</strong>: Accessing developers and navigating blockchain tools continue to be hurdles for several nodes, especially in emerging markets.</li></ul><p>The findings from this research are shaping ReFi DAO’s strategic direction for 2025, ensuring that Local Nodes receive the support they need to deepen their impact. For those interested in the full details, both the <strong>Successes, Core Activities, and Insights Report</strong> and the <strong>Challenges, Support, and Recommendations Report</strong> are available to explore further.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://refi-dao.notion.site/ReFi-DAO-2024-State-of-the-Network-Research-15ebf304370a801587f1c8d8b900da73?pvs=74" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Local Node Research Reports</a></div><h2 id="refi-dao-global-strengthening-the-foundation-for-regeneration"><strong>ReFi DAO Global: Strengthening the Foundation for Regeneration</strong></h2><p>While Local Nodes lead the charge on the ground, <strong>ReFi DAO Global</strong> provides resources, tools, and support to elevate their work and build global cohesion. In 2024, ReFi DAO Global played a pivotal role in advancing the regenerative finance movement through a series of transformative initiatives. Key highlights include:</p><ul><li><strong>ReFi Local Node Incubator</strong>: Empowering over 100 participants through a 13-session program designed to equip Local Nodes with the tools to drive localized regeneration.</li><li><strong>Regen Coordination Genesis</strong>: Distributing over $236,000 to grassroots communities, including Local Nodes, through innovative funding rounds.</li><li><strong>Celo Public Goods Partnership</strong>: Supporting climate-focused funding initiatives and advancing programs like the <strong>BioFi Pathfinders Round</strong> to foster bioregional finance.</li></ul><p>Looking ahead to 2025, ReFi DAO is preparing for the launch of <strong>ReFi DAO 2.0</strong>—an ambitious evolution that will enhance the governance, capacity, and infrastructure of the network. Key milestones include:</p><ul><li><strong>The Impact Data Commons</strong>: A scalable system for tracking and reporting impact across the ecosystem.</li><li><strong>The ReFi Local Node Toolkit</strong>: Expanding and refining resources to support Local Nodes and the broader regenerative community.</li><li><strong>The Prosperity Passport</strong>: An on-chain identity and reputation platform to recognize contributions and incentivize participation in the ReFi ecosystem.</li></ul><p>These efforts reflect ReFi DAO’s commitment to scaling regeneration from the ground up and ensuring that Local Nodes have the resources and support needed to thrive. To learn more about ReFi DAO’s journey this past year and its vision for the future, check out the full retrospective:</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-dao-wrapped-2024/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Read ReFi DAO Global Wrapped 2024</a></div><figure class="kg-card kg-bookmark-card"><a class="kg-bookmark-container" href="__GHOST_URL__/refi-dao-wrapped-2024/"><div class="kg-bookmark-content"><div class="kg-bookmark-title">ReFi DAO Wrapped 2024 &amp; Whats Next?</div><div class="kg-bookmark-description">ReFi DAO’s story from the past year—our successes, learnings, and ambitious visions for 2025.</div><div class="kg-bookmark-metadata"><img class="kg-bookmark-icon" src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/icon/6319c4c1d0b248c635dc4002_ReFi-DAO-6.png" alt=""><span class="kg-bookmark-author">ReFi DAO</span><span class="kg-bookmark-publisher">Monty Merlin Bryant</span></div></div><div class="kg-bookmark-thumbnail"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/thumbnail/ReFi-DAO-Wrapped-2024---Whats-Next--.jpg" alt="" onerror="this.style.display = 'none'"></div></a></figure><h2 id="get-involved"><strong>Get Involved!</strong></h2><p>2024 has been a transformative year for ReFi DAO and its global network of Local Nodes. From groundbreaking projects on the ground to the strategic support provided by ReFi DAO Global, the regenerative finance movement is gaining momentum. As we look toward 2025, the work ahead is clear: scale the successes, address the challenges, and continue building towards a regenerative economy that serves both people and the planet.</p><p>Whether you’re a seasoned participant or new to the movement, now is the time to get involved. Explore the <strong>ReFi Local Node Showcase 2024</strong>, learn from the <strong>State of the Network Research</strong>, and join ReFi DAO Global in shaping the future of regeneration. Together, we can make a lasting impact.</p><p><strong>Lets Grow 🌱</strong></p>
item.excerpt:encoded: Explore the successes, challenges, and innovations of ReFi Local Nodes in 2024 — an in-depth look at how communities worldwide are driving regeneration through Web3 and localized action.

item.title: Reflections on the Third ReFi Podcast S4 Miniseries: Tools to Scale Impact 🛠️🎙️
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <p>After taking a short break over the New Year, we’re back with reflections from the final miniseries of <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">Season 4</a><strong> on The Tools: <em>How can technological advances enhance and scale regenerative vision?</em></strong></p><p>This series explored how emerging technologies—from AI to blockchain—can support ecological restoration, empower communities, and shift financial systems toward regeneration. But a key theme emerged across the conversations: <strong>Technology alone won’t save us.</strong> The way we design and implement these tools matters just as much as the tools themselves. 🙌</p><p>Through conversations with <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jessicagroopman" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Jessica Groopman</strong></a><strong> </strong>&amp;<strong> </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dlanyard" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Danielle Lanyard</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/constanzagomezmont" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Constanza Gomez Mont</strong></a><strong>, </strong><a href="https://es.linkedin.com/in/anna-lerner-nesbitt-0569111" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Anna Lerner</strong></a>, and<strong> </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/wesgeisenberger" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Wes Geisenberger</strong></a>, we explored the tension between innovation and extraction, the risks of financializing nature, and the role of trust and collaboration in making technology work for regeneration.</p><p>Even though Season 4 has wrapped up, we’re not done yet—we have <strong><u>two special bonus episodes</u></strong> on the way and are already brainstorming for Season 5. In the meantime, <strong>we’d love your support! </strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💗</div><div class="kg-callout-text">We’re participating in the <b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Loving on Public Goods</strong></b> round on <b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Giveth</strong></b>, with a <b><strong style="white-space: pre-wrap;">$100,000 USDGLO matching pool</strong></b>. You can <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">donate directly here</a> by February 14th.</div></div><p>And now, let's dive into our learnings... 👇</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/ReFi-Podcast--24-.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/01/ReFi-Podcast--24-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/01/ReFi-Podcast--24-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/01/ReFi-Podcast--24-.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/ReFi-Podcast--24-.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="%F0%9F%92%A1-key-themes"><strong>💡 Key Themes</strong></h2><h3 id="%E2%9A%96%EF%B8%8F-technology-reflects-our-morality">⚖️ <strong> Technology Reflects Our Morality</strong></h3><p>For too long, technological progress has been treated as inevitable. But progress toward what—and at what cost? Jessica Groopman and Danielle Lanyard challenge the dominant narrative that technology is inherently good, emphasizing that it always reflects the values embedded within it.</p><p>Jessica reframes technology not as just digital tools, but as&nbsp;<strong>“the structuring of flows of materials, energy, and information to adapt and thrive.”</strong>&nbsp;The real question, then, is: Are we designing these flows to regenerate life—or to extract from it? The answer hinges on the moral and ethical choices of those who create and deploy technology.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/11.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/01/11.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/01/11.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/01/11.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/11.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Danielle, drawing from deep ecology and alternative economies, highlights that regenerative technology isn’t about efficiency—it’s about <strong>relationships, interdependence, and care</strong>. Mindfulness, she argues, is not just a personal practice; it’s an essential design principle. When we cultivate awareness, we resist the impulse to extract, optimize, and control—and instead create technology that nurtures and sustains.</p><blockquote>“I often say that my most important skill as a tech builder is my meditation practice because I know when to step away from the machine when things are not going right and just take a breath and go for a walk.” – Danielle Lanyard</blockquote><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">📱</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: </em></i>If we want technology to serve regeneration, we must embed morality, mindfulness, and care into its design. The way we engage with technology—whether with presence or with blind automation—determines whether it serves life or exploits it.</div></div><p><strong>Tune into Jessica's &amp; Danielle's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/12QDlRIe0ZCbyZkGDqab0O?si=4eb48663f1d74296&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/regenerative-technology-with-jessica-groopman-danielle/id1609683147?i=1000678182878&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQYeNtxzor4&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h3 id="%F0%9F%A7%A0-technology-serves-not-replaces-human-knowledge"> 🧠 Technology Serves, Not Replaces, Human Knowledge</h3><p>In her work leading an AI-driven jaguar conservation project, Constanza Gomez Mont found that technology alone wasn’t enough. AI could map out jaguar populations and monitor movement patterns, but it was the local communities who <strong>understood what those patterns meant, how they connected to broader ecological health, and what interventions would actually support conservation efforts.</strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/13.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/01/13.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/01/13.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/01/13.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/13.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>This reflects a broader issue in climate tech: too often, solutions are developed with a narrow focus on efficiency, sidelining the cultural and ecological expertise of the people closest to the land. </p><p>Rather than seeing technology as a replacement for traditional knowledge, Constanza’s work shows the power of combining the two—using tools like AI to enhance community-driven conservation rather than dictate it.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌳</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: AI might provide “eyes in the forest,” but without human insight, those eyes remain blind.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune into Constanza's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/3AcuS6B2wQZRFKbm6DbFvp?si=b71bd21ae9e84f9e&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/embedding-culture-into-tech-with-constanza-gomez-mont/id1609683147?i=1000678929685&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jb6QSvEH44o&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h3 id="%F0%9F%8C%BF-nature-should-be-at-the-center-of-climate-solutions">🌿 <strong>Nature Should Be at the Center of Climate Solutions</strong></h3><p>At COP16, Indigenous leaders reminded the world of a simple truth: <strong>nature itself is technology.</strong> Yet, many climate solutions continue to treat ecosystems as passive resources rather than active, intelligent systems.</p><blockquote>“You all talk about technology—nature is technology. It is the first and ultimate technology.” - Anna Lerner</blockquote><p>Anna Lerner warns against the growing tendency to rely on engineered solutions while neglecting the most powerful climate tool we already have—<strong>protecting and restoring the Earth’s natural systems.</strong> She critiques the idea that high-tech interventions like direct air capture or geoengineering should take priority over preserving forests, wetlands, and biodiversity.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/12.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/01/12.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/01/12.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/01/12.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/12.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>Instead of constantly looking to new inventions, she argues that we need to refocus on ecosystem protection and regeneration as the foundation of climate action.</p><p>Anna also challenges the current approach to climate finance, which remains stuck in <strong>political gridlock over who should pay for climate action</strong>. Instead of waiting for new climate funds, she calls for redirecting the trillions of dollars currently spent on environmentally harmful subsidies.</p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌍</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: Real climate solutions aren’t just about new technologies—they’re about reallocating existing resources, protecting what already works, and recognizing nature as the most powerful regenerative system we have.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune in to Anna's Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/6vuAx0w26V2jZCUV3ZOVrl?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000679769431&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCT-undpnqU&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h3 id="%F0%9F%A4%9D-trust-is-the-infrastructure-that-enables-regeneration">🤝 <strong>Trust Is the Infrastructure that Enables Regeneration</strong></h3><p>Wes Geisenberger points out that while tools like AI and blockchain can enhance transparency and coordination, <strong>technology alone can’t build trust—it has to be designed in ways that foster accountability, inclusion, and long-term collaboration.</strong></p><p>At COP29, Hedera played a key role in tracking carbon emissions and offsets in real time, creating a unified and tamper-proof source of truth. Instead of fragmented, unverifiable data, blockchain provided transparency across stakeholders, ensuring better accountability.</p><p>But technology’s effectiveness depends on <strong>who controls it and whose interests it serves.</strong> Wes warns that tokenizing environmental assets without community governance could become just another mechanism for top-down control.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/14.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/01/14.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/01/14.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/01/14.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/01/14.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🔎</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Takeaway</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">: Without trust and transparency, even the most advanced systems risk reinforcing existing inequalities rather than solving them.</em></i></div></div><p><strong>Tune in to Wes' Episode. 👇</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/5cpXhk9ECMEbcwV8w2Aczc?ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000681461647&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQeshfOWdOw&amp;ref=blog.refidao.com" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h2 id="%F0%9F%8C%B1-wrapping-up"><strong>🌱 Wrapping Up</strong></h2><p>Again and again, our guests reminded us:&nbsp;<strong>technology is a tool—but it’s how we use it that determines whether it regenerates or extracts, connects or fragments, redistributes power or concentrates it.</strong>&nbsp;The real impact of innovation depends on the intentions behind it, the values embedded within it, and how it integrates with the living systems we depend on.</p><p><strong>At the heart of all of this is</strong>&nbsp;<strong>empathy</strong>. When technology ignores local contexts and lived realities, it risks being irrelevant—or even harmful. But when designed with care, it can become a force for regeneration, equity, and resilience.</p><p><strong>🎧 Listen to Season 4 now on your favorite platform:</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/show/5RTHF6JVgQL1cgaVfvi7cv" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147" rel="noreferrer">Apple Podcasts</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I63gGjNv2Ag&amp;list=PLArKB4hKFyGHwsAl-AntG1qc2cswK08Bw" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><h2 id="%F0%9F%99%8F-support-us">🙏 Support Us </h2><p>Help us grow the <a href="https://x.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer"><strong>ReFi Podcast</strong></a> and reach even more listeners! You can directly support our work by <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">contributing on Giveth</a> or simply <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> to fuel the journey. Your support, no matter how small, makes a big impact. 🙌</p><p>Thank you for being part of this journey toward a regenerative future! 💜</p>

item.title: Incubating New Societies: The Rise of Pop-Up Cities with Timour Kosters │ S4 Bonus 🏙️🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="can-temporary-pop-up-cities-incubate-the-future-of-society">Can temporary pop-up cities incubate the future of society?</h3><p>In this Bonus Episode of Season 4, <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>, of the ReFi Podcast, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a> and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> welcome <a href="https://x.com/timourxyz" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Timour Kosters</strong></a>, co-founder of <a href="https://x.com/joinedgecity" rel="noreferrer">Edge City</a>, a project pioneering the <strong>pop-up city</strong>&nbsp;model. These temporary, month-long communities bring together people from&nbsp;<strong>technology, governance, science, and culture</strong>&nbsp;to test new ideas for living, collaborating, and building the future. </p><p>From&nbsp;<strong>community currencies and decentralized governance</strong>&nbsp;to&nbsp;<strong>public goods funding and real-world resilience</strong>, Edge City is testing new models of&nbsp;living, collaborating, and innovating—all in real time. </p><p>Inspired by&nbsp;<strong>Vitalik Buterin’s </strong><a href="https://www.palladiummag.com/2023/10/06/why-i-built-zuzalu/" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Zuzalu</strong></a><strong> experiment</strong>, these 1-2 months communities&nbsp;<strong>go beyond conferences</strong>&nbsp;to create a space where&nbsp;<strong>people don’t just talk about the future—they live it.</strong></p><p>While Edge City doesn’t explicitly position itself as a&nbsp;<strong>“regenerative” project</strong>, its theory of change is deeply&nbsp;<strong>aligned with regenerative principles</strong>—emphasizing&nbsp;<strong>community resilience, interdisciplinary collaboration, and self-sustaining ecosystems.</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🤝</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">“We need more spaces for this kind of thinking, for this kind of experimentation, and we need to create places where people from a lot of different fields come together. It’s not like a conference where you exchange contacts and never talk again. It’s about meaningful time with people, going deep on ideas, and actually incubating projects in a real-world setting.”</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/fD9nF1b0uuk?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="Incubating New Societies with Timour Kosters | S4Bonus: Regeneration Nexus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from the Bonus episode include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Pop-up cities are not conferences—they’re living labs.</strong>&nbsp;Unlike traditional events, Edge City provides&nbsp;<strong>deep, immersive collaboration</strong>, where attendees&nbsp;<strong>co-create governance, funding models, and social structures</strong>&nbsp;in real time.</li><li><strong>Governance, coordination, and public goods are being reimagined.</strong> Attendees experiment with<strong> local currencies, AI-assisted decision-making, and decentralized funding models</strong>&nbsp;to explore&nbsp;<strong>new ways of organizing society.</strong></li><li><strong>Edge City is not just a temporary experiment—it’s a blueprint.</strong>&nbsp;The movement is scaling, with&nbsp;<strong>upcoming pop-ups</strong>&nbsp;aiming to transition from temporary villages to&nbsp;<strong>permanent communities.</strong></li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to Episode with Timour</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/5nAK9gbjiFsMBk8KnFfbAX?si=85143d50055c4328" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fD9nF1b0uuk" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li></ul><p><strong>Thank you to everyone who has joined this journey.</strong> Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. item.title: From Green Rush to ReFi Realism with David Fortson and Sandra Ponce de Leon │ S4 Bonus 🌿🎧
item.dc:creator: Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="what-does-it-take-to-build-regenerative-projects-that-actually-sustain-themselves"><strong>What does it take to build regenerative projects that actually sustain themselves?</strong></h3><p>In this special bonus episode of the Season 4 of the <a href="https://x.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Podcast</a>, <em>Regeneration Nexus</em>, host <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer">Maya Dentzel</a> sits down with two longtime builders in the regenerative movement—<a href="https://x.com/dave_fortson" rel="noreferrer"><strong>David Fortson</strong></a>, Chief Growth Officer at <a href="https://x.com/regen_network" rel="noreferrer">Regen Network</a>, and&nbsp;<a href="https://x.com/sandramp" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Sandra Ponce de Leon</strong></a>, co-founder of <a href="https://x.com/ReFiTulum" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Tulum</a>—to ask the hard questions facing ReFi today. </p><p>We’ve come a long way since the “green rush” of 2021 and 2022, when vibes ran high and new projects launched weekly. But in 2025, <strong>the question isn’t&nbsp;<em>how</em>&nbsp;to start a ReFi project—it’s&nbsp;<em>how to keep it going</em>.</strong> In this candid conversation, David and Sandra reflect on the need to move beyond hype into grounded, long-term, financially viable regenerative work.</p><p>This episode calls for a new mindset of <strong>creative realism—a balance between idealism and discipline, experimentation and execution</strong>. This isn’t about abandoning the mission—it’s about designing systems that&nbsp;<em>last.</em></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">💪</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">“We’ve got some scarring now, a little reality check—and now it’s time to roll up our sleeves. Let’s be serious, let’s be disciplined, and let’s help each other out, and know that an incremental steady improvement is the name of the game.”</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/HdaxRx8cv5s?feature=oembed" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen="" title="From Green Rush to ReFi Realism with David Fortson and Sandra Ponce De Leon | S4 Bonus"></iframe></figure><p>Key insights from this bonus episode include... 💡</p><ul><li><strong>Sustainable regeneration requires financially viable models.</strong>&nbsp;Without clear business strategies and user traction, even the most mission-driven ReFi projects struggle to scale.</li><li><strong>Regeneration takes time</strong>. Regenerative systems don’t happen overnight—<em>“some seeds take years to bear fruit.”</em>&nbsp;While experimentation is essential, long-term thinking, patience, and ecosystem accountability are critical to meaningful impact.</li><li><strong>&nbsp;Community trust is non-negotiable</strong>. Building trust through human relationships—not just technology—is essential for lasting regenerative impact. Whether in the rainforests of Ecuador or the beaches of Tulum, regeneration begins with being present, listening, and co-creating with communities.</li><li><strong>Web3 needs to abstract itself away.</strong>&nbsp;To reach broader audiences, regenerative tools must be intuitive, accessible, and seamless—users shouldn’t need to understand blockchain to participate.</li><li><strong>Clarifying what “regen” means can strengthen the movement.</strong>&nbsp;As the space grows, there’s increasing interest in creating shared frameworks—like a Regen Brand Commons—to prevent greenwashing, foster alignment, and provide supportive infrastructure for scaling regenerative projects with integrity.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to the Bonus Episode:</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/47KHKrD0zltDtJ8h8IkP0C?si=fWVyDQ__SSeJd2OgoeXzQw" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000702566198" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HdaxRx8cv5s" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li><li><a href="https://pods.media/refi-podcast/from-green-rush-to-refi-realism-with-david-fortson-and-sandra-ponce-de-leon-s4-bonus" rel="noreferrer">Pods.media</a></li></ul><p>🎙️&nbsp;<strong>Join us for a special community Twitter Space this Friday, April 11 at 11 AM ET!</strong></p><p>We’ll be reflecting on the journey of&nbsp;<em>Regeneration Nexus</em>, sharing behind-the-scenes insights, and inviting your thoughts on where ReFi goes next. Let’s wrap the season together—your voice matters.</p><p>👉 Join the discussion on Twitter Spaces: <a href="https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1LyGBWkoZZpJN">https://twitter.com/i/spaces/1LyGBWkoZZpJN</a></p><p><strong>💜 Support Our Work</strong></p><p>The ReFi Podcast is participating in the&nbsp;<strong>Gitcoin Regen Coordination Round</strong>, and your support helps us keep producing these important conversations and sharing them with the world.</p><p>🙏&nbsp;Donate here: <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/31/28">https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/31/28</a></p><p>Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. You can also <a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer">buy us a coffee</a> or support our work directly <a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer">on Giveth</a>. <br><br>We are honored to be on this journey alongside you. </p>

item.title: Reflecting on Regeneration Nexus with Maya Dentzel and Tereza Bízková │ S4 Bonus 🌐🎧
item.dc:creator: Tereza Bizkova
Maya Dentzel
item.content:encoded: <h3 id="what-stood-out-what-still-lingers-and-what%E2%80%99s-next-for-refi"><strong>What stood out, what still lingers, and what’s next for ReFi?</strong></h3><p>In the final episode of <em>Season 4: The Regeneration Nexus </em>of the <a href="https://x.com/ReFiPodcast" rel="noreferrer">ReFi Podcast</a>, hosts <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Maya Dentzel</strong></a><strong> </strong>and <a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer"><strong>Tereza Bízková</strong></a> take a step back to reflect on everything that’s unfolded over the 15 episodes—from early questions about the meaning of regeneration to the real-world challenges of building systems that last.</p><p>For the first time, it was just the two of us on the mic (could you tell we were nervous? 😅). We looked back on the season’s three-part arc—<strong><em>Vision, Practice, and Tools</em></strong>—and talked through the moments that stayed with us, the ideas that shaped our thinking, and the patterns we kept seeing across conversations.</p><p>From building trust with communities to asking better questions about tech, from learning <strong>what “regenerative” really means</strong> in different contexts to grappling with the need for sustainable funding models—we tried to map some of the shifts we’ve noticed across the space. But we also wanted to take a beat and reflect on regeneration as something personal: <strong>how it shows up in our own lives and why that matters, too. 🧘‍♀️</strong></p><div class="kg-card kg-callout-card kg-callout-card-purple"><div class="kg-callout-emoji">🌎</div><div class="kg-callout-text"><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">"</em></i><i><b><strong class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">We first are being, then we’re doing, and then we’re having</strong></b></i><i><em class="italic" style="white-space: pre-wrap;">. But in modern society, we tend to skip the being—we jump straight into doing or wanting to have. Focusing on cultivating a state of peace and staying in touch with your higher self, not your ego self, is so important." —Maya</em></i></div></div><figure class="kg-card kg-embed-card"><iframe width="200" height="113" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/guNCjyPGmvU?list=PLArKB4hKFyGEXDFY2N8bxfiJQtrmCwMDh" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen=""></iframe></figure><p><strong>Key insights from the finale include... 💡</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Regeneration is a process, not a blueprint</strong>. It looks different in every place—and that’s the point. One-size-fits-all approaches don’t work for systems grounded in relationships and context.</li><li><strong>The role of Web3 is still being defined</strong>. There's growing clarity that blockchain should be part of the infrastructure—but not the focus. Making tools usable and accessible matters more than the tech itself.</li><li><strong>Funding is still a bottleneck</strong>. Many projects are overly reliant on grants. If this space is going to grow, sustainable business models will need to be part of the equation.</li><li><strong>Real-world stories matter</strong>. From legal personhood for rivers to sensor-driven forest data, what resonates most are the grounded, specific examples that show what regeneration looks like in action.</li><li><strong>Language shapes how we think</strong>. Whether it’s shifting away from extractive metaphors or using simpler, clearer ways to explain complex ideas, communication remains one of ReFi’s most powerful tools.</li></ul><p>🎧 <strong>Tune in to the Bonus Episode:</strong></p><ul><li><a href="https://open.spotify.com/episode/01ixB0WVkj9MdZQexju5EB" rel="noreferrer">Spotify</a></li><li><a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refi-podcast/id1609683147?i=1000703476929" rel="noreferrer">Apple</a></li><li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=guNCjyPGmvU" rel="noreferrer">YouTube</a></li><li><a href="https://pods.media/refi-podcast/reflecting-on-regeneration-nexus-with-tereza-bizkova-and-maya-dentzel-s4-bonus" rel="noreferrer">Pods.media</a></li></ul><p><strong>🌐 Looking Back at the Nexus</strong></p><p>This bonus episode is also the final one of <em>The Regeneration Nexus</em>. It’s been almost a year since we took on the mandate for the season, and we have learned so much along the way. <strong>We are so grateful for all the challenges, lessons, and growth </strong>and also incredibly thankful to everyone who listened, shared the episodes, reached out with feedback—or supported in any other way (including but not limited to 😊) John, Monty, Drew, Cash, and all our amazing guests. </p><p>Hosting this season has meant a lot to us, and we hope the content was useful and interesting or that it sparked something for you. And perhaps—if that’s not too naive of us—you’ll be coming back to it in the months or years to come.</p><p><strong>Thanks so much for being part of it. </strong>We would love to stay in touch, so feel free to follow us both on socials (<a href="https://x.com/TerezaBizkova" rel="noreferrer">Tereza</a> &amp; <a href="https://x.com/mayazdentzel" rel="noreferrer">Maya</a>).<strong> 🙌</strong></p><p><strong>💜 Support Our Work</strong></p><p>The ReFi Podcast is participating in the&nbsp;<strong>Gitcoin Regen Coordination Round</strong>, and your support helps us keep producing these important conversations and sharing them with the world.</p><p>🟡 Donate with Celo <a href="https://explorer.gitcoin.co/#/round/42220/31/28" rel="noreferrer">on Gitcoin</a>.<br>💳 Prefer fiat? You can contribute via PayPal <a href="https://qf.normie.tech/regen-global/28" rel="noreferrer">here</a>.</p><p>Please share your thoughts and feedback, and if you've found value in our efforts, consider supporting us with <a href="https://podfollow.com/refi-podcast/view" rel="noreferrer">a five-star review on your favorite podcast platform</a>. </p><p>Every bit of encouragement helps us expand our reach and deepen the impact of ReFi Podcast. <strong>You can also </strong><a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/refipodcast" rel="noreferrer"><strong>buy us a coffee</strong></a><strong> or support our work directly </strong><a href="https://giveth.io/project/refi-podcast-season-4-the-regeneration-nexus" rel="noreferrer"><strong>on Giveth</strong></a><strong>. </strong></p><p><strong>Thank you again for all your support! </strong></p>

I hope you touched some trees during the weekend.&nbsp;Here's a recap of key happenings last week in the ReFi space, including the regen alphas you missed 👇</em></p><h2 id="%F0%9F%93%B0-the-great-reset">📰 The Great Reset</h2><p>The ReFi movement may need to rethink its fundamental assumption that individuals and small businesses are willing to heavily finance climate impact initiatives. Recent surveys suggest the public believes governments and big businesses bear the primary responsibility for climate action, which poses a challenge to ReFi's reliance on "non-traditional" capital sources. item.title: Prosperity Pass: ReFi DAO’s New Era of Onchain Reputation & Rewards — Claim Yours Today!
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <p>A new era of regenerative onchain identity is here 🆔</p><p>Now live in beta at<a href="https://pass.celopg.eco"> <u>pass.celopg.eco</u></a>, <strong>Prosperity Pass</strong> is a powerful&nbsp;new system for recognizing, rewarding, and coordinating builders, organizers, and aligned community members across the ReFi and Celo ecosystem. As part of this, we’re proud to launch the <strong>ReFi DAO Badge</strong>, a system to track meaningful engagement and participation across years of involvement in ReFi DAO.</p><p>Our aim is for this system to become the new foundation for <strong>regenerative identity</strong>. A place where your contributions become credentials. And where your earned reputation unlocks real opportunities across the ecosystem.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/image.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1200" height="675" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/08/image.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/08/image.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/image.png 1200w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%8C%90-why-prosperity-pass-matters">🌐 Why Prosperity Pass Matters</h2><p>Since the very beginning of ReFi DAO, we’ve held a clear vision to build systems and tools that can recognize and reward the regenerators — from restoring forests and building local economies, to cultivating healthy online communities and contributing to regenerative cryptoeconomics. We need both to regenerate our living ecosystems <u>and</u> the Web3 ecosystems we’re building on.</p><blockquote><em>What if your regenerative actions across the ReFi ecosystem could help form your sovereign onchain identity?</em></blockquote><p>We dreamed of a system that could see the full depth of someone’s contribution — not just one wallet or one behaviour, but a <strong>rich, multidimensional identity</strong> made up of participation, alignment, consistency, and care.</p><p>Over the past few years, we’ve sketched this vision countless times. From early whiteboard wireframes to concept decks shared in community calls, the idea persisted.👇 <em>Some of those early mockups over the years…</em></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="658" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups1.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups2.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="666" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups2.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups2.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups2.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2025/08/ReFi-Passport-Mockups2.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><p>Now, that vision is now taking real shape with the launch of Prosperity Pass.</p><p>Developed by Kolektivo Labs, and powered by the Safe smart account stack on Celo, Prosperity Pass is more than just a wallet. It’s a way to bring together your onchain activity, reputation, and community participation into one evolving account. Prosperity Pass lets you:</p><ul><li><strong>Link multiple wallets</strong> into a single account</li><li><strong>Earn badges</strong> based on community involvement and relevant onchain activity</li><li><strong>Level up</strong> your reputation across the ecosystem</li><li><strong>Unlock meaningful rewards, governance access, and visibility</strong></li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/Prosperity-Pass-leaderboard.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1990" height="838" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/08/Prosperity-Pass-leaderboard.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/08/Prosperity-Pass-leaderboard.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/08/Prosperity-Pass-leaderboard.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/Prosperity-Pass-leaderboard.png 1990w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>For ReFi DAO, this is a dream years in the making. And with the <strong>ReFi DAO Badge</strong>, whether you’ve written a blog post for our blog, were part of foundational programs like Founders Circles or the Local Node Incubator, contributed to us in a past grant round — these contributions will now be recognized and rewarded onchain. Your ReFi DAO Badge will continue to level up as you earn Contribution Points for your involvement in the network — and this badge will be a critical credential for future governance, funding, and recognition, both within ReFi DAO and in the broader ecosystem.</p><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%9F%A1-celo-seasonal-rewards-are-coming-%E2%80%93-are-you-eligible">🟡 Celo Seasonal Rewards Are Coming – Are You Eligible?</h2><p>As Celo transitioned to an L2, it has adopted a new <a href="https://forum.celo.org/t/celo-governance-seasons-a-conversation-about-governance-evolution-ahead-of-cel2-migration/10055" rel="noreferrer"><strong>seasonal governance model</strong></a>. Now, with the launch of Prosperity Pass, the CeloPG team is pioneering a new way of distributing rewards: one rooted in real contribution, onchain identity, and aligned participation.</p><p><strong>Season 0</strong> (Jan–June 2025) has just concluded — and Prosperity Pass is the gateway to recognition.</p><ul><li><strong>125,000 CELO</strong> will be distributed this August to Prosperity Pass holders based on their past ecosystem contributions and active involvement during Season 0 (account level and badges earned)</li><li><strong>All 600 wallet addresses</strong> already recognized by the ReFi DAO Contribution Points system are eligible to claim a badge and receive rewards.</li><li><strong>Visit</strong><a href="https://pass.celopg.eco/"><strong> <u>pass.celopg.eco</u></strong></a><strong> today</strong> to create your account, link your wallets, and claim your impact. </li></ul><p>And this is just the beginning. <strong>Celo Season 1</strong> has now officially kicked off, with a <a href="https://forum.celo.org/t/celo-governance-season-1-intent/11573"><u>new intent</u></a> to grow meaningful onchain activity and deepen capital participation across the ecosystem. As part of this, CeloPG aims to continue using Prosperity Pass as a core tool for recognizing contributions, guiding rewards, and aligning the community around shared goals. Those who show up early will be best positioned to benefit from the next wave of coordination and incentives. And there is more 👇</p><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%AA%82-airdrops-the-future-of-the-refi-token">🪂 Airdrops &amp; The Future of the $ReFi Token</h2><p>Unlike past airdrop cycles driven by speculation and sybil games, Prosperity Pass unlocks a new paradigm for trusted airdrops:</p><ul><li><strong>Identity &amp; Sybil Resistance</strong> via verified wallets, Self ID, and multi-wallet linking</li><li><strong>Reputation-Based Allocation</strong> using badges and Contribution Points</li><li><strong>Ongoing Rewards</strong> through seasonal systems like CeloPG and future ReFi DAO incentives</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/image-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/08/image-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/08/image-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/08/image-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/image-1.png 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p>As ReFi DAO looks ahead to support the launch of <strong>$ReFi token</strong>, Prosperity Pass is set to play a foundational role in community allocations and governance dynamics. Furthermore, holding a high-level ReFi DAO Badge won't just look good — it will unlock real utility:</p><ul><li>Greater <strong>access to funding and resources</strong></li><li>Increased <strong>voting weight in ReFi DAO governance</strong> (e.g., via ReFi DAO Gardens)</li><li>Priority in future <strong>collaborations, bounties, and contributor roles</strong></li></ul><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%A7%AD-how-to-earn-refi-dao-points-and-level-up-your-badge">🧭 How to Earn ReFi DAO Points (and Level Up Your Badge)</h2><p>The <strong>ReFi DAO Contribution Points System</strong> is how we recognize and celebrate the diverse ways our community contributes to building a regenerative future — whether that’s through showing up, stewarding, donating, creating, or coordinating. Each action you take adds points to your record, helping you <strong>level up your ReFi DAO Badge</strong> in Prosperity Pass and unlock greater rewards, recognition, and governance access.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/08/ReFi-DAO-Reputation---Contribution-Points-1.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1119" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/08/ReFi-DAO-Reputation---Contribution-Points-1.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/08/ReFi-DAO-Reputation---Contribution-Points-1.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/08/ReFi-DAO-Reputation---Contribution-Points-1.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2025/08/ReFi-DAO-Reputation---Contribution-Points-1.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><h3 id="%F0%9F%8C%B1-new-here-want-to-start-earning-points">🌱 New Here? Want to Start Earning Points?</h3><p>Whether you’re just discovering ReFi or want to go deeper, there are many meaningful ways to begin earning Contribution Points and get involved in ReFi DAO’s mission. Explore the new <a href="https://www.regencoordination.xyz/refidao"><strong><u>ReFi DAO Resources Hub</u></strong></a> to:</p><ul><li>🌐 Learn about regenerative finance and the ReFi DAO community</li><li>🤝 Join the network as a contributor or Local Node lead</li><li>💰 Apply for funding and launching initiatives within the DAO</li></ul><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regencoordination.xyz/refidao" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Explore ReFi DAO Resources Hub</a></div><p>Every step forward counts — and now, it can be recognized onchain.</p><h3 id="%F0%9F%8C%9F-already-contributed-you-might-have-points-waiting">🌟 Already Contributed? You Might Have Points Waiting...</h3><p>Nearly <strong>600 wallets</strong> have already been recognized — but so far, only a fraction have currently claimed their badge in Prosperity Pass!</p><p>If you’ve participated in any of the following, you should already have Contribution Points ready to claim:</p><ul><li>Participated in <strong>Founders Circles</strong> or the <strong>Local Node Cohorts</strong></li><li>Contributed to the <strong>ReFi DAO Blog</strong>, <strong>Podcast</strong>, or <strong>Newsletter</strong></li><li>Donated to ReFi DAO through <strong>Gitcoin</strong> or <strong>Giveth</strong></li><li>Served ReFi DAO Global as a <strong>Core Contributor, Advisor, or Steward</strong></li><li>Collecting <strong>POAPs at ReFi DAO events</strong>, onboarding others, sharing resources, or spreading the ReFi movement</li></ul><p>For full details on points allocations and how the system works, click below for the full documentation 👇</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regencoordination.xyz/refi-dao-reputation-contribution-points" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">ReFi DAO Reputation &amp; Contribution Points Documentation</a></div><p>🛠️ <strong>Missing a contribution? </strong>If you believe something is missing or misattributed, please reach out to one of the ReFi DAO's Core Stewards or post in this <a href="https://hub.regencoordination.xyz/t/refi-dao-contribution-points" rel="noreferrer"><u>section of the Regen Coordination Forum</u></a>. We’re actively improving the system and welcome community input to ensure accuracy and fairness.</p><hr><h2 id="%F0%9F%92%A1-what%E2%80%99s-next">💡 What’s Next?</h2><p>Here’s how you can get involved right now:</p><p>✅ <strong>Visit</strong><a href="https://pass.celopg.eco"> <u>pass.celopg.eco</u></a> and connect your wallet<br>🎨 <strong>Create your Prosperity Pass</strong> account<br>🏅 <strong>Claim your badges</strong> (especially the ReFi DAO Badge!)<br>📈 <strong>Level up</strong> to maximize your rewards<br>🌿 <strong>Share your profile</strong> and help others get onboarded</p><blockquote><em>💬 <strong>NOTE:</strong> This is still a <strong>Beta release</strong> — if you encounter any bugs or issues, please share them in the dedicated channel within the</em><a href="https://t.me/+FNIxL3D4UUE1ZGZk"><em> <u>CeloPG Community Telegram group</u></em></a><em>. Your feedback will help strengthen the next version of Prosperity Pass.</em></blockquote><p>We’re just scratching the surface of what this new identity and coordination infrastructure can do — let’s co-create this future together.</p>
