item.title: Introducing Localism Fund: Building Place-Based Power with Ethereum
item.dc:creator: Monty Merlin Bryant
item.content:encoded: <h2 id="tldr">TL;DR</h2><p>The <strong>Localism Fund</strong> has officially launched — with <strong>$155,000 in funding</strong> to empower local hubs, networks, and place-based groups around the world.</p><p>Two major opportunities are now open:</p><ul><li>🌿 <strong>Local Grant Programs | Round 01</strong> — Apply for funding to design and run a local funding program rooted in political, economic, cultural, or ecological localism. Matching Pool: $125,000 USD. <br>Apply now → <a href="https://www.localism.fund/round-01">localism.fund/round-01</a><br></li><li>🕸️ <strong>Localism Fund Expert Network</strong> — Join as a peer-validated expert in grant-making, Web3 tooling, or localism. Contribute as an evaluator, mentor, or tooling feedback advisor. Compensation pool: $5,500 USD + 10,000 CELO<br>Apply now → <a href="https://www.localism.fund/expert-network">localism.fund/expert-network</a><br></li></ul><blockquote>Read on to explore how the Localism Fund works, the partners behind it, and how you can help shape the future of <strong>Ethereum-powered local coordination</strong>. 🌱</blockquote><h2 id="ethereum-for-what">Ethereum for what?</h2><p>For all its promise, Web3 has often concentrated energy in speculative cycles and abstract narratives. Meanwhile, the world’s most urgent challenges—democratic fragility, brittle local economies, cultural erosion, and ecological decline—are experienced locally. Global tools alone don’t create legitimacy or lasting adoption; <strong>grounded</strong> <strong>relationships, institutions, and practice in place do</strong>.</p><p>If Ethereum is to matter beyond crypto-native circles, it must <strong>serve</strong> <strong>real communities</strong> as reliable infrastructure for coordination, not just capital. That requires working with the grain of local life—supporting those already stewarding trust, knowledge, and care on the ground.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Ethereum-Localism-Comics.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1005" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/Ethereum-Localism-Comics.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/10/Ethereum-Localism-Comics.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/10/Ethereum-Localism-Comics.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Ethereum-Localism-Comics.png 2166w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="introducing-localism-fund">Introducing Localism Fund </h1><p><strong>Localism Fund exists to support credible local networks and place-based groups</strong> to nurture political, economic, cultural, and ecological localism, while demonstrating Ethereum as foundational infrastructure for that work. We provide grants, guidance, and hands-on support that help local hubs translate global tools and knowledge into practical, locally rooted outcomes.</p><p>We aim to:</p><ul><li><strong>Strengthen communities &amp; economies</strong> by integrating Ethereum tools into local coordination, governance, and resource flows.</li><li><strong>Advance Ethereum adoption &amp; legitimacy</strong> through credible, non-speculative use cases and measurable on-chain activity.</li><li><strong>Catalyze tangible local impact</strong> across political, economic, cultural, and ecological dimensions.</li><li><strong>Build open knowledge commons</strong> so successful models can be adapted and scaled.</li><li><strong>Weave a global-local network</strong> that connects diverse hubs into a coherent movement for Ethereum Localism.</li></ul><h2 id="why-localism">Why Localism?</h2><p><strong>Localism</strong> is the belief and practice that decision-making, governance, and economic activity should be <strong>rooted in local communities</strong>, not distant authorities. It values <strong>place-based solutions</strong>, where those closest to an issue are best positioned to solve it.</p><ul><li><strong>Political Localism:</strong> decentralizing authority; assemblies, participatory budgeting, municipal innovation.</li><li><strong>Economic Localism:</strong> local ownership &amp; value circulation—co-ops, community currencies, CSAs.</li><li><strong>Cultural Localism:</strong> identity, heritage, bioregional stories and practices as foundations of resilience.</li><li><strong>Ecological Localism:</strong> stewardship, shorter supply chains, watershed/bioresource governance.</li><li><strong>Ethereum Localism</strong>: Ethereum-based infrastructure and tools —payments, identity/attestations, governance, open data—to empower local coordination without extracting.</li></ul><h2 id="how">How?</h2><p>Localism Fund is running <strong>thematic grant funding rounds</strong> focused on locally rooted adoption and impact. Funding flows to <strong>local hubs</strong>—organizations, chapters, coalitions, or bioregional nodes—that then operate <strong>their own local funding processes</strong>. Hubs decide priorities, select projects, disburse funds, and report outcomes.</p><ul><li><strong>Subsidiarity:</strong> decisions sit at the most local competent level.</li><li><strong>Matching + Mentorship:</strong> we add matching funds, expert evaluation, and operational support.</li><li><strong>Attest &amp; Learn:</strong> hubs publish impact via on-chain attestations and open reports; learnings roll up to improve future rounds.</li></ul><p>This lets global partners achieve strategic goals (e.g., Ethereum adoption, regeneration) <strong>without overriding local context</strong>.</p><ul><li><strong>Downward flows:</strong> capital, tooling, frameworks, and mentorship move from domain → fund → networks → local hubs → local activities.</li><li><strong>Upward flows:</strong> attestations, metrics, and stories flow back up, informing future rounds and increasing alignment.</li><li><strong>Outcome:</strong> a polycentric, learning system where effective strategies replicate and credible hubs attract more resources.</li></ul><h2 id="partners-roles">Partners &amp; Roles</h2><p>Embodying a networked and collabrative approach, Localism Fund is co-stewarded and co-funded by aligned partners:</p><ul><li><strong>Stewardship:</strong> <em>OpenCivics</em> (civic innovation &amp; ops), <em>Regen Coordination</em> (regenerative finance, localism strategy, network weaving).</li><li><strong>Current Funders:</strong> <em>Gitcoin</em>, <em>Celo Public Goods</em>, <em>Ma Earth</em>, <em>Ethereum Foundation / Ethereum Everywhere</em>.</li><li><strong>Technical:</strong> <em>Karma GAP</em> (applications &amp; milestones), <em>TrustGraph</em> (peer attestation &amp; reputation).</li><li><strong>Development:</strong> <em>Ethereum For The World</em> (ecosystem expansion).</li></ul><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-wide"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Partners.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="499" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Partners.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Partners.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Partners.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Partners.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 1200px) 1200px"></figure><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Round-01---Local-Grant-Programs.webp" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="516" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Round-01---Local-Grant-Programs.webp 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Round-01---Local-Grant-Programs.webp 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Round-01---Local-Grant-Programs.webp 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Localism-Fund-Round-01---Local-Grant-Programs.webp 2048w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h1 id="round-01-local-grant-programs"><strong>Round 01 | Local Grant Programs</strong></h1><h1 id="live-now">(Live Now!)</h1><p><strong>Local Grant Programs</strong> is the first funding round of the Localism Fund. Through this round, we’re funding locally-led grant programs — not just single projects — that bring Ethereum tools and values into the heart of communities to coordinate resources, governance, and regeneration on the ground.</p><p>Our aim is empower local hubs to <strong>design and operate grant programs</strong> that strengthen political, economic, cultural, and ecological localism—<strong>while piloting Ethereum tools in practice</strong>.</p><ul><li><strong>Applications:</strong> Open now!</li><li><strong>Matching Pool:</strong> $125K</li><li><strong>Grant Range</strong>: $5,000 – $20,000 per local program (matching basis)</li><li><strong>Who should apply:</strong> local programs ready to launch late 2025 / early 2026</li><li><strong>Learn more:</strong> <a href="https://localism.fund/round-01" rel="noreferrer">localism.fund/round-01</a></li></ul><h2 id="the-localism-fund-expert-network"><strong>The Localism Fund Expert Network</strong></h2><p>To ensure that funding decisions and learning processes are credible, contextual, and regenerative, we are seeding the <strong>Localism Fund Expert Network</strong> – a peer-attested network of trusted practitioners advancing the intersection of localism and Ethereum coordination.</p><p>In many funding systems, evaluators operate behind closed doors — detached from communities and tools they assess. The Expert Network aims to flip that model by grounding evaluation in <strong>peer validation and transparent reputation</strong>.</p><p>Each expert brings practical experience from at least one of three key domains:</p><ol><li><strong>Grant-making</strong> — designing, managing, or evaluating funding programs across Web3, philanthropy, civic, or public sectors.</li><li><strong>Web3 / Ethereum Tooling</strong> — proficiency with Ethereum-based tools for coordination, funding, governance, or identity.</li><li><strong>Localism</strong> — leading or advising initiatives that advance political, economic, cultural, ecological, or Ethereum localism.</li></ol><h3 id="why-it-matters">Why It Matters</h3><p>Funding credible local programs requires local understanding, ethical awareness, and technical fluency. Rather than outsourcing this expertise, the Expert Network builds it as a living, community-governed trust layer — ensuring evaluation, mentorship, and learning flow through peer relationships, not bureaucracy.</p><p>Experts contribute by:</p><ul><li><strong>Evaluating applications</strong> for Local Grant Programs using a shared rubric.</li><li><strong>Mentoring local hubs</strong>, helping them design, operate, and measure community-led programs.</li><li><strong>Providing feedback</strong> to improve the Web3 tools (like Karma GAP, Gardens, and Prosperity Pass) that power these rounds.</li></ul><p>Participation is flexible — from light-touch review to deeper mentorship — and experts are compensated according to their contribution tier (ranging <strong>$200–$1,200 USD + CELO rewards + onchain badges</strong>).</p><h3 id="a-new-way-to-build-trust">A New Way to Build Trust</h3><p>At the core of enabling this new network will be <a href="https://trustgraph.network"><strong>TrustGraph</strong></a> — a newly launched attestation protocol that enables communities to build transparent webs of trust and expertise.</p><p>Rather than relying on centralized credentials, <strong>TrustGraph lets experts vouch for one another</strong> through attestations. As these peer attestations accumulate, each member’s <strong>TrustScore</strong> grows dynamically using a PageRank-style algorithm powered by <a href="https://wavs.xyz" rel="noreferrer">WAVS</a>. TrustGraph continuously recalculates scores as new attestations flow, creating a <strong>living, adaptive reputation system</strong> that evolves with real collaboration and contribution.</p><p>You can learn more at <a href="https://trustgraph.network">trustgraph.network</a> or follow updates via <a href="https://x.com/TrustGraphNetwork">@TrustGraphNetwork</a>.</p><hr><h2 id="the-vision-call-to-action"><strong>The Vision &amp; Call to Action</strong></h2><p>Over time, Localism Fund aims to grow into a <strong>polycentric funding network </strong>with global resources and local wisdom flowing in harmony. Each round strengthens a growing ecosystem of local hubs, expert networks, and open-source tools that enable communities to coordinate, govern, and regenerate their place. </p><p>And with the Localism Fund now live we’re calling on builders, funders, and community organizers to join us in growing this experiment. </p><p><strong>For local hubs:</strong> Apply to <strong>Local Grant Programs | Round 01</strong> and pilot your own community-led funding round that connects local needs with Ethereum coordination. Apply now → <a href="https://www.localism.fund/round-01">localism.fund/round-01</a></p><p><strong>For experts:</strong> Join the <strong>Localism Fund Expert Network</strong>, help evaluate and mentor local hubs, and earn recognition for your contribution to the movement. Apply now → <a href="https://www.localism.fund/expert-network">localism.fund/expert-network</a></p><p><strong>For partners &amp; allies:</strong> Collaborate with us to launch new localism-aligned rounds and extend this polycentric funding architecture to more regions and ecosystems.</p><p>Let’s build the future of <strong>Ethereum Localism</strong> together 🌱</p><p>💬 Join our community: <a href="https://t.me/localismfund">t.me/localismfund</a></p><p>✉️ Contact: <a href="mailto:support@localism.fund?subject=Hi" rel="noreferrer">support@localism.fund</a></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-width-full"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Pixelart-Comic-Cover-Apr-14-2025--7-.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1536" height="1024" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/Pixelart-Comic-Cover-Apr-14-2025--7-.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/10/Pixelart-Comic-Cover-Apr-14-2025--7-.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/10/Pixelart-Comic-Cover-Apr-14-2025--7-.png 1536w"></figure>

item.title: Bread Cooperative <> Regen Coordination: Celebrating Evolution and Alignment
item.dc:creator: luizfernando ✨
item.content:encoded: <p>We're excited to announce that <strong>Regen Coordination is joining the Bread Solidarity Fund</strong> — transitioning from <a href="https://x.com/ReFiDAOist/status/1872678104541385021" rel="noreferrer">ReFi DAO's membership</a> that began earlier this year.</p><hr><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/11/Bread-Coop.jpeg" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="1500" height="500" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/11/Bread-Coop.jpeg 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/11/Bread-Coop.jpeg 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/11/Bread-Coop.jpeg 1500w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><h2 id="what-is-bread-cooperative">What is Bread Cooperative?</h2><p><strong>Bread Cooperative</strong> is the evolution (not a pivot) from Breadchain — a worker collective building solidarity tools more accessible to broader communities — from the <a href="https://bread.coop/solidarity-fund" rel="noreferrer">Bread Solidarity Fund</a> (previous named Bread Crowdstaking) to upcoming tools like <strong>Bread Stacks</strong> (collective savings) and <strong>Bread Safety Net</strong> (community insurance).&nbsp;</p><p>Bread Coop is grounded in four key principles: </p><ul><li><em><strong>Dual Power</strong> </em>— Building parallel tech institutions from the grassroots;</li><li><em><strong>Economic Democracy</strong> </em>— Striving for democratically allocated resources rather than market-driven ones;</li><li><em><strong>Mutual Aid</strong> </em>— Communal solidarity through reciprocal exchange for mutual benefit;</li><li><strong><em>Transparent Governance </em></strong>— Everyone should have a say, with power holders held accountable.</li></ul><p>Through the <strong>Bread</strong> <strong>Solidarity Fund</strong>, real funding is channeled for member projects every month — now including Regen Coordination! The fund works by turning passive crypto yields into active community funding, providing continuous support through community-directed yield distribution.</p><p>With over $40,000 distributed to member projects and a growing community united by solidarity, Bread Cooperative is demonstrating what a worker-owned future can look like.</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="http://bread.coop" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Visit Bread.Coop</a></div><hr><h2 id="why-this-transition-why-now">Why This Transition, Why Now?</h2><p>ReFi DAO joined Breadchain as a member project at the beginning of 2025 - while this connection has been fruitful, we saw that transitioning the membership to Regen Coordination unlocks even greater potential for interconnecting networks, communities, and movements.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card"><img src="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/2025/11/banner.png" class="kg-image" alt="" loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1000" srcset="__GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w600/2025/11/banner.png 600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1000/2025/11/banner.png 1000w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w1600/2025/11/banner.png 1600w, __GHOST_URL__/content/images/size/w2400/2025/11/banner.png 2400w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"></figure><p><strong>Regen Coordination</strong> is a values-aligned alliance of Web3-enabled communities working together to drive <em>ecological, social, and economic regeneration</em>.&nbsp;Founded by ReFi DAO and Greenpill Network with support from Celo Public Goods and Gitcoin, Regen Coordination weaves together local and global networks to create shared infrastructure, coordinate funding rounds, and advance collective impact.&nbsp;</p><div class="kg-card kg-button-card kg-align-center"><a href="https://www.regencoordination.xyz/" class="kg-btn kg-btn-accent">Visit RegenCoordination.xyz</a></div><p>This transition brings Bread Coop closer to Regen Coordination's constellation of local and global networks - including ReFi Nodes, Greenpill Chapters, BioFi Hubs, and more - supporting the creation &amp; adoption of novel (regenerative) financial systems by local place-based communities, going beyond the historical disconnection of crypto from real/local economies and values.</p><p>In a time when public goods funding is ever more scarce, and crypto is increasingly co-opted into tech-fascism — it becomes necessary for aligned movements to articulate alternative visions, exercise solidarity, and build more resilient communities.</p><hr><h2 id="how-to-engage">How to Engage</h2><p><strong>$BREAD</strong> is the cooperative funding mechanism where pooled stablecoin collateral (1:1 USD peg) generates yield that is distributed between member projects of the <a href="https://bread.coop/solidarity-fund"><strong><u>Bread Solidarity Fund Network</u></strong></a>. When you bake (mint) $BREAD, you can vote on which member organizations should receive more yield.</p><p>And now Regen Coordination is a member project of the Bread Solidarity Fund Network!</p><ol><li>Visit <a href="http://bread.coop"><u>bread.coop</u></a> and click "<a href="https://app.breadchain.xyz/"><u>Visit app</u></a>"</li><li>Connect your wallet and deposit stablecoins (xDAI on Gnosis Chain) to bake $BREAD 🍞</li><li>Vote every month on which member projects receive the yield through the <a href="https://app.breadchain.xyz/governance"><strong><u>governance portal</u></strong></a></li></ol><p>Since launch, the Solidarity Fund has distributed over $40,000 toward projects—demonstrating we can channel crypto's potential toward mutual aid and collective well-being.</p><hr><h2 id="looking-ahead-solidarity-forever">Looking Ahead: Solidarity Forever</h2><p>This alignment between Bread Cooperative and Regen Coordination signals something larger — a growing movement of networks choosing cooperation over competition, regeneration over extraction, and solidarity over individualism.</p><p>As we move forward, expect to see <strong>more cross-network collaboration</strong> between Bread Coop and Regen Coordination's allied communities.</p><p>Stay tuned for more alignment between networks and movements. In the meantime, we invite you to explore Bread Cooperative's tools, join the conversation in Regen Coordination's forum, and participate in building the regenerative, cooperative future we know is possible.</p><p><em>Solidarity forever.</em> 🍞💚 ✨</p><hr><p><em>P.S. Bread Cooperative is hosting a free online workshop this Thursday (Nov 6) called ‘</em><a href="https://dandelion.events/e/breadcoop"><em><u>Beyond the Bank: Financial Tools for Democratic Organizations</u></em></a><em>’.
